title: Đề 09 - The Arrival of the Four-Day Work Week

questions.prompt: The Arrival of the Four-Day Work Week
options: A way of life now out of date
An unfair plan for some people
Businesses preparing for a new policy
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. "A way of life now out of date" → Henry Ford cắt từ 48 xuống 40 giờ tạo ra tuần 5 ngày, nhưng "what once looked progressive is no longer the norm for 21st-century workers" — nếp cũ đã lỗi thời.
2. "Benefits for employees" → cả đoạn là lợi ích cho nhân viên: "higher job satisfaction, lower stress", "balance work with personal life", chia sẻ việc chăm con.
3. "Undesirable financial consequences" → toàn số liệu tiền bạc của doanh nghiệp: "output falling by as much as 20%", "sharp rise in running costs", "pushes up spending on wages, training and supervision".
4. "Unforeseen challenges for employees" → những cái KHÔNG NGỜ xảy ra với chính người lao động: tưởng vui hơn nhưng "satisfaction settles back to where it started" (hedonic treadmill), rồi "working faster is how accidents happen", "more strained than they were on the old schedule". Không chọn "An unfair plan" vì đoạn này không so sánh nhóm nào được lợi hơn nhóm nào.
5. "Difficult to change old habits" → dù được nghỉ, người ta vẫn quay về nếp cũ: "some employees drifted back to the factory floor of their own accord", "others picked up a second job to fill the hours". Không chọn "Undesirable financial consequences" vì heading đó đã dùng cho đoạn 3 và đoạn 3 nói về tiền của doanh nghiệp, còn đây là thói quen của cá nhân.
6. "An unfair plan for some people" → nhân viên văn phòng được lợi còn "teachers gain nothing", bác sĩ y tá "how can doctors and nurses work any less?", lính cứu hoả vẫn phải trực; câu chốt "widening the gap between one kind of work and another" = bất công. Không chọn "Unforeseen challenges" vì đoạn này không nói về hậu quả bất ngờ, mà nói về ai được ai không.
7. "Alternative solutions worth considering" → đoạn liệt kê 3 cách khác thay cho tuần 4 ngày: "Raising basic pay", "Improving social welfare", "Adding more public holidays".
Nhiễu: "Businesses preparing for a new policy" — không đoạn nào nói doanh nghiệp đang chuẩn bị áp dụng chính sách; đoạn 3 chỉ nói doanh nghiệp bị tốn tiền.
👉 Mẹo: heading có "unfair" → tìm đoạn so sánh nhóm này được / nhóm kia không (đoạn 6). Heading có "challenges" → tìm đoạn nói hậu quả xấu xảy ra với chính người áp dụng (đoạn 4). Heading "old habits" → tìm hành động quay về cách cũ (đoạn 5).

--- GIẢI THÍCH ---

▸ University welcome day — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "The beginning of term for our new students is on Wednesday, 14th February." → câu cho sẵn, nêu ngày nhập học.

  3. “Her passion for space led Mae to join a dedicated research team.” → bắt đầu bằng đại từ “Her” — bắt buộc phải có câu giới thiệu đứng trước.

  5. “Some of these experiments involved growing plants and observing animals aboard the spacecraft.” → mở bằng “Some of these” — từ nối bám thẳng vào ý câu trước.

2. Đoạn liệt kê những cái lợi khiến thói quen này lan nhanh: so sánh chục người bán trong vài phút, xem số đo chính xác, giao tận nhà sau một hai ngày, mua bất kỳ giờ nào — vì sao thay đổi hấp dẫn đến vậy.
3. Đoạn nói người mua dựa vào đánh giá sao và bình luận của những khách lạ chưa từng gặp, tin họ hơn cả mô tả của người bán — để người lạ dẫn dắt lựa chọn của mình.
4. Đoạn nói khi thẻ đã lưu sẵn và chỉ cần chạm một cái là xong, khoảng dừng giữa lúc muốn và lúc trả tiền gần như biến mất, cộng thêm đồng hồ đếm ngược thúc giục — mua nhiều hơn dự định.
5. Đoạn nói chuyện trả hàng: khách đặt cùng một món ba cỡ rồi trả lại hai, chi phí xử lý và đóng gói lại rất tốn kém — cái giá của những kiện hàng không ai muốn.
6. Đoạn nói tác động không nằm trên hóa đơn: từng kiện hàng đi quãng đường xa hơn, dùng nhiều bìa carton và nhựa hơn, xe tải chạy đi chạy lại cùng một tuyến — thiệt hại khách không nhìn thấy.
7. Đoạn kết đưa lời khuyên: lập danh sách, chờ một ngày trước khi bấm đặt, đọc kỹ số đo — những cách đơn giản để giữ chừng mực.

questions.prompt: Put the sentences in the correct order.
options: These included football, swimming and jumping, and the children had lots of fun.
They were all hungry after all of this, so the children had tasty food and drinks with their parents.

questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
Dạng sắp xếp câu: tìm câu mở đầu (không trỏ ngược), rồi bám vào đại từ, từ chỉ định và từ nối để nối dần.

▸ Family sports day — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "Last weekend the weather was good, so the town held a family sports day in the park." → câu cho sẵn, giới thiệu sự kiện.
  1. "It started early on Saturday morning with a ten-mile race for adults." → "It" trỏ về "a family sports day".
  2. "Sixty men and women ran in this, and Ms Kamur won with a very fast time." → "ran in this" trỏ về "a ten-mile race".
  3. "After she had received her prize, the children's activities and competitions began." → "she" trỏ về Ms Kamur ở câu trước.
  4. "These included football, swimming and jumping, and the children had lots of fun." → "These" trỏ về "the children's activities and competitions".
  5. "They were all hungry after all of this, so the children had tasty food and drinks with their parents." → "after all of this" gom lại toàn bộ hoạt động, chốt bằng bữa ăn.

▸ Making films — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "In 1895, the Grand Café in France showed the first ever commercial film." → câu cho sẵn, nêu mốc thời gian và sự kiện đầu tiên.
  1. "Films from that period were very different from films of today." → "that period" trỏ thẳng về năm 1895 ở câu cho sẵn.
  2. "This is because they were all in black and white, and they had no sound." → "This is because" giải thích cho ý "very different" ở câu trước.
  3. "In addition to these technical limitations, the film producers also had a limited budget." → "these technical limitations" gom lại ý đen trắng và không có tiếng.
  4. "This lack of money mainly affected the actors, and they did not earn a lot of money." → "This lack of money" trỏ về "a limited budget".
  5. "Things have changed over time, and some of them now earn millions of dollars for appearing in films." → "some of them" trỏ về "the actors", chốt bằng tương phản quá khứ với hiện tại.

questions.prompt: Here is the perspective of four people on the above topic. Please read the content and answer the question.
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. "enjoyed the last day of the festival" → Nadia: "The last day was special. All my favorite bands and singers performed and joined up onstage."
2. "liked all the music at the festival" → Alek: "I like different genres. This festival didn’t disappoint me. We sang along and danced." (Nadia không chọn vì ngày đầu "the music didn't appeal to me"; Cora thấy "The music was uninspiring".)
3. "thought the venue wasn't good" → Farhan: "However, the venue wasn’t located in the center and there wasn’t convenient transportation around." (Cora không chọn vì cô nói "The venue was nice".)
4. "was disappointed with the festival" → Cora: "I had high expectations this time"… đồ ăn toàn fast food, đông đúc, nhạc nhạt, và "I won’t go there next time." (Alek không chọn vì "This festival didn’t disappoint me".)
5. "didn't like the rain" → Nadia: "I didn't like getting wet all the time... Some sunshine would have been nice." (Alek vẫn vui "despite the constant rain".)
6. "thought the tickets were expensive" → Alek: "Not many young people can afford the tickets."
7. "enjoyed meeting old friends" → Farhan: "We caught up with some ex-band members. We had a really good time together despite the little money we earned." (Nadia chỉ "met some new people" — người mới, không phải bạn cũ.)

title: Đề 14 - Volunteering to clean a local park

questions.prompt: Here is the perspective of four people on the above topic. Please read the content and answer the question.
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói "we should clean this park regularly about once a month" — việc dọn dẹp cần làm đều đặn, định kỳ.
2. Chọn A vì đoạn A nói "I'm a very busy person and I have to spend this weekend with my family" — không tham gia được vì quá bận.
3. Chọn A vì đoạn A nói "students and schools also have days off on weekends" và cho rằng học sinh, sinh viên nên là người đi làm tình nguyện. Đây là ý nói việc tình nguyện quan trọng với ĐỐI TƯỢNG học sinh, sinh viên.
4. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói "My son has a dream of becoming a biologist so I think cleaning up this park will be very helpful for my son" — nêu một nghề nghiệp tương lai cụ thể và việc tình nguyện giúp ích trực tiếp cho con đường đó.
   LƯU Ý PHÂN BIỆT với đoạn A: A cũng có cụm "students' future careers", nhưng A đang nói về ĐỐI TƯỢNG nên tham gia (học sinh, sinh viên) và đã ứng với câu 3. Câu 4 hỏi về lợi ích nghề nghiệp tương lai, và chỉ đoạn D nêu một nghề cụ thể. Khi hai đoạn cùng nhắc tới một từ khoá, hãy chọn đoạn nói CỤ THỂ hơn về đúng trọng tâm câu hỏi.
5. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói "I know my brother and his friend…" — sẽ nhờ người khác giúp thay mình.
6. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói các khu vực xung quanh cũng cần được dọn — không chỉ riêng công viên.
7. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói "I feel very lucky to have this park here… because of the natural landscape here" — công viên là nơi đẹp, thư giãn, khác hẳn thành phố bụi bặm.

questions.prompt: Here is the perspective of four people on the above topic. Please read the content and answer the question.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói "I'm old so I'm no longer interested in traveling to far away places. Instead, I want to lie on a comfortable sofa and watch my favorite TV show" — thích ở nhà hơn là đi xa.
2. Chọn A vì đoạn A nói "If the weather is nice then our plans go ahead as usual, if not, we will postpone that vacation" — chuyến đi phụ thuộc vào thời tiết đẹp.
3. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói "I don't understand why many people just like to sit still at the beach when traveling, I find that uninteresting and time-consuming" — cho rằng ngồi ở biển là nhàm chán.
4. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói "Next month's trip will be the first time I travel to another country. Normally I only travel to famous local places or in my country" — chưa từng ra nước ngoài.
5. Chọn A vì đoạn A nói "in the future I really want to try mountain climbing once" — muốn đi leo núi. Lưu ý phân biệt với đoạn B: B ĐÃ đi leo núi rồi và thấy đó là chuyến tệ nhất, không phải người đang muốn đi.
6. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói "Famous tourist destinations are the places I want to explore the most when traveling somewhere" — thích tham quan các điểm du lịch nổi tiếng.
7. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói "after that trip, I had a strong passion for walking. So now, every day I walk as a hobby" — đi bộ đã thành sở thích hằng ngày.

1. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn giải thích cách Nam Cực được điều hành tập thể theo Hiệp ước Nam Cực chứ không thuộc riêng quốc gia nào.
2. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn kể về lần đầu con người đặt chân lên Nam Cực và ý nghĩa lịch sử của sự kiện đó.
3. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn mô tả vị trí cực nam, sự xa xôi và vẻ bí ẩn của Nam Cực như “tận cùng thế giới”.
4. Heading: Cảnh quan ẩn dưới lớp băng Why this answer: Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn tập trung vào những gì nằm “beneath its surface”, như “vast mountain ranges, deep valleys, and even ancient lakes”, cho thấy Nam Cực có một thế giới ẩn dưới lớp băng. Vietnamese translation: Dù bị bao phủ bởi những lớp băng dày, Nam Cực lại có một cảnh quan đáng kinh ngạc và rất đa dạng ẩn dưới bề mặt. Nhờ radar xuyên đất và ảnh vệ tinh, các nhà khoa học đã phát hiện ra những dãy núi rộng lớn, những thung lũng sâu và thậm chí cả những hồ cổ bị chôn vùi dưới hàng kilômét băng. Những phát hiện này cho thấy Nam Cực từng là một môi trường rất khác trước đây. Việc nghiên cứu địa hình ẩn này giúp các nhà nghiên cứu hiểu rõ hơn về quá khứ địa chất của Trái Đất, cũng như cách biến đổi khí hậu có thể ảnh hưởng đến lớp băng của khu vực này trong tương lai.
5. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn kể lại cuộc cạnh tranh nổi tiếng giữa Amundsen và Scott để chạm tới Nam Cực trước tiên.
6. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nêu bật việc công nghệ hiện đại đã làm giảm đáng kể mức độ nặng nhọc khi di chuyển ở Nam Cực.
7. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn giải thích các nguyên nhân tự nhiên khiến Nam Cực trở thành nơi lạnh nhất Trái Đất.

options: He or she will ask for your name and your flat number, and then will write these down.

questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
Dạng sắp xếp câu: tìm câu mở đầu (không trỏ ngược), rồi bám vào đại từ, từ chỉ định và từ nối để nối dần.

▸ Key card — thứ tự đúng:
  1. “To enter the building and use the lift, you will need your key card.” → câu mở đầu: nêu chủ thể và bối cảnh, không trỏ ngược về câu nào.
  2. “If you lose this, you will need to see the staff member at the front desk.” → nối tiếp mạch nội dung của câu ngay trước.
  3. “He or she will ask for your name and your flat number, and then will write these down.” → bắt đầu bằng đại từ “He” — bắt buộc phải có câu giới thiệu đứng trước.
  4. “You will also need to show your identification card.” → nối tiếp mạch nội dung của câu ngay trước.
  5. “He or she will make a copy of it and give you a new key card.” → bắt đầu bằng đại từ “He” — bắt buộc phải có câu giới thiệu đứng trước.

▸ How Jay became an actor — thứ tự đúng:
  1. “When Jay was a child, his parents left their home country and took him to live in the United States.” → câu mở đầu: nêu chủ thể và bối cảnh, không trỏ ngược về câu nào.
  2. “He started studying at a school in that country, and in his free time, he did strength exercises.” → bắt đầu bằng đại từ “He” — bắt buộc phải có câu giới thiệu đứng trước.
  3. “Jay became very good at this and participated in several bodybuilding competitions.” → nối tiếp mạch nội dung của câu ngay trước.
  4. “At one of these events, an acting agent saw him and gave him a starring role.” → nối tiếp mạch nội dung của câu ngay trước.
  5. “It was a major action movie, and he gained fame from that film.” → bắt đầu bằng đại từ “It” — bắt buộc phải có câu giới thiệu đứng trước.

3. Chọn D vì đoạn D nói người này tham gia nhiều chương trình tình nguyện để lấy kinh nghiệm, việc đó giúp họ chọn hướng nghề nghiệp và mang lại nhiều bài học giá trị.
4. Chọn C vì đoạn C nói người này đã học hai năm ở đại học để trở thành thợ điện, nhưng sau đó biết có những khóa học ngắn hơn và hối tiếc vì không chọn lựa chọn đó.
5. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói mùa hè trước người này đã thực tập tại các trường địa phương và việc đó cực kỳ hữu ích cho sự nghiệp tương lai.
6. Chọn B vì đoạn B nói khi còn đi học, người này đã biết mình muốn trở thành giáo viên, nên không cần thử các công việc khác.

2. Đoạn nói các quy tắc bàn ăn học từ nhỏ, không ai giải thích cho khách: người lớn tuổi ngồi quay ra cửa và ăn trước, rót trà cho người bên cạnh trước khi rót cho mình, gõ hai ngón tay để cảm ơn — luật bất thành văn.
3. Đoạn nói bữa sáng thường mua chứ không nấu: hàng quán gần chợ và ga tàu bán bánh bao, cháo, quẩy cho người đi làm trước 8 giờ — bữa sáng mua trên đường đi làm.
4. Đoạn nói vài món được chọn vì ý nghĩa chứ không vì vị: mì dài tượng trưng trường thọ, cá nguyên con ngày Tết mang ý dư dả — món ăn chọn vì ý nghĩa tượng trưng.
5. Đoạn về trà: luôn có mặt trong mọi dịp, mời trà là cách đón khách, rót cho người lớn tuổi còn là lời xin lỗi — thức uống mang theo thông điệp.
6. Đoạn nói thói quen đổi nhanh ở thành phố lớn: dân văn phòng trẻ đặt đồ ăn qua app và ăn tại bàn làm việc thay vì về nhà — nếp sinh hoạt mới của người trẻ đi làm.
7. Đoạn nói về lượng đồ ăn bỏ lại sau tiệc, nhà hàng thống kê con số khổng lồ, thực khách được khuyến khích gọi ít và mang phần thừa về — nhìn lại chuyện lãng phí thức ăn.

Dạng sắp xếp câu: tìm câu mở đầu (không trỏ ngược), rồi bám vào đại từ, từ chỉ định và từ nối để nối dần.

▸ Healthy eating — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "Over the years, people's eating habits have changed a lot as they have become more aware of their health." → câu cho sẵn, nêu chủ đề thay đổi thói quen ăn uống.
  1. "In the past, meals were often filled with sugar and unhealthy fats." → mở bằng "In the past", mô tả vế quá khứ trước.
  2. "Limited access to fresh produce made healthy eating much more difficult years ago." → vẫn ở quá khứ ("years ago"), bổ sung khó khăn thứ hai.
  3. "Modern diets now focus on fresh, whole foods rather than processed ones." → "Modern... now" chuyển sang vế hiện tại.
  4. "Nutritionists today educate people on how to plan balanced and nutritious meals." → tiếp mạch hiện tại, thêm vai trò của chuyên gia.
  5. "Nowadays, mobile apps help people track calories and suggest healthy recipes to support a healthier lifestyle." → chốt bằng công nghệ, cùng mạch thời gian hiện tại.

▸ Wellness fair — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "Last weekend, the community organised a special event to inspire people to live healthier lives." → câu cho sẵn, giới thiệu sự kiện.
  1. "The wellness fair took place on Saturday afternoon, promoting healthy habits and lifestyles." → gọi tên sự kiện đã nhắc ở câu cho sẵn và cho mốc thời gian.
  2. "Over sixty participants joined the event, with Dr Patel leading an exciting fitness workshop." → "the event" trỏ về hội chợ, thêm số người và hoạt động đầu tiên.
  3. "The fair also featured activities such as cooking demonstrations, mindfulness sessions and a fun run." → "also" nối thêm hoạt động sau workshop.
  4. "After the workshops, prizes were given to those with the most creative health posters." → "After the workshops" nối tiếp ngay sau các workshop/hoạt động vừa nêu, kể phần trao giải.
  5. "Families had a great time sampling healthy snacks and learning useful tips about overall wellness." → câu kết: tổng kết cảm nhận chung của người tham dự về cả sự kiện.

questions.prompt: Put the sentences in the correct order.
options: In these performances, he liked to wear bright clothes and paint his face.
This strange way of dressing and his songs have attracted people's attention.
During this education, he learned to be creative and to practise singing on stage.
They started to follow him on social media, and now he is very popular.
Before becoming famous at this young age, he studied art and music at high school.
Before becoming famous, he studied music at school when he was 15.
His unique way of dressing and performing made him stand out from others.
This helped him receive many invitations for collaborations and performances.
He eventually became famous among audiences around the world.
He is a successful singer with many fans.
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
Dạng sắp xếp câu: tìm câu mở đầu (không trỏ ngược), rồi bám vào đại từ, từ chỉ định và từ nối để nối dần.

▸ A famous singer — câu cho sẵn: "Jade Nobelton was only 18 when he became a famous singer." Thứ tự 5 câu còn lại:
  1. "Before becoming famous at such a young age, he studied music in high school." → "at such a young age" trỏ về "only 18" ở câu cho sẵn; "Before becoming famous" mở phần quá khứ.
  2. "During his studies, he learnt how to be creative on stage." → "During his studies" bám vào "studied music in high school".
  3. "In his performances, he wore brightly coloured clothes and painted his face." → "his performances" nối "creative on stage".
  4. "This unique way of dressing and performing made people pay attention to him." → "This unique way of dressing" tổng kết câu 3.
  5. "Many people started following him on social media and he became a famous singer." → kết quả cuối, khép lại với "famous singer" ở câu cho sẵn.

▸ The famous singer — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "Jade Nobelton is only 18 years old, and he is a famous singer." → câu cho sẵn, giới thiệu nhân vật.
  1. "Before becoming famous at this young age, he studied art and music at high school." → "this young age" trỏ về "18 years old".
  2. "During this education, he learned to be creative and to practise singing on stage." → "this education" trỏ về việc học ở high school.
  3. "In these performances, he liked to wear bright clothes and paint his face." → "these performances" trỏ về "singing on stage".
  4. "This strange way of dressing and his songs have attracted people's attention." → "This strange way of dressing" trỏ về quần áo sặc sỡ và vẽ mặt.
  5. "They started to follow him on social media, and now he is very popular." → "They" trỏ về "people" ở câu trước, chốt bằng kết quả hiện tại.

▸ A famous singer (Version 2) — thứ tự đúng:
  1. "He is a successful singer with many fans." → câu mở đầu: tiêu đề đã nêu nhân vật nên vào bài dùng luôn "He".
  2. "Before becoming famous, he studied music at school when he was 15." → "Before becoming famous" quay về quá khứ.
  3. "His unique way of dressing and performing made him stand out from others." → "His" cần câu giới thiệu đứng trước.
  4. "This helped him receive many invitations for collaborations and performances." → "This helped him" trỏ ngược về việc nổi bật ở câu 3.
  5. "He eventually became famous among audiences around the world." → "eventually" chốt kết quả cuối cùng.
👉 Mẹo: câu mở đầu là câu duy nhất KHÔNG có đại từ/từ chỉ định trỏ ngược. Sau đó bám mỏ neo: "at his age → 18 years old", "During his studies → studied at school", "these performances → singing on stage".

questions.prompt: A Plant-Based Plate
options: A gradual shift rather than a strict rule
Not every option is a healthy one
The effect on a weekly budget
questions.explanation:
1. Đoạn mở đầu nói ăn chay không phải một luật cứng mà là sự chuyển dịch dần dần, có nhiều mức độ khác nhau — thay đổi từ từ chứ không phải quy tắc nghiêm ngặt.
2. Đoạn giải quyết nỗi lo đạm: đậu lăng, đậu gà, đậu phụ, hạt, bánh mì và cơm đều góp đạm, ăn đa dạng trong ngày là đủ — tìm nguyên liệu xây dựng cơ thể từ nguồn khác.
3. Đoạn chỉ ra vài chất cần để mắt: B12 hầu như chỉ có trong sản phẩm động vật nên phải bổ sung, sắt từ thực vật hấp thu kém hơn — những lỗ hổng cần theo dõi.
4. Đoạn cảnh báo bỏ thịt không tự động thành ăn lành mạnh: đồ chay đông lạnh và đồ ăn sẵn nhiều muối, nhiều dầu, sống bằng khoai chiên và bánh mì trắng cũng không tốt — không phải lựa chọn nào cũng lành mạnh.
5. Đoạn bàn chuyện tiền: đậu khô, rau theo mùa, yến mạch, đậu Hà Lan đông lạnh thuộc nhóm rẻ nhất, nhưng đồ chay chế biến sẵn lại đắt — ảnh hưởng tới ngân sách hằng tuần.
6. Đoạn nói kỹ năng nấu quyết định nhiều hơn ta tưởng: rau luộc nhạt thì không ai thích, cũng rau đó đem nướng vàng, nêm tỏi, thảo mộc, chanh thì khác hẳn — làm nguyên liệu đơn giản trở nên ngon.
7. Đoạn kết khuyên bắt đầu nhẹ nhàng: chọn một hai ngày mỗi tuần, sửa lại món quen thay vì học món mới phức tạp, thủ sẵn vài món tin cậy cho tối bận — bắt đầu mà không tạo áp lực.

4. Đoạn kể thời kỳ đầu thú lớn bị nhốt trong chuồng chật hẹp chỉ đủ sống, làm giảm chất lượng sống của chúng — bối cảnh dẫn tới xu hướng chuyển sang không gian rộng rãi hơn.

6. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nhấn mạnh sự phát triển của nhiệm vụ bảo tồn trong sứ mệnh giáo dục của sở thú hiện đại.
7. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nói rằng sở thú ngày nay được xem như một hình thức hiện đại để giáo dục và bảo tồn thay cho một số cách tiếp cận cũ.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about noise. Do you like to live in a noisy place or a quiet place?
questions.explanation: I prefer to live in a quiet place because it helps me relax and concentrate better. Noisy environments can be distracting, especially when I am trying to read, study, or sleep. A quiet place also makes me feel calmer after a busy day. However, I still want some shops and services nearby. For me, the best place is peaceful but not too far from daily conveniences.

questions.prompt: What kind of noise disturbs you most?
questions.explanation: The kind of noise that disturbs me most is loud music late at night. It is annoying because I cannot sleep or focus on anything when the sound is too strong. Traffic noise can also be tiring, especially during rush hour. I do not mind normal daily sounds, but repeated loud noise makes me feel stressed. I prefer a calm environment at home.

questions.prompt: Does noise affect your health?
questions.explanation: Yes, I think noise can affect our health. When the environment is too loud, people may feel stressed, tired, or angry. It can also make it difficult to sleep well, and poor sleep can cause many problems during the day. For example, I cannot concentrate if there is construction noise near my house. That is why a quiet living space is important.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about your favorite photograph. What is your favorite photograph?
questions.explanation: My favorite photograph is a picture of my family at the beach. In the photo, we are standing together near the sea and smiling happily. The sky is blue, and everyone looks relaxed. It is not a professional photo, but it captures a real and joyful moment. I keep it on my phone because it reminds me of the love and warmth in my family.

questions.prompt: When was it taken?
questions.explanation: The photograph was taken about three years ago during our summer vacation. We went to the beach for a short trip after a busy period of work and study. One afternoon, we walked along the sand and asked another tourist to take a picture for us. The weather was beautiful, and everyone was in a good mood. That is why the photo looks so natural.

questions.prompt: What makes the photograph special to you?
questions.explanation: The photograph is special to me because it reminds me of a happy time with my family. We do not travel together very often, so that trip was meaningful. Every time I look at the photo, I remember the sound of the waves, the seafood dinner, and the laughter we shared. It makes me feel warm and thankful for my family.

questions.prompt: What is your favourite colour?
questions.explanation: My favorite color is blue because it reminds me of the ocean and the sky. I find it calm, peaceful, and easy to look at. I also like green because it feels fresh and natural, especially when I see trees or parks. When I buy clothes or notebooks, I often choose blue. This color makes me feel relaxed and comfortable.

questions.prompt: Do you care for colors when choosing clothes to wear?
questions.explanation: Yes, I care about colors when I choose clothes because colors can affect how I look and feel. For daily clothes, I prefer simple colors such as white, black, navy, or grey because they are easy to match. For special occasions, I may choose brighter colors to look more cheerful. I think choosing the right color can make an outfit more attractive.

questions.prompt: Does color affect your mood/feeling?
questions.explanation: Yes, color can affect my mood quite a lot. When I see bright colors like yellow or orange, I feel more energetic and positive. Soft colors like blue or green make me feel calm and relaxed. Very dark colors can look serious or formal. That is why I prefer using light colors in my room because they create a comfortable atmosphere.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about going to the library. How often do you go to the library?
questions.explanation: I do not go to the library every day, but I try to visit it once or twice a month. I usually go there when I need a quiet place to study or when I want to borrow a book. The library near my school is clean and comfortable. I like the peaceful atmosphere because it helps me concentrate better than studying at home.

questions.prompt: What do you usually do in the library?
questions.explanation: In the library, I usually read books, study English, or work on assignments. Sometimes I use the computers there to search for information. I also like walking around the shelves to find interesting books that I did not plan to read. The library is quiet, so it is easier for me to focus. I think it is one of the best places for learning.

questions.prompt: Do you think that fewer people go to the library nowadays?
questions.explanation: Yes, I think fewer people go to the library nowadays because information is easy to find online. Many students prefer reading e-books or watching videos at home instead of borrowing books. However, I believe libraries are still important. They provide a quiet study space, free resources, and a serious learning atmosphere. The internet is convenient, but it cannot completely replace libraries.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about parties. Do you enjoy going to a party?
questions.explanation: Yes, I enjoy going to parties, but I prefer small parties with close friends or family. Big parties can be exciting, but they are sometimes too noisy for me. At a party, I can talk to people, enjoy good food, and take photos. I also like the happy atmosphere when everyone celebrates together. Parties are a nice way to relax and build relationships.

questions.prompt: What do you usually do at a party?
questions.explanation: At a party, I usually chat with friends, eat snacks, and take some photos. If there is music, I may dance a little, but I am not very confident. Sometimes we play simple games or sing karaoke together. I like helping the host prepare food or clean up afterward. For me, the best part of a party is spending time with people I like.

questions.prompt: On what occasions do you hold a party?
questions.explanation: I usually hold a party on birthdays or special family events. Sometimes, we also have a small party when a friend passes an exam, gets a new job, or comes back from another city. The party does not need to be expensive. We just prepare some food, drinks, and music. I think parties are a simple way to celebrate and create happy memories.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about your city. Which part of the city do you like best?
questions.explanation: I like the old town area of my city the most. It has narrow streets, old houses, small shops, and many cozy cafes. The area is always lively, but it still has a traditional feeling. I enjoy walking there in the evening because the lights are beautiful and the food smells delicious. It is a great place to relax and learn about local culture.

questions.prompt: Why do you like it?
questions.explanation: I like it because it feels different from modern parts of the city. There are many old buildings, street food stalls, and friendly local people. I can take photos, try traditional dishes, and buy small souvenirs there. The atmosphere is busy but charming. Whenever I visit that area, I feel connected to the history and culture of my city.

questions.prompt: Are there any changes you would like to make to the place?
questions.explanation: Yes, I would like to make a few small changes. First, I think there should be more green spaces or small parks so people can rest outdoors. Second, the streets should be cleaner, especially after busy evenings. I would also improve traffic control because it can be crowded. These changes would make the area more comfortable while keeping its traditional beauty.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about holidays. What did you do on your last holiday?
questions.explanation: On my last holiday, I went to the beach with my friends. We spent two days there, relaxing in the sun, swimming, and trying local seafood. In the evening, we walked along the beach and took many photos. It was a nice break from our busy lives because we did not have to think about work or study. I came home feeling refreshed.

questions.prompt: Who do you prefer spending your holidays with?
questions.explanation: I prefer spending my holidays with my family because we do not always have much time together during normal weeks. When we travel, we can talk more, eat together, and create good memories. Sometimes I also enjoy traveling with friends because it feels more active and fun. However, for important holidays like Tet, I always want to be with my family.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer going on holidays abroad?
questions.explanation: Yes, I would like to go on holidays abroad because I enjoy experiencing different cultures, trying new foods, and seeing famous places. Traveling abroad can be exciting and educational. However, it can also be expensive, so I need to plan carefully. I still enjoy traveling inside my country as well. For me, the most important thing is having a meaningful and relaxing trip.

questions.prompt: Now, let's talk about TV programs. How many hours a day do you watch television?
questions.explanation: I do not watch television for many hours a day. Usually, I watch about thirty minutes to one hour in the evening after finishing my work or study. I mostly watch the news, game shows, or short programs with my family. On busy days, I do not watch TV at all. I think watching a little is relaxing, but watching too much wastes time.

questions.prompt: What kinds of programs do you like?
questions.explanation: I like documentaries, comedies, and travel programs. Documentaries are useful because they teach me about nature, history, and different countries. Comedies help me relax and laugh after a tiring day. I also enjoy travel programs because they show beautiful places and interesting cultures. I do not like programs with too much drama. I prefer shows that are either educational or light and entertaining.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer watching television alone or with others? Why?
questions.explanation: I prefer watching television with others, especially my family. It is more enjoyable because we can share reactions, discuss the story, and laugh together. For example, when we watch a game show, everyone can guess the answers and have fun. Watching alone is sometimes peaceful, but it feels less exciting. For me, TV is better when it becomes a small family activity.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about music. Do you like music? If yes, what kind of music do you like best? Why? If no, why not?
questions.explanation: Yes, I really enjoy music. I like pop music the most because it has catchy melodies and makes me feel happy. I usually listen to music when I am on the bus, doing housework, or relaxing at home. Sometimes I also listen to soft music before sleeping. Music helps me reduce stress and improve my mood, so it is an important part of my daily life.

questions.prompt: What is the most popular kind of music in your country?
questions.explanation: In my country, pop music is probably the most popular kind of music, especially among young people. Many people listen to local pop singers on social media, music apps, or television shows. Ballads are also very popular because the melodies are emotional and easy to sing. Older people may prefer traditional music. I think Vietnamese music is becoming more diverse and creative nowadays.

questions.prompt: How is music good or not good for people?
questions.explanation: Music can be very good for people because it helps improve mood, reduce stress, and make life more enjoyable. It can also bring people together at concerts or family gatherings. However, music can be bad if it is too loud or listened to at the wrong time. For example, loud music can disturb sleep or study. So music is helpful when we use it properly.

questions.prompt: Now, let's talk about English as a school subject. Did you learn English at secondary school?
questions.explanation: Yes, I started learning English at secondary school. At first, it was quite challenging because I had to remember new words, grammar rules, and pronunciation. My teacher often asked us to practice reading and writing, but we did not speak much. Later, I became more interested because I could understand songs and simple movies. I think secondary school gave me a basic foundation in English.

questions.prompt: What do you think about how English is taught at school now?
questions.explanation: I think English is taught in a more interactive way now than in the past. Many teachers use games, videos, group work, and online tools to make lessons more interesting. Students also have more chances to practice speaking instead of only learning grammar. However, some classes are still too large, so not everyone can speak much. Overall, I think English teaching is improving step by step.

questions.prompt: In what ways has children's English much improved nowadays?
questions.explanation: Children's English has improved nowadays because they have more chances to hear and use the language. Many children watch English videos, listen to songs, and use learning apps from a young age. Some also join extra classes or speak with foreign teachers online. As a result, their listening and pronunciation are often better than before. Technology gives them more practice outside the classroom.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about a beautiful place in your hometown. What is that place?
questions.explanation: One beautiful place in my hometown is the city park near the center. It has lovely gardens, a small lake, and many tall trees. In the morning, people go there to exercise, and in the evening, families come to walk or relax. I like it because the air is fresh and the view is peaceful. It is a simple but pleasant place.

questions.prompt: What is the best way to go there?
questions.explanation: The best way to go there is by motorbike or bicycle because the park is not very far from my house. If the weather is nice, walking is also a good choice because I can enjoy the streets on the way. There is not much parking space, so using a car is less convenient. I usually go there by motorbike with my family.

questions.prompt: When is the best time to go there?
questions.explanation: I think the best time to go there is early in the morning or late in the afternoon. At those times, the weather is cooler, and the park is not too crowded. In the morning, people can exercise and enjoy fresh air. In the afternoon, the sunset looks beautiful near the lake. I do not like going there at noon because it is too hot.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about traditional village. Have you ever been to a traditional village?
questions.explanation: Yes, I have been to a traditional village in my country. I visited it with my family during a short holiday. The village had old houses, narrow lanes, and small workshops where local people made traditional products. I enjoyed walking around and learning about their daily life. It was different from the city and helped me understand more about Vietnamese culture.

questions.prompt: What is your favorite traditional village in your country?
questions.explanation: My favorite traditional village is Bat Trang, a famous pottery village near Hanoi. I like it because visitors can see how local people make bowls, cups, and decorations from clay. The products are colorful and beautiful. I also tried making a small pottery item by myself, which was fun. Bat Trang is a good place to learn about traditional craft and buy meaningful souvenirs.

questions.prompt: What can be done to maintain the traditional village?
questions.explanation: To maintain traditional villages, we should support local crafts, protect old houses, and teach young people about their culture. Tourism can help bring money to the village, but it should be controlled so the environment is not damaged. The government can also help by improving roads and promoting local products. If local people can earn a living from traditions, they will want to keep them.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about room in your house. What is your favorite room in your house? Why?
questions.explanation: My favorite room in my house is the living room because it is where my family spends time together. The room is not very large, but it is bright and cozy. There is a sofa, a television, and some family photos on the wall. In the evening, we usually sit there, talk, or watch TV. I like it because it feels warm and comfortable.

questions.prompt: What do you often do in the room?
questions.explanation: In the living room, I often watch TV, read books, or chat with my family. Sometimes I sit there to drink tea and relax after a long day. On weekends, we may watch a movie together or welcome guests in that room. It is also a place where my family talks about daily life. Because of that, the living room feels very important to me.

questions.prompt: Would you like to change anything in the room? Why?
questions.explanation: Yes, I would like to change a few things in the living room. First, I want to repaint the walls in a brighter color, maybe light blue or cream, to make the room feel fresher. I would also add some plants near the window. These changes are simple, but they would make the room more cheerful, comfortable, and relaxing for my family.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about accommodation. Do you live in a house or a flat?
questions.explanation: I live in a small house with my family. It is not very big, but it has enough space for us. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room, and a small yard. I like living in a house because it feels private and comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet, and daily services like markets and shops are not too far away.

questions.prompt: Who are you living with?
questions.explanation: I am living with my parents and my younger sister. We have different schedules, but we usually meet in the evening for dinner. My parents are caring and often give me advice, while my sister is funny and makes the house more lively. Sometimes we have small disagreements, but we understand each other. Living with my family makes me feel safe and supported.

questions.prompt: Which room does your family spend most of the time in?
questions.explanation: My family spends most of the time in the living room. After dinner, we often sit there to watch TV, talk about our day, or drink tea together. It is the most comfortable room in the house because it has a sofa and a big window. Sometimes guests also sit there when they visit us. I think it is the heart of our home.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about the library. Do you often go to the library? On which occasion?
questions.explanation: I do not go to the library very often, but I visit it when I need a quiet place to study or prepare for exams. Sometimes I also go there to find a book for a project. The library is useful because it has many resources and a calm atmosphere. When I need to focus seriously, it is much better than studying in a noisy cafe.

questions.prompt: What activities do people often do in the library?
questions.explanation: In the library, people often read books, study for exams, or use computers for research. Some students work on assignments, while others borrow books to take home. In some libraries, people can also join workshops, book clubs, or language activities. The most important thing is that everyone tries to keep quiet. Because of that, libraries are good places for learning and concentration.

questions.prompt: How do you introduce a book to others?
questions.explanation: When I introduce a book to others, I usually start with a short summary of the story or main idea. Then I explain why I like it and who may enjoy reading it. I try not to reveal the ending because I want them to stay curious. I may also mention the author, the style, and one useful lesson from the book.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about an interview. Have you ever been interviewed?
questions.explanation: Yes, I have been interviewed a few times, mostly for part-time jobs and school activities. At first, I felt nervous because I had to answer questions in front of people I did not know well. However, I tried to prepare carefully and speak clearly. After each interview, I learned something new about communication. I think interviews are challenging but useful experiences.

questions.prompt: What do you often prepare for the interview?
questions.explanation: Before an interview, I usually prepare several things. First, I learn about the company, school, or organization so I understand what they are looking for. Then I practice answering common questions about myself, my strengths, and my experience. I also prepare suitable clothes and arrive early. These steps help me feel more confident and make a better impression.

questions.prompt: How did you feel during the interview?
questions.explanation: During the interview, I felt both excited and nervous. My heart was beating fast at first, especially when the interviewer asked the first question. However, I tried to breathe slowly, smile, and answer as clearly as possible. After a few minutes, I felt more comfortable. When the interview ended, I felt proud because I had tried my best.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about banking services. Have you ever used banking services in your area?
questions.explanation: Yes, I have used banking services in my area many times. There are a few banks and ATMs near my house, so it is convenient for me to withdraw money, transfer money, and check my balance. I also use online banking on my phone. It saves a lot of time because I do not need to visit the bank for every small transaction.

questions.prompt: How often do you use banking services?
questions.explanation: I use banking services almost every week. Most of the time, I use mobile banking to transfer money, pay bills, or check my account balance. I only go to the bank directly when I need help with important documents or a new card. Banking services have become a normal part of my life because they are quick, useful, and easy to access.

questions.prompt: What do you like about banking services?
questions.explanation: What I like most about banking services is their convenience. With online banking, I can send money, pay bills, and check my balance at any time. This is very helpful when I am busy or when the bank is closed. I also feel safer because I do not need to carry too much cash. Modern banking makes daily life faster and easier.

questions.prompt: Let’s talk about dictionaries. Do you ever use a dictionary?
questions.explanation: Yes, I often use a dictionary, especially when I learn English. When I see a new word, I check its meaning, pronunciation, and example sentences. A dictionary helps me understand words more clearly and avoid using them incorrectly. I also use it when reading articles or writing short paragraphs. For language learners, I think a dictionary is an essential tool.

questions.prompt: What do you use for it?
questions.explanation: I use a dictionary mainly to learn new English words. I check the meaning, pronunciation, word form, and example sentences. Sometimes I also look up synonyms so that I can express my ideas in different ways. When I write in English, a dictionary helps me choose more accurate words. It is useful not only for understanding vocabulary but also for improving speaking and writing.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer paper or electronic dictionaries?
questions.explanation: I prefer electronic dictionaries because they are faster and more convenient. I can use one on my phone anywhere, and it often includes pronunciation, examples, and translations. This is very helpful when I am studying or traveling. However, paper dictionaries are still useful because they help learners focus and avoid distractions. For daily use, I choose an electronic dictionary.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about body language. Do you use body language in communication?
questions.explanation: Yes, I use body language when I communicate. For example, I smile when I greet people, nod when I agree, and use my hands to explain ideas. Body language makes conversations more natural and helps others understand my feelings. Sometimes, a smile or eye contact can show friendliness better than words. I think body language is a small but important part of communication.

questions.prompt: In which situation do you use body language?
questions.explanation: I often use body language in social situations, such as meeting new people, giving presentations, or talking with friends. When I listen to someone, I nod to show that I understand. When I give directions, I may use my hands to point. In interviews or exams, I try to sit straight and smile. Good body language helps me look more confident and friendly.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of body language?
questions.explanation: Body language has many benefits. It can make communication clearer by adding meaning to our words. For example, smiling can show friendliness, and eye contact can show confidence. Body language also helps people express feelings when words are not enough. In presentations, good gestures can make the speaker more interesting. However, we need to use it naturally, not too much.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about foreign language. What foreign language can you speak?
questions.explanation: I can speak English, although I am still learning and improving every day. I can introduce myself, talk about familiar topics, and understand simple conversations. Sometimes I still make grammar or pronunciation mistakes, but I try not to be afraid of speaking. Besides English, I know a few basic words in other languages. For now, English is the foreign language I use most.

questions.prompt: Do you enjoy learning a foreign language?
questions.explanation: Yes, I enjoy learning a foreign language because it helps me discover new ways to communicate. When I learn English, I can understand songs, movies, books, and people from other countries. It is difficult sometimes, especially speaking and pronunciation, but I feel happy when I make progress. Learning a language also makes me more confident and opens my mind to different cultures.

questions.prompt: How important is it to learn a foreign language?
questions.explanation: Learning a foreign language is very important in today's world. It can help people get better jobs, travel more easily, and communicate with people from different countries. It also allows us to understand other cultures, not just words and grammar. For students, a foreign language can provide more study opportunities. I think everyone should learn at least one foreign language if they can.

questions.prompt: Can you tell me about your job?
questions.explanation: I work as a marketing assistant. My job is to help promote products, write simple posts for social media, and support small campaigns. I often work with my team to prepare ideas and check customer feedback. The job can be busy, especially before a campaign starts, but it is also creative. I enjoy it because I can learn new skills and meet different people.

questions.prompt: Do you have a part-time job?
questions.explanation: Yes, I have a part-time job at a local cafe. I usually work a few evenings during the week and sometimes on weekends. My tasks include taking orders, serving drinks, and cleaning tables. It can be tiring when the cafe is crowded, but I enjoy meeting customers and working with my colleagues. The job helps me earn extra money and become more responsible.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of part-time job?
questions.explanation: A part-time job has many benefits, especially for students or young people. It helps them earn extra money and understand the value of work. It also teaches useful skills such as time management, communication, and responsibility. Working part-time can make people more confident when they apply for full-time jobs later. However, they need to balance work with study and rest.

questions.prompt: How often do you watch TV?
questions.explanation: I watch TV a few times a week, usually in the evening after I finish my work or study. I do not watch it for too long because I also want time for reading and sleeping early. I often watch the news, comedies, or travel programs. Watching TV helps me relax, and sometimes it gives me useful information about the world.

questions.prompt: What is your favourite TV program?
questions.explanation: My favorite TV program is a comedy show because it always makes me laugh. The stories are simple and close to daily life, so I can understand them easily. I usually watch it with my family after dinner. We enjoy talking about the funny characters and situations. For me, this program is a good way to reduce stress and spend time with my family.

questions.prompt: What are the advantages of watching TV?
questions.explanation: Watching TV has several advantages if people choose good programs. It can help us relax after a busy day and learn about news, culture, science, or travel. Some programs are educational and can improve our knowledge. Watching TV with family can also create shared moments at home. However, we should not watch too much because it may waste time or affect our health.

questions.prompt: Do you like walking? When and where do you walk?
questions.explanation: Yes, I like walking because it is simple and relaxing. I usually walk in the evening around my neighborhood or in a small park nearby. If I have more free time at the weekend, I may walk for longer with a friend. Walking gives me fresh air and helps me stop thinking too much about work. It is an easy habit to keep.

questions.prompt: Do you think walking is important?
questions.explanation: Yes, walking is important because it keeps people active without costing money. We do not need special skills or expensive equipment to walk. It can improve physical health, support mental health, and reduce stress. Walking is also better for the environment when people use it for short distances. I think even ten or twenty minutes of walking each day can make a difference.

questions.prompt: Do you think walking in the countryside is better than walking in the city?
questions.explanation: Yes, I think walking in the countryside is better for relaxation. The air is cleaner, the roads are quieter, and the views are more natural. You can see fields, trees, and mountains instead of traffic and buildings. However, walking in the city is more convenient because there are shops and lights everywhere. For health and peace of mind, I still prefer the countryside.

questions.prompt: Do you often eat healthy food?
questions.explanation: Yes, I try to eat healthy food regularly. I usually have rice, vegetables, eggs, fish, or chicken, and I eat fruit when I can. I avoid drinking too many soft drinks because they contain a lot of sugar. Of course, I sometimes eat fried food or snacks with friends. I think the key is not to be perfect, but to keep a balanced diet.

questions.prompt: What do you usually eat at school or at work?
questions.explanation: At school or at work, I usually eat something simple and convenient. If I bring food from home, I often have rice, vegetables, and meat in a lunch box. If I buy food outside, I may choose noodles, bread, or a small rice meal. I try not to eat too much fried food at lunchtime because it can make me feel sleepy.

questions.prompt: What is the unhealthiest food you can think of?
questions.explanation: The unhealthiest food I can think of is deep-fried fast food, such as fried chicken, chips, and burgers. These foods are popular because they are tasty and convenient, but they often have too much fat, salt, and calories. Eating them too often can be bad for the heart and weight. I still enjoy them occasionally, but I try not to make them a habit.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about your favorite childhood game. What game did you enjoy playing when you were a child?
questions.explanation: When I was a child, I enjoyed playing hide and seek. It was a simple game, but it was always exciting because we had to find clever hiding places. I usually played after school with other children in my neighborhood. We did not need expensive toys, only space and imagination. I liked it because it made us active and brought us closer together.

questions.prompt: Who did you play with?
questions.explanation: I usually played with my friends from the neighborhood. We would gather outside in the late afternoon when the weather was cooler. Sometimes my cousins joined us during holidays, and the game became even more exciting. We took turns hiding and seeking, and everyone laughed a lot. I liked playing with them because they were friendly, active, and easy to be with.

questions.prompt: Did you need any skills to play the game?
questions.explanation: The game did not need many skills, so everyone could join. However, it was helpful to be quick, quiet, and creative. If you were hiding, you needed to choose a smart place and stay silent. If you were seeking, you had to look carefully and think like the other players. These small skills made the game more exciting and enjoyable.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about your favorite color. What color do you like most?
questions.explanation: The color I like most is blue. It reminds me of the sky and the sea, so it gives me a peaceful feeling. I often choose blue clothes, notebooks, or phone wallpapers because the color is easy to look at. Blue also looks simple and clean, not too bright or too dark. I think it matches my personality because I like calm things.

questions.prompt: Do you care for colors when choosing clothes to wear?
questions.explanation: Yes, I care about colors when I choose clothes because colors can affect how I look and feel. For daily clothes, I prefer simple colors such as white, black, navy, or grey because they are easy to match. For special occasions, I may choose brighter colors to look more cheerful. I think choosing the right color can make an outfit more attractive.

questions.prompt: Does color affect your mood/feeling?
questions.explanation: Yes, color can affect my mood quite a lot. When I see bright colors like yellow or orange, I feel more energetic and positive. Soft colors like blue or green make me feel calm and relaxed. Very dark colors can look serious or formal. That is why I prefer using light colors in my room because they create a comfortable atmosphere.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about birthday. How do you often celebrate your birthday?
questions.explanation: I usually celebrate my birthday with a small gathering of friends and family. We have dinner together, eat cake, take photos, and talk about funny memories. I do not need a big or expensive party because I prefer a warm atmosphere with people I love. Sometimes my friends surprise me with small gifts. These simple moments make my birthday special and meaningful.

questions.prompt: What is the best birthday gift you have received?
questions.explanation: The best birthday gift I have received was a watch from my parents. It was not only useful but also meaningful because they knew I had wanted one for a long time. I still remember feeling surprised and touched when I opened the box. Whenever I wear it, I think of their love and support. That is why it is special to me.

questions.prompt: What are your plans for your next birthday?
questions.explanation: For my next birthday, I plan to have a simple dinner with my family and close friends. I may choose a small restaurant with good food and a quiet atmosphere. After dinner, we can have cake, take photos, and maybe go for coffee. I do not want anything too crowded or expensive. I just want to spend the day with people who care about me.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about mobile phones. What type of mobile phone do you have?
questions.explanation: I have a smartphone that I use every day. It is a mid-range model, not very expensive, but it has a good camera and enough battery life for my needs. I like it because it is easy to use and works well for studying, chatting, and taking photos. I do not need the newest phone; I just need one that is reliable.

questions.prompt: What do you use your mobile phone for?
questions.explanation: I use my mobile phone for many things. I send messages, make calls, check social media, take photos, and watch short videos. I also use it for studying English, looking up words, and joining online classes. When I go out, I use maps to find directions. My phone is very useful, but I try not to use it too much before sleeping.

questions.prompt: Do you think you should change anything in the way that you use your mobile phone?
questions.explanation: Yes, I think I should spend less time on my mobile phone, especially on social media. Sometimes I scroll for a long time without learning anything useful. This can waste time and make my eyes tired. I want to use my phone more for studying, reading, and communication. I also plan to put it away earlier at night so I can sleep better.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about learning languages. What foreign languages do you study?
questions.explanation: I am studying English at the moment. I focus on vocabulary, pronunciation, listening, and speaking because I want to communicate more confidently. Sometimes I also learn a few simple words from other languages through songs or videos, but English is still my main goal. I try to practice every day, even if only for a short time, because regular practice helps me improve.

questions.prompt: Do you think that English is the most important language?
questions.explanation: I think English is one of the most important languages in the world. It is used in international business, travel, education, and technology. If people can speak English, they may have more chances to study abroad, find better jobs, or make foreign friends. However, other languages such as Chinese, Spanish, or Japanese are also important in different areas. So English is very useful, but not the only valuable language.

questions.prompt: What do you find difficult about studying languages?
questions.explanation: The most difficult thing about studying languages for me is speaking naturally. I may know the words and grammar, but I sometimes feel nervous and cannot say my ideas quickly. Pronunciation is also challenging because some sounds are different from Vietnamese. Another problem is remembering new vocabulary for a long time. To improve, I need more practice and more confidence.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about public transportation. What is the best way to travel in your town or city?
questions.explanation: In my city, the best way to travel is by motorbike because it is fast, flexible, and convenient. Many streets are narrow, so a motorbike is easier to park than a car. However, during rush hour, traffic can be stressful. For longer distances, buses or ride-hailing services are also useful. I think the best choice depends on the time, distance, and weather.

questions.prompt: What is your favourite means of transportation?
questions.explanation: My favorite means of transportation is the motorbike. It is convenient for daily life in Vietnam because I can go almost anywhere and park easily. I also like the feeling of being outside and seeing the streets around me. Of course, I need to drive carefully and wear a helmet. questions.prompt: Do you think people should use public transportation more? Why or why not?
questions.explanation: Yes, I think people should use public transportation more if the service is good. Buses, trains, and metro systems can reduce traffic jams and air pollution. They are also cheaper than using a private car every day. However, public transportation needs to be clean, safe, and on time. If it becomes more convenient, more people will choose it for work, school, and travel.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about your holidays. Where would you like to go for your next holiday?
questions.explanation: For my next holiday, I would like to visit Japan. I am interested in its culture, food, technology, and beautiful scenery. questions.prompt: What do people in your country do during their holidays?
questions.explanation: During holidays, people in my country often visit family, travel, or relax at home. For Tet, many people return to their hometowns, clean the house, cook traditional food, and give lucky money to children. On shorter holidays, some families go to the beach, visit tourist attractions, or eat out together. Holidays are important because they give people time to rest and reconnect with loved ones.

questions.prompt: Why are holidays important?
questions.explanation: Holidays are important because they give people time to relax and recharge after work or study. They also allow families and friends to spend quality time together, which can strengthen relationships. During holidays, people can travel, enjoy hobbies, or simply sleep more. Without holidays, life may feel too busy and stressful. A good holiday helps people return to daily life with more energy.

questions.prompt: Let's talk about childhood. Did you enjoy your childhood?
questions.explanation: Yes, I really enjoyed my childhood. I had a lot of freedom to play outside with my friends, especially after school and during summer holidays. questions.explanation: One of the most memorable things about my childhood is the time I spent at my grandparents' house during summer vacations. Those days were simple, but they made me feel loved, free, and connected to my family.

questions.prompt: Did you have a lot of friends when you were small?
questions.explanation: Yes, I had quite a lot of friends when I was small. Most of them were classmates or children who lived near my house. We played together after school and during weekends. questions.explanation: My favorite sport is football because it is exciting and easy to play with friends. I like the teamwork, speed, and energy of the game. I think this topic is quite common in daily life.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, a family is sitting together and playing chess. The parents look happy, and the child seems focused on the game. It shows a calm family activity that needs thinking. In the second picture, a boy is playing video games alone on a sofa. He looks concentrated and relaxed. Both pictures show indoor games, but chess is more traditional and social, while video games are more modern and personal.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer playing chess or playing video games?
questions.explanation: I prefer playing video games because they are more exciting and interactive. They have many types, such as action, adventure, sports, and puzzle games, so I never feel bored. I can also play with friends online, which makes the experience more social. However, I respect chess because it trains the mind and improves planning skills. If I want entertainment, I choose video games, but chess is better for deep thinking.

questions.prompt: Are indoor activities important? Why?
questions.explanation: Yes, indoor activities are important because they give people a way to relax and enjoy themselves, especially when the weather is bad. Activities like reading, playing chess, watching movies, or playing games can improve thinking and creativity. They are also safe and easy to do at home. Indoor activities can bring family members together, for example when they cook, play board games, or watch a film together after dinner.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, a man and a boy are cooking together in a kitchen. They look happy and focused, and there are fresh ingredients on the counter. It seems like a warm family moment. In the second picture, a man is eating pizza at an outdoor restaurant. He looks relaxed and is enjoying his meal. Both pictures are about food, but one shows cooking at home and the other shows eating out.

questions.prompt: Why is it appealing to eat at different places?
questions.explanation: Eating at different places is appealing because it gives people new experiences. When we eat at a restaurant, a cafe, or a local market, we can try different dishes and flavors. It is also a chance to learn about other cultures and cooking styles. Eating outside can make daily life more interesting, especially when we go with friends or family. A new place can make a meal feel special.

questions.prompt: Where do people like to eat on special occasions?
questions.explanation: On special occasions, people usually like to eat somewhere comfortable and memorable. Some families choose a nice restaurant because they want good food and good service. Others prefer eating at home because it feels warmer and more personal. For birthdays, weddings, or anniversaries, people may choose a buffet, a barbecue restaurant, or a place with a beautiful view. The most important thing is spending happy time together with loved ones.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, a family is sitting together on the grass in front of a house. They look happy, close, and relaxed, which shows a warm family life. In the second picture, a young woman is standing alone on a balcony in the city. She looks independent and peaceful. Both pictures show different lifestyles. The first shows living with family, while the second shows living alone and enjoying personal space.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer living with family or living alone?
questions.explanation: I prefer living with my family because it gives me comfort and emotional support. When I live with my family, I can share meals, talk about my day, and ask for help when I have problems. We can also share housework, so daily life becomes easier. Living alone gives more privacy, but it can feel lonely. For me, living with family is warmer and more meaningful for me.

questions.prompt: Nowadays, why do many people like to live alone?
questions.explanation: Nowadays, many people like to live alone because it gives them independence and privacy. They can decide what to eat, when to sleep, and how to decorate their home. Living alone is also common for people who move to big cities for work or study. It helps them become more responsible because they must manage money, cleaning, and cooking by themselves. Although it can be lonely, many people enjoy the freedom.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, a father and his son are standing near a horse and feeding it. They look happy, and it seems like they are enjoying a day outside together. In the second picture, a teacher is showing children a snake in a classroom. The children look curious and excited. Both pictures show children learning about animals, but one happens outdoors with family, while the other happens indoors at school.

questions.prompt: Do you like interacting with animals?
questions.explanation: Yes, I enjoy interacting with animals because they make me feel relaxed and happy. I especially like dogs because they are loyal, playful, and friendly. When I spend time with animals, I can forget about stress and feel more positive. I also think animals help people become kinder and more responsible. Even simple activities like feeding a pet or walking a dog can bring a lot of joy.

questions.prompt: Should children be exposed to animals?
questions.explanation: Yes, children should be exposed to animals, but it should be done safely. Spending time with animals can teach children responsibility, kindness, and respect for living things. For example, when children feed a pet or clean its place, they learn to care for others. Animals can also help children feel calmer and happier. However, adults should guide them so they know how to treat animals gently and safely.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, a rowing team is racing on the water. The athletes are using all their strength, and they must move together to control the boat. In the second picture, a cyclist is riding on a road, wearing a helmet and sports clothes. He looks focused and determined. Both pictures show competitive sports, but rowing is a team sport, while cycling in this picture seems more individual.

questions.prompt: What are the difficulties of these 2 sports?
questions.explanation: Both rowing and cycling are difficult sports. Rowing requires strong arms, shoulders, and teamwork because all members must row at the same rhythm. Bad weather or strong waves can make it even harder. Cycling requires strong legs, balance, and concentration, especially on long roads or during races. Cyclists must keep their speed and avoid accidents. Both sports are physically demanding and need regular training, strong discipline, and patience.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer team sports to individual sports?
questions.explanation: Some people prefer team sports because they enjoy working with others. In a team, players can support each other, share pressure, and celebrate success together. Team sports also help people improve communication, cooperation, and leadership skills. They are suitable for outgoing people who like social activities. Individual sports can be rewarding, but they may feel lonely. For many people, the friendship and teamwork in team sports make them more enjoyable.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, a couple is walking through an airport with suitcases. They look ready for a trip, and the place feels busy and exciting. In the second picture, a man is standing on a mountain and taking a photo of the beautiful view. He looks calm and focused. Both pictures are about travel, but the first shows the start of a journey, while the second shows enjoying nature.

questions.prompt: What do you think of these two ways of travelling?
questions.explanation: I think these two ways of traveling are both interesting but very different. Traveling through cities or airports feels exciting because people can visit new places, meet others, and experience modern life. It is suitable for those who like convenience and activity. Traveling in the mountains is quieter and closer to nature. It is better for people who want fresh air, beautiful views, and a break from busy city life.

questions.prompt: Advantages and disadvantages of these 2 ways of travelling?
questions.explanation: City travel has many advantages because it is convenient and offers many choices, such as restaurants, hotels, museums, and shopping centers. However, it can be noisy, crowded, and expensive. Mountain travel gives people fresh air, beautiful scenery, and a peaceful feeling. It is good for hiking and relaxing. The disadvantage is that it may be far from hospitals, shops, or transport. Both ways are enjoyable, depending on personal needs.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In the first picture, many people are standing around an old bus. Some luggage is on the top, and the ground looks wet, so the journey may have been difficult. In the second picture, a man is opening the door of a red car. He looks comfortable and ready to go somewhere. Both pictures are about transportation, but the bus seems crowded and less private, while the car looks more convenient.

questions.prompt: What is the experience of traveling on these two vehicles?
questions.explanation: Traveling by bus can be affordable and useful, especially for people who do not have their own vehicle. It allows many passengers to travel together, but it can sometimes be crowded, noisy, and uncomfortable. Traveling by car is more private and flexible. People can choose their own route, stop whenever they want, and carry more luggage easily. However, cars are more expensive because of fuel, maintenance, and parking costs.

questions.prompt: Why do you think people still choose to have their own cars?
questions.explanation: Many people still choose to have their own cars because cars give them freedom and convenience. With a car, they can travel whenever they want without waiting for a bus or train. It is also easier to go to work, take children to school, or carry shopping bags. Cars are more private and comfortable, especially in bad weather. Although owning a car is expensive, many people think it saves time.

questions.prompt: A person calls a friend about his new car. How much does the small car cost him?
questions.explanation:
Hi Mark, it's me. I finally went to the car dealer this morning, and yes, I had to choose between the two models again. The bigger one is beautiful, but they want four thousand two hundred and fifty for it — more than I can manage. The salesman started the small one at three thousand five hundred and fifty, we talked for a while, and in the end it costs me three thousand two hundred and fifty. I pick it up on Friday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "in the end it costs me three thousand two hundred and fifty" — cụm "in the end" báo hiệu đây là giá CHỐT sau khi mặc cả.
• 3550 pounds sai: đó là giá người bán CHÀO ban đầu cho xe nhỏ ("The salesman started the small one at three thousand five hundred and fifty").
• 4250 pounds sai: đó là giá của xe TO, đã bị loại vì quá khả năng ("they want four thousand two hundred and fifty for it — more than I can manage").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi giá tiền luôn thả đủ 3 con số. Khoanh số đi sau "in the end / finally / we agreed on", gạch số đi sau "started at / they want / originally".

questions.prompt: Two people are talking about meeting for dinner. What time does Ahmed meet Rose?
questions.explanation:
Hello Rose, Ahmed here. About dinner tonight — I know we first said half past seven, but my meeting now finishes late, so that's impossible for me. I thought about quarter past seven for a moment, but that's even earlier, silly me. Let's make it quarter to eight instead, same restaurant. The table is already changed to quarter to eight, so see you then!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – quarter to eight.
• Vì sao đúng: "Let's make it quarter to eight instead" và được xác nhận lại "The table is already changed to quarter to eight".
• half past seven sai: đó là giờ hẹn BAN ĐẦU, đã bỏ vì cuộc họp kết thúc muộn ("I know we first said half past seven, but my meeting now finishes late").
• quarter past seven sai: chính người nói nghĩ tới rồi tự bác bỏ vì còn sớm hơn ("I thought about quarter past seven for a moment, but that's even earlier, silly me").
👉 Mẹo: trong tin nhắn đổi lịch, giờ đúng nằm sau "instead" hoặc "let's make it"; giờ đứng sau "we first said / originally" luôn là bẫy.

questions.prompt: A man calls the teleshop. What is the teleshop number?
questions.explanation:
Good afternoon, you have reached Teleshop customer service. All our assistants are busy at the moment, so please note down our direct order line and call again: two zero one zero three zero. Let me repeat that slowly for you: two — zero — one — zero — three — zero. Our lines are open every day from eight in the morning until nine at night. Thank you for choosing Teleshop.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 201030.
• Vì sao đúng: tổng đài đọc rồi nhắc lại chậm từng chữ số "two — zero — one — zero — three — zero" = 201030.
• 102030 sai: chỉ là đảo thứ tự các cặp số, không hề được đọc trong bài.
• 301020 sai: cũng là đảo thứ tự, không xuất hiện trong bài.
👉 Mẹo: dạng đọc dãy số luôn có lần đọc lại ("Let me repeat that slowly"). Ghi nháp lần một, đối chiếu ở lần hai rồi mới chốt.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between the speaker and Lisa?
questions.explanation:
I have just come back from the most wonderful two weeks by the sea, and of course I went with Lisa — who else? We have shared everything since we sat next to each other on our very first day of school, thirty years ago now. Our husbands joke that we speak our own language. Every summer, wherever life has taken us, the two of us find one week for a trip together, just like when we were girls.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: "We have shared everything since we sat next to each other on our very first day of school, thirty years ago" — ngồi cạnh nhau từ ngày đầu đi học nghĩa là bạn thân cùng lứa.
• Mother and daughter sai: hai người cùng tuổi và mỗi người đều có chồng riêng ("Our husbands joke that we speak our own language"), không thể là mẹ con.
• Teacher and student sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
