👉 Mẹo: thông báo nhà ga hay dùng cấu trúc "now X, not Y as printed" kèm một chuyến kế tiếp. Chọn số ngay sau "now", bỏ số sau "as printed" và "the following service".

questions.prompt: Listening to Sarah leaving a message for her friend. When does she want to meet?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Sarah! Listen, about tomorrow — I need to change our plan a little. I know we said one o'clock, but my dentist appointment got moved and I won't be free by then. I first thought two o'clock would work, but the buses at that hour are terrible. So let's meet at three o'clock instead, same café, corner table. Three o'clock, okay? Text me if that's a problem, otherwise I'll see you there. Kisses!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Three o'clock.
• Vì sao đúng: "So let's meet at three o'clock instead, same café, corner table. Three o'clock, okay?".
• One o'clock sai: giờ hẹn ban đầu, phải hủy vì lịch nha sĩ bị dời ("I know we said one o'clock, but my dentist appointment got moved and I won't be free by then").
• Two o'clock sai: cô có nghĩ tới nhưng loại vì xe buýt giờ đó rất tệ ("I first thought two o'clock would work, but the buses at that hour are terrible").
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn đổi hẹn đi theo trình tự "giờ cũ → giờ cân nhắc → giờ mới". Giờ đúng luôn đi kèm "instead" và được nhắc lại lần hai để xác nhận.

questions.prompt: Listen to a woman talking about what she has just bought. What is Dress she wears like?
questions.explanation:
You will not believe what I found at the market this morning! You know I've been hunting for a dress for Mai's wedding for weeks. I almost bought that black and white one from the shop window last month — glad I waited. Today, there it was: long, deep red, exactly my size, half price because of a tiny loose thread grandma can fix in five minutes. Long and red, like something from a film! I'm wearing it tonight just to practise walking in it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – long and red.
• Vì sao đúng: "there it was: long, deep red, exactly my size" và cô nhắc lại "Long and red, like something from a film!".
• black and white sai: đó là chiếc cô SUÝT mua tháng trước và may là đã không mua ("I almost bought that black and white one from the shop window last month — glad I waited").
• long and white sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu ghép nửa đúng nửa sai.
👉 Mẹo: đáp án mô tả đồ vật thường gồm hai đặc điểm (dáng + màu) và phải khớp CẢ HAI. Phương án nhiễu hay giữ một đặc điểm đúng rồi đổi đặc điểm còn lại.

questions.prompt: A man is talking to a shop assistant. What does the man buy in the shop?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Good afternoon! Looking for anything special?
Man: A birthday present for my wife. I saw those printed mugs in your window — she collects them, but honestly she has forty already.
Woman: Then perhaps not mug number forty-one! What about clothes? We have lovely scarves.
Man: I never get her size right — last time was a disaster. What are those on the shelf there?
Woman: Our handmade candles — lavender, vanilla, sea salt. They burn for sixty hours, and the jars are reusable.
Man: She lights candles every single evening, actually. Perfect. I'll take the lavender set, gift-wrapped please.
Woman: Wonderful choice. She'll love them.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Candles.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll take the lavender set, gift-wrapped please" — ngay sau khi nhân viên giới thiệu "Our handmade candles — lavender, vanilla, sea salt".
• Mugs sai: vợ anh đã có bốn mươi chiếc ("she collects them, but honestly she has forty already").
• Clothes sai: anh sợ chọn sai size như lần trước ("I never get her size right — last time was a disaster").
👉 Mẹo: trong hội thoại mua quà, hãy đợi câu có động từ mua thật ("I'll take..."). Mọi món trước đó chỉ là bước sàng lọc, dù được khen nhiều đến đâu.

questions.prompt: A man is talking on the phone. What did the man lose?
questions.explanation:
Man: Hi love, it's me. Quick question — have you seen my things anywhere at home?
Woman: Which things? Your jacket is here, hanging by the door where you left it.
Man: No no, the jacket I have — I'm wearing it. And my books are in the car, I already checked.
Woman: Then what's missing?
Man: My glasses! I've searched the whole office, my bag, everywhere. I can't read a single document without them.
Woman: Did you check the bathroom shelf? You left them there yesterday too.
Man: The bathroom... of course. Can you look? I'll wait.
Woman: Found them! Next to your razor, as always. Honestly, you'd lose your own head.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Glasses.
• Vì sao đúng: "My glasses! I've searched the whole office, my bag, everywhere" — và vợ tìm thấy trên kệ nhà tắm ("Found them! Next to your razor, as always").
• Jacket sai: áo khoác anh đang mặc trên người ("the jacket I have — I'm wearing it").
• Books sai: sách nằm trong xe và anh đã kiểm tra ("my books are in the car, I already checked").
👉 Mẹo: dạng tìm đồ thất lạc — hai món nhiễu bị loại rất nhanh bằng "I have it / I already checked". Món đúng đi kèm câu than phiền dài và dấu chấm than.

questions.prompt: Anna is calling her friend. Where will they meet?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Hi! It's Anna. Are we still meeting tomorrow morning?
Man: Absolutely. Where suits you? The mall opens at nine — we could do breakfast there.
Woman: Honestly, the mall is chaos on Saturdays, all those queues. And the park... they're setting up a concert stage, half of it is fenced off this week.
Man: So the park is out too. Where then?
Woman: The marketplace! The farmers' stalls are there on Saturdays — we can buy cheese, look at the flowers, and there's that little coffee cart you liked.
Man: The one with the cinnamon buns! Sold. The marketplace at nine, by the fountain?
Woman: By the fountain at nine. Bring a shopping bag!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At the marketplace.
• Vì sao đúng: "The marketplace! The farmers' stalls are there on Saturdays" và chốt "By the fountain at nine".
• At the mall sai: thứ Bảy quá đông và phải xếp hàng ("the mall is chaos on Saturdays, all those queues").
• At the park sai: đang dựng sân khấu ca nhạc, bị rào mất một nửa ("they're setting up a concert stage, half of it is fenced off this week").
👉 Mẹo: khi hai địa điểm đầu đều bị chê, hãy chờ câu bắt đầu bằng tên địa điểm kèm dấu chấm than — đó gần như luôn là đáp án.

questions.prompt: A man is seeking advice on future career. What is he going to do?
questions.explanation:
Man: Thanks for making time. I need advice — everyone keeps planning my future for me.
Woman: Let's hear it. What are the options?
Man: My mother wants me to become a teacher like her. Stable, holidays, respect — I understand the appeal, but standing in front of a class terrifies me.
Woman: And college? You mentioned applying last year.
Man: I did, and I got in — but honestly, three more years of exams is not what I want. I've made my decision, actually: I'm going to work in business. My uncle offered me a place at his trading company, starting from the bottom.
Woman: You sound sure.
Man: For the first time, I am. Business it is — I start next month.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To work in business.
• Vì sao đúng: "I've made my decision, actually: I'm going to work in business. My uncle offered me a place at his trading company" và chốt "Business it is — I start next month".
• To become a teacher sai: đó là mong muốn của MẸ anh, còn anh thì sợ đứng lớp ("My mother wants me to become a teacher like her... standing in front of a class terrifies me").
• To study at college sai: anh đã đỗ nhưng từ chối vì không muốn thi cử thêm ("I got in — but honestly, three more years of exams is not what I want").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi dự định tương lai — ưu tiên câu có "I've made my decision / I'm going to". Nguyện vọng của bố mẹ và cơ hội đã từ chối đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about doing arts. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: Wednesday evening is the highlight of my week: eight of us meet above the bakery with our easels, paint for two hours, then argue about whose sunset is worse over tea and biscuits. Half of us have no talent whatsoever, and it truly does not matter. I joined to meet people after moving to this town, and the painting turned out to be the easiest doorway into friendship I have ever found. We are planning a little group show in the spring.
Speaker B: Every Sunday morning my kitchen table disappears under glue, glitter and coloured card, because that is craft time with my two little ones. We make lopsided animals, potato-print wrapping paper, birthday cards for the grandparents. The floor suffers terribly. But watching a five-year-old concentrate on her wobbly giraffe is worth any mess, and the fridge door has become our family gallery. It is our time together, away from every screen in the house.
Speaker C: People assume drawing is my hobby, but it is actually how I pay my rent. I illustrate children's books for two publishers, so from nine to five I am sketching dragons and checking colour proofs against deadlines. When your passion becomes your profession, it changes — some days the pencil feels heavy, like any tool. Still, I remind myself that plenty of people would trade their desk for mine, deadlines and all.
Speaker D: My painting happens behind a closed door, and that is exactly how I like it. Sunday afternoons, the flat empty, the phone off — just me, the brushes and the radio. Nobody sees the results; most canvases end up stacked in the wardrobe. Friends keep telling me to join a class or share pictures online, and I always refuse. The whole point is that no one is watching. It is the only truly private hour I own.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = social activity (PARAPHRASE: "easiest doorway into friendship... meet people"). B = with children (keyword "craft time with my two little ones"). C = part of the job (PARAPHRASE: "how I pay my rent... profession... deadlines"). D = alone (keyword "behind a closed door... no one is watching"). Nhiễu: online classes, competitions.

questions.prompt: Housing space is more important than farming space.
questions.explanation:
M: Did you see they're turning that empty car park behind the station into allotments?
W: I did, and honestly I think it's the wrong call. In a city as crowded as this one, a plot of land like that ought to go to flats long before it ever goes to vegetables. Housing has to come first.
M: I'm not so sure about that, actually. We've concreted over every green patch for thirty years now and rents are still absurd. Another block on that site wouldn't fix a thing.
W: It would put a roof over forty families, though.
M: Possibly. For me, though, the whole notion of growing food in the middle of a city is tremendously attractive — rooftops full of beans and tomatoes. I find the idea genuinely lovely.
W: Hmm, I don't share your enthusiasm, I'm afraid. It photographs beautifully, but close up it's mud, torn netting and slugs. I simply can't get excited about it.
M: Each to their own, I suppose. There's a practical side too: this city doesn't come close to producing what it eats. We need a great deal more food than we're growing.
W: I'd question that one. I'll accept the import figures, of course, but the shops are stuffed and half of what's on the shelves gets binned at closing time. That isn't a shortage — it's appalling distribution.
M: Well, waste is a separate argument, I'd say.
W: It's the same argument, really.
M: Anyway, the part I don't think anybody could object to is the money side of it. All those small growers, the tool shops, the market stalls — it would put a real lift under the local economy.
W: Yes, I agree with you there completely. Proper work for people who've been out of it for ages, and the money stays in the neighbourhood instead of going off to some warehouse two hundred miles away.
M: Exactly. That's the bit the council ought to be shouting about.
W: They'd rather put up a sign about biodiversity and leave it at that.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: Đất ở quan trọng hơn đất trồng = Woman · Nông nghiệp đô thị hấp dẫn = Man · Thành phố cần thêm lương thực = Man · Nông nghiệp đô thị có lợi cho kinh tế = Both

1. Housing space is more important than farming space. → Woman: người phụ nữ nêu "a plot of land like that ought to go to flats long before it ever goes to vegetables. Housing has to come first." Người đàn ông phản đối: "I'm not so sure about that, actually... Another block on that site wouldn't fix a thing."

2. Urban farming is appealing. → Man: người đàn ông nêu "the whole notion of growing food in the middle of a city is tremendously attractive... I find the idea genuinely lovely." Người phụ nữ phản đối: "Hmm, I don't share your enthusiasm, I'm afraid... I simply can't get excited about it."

3. Cities need more food. → Man: người đàn ông nêu "this city doesn't come close to producing what it eats. We need a great deal more food than we're growing." Người phụ nữ phản đối: "I'd question that one. I'll accept the import figures, of course, but... That isn't a shortage — it's appalling distribution."

4. Urban farming will benefit the urban economy. → Both: người đàn ông nêu "it would put a real lift under the local economy", người phụ nữ tán thành: "Yes, I agree with you there completely."

👉 Mẹo: Bẫy chính ở ý 3 — người phụ nữ nói "I'll accept the import figures, of course" nghe như đồng tình, nhưng cô phủ nhận đúng kết luận (thiếu lương thực), nên đáp án là Man chứ không phải Both.

questions.prompt: Urban farming is appealing.
Cities need more food.
Urban farming will benefit the urban economy.
What is the importance of advertising?
options: It can help reach new customers
questions.explanation:
Let me say a few words about advertising, because many business owners still see it as an expense rather than an opportunity. First, let me deal with a common worry. Some companies fear that spending on advertising will force them to increase the product price, and in a badly-run campaign that can happen. But a well-planned campaign usually pays for itself many times over. People also like to say that advertising is mainly about building brand recognition — making sure customers remember your name and your logo. Recognition is pleasant, certainly, but a name that people remember and never buy from is worth very little. In my view, the real importance of advertising is simpler and more practical: it helps a business reach new customers. A good campaign travels far beyond your existing audience and puts your product in front of people who had never heard of you last month. That is where real growth comes from, and that is why even successful companies keep advertising.
Now, a word of warning about sports sponsorship, because it is not as safe as it looks. Companies usually hope their sponsorship will attract more fans to the sport, and they dream of boosting ticket sales and sales of shirts and equipment. Sometimes that happens. But think about what happens when things go wrong. If a tournament is hit by cheating or bad behaviour, the heavy advertising around it means the story spreads everywhere, and the sponsorship can generate negative publicity for the sport itself. Both the company and the sport can walk away damaged. So sponsor carefully, and always have a plan for bad news.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It can help reach new customers. Bẫy: "increases the product price" chỉ là lo ngại ("in a badly-run campaign"), "build brand recognition" bị hạ cấp ("worth very little" nếu không ai mua).
2. Đáp án: They can generate negative publicity for the sport. Bẫy: "attract more fans" và "boost ticket sales" đều là kỳ vọng ("hope", "dream"), còn cảnh báo thật nằm sau "But think about what happens when things go wrong".

questions.prompt: In what way can advertising affect sports?
options: They help to attract more fans.
They can boost ticket sales and sales of sports-related items.
They can generate negative publicity for the sport.

questions.prompt: What part of the movie is disappointing?
options: The settings do not make sense.
questions.explanation:
As someone who has watched the film industry for twenty years, I left the cinema after The Silver Horizon with mixed feelings. Let me start with what the film gets right, because the rumours you may have heard are not true. Some fans claimed the original cast had been replaced at the last minute — they were not; every main actor stayed. And the settings are actually beautiful and completely believable, from the mountain villages to the night markets. Visually, the film makes perfect sense. The real disappointment is the dialogue, which simply seems unrealistic. The characters speak as if they came from another century. There is one long conversation between the hero and his teacher that should feel emotional, but the words are so stiff that it sounds like a school play instead of two real people talking. Every time the film starts to pull you in, another awkward line pushes you straight back out.
Why does this keep happening in modern films? Some people blame technology and even fear it will soon replace human actors, but I think that fear misses the point. Others say the studios should simply invent newer, fresher story plots. Also not the heart of it. The real problem is that the new industry demand for speed is negatively influencing script production. Studios want films finished quickly to follow market trends, so writers are not given the time to build believable characters and natural conversations. Until that pressure changes, we will keep seeing beautiful films that sound wrong the moment the characters open their mouths.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The dialogue seems unrealistic. Bẫy: "settings do not make sense" bị phủ định ("completely believable"), "original cast was replaced" bị phủ định ("they were not").
2. Đáp án: The new industry demand is negatively influencing script production. Bẫy: "technology will replace actors" bị gạt ("misses the point"), "new story plots should be invented" bị gạt ("Also not the heart of it").

questions.prompt: What is the expert comment on the movie industry?
options: Technology will soon replace human actors.
The new industry demand is negatively influencing script production
New story plots should be invented to capture the audience's interest

questions.prompt: A man is talking to a friend about his family. What is his main problem?
questions.explanation:
My move abroad is nearly sorted, and honestly, the practical side went smoothly. The job? Signed the contract last month — a good position in Toronto with a company that even pays my flights. Money is fine too; I've been saving for two years and the moving costs are covered. No, my headache is at home: my parents. Every dinner turns into a debate, my mother cries, my father goes silent. Convincing my family this is right — that is the mountain I still have to climb.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "my headache is at home: my parents... Convincing my family this is right — that is the mountain I still have to climb".
• Finding a job abroad sai: đã ký hợp đồng từ tháng trước ("The job? Signed the contract last month — a good position in Toronto").
• Saving money for the move sai: tiền đã đủ, chi phí chuyển nhà được lo ("I've been saving for two years and the moving costs are covered").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "main problem" — hai phương án nhiễu luôn được nói với nghĩa "đã xong" (signed, covered, sorted). Vấn đề thật đi kèm ẩn dụ khó khăn: my headache, the mountain to climb.

questions.prompt: A woman is chatting with a friend about her afternoon plans. What is she going to do this aftermoon?
questions.explanation:
My afternoon? Oh, I have it all planned. My sister suggested the new museum, but honestly, queuing behind school groups on a sunny day like this? No, thank you — the paintings will still be there in winter. And staying home felt like a waste of this weather. So I've booked myself onto the city tour instead — the open-top bus, the old quarter, the cathedral, all of it. Two hours of playing tourist in my own town. I've even charged my camera!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Go on a city tour.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I've booked myself onto the city tour instead — the open-top bus, the old quarter, the cathedral, all of it".
• Visit a museum sai: là gợi ý của chị gái, bị từ chối vì phải xếp hàng giữa ngày nắng ("queuing behind school groups on a sunny day like this? No, thank you").
• Relax at home sai: cô thấy ở nhà là phí thời tiết đẹp ("staying home felt like a waste of this weather").
👉 Mẹo: dạng kế hoạch cá nhân — chọn hoạt động đi kèm động từ đã hành động thật ("I've booked"), không chọn thứ chỉ được gợi ý ("my sister suggested").

questions.prompt: Doctor's office is calling to change the appointment. When is the new appointment?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, this is a message from Doctor Hartley's office regarding your appointment. Unfortunately the doctor must attend a conference, so we need to reschedule you. Your original booking on Friday the fourteenth is cancelled. We first offered Thursday the thirtieth, but a slot has opened much sooner: Thursday the thirteenth, at ten in the morning — one day earlier than your original date. We've reserved it for you: Thursday the thirteenth. Please call to confirm. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Thursday 13th.
• Vì sao đúng: "a slot has opened much sooner: Thursday the thirteenth, at ten in the morning... We've reserved it for you: Thursday the thirteenth".
• On Friday 14th sai: là lịch cũ và đã bị hủy ("Your original booking on Friday the fourteenth is cancelled").
• On Thursday 30th sai: chỉ là lịch được đề nghị lúc đầu, sau đó có chỗ trống sớm hơn ("We first offered Thursday the thirtieth, but a slot has opened much sooner").
👉 Mẹo: phương án gồm thứ + ngày thì phải khớp cả hai. Cẩn thận cặp "Thursday 30th" và "Thursday 13th" — nghe cho rõ con số ngày, đừng dừng ở tên thứ.

questions.prompt: Max is calling his friend. How much can Max pay for the computer?
questions.explanation:
Hey, it's Max, calling about that computer you're selling for your brother. So, my budget — let me be straight with you. The price you listed, three hundred and fifty, is just beyond me right now, I'm sorry. I did think I could only manage one hundred and fifty at first, but my freelance payment arrived yesterday, so I've counted again. Two hundred and fifty — that I can pay, in cash, today. If that works for your brother, the computer has a new home. Call me back!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Two hundred and fifty — that I can pay, in cash, today".
• 150 pounds sai: là dự tính ban đầu, đã thay đổi sau khi nhận tiền freelance ("I did think I could only manage one hundred and fifty at first, but my freelance payment arrived yesterday").
• 350 pounds sai: đó là giá RAO, vượt khả năng của Max ("The price you listed, three hundred and fifty, is just beyond me right now").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "how much can X pay" hỏi KHẢ NĂNG CHI TRẢ, không phải giá bán. Tìm đúng cụm "I can pay / that I can manage".

questions.prompt: How long does it take to get to the station?
questions.explanation:
If you're coming to visit me, let me explain the way from the station properly, because people always misjudge it. The taxi drivers will tell you it takes twenty-five minutes — they mean by the ring road, with traffic, in their interest. On the town map it says fifteen minutes, but that's measured for some Olympic walker, I swear. Realistically, with a suitcase, at a human pace, it takes twenty minutes from my door to the station. Twenty minutes — plan for that and you'll be exactly on time.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 20 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "Realistically, with a suitcase, at a human pace, it takes twenty minutes from my door to the station".
• 15 minutes sai: là con số ghi trên bản đồ, tính cho người đi bộ siêu nhanh ("On the town map it says fifteen minutes, but that's measured for some Olympic walker").
• 25 minutes sai: là con số tài xế taxi nói, đi vòng đường vành đai vì lợi ích của họ ("The taxi drivers will tell you it takes twenty-five minutes").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi thời lượng — mỗi con số nhiễu gắn với một NGUỒN không đáng tin (bản đồ, taxi). Đáp án đi kèm "realistically", "actually", "in fact".

questions.prompt: Who does she live with? / A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between Lisa and the speaker?
questions.explanation:
Everyone at the beach kept asking if Lisa and I were sisters — apparently we laugh the same way. We're not, though people also guess cousins because we call each other's mothers auntie. The truth is simpler and, I think, lovelier: we met on the first day of primary school, aged six, when she shared her crayons with me, and we've been inseparable ever since. Thirty years of shared holidays, secrets and terrible haircuts. Best friends — the family you choose yourself!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: "we met on the first day of primary school, aged six, when she shared her crayons with me, and we've been inseparable ever since... Best friends — the family you choose yourself!".
• Cousins sai: chỉ là phỏng đoán của người ngoài vì hai người gọi mẹ của nhau là dì ("people also guess cousins because we call each other's mothers auntie").
• Sisters sai: cũng là phỏng đoán ở bãi biển và đã bị phủ nhận ("Everyone at the beach kept asking if Lisa and I were sisters... We're not, though").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi quan hệ — mọi phương án đi kèm "people ask if / everyone guesses" đều là phỏng đoán sai. Sự thật nằm sau "The truth is".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his jobs. What does the man want to do next?
questions.explanation:
My CV confuses everyone, I know. Ten years as a chef — good years, but standing fourteen hours a day finally broke my back, so that door is closed for good. Then history teaching, which I loved until the paperwork swallowed my evenings. Friends keep betting on which career I'll return to. Neither! All those kitchens and classrooms left me full of stories, and I've already started typing them. My next job title, if everything goes well: writer. The first three chapters are done.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Become a writer.
• Vì sao đúng: "My next job title, if everything goes well: writer. The first three chapters are done".
• Become a chef sai: nghề cũ, đã đóng lại vĩnh viễn vì lưng hỏng ("standing fourteen hours a day finally broke my back, so that door is closed for good").
• Become a history teacher sai: cũng là quá khứ, bỏ vì giấy tờ ngốn hết buổi tối ("which I loved until the paperwork swallowed my evenings").
👉 Mẹo: cụm "My next job title is / my next chapter is" chính là câu trả lời cho "what next". Mọi nghề kèm số năm kinh nghiệm đều là chuyện đã qua.

questions.prompt: What will she do?
questions.explanation:
What a strange Saturday this is turning out to be! The office called asking if I could come in for a few hours — on my day off, imagine — and I said absolutely not, Saturdays are sacred. Then I thought about just staying home with a book, but the sun through the window kept teasing me. So, decision made: I'm taking the car out for a drive along the coast road, windows down, my playlist on. Maybe lunch in that fishing village. The book can wait for a rainy day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go for a drive.
• Vì sao đúng: "So, decision made: I'm taking the car out for a drive along the coast road, windows down, my playlist on".
• Go to work sai: cô đã từ chối lời đề nghị đi làm ngày nghỉ ("I said absolutely not, Saturdays are sacred").
• Stay home sai: có nghĩ tới nhưng bỏ vì trời quá đẹp ("I thought about just staying home with a book, but the sun through the window kept teasing me").
👉 Mẹo: kế hoạch thật luôn nằm sau cụm chốt "So, decision made / So that's settled". Hai ý trước đó, dù nghe rất hợp lý, đều đã bị loại.

questions.prompt: How much are the eggs?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to the market, dear! You're asking about my eggs? Let me tell you honestly, because prices jumped everywhere this month. The supermarket wants two pounds for their pale little things, and the organic shop across the road — three pounds, daylight robbery! Mine are from my own hens, fresh this morning, and I charge one pound fifty for the box. One fifty, best eggs in the market. Take two boxes and I'll add a little honey jar for your tea!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1.50 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Mine are from my own hens, fresh this morning, and I charge one pound fifty for the box. One fifty, best eggs in the market".
• 2 pounds sai: đó là giá của siêu thị ("The supermarket wants two pounds for their pale little things").
• 3 pounds sai: là giá cửa hàng thực phẩm hữu cơ bên kia đường ("the organic shop across the road — three pounds, daylight robbery!").
👉 Mẹo: khi người bán so sánh giá, mỗi con số gắn với một nơi bán khác nhau. Câu hỏi hỏi giá của NGƯỜI ĐANG NÓI thì lấy số đi kèm "Mine / I charge".

questions.prompt: Lalia is talking to her friend about her upcoming trip. How much does she think the bus fare will be?
questions.explanation:
Man: So, Lalia, is everything ready for your trip tomorrow?
Woman: Almost! I'm just working out my money for the day. The big cost is the bus to the coast.
Man: My cousin did that route last month — he paid four fifty, I think.
Woman: That was the express with the reserved seats! I'm taking the ordinary morning bus.
Man: Ah. Someone told me that one costs three pounds now, after the price rise.
Woman: They raised it, yes, but only on weekends. Tomorrow is Tuesday, so I think the fare will be two pounds fifty, same as always. I've kept the exact coins ready!
Man: Organised as ever. Send me photos from the beach!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – £2.5.
• Vì sao đúng: câu hỏi hỏi cô ấy NGHĨ giá bao nhiêu — "Tomorrow is Tuesday, so I think the fare will be two pounds fifty, same as always".
• £3 sai: đó là giá sau khi tăng nhưng chỉ áp dụng cuối tuần ("They raised it, yes, but only on weekends").
• £4.5 sai: là giá xe express có ghế đặt trước, không phải xe buýt thường cô đi ("That was the express with the reserved seats!").
👉 Mẹo: đọc kỹ câu hỏi — "how much does she THINK" nên đáp án phải là con số cô ấy nói kèm "I think", không phải con số do người khác đưa ra.

questions.prompt: Nate is on the phone with his friend. How long does Nate stay in India?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Nate! I heard you're finally doing the India trip. How long will you be gone?
Man: It's happening! You know, the original plan was just three days for the wedding in Delhi.
Woman: Three days for India? That would be criminal.
Man: Exactly what my cousin said! So I looked at one week — wedding plus the Taj Mahal and Jaipur.
Woman: And? I hear something bigger in your voice.
Man: My boss approved all my remaining leave this morning. So it's official: two weeks! Wedding, the golden triangle, and five days in Kerala on the backwaters.
Woman: Two weeks in India! I'm officially jealous. Bring me tea from the mountains!
Man: A whole box, promised.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 2 weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "My boss approved all my remaining leave this morning. So it's official: two weeks!".
• 3 days sai: là kế hoạch ban đầu, chỉ để dự đám cưới ("the original plan was just three days for the wedding in Delhi").
• 1 week sai: là phương án trung gian anh từng cân nhắc ("So I looked at one week — wedding plus the Taj Mahal and Jaipur").
👉 Mẹo: dạng kế hoạch "nở dần" (3 ngày → 1 tuần → 2 tuần) — đáp án là con số cuối cùng, thường đi kèm "it's official", "in the end", "so it's settled".

questions.prompt: Two friends are discussing a movie they recently watched. What elements of the film do they agree on?
questions.explanation:
M: So — last night's film! Give me your honest review.
W: Mixed, honestly. The music first: that piano theme carried the whole story for me.
M: Really? The music kept drowning the dialogue — I missed half the lines because of it.
W: Philistine. The characters, then? The old captain was wonderful.
M: He mumbled for two hours! I couldn't warm to any of them, honestly.
W: We agree on nothing, as usual. Except... admit it about the ending.
M: Ah, the ending. The silent scene on the bridge? I sat through the credits without moving.
W: Same! I actually gasped. So: music no, characters no — but the ending, we both loved.
M: The ending was perfect. One out of three — that's harmony for us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The ending.
• Vì sao đúng: cả hai cùng khen phần kết — "The silent scene on the bridge? I sat through the credits without moving" / "Same! I actually gasped", và tổng kết "the ending, we both loved".
• The music sai: hai người trái ngược — cô khen chủ đề piano, anh chê nhạc át lời thoại ("The music kept drowning the dialogue — I missed half the lines").
• The characters sai: cô khen ông thuyền trưởng, anh chê lí nhí và không thấy gần gũi ("He mumbled for two hours! I couldn't warm to any of them").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "agree on" — nghe các dấu hiệu bất đồng (Really? / I couldn't...) để loại, rồi bắt cụm đồng thuận: "Same!", "Exactly", "we both loved".

questions.prompt: A man is talking to the shopping assistant. What color top does he buy?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Welcome back! Did you decide on the top you looked at yesterday?
Man: Almost. The red one still calls to me — but my wife says red makes me look like a traffic light.
Woman: Ha! We do have it in blue, the exact same cut. Very popular this season.
Man: Blue... I tried it on. It's nice, but I own four blue tops already, according to this morning's wardrobe inspection.
Woman: Then may I suggest the black? Same fabric, and black never argues with anything in a wardrobe.
Man: Black. Safe, elegant, wife-approved. You know what, yes — the black one, size medium.
Woman: Excellent choice. Shall I wrap it, or will you wear the peace treaty home?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "You know what, yes — the black one, size medium", sau gợi ý "may I suggest the black? Same fabric, and black never argues with anything".
• Red sai: vợ anh chê trông như đèn giao thông ("my wife says red makes me look like a traffic light").
• Blue sai: anh đã có sẵn bốn áo xanh ("I own four blue tops already, according to this morning's wardrobe inspection").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại mua quần áo hay dùng lý do hài hước để loại từng màu. Cứ chờ câu có cỡ áo đi kèm ("size medium") — màu ở câu đó là màu được mua.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about shopping online. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: My little village has one bus a day and no real shops, so the delivery van has changed my life. Whatever I order appears at my gate within the week — garden tools, birthday presents, even my dog's special food. The driver knows my house so well he waves at my kitchen window. That magic trick of things simply arriving at my door is the whole reason I shop this way.
Speaker B: I refuse to pay full price for anything, and the internet is where the bargains live. Every evening I check three comparison sites the way other people check the news. The same television my brother bought in town cost me eighty pounds less, delivered. Add the voucher codes and the end-of-season sales, and my yearly savings would pay for a small holiday. My motto is simple: whoever pays the shop price simply has not looked.
Speaker C: I manage a restaurant, which means my days off are rare and short. Shopping in town would eat those precious hours — instead I clear my whole list in the taxi between shifts. Groceries ordered at midnight, shoes chosen while the pasta boils. What used to cost me an afternoon now costs minutes squeezed into the gaps of my day. Those saved hours go to my daughter, and no shop window could compete with that.
Speaker D: I collect vinyl records, and no town on earth stocks what I am hunting for. Online, I wander through shops in Tokyo, Berlin and Chicago without leaving my chair — pressings I had only read about, colours and editions I never knew existed. Last month I finally found a Brazilian record I had chased for nine years. When the hunt matters, the endless online catalogue beats every physical shelf in the country.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = products are delivered (keyword "delivery van... arriving at my door"). B = it is cheaper (keyword "bargains... eighty pounds less"). C = it saves time (PARAPHRASE: "costs minutes squeezed into the gaps... saved hours"). D = it has more choices (PARAPHRASE: "shops in Tokyo, Berlin and Chicago... editions I never knew existed"). Nhiễu: easy to return, safer than cash.

questions.prompt: Auditions are most important for an actor's career.
questions.explanation:
W: Hi Steve. You've directed so many successful films recently. For me, it's the auditions that make the difference — a good audition is what gives you a great cast, and a great cast is what makes a film stay with the audience. Would you agree?
M: Everyone assumes it's the casting stage, or the special effects, or the beautiful photography, but I don't think so. I've never put much faith in auditions. A lot of actors these days believe that their work on screen is proof enough of what they can do, and I tend to agree with them.
W: So how do you get to know an actor, then?
M: I watch their earlier work, and then I ask them to read a scene from the script. That's how I find out whether someone can really become the character or not.
W: What about improvisation? I'd rather let them improvise — that's when you see what an actor is truly capable of. Performing a scene from a script they've just been handed feels a bit forced to me.
M: I don't agree. When the script is strong enough, a great performance emerges by itself. Actors respond to good writing.
W: Anyway, you've worked with actors from the theatre as well, haven't you? Do you think stage actors really do well on film?
M: They have wonderful expressions and a very strong voice — theatrical, you know. But being a great stage actor doesn't mean you'll be a great screen actor. The two are quite different crafts.
W: True. And another thing — I think actors these days get far too little praise from people. Wouldn't you agree?
M: Yes. I think one way to help actors improve is to give them constructive feedback, and people tend to overlook how much recognition matters to them.
W: So we should praise them as much as possible. It's the best way to recognise their effort.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: W-M-B-B.
1. Auditions most important → The woman: "For me, it's the auditions that make the difference... what gives you a great cast". Người đàn ông phản bác: "I've never put much faith in auditions... their work on screen is proof enough".
2. Respond best to strong scripts → The man: "When the script is strong enough, a great performance emerges by itself". Người phụ nữ ngược lại: "I'd rather let them improvise".
3. Theater vs screen different → Both: anh "The two are quite different crafts", cô đồng ý "True".
4. Praised as much as possible → Both: cô mở "far too little praise", anh "Yes... people tend to overlook how much recognition matters", cô chốt "praise them as much as possible".
👉 Mẹo: câu 1 là bẫy "người hỏi Would you agree? ≠ được đồng ý" — nghe câu trả lời "but I don't think so" để loại Both; câu 2 bắt cặp đối lập script vs improvise.

questions.prompt: Actors tend to respond best to strong and engaging scripts.
Theater acting and screen acting are quite different from each other.
Actors should be praised and recognized as much as possible.
What is one of the main criticisms of the Regional Development Plan?
options: It will remove several public parks in the area
It makes public transportation more expensive for residents
It doesn't do enough to promote alternatives to driving
questions.explanation:
Welcome back to our community forum. Tonight we are discussing the proposed Regional Development Plan, and I want to begin by clearing up some rumours. Some residents heard that the plan would remove several public parks in the area. That is not in the document — every existing park stays. Others worried that it would make public transportation more expensive. Again, not true; ticket prices are not part of this plan at all. The criticism that people are actually making, and making loudly, is different: the plan does not do enough to promote alternatives to driving. Look through the pages and you will see new roads, wider roads, and more parking. What you will hardly find are new bus routes, safe cycle lanes, or streets designed for walking. For a city that says it wants cleaner air, that balance seems wrong, and I understand why residents keep raising their hands at every meeting to say so.
The city council has its own worry, and it is a practical one. You might expect strong opposition from local businesses, but in fact most shop owners support the plan, hoping it brings more customers. Nor is money the issue — so far the project remains inside its budget. The real challenge is land. There are large empty areas in the city centre, old warehouses and unused plots, that could be developed first. Instead, the plan spreads outward into the countryside. Several council members argue this means the plan is simply not making efficient use of the land we already have, and until that changes, they will not vote for it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It doesn't do enough to promote alternatives to driving. Bẫy: "remove public parks" là tin đồn bị bác ("not in the document"), "public transportation more expensive" bị bác ("not part of this plan").
2. Đáp án: The plan is not making efficient use of existing land. Bẫy: "opposition from local businesses" bị phủ định ("most shop owners support"), "exceeded budget" bị phủ định ("remains inside its budget").

questions.prompt: What challenge is the Regional Development Plan likely to face?
options: It has faced strong opposition from local businesses
The plan has already exceeded its budget by a large margin
The plan is not making efficient use of existing land

questions.prompt: What is the expert's opinion about sport competitions?
options: Nurture potential sportsmen for the country.
questions.explanation:
Are sports good or bad for children? As a child development researcher, I hear this question every week, and my answer always starts the same way: it depends on what kind of sport we mean. Let me first mention two arguments you often hear from school boards. Some say sports programmes provide schools with external investments, since local companies love putting their names on a young team's shirts. Others believe school sports exist to nurture future champions for the country. Both things can happen, but neither is the point, and chasing them can actually cause damage. Because here is my honest view about sport competitions for young children: they can cause harmful effects. When every game ends with a ranking, children are constantly compared with each other — who is better, who is worse. For a nine-year-old, losing week after week in front of friends can hurt confidence far more than adults realise. Many children do their best learning in friendly, active environments where cooperation matters more than winning.
So what is my advice for schools? Some head teachers want to make sport a mandatory subject with grades and exams; others quietly push children to focus only on their academic subjects and treat sport as wasted time. I disagree with both. The real value of sport in school is that it provides children with a balance in their lives. After hours of sitting, reading and memorising, the playground is where the body wakes up and the mind rests. Schools that protect that balance — without turning it into another competition — raise healthier and, in the end, better-performing students.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: They can cause harmful effects. Bẫy: "external investments" và "nurture sportsmen" đều được nhắc là lập luận của người khác rồi bị gạt ("neither is the point").
2. Đáp án: Provides them with a balance in their lives. Bẫy: "mandatory subject" và "focus on academic subjects" đều bị phản đối trực tiếp ("I disagree with both").

questions.prompt: What is the expert's advice for schools?
options: Should consider sports as a mandatory subject.
Provides them with a balance in their lives.
Keep students focus on academic subjects

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
questions.explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

questions.prompt: Linda is talking about what she likes to eat. What does she have for lunch?
questions.explanation:
My eating day is a bit unusual, people say. Breakfast is my big coffee moment — two cups, no negotiation, or I'm useless all morning. For lunch, though, I keep things gentle: just a large pot of tea with my sandwiches, green tea usually, sometimes with a little honey. Coffee after midday makes my heart race. And juice? Only at weekends, fresh orange with breakfast, when there's time to squeeze it properly. Simple habits, happy stomach!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "For lunch, though, I keep things gentle: just a large pot of tea with my sandwiches, green tea usually".
• Coffee sai: đó là đồ uống bữa SÁNG, và cô tránh cà phê sau trưa ("Breakfast is my big coffee moment... Coffee after midday makes my heart race").
• Juice sai: chỉ uống cuối tuần cùng bữa sáng ("Only at weekends, fresh orange with breakfast").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi giới hạn bữa ăn ("for lunch") — nghe các mốc breakfast / lunch / at weekends rồi chỉ lấy đồ uống gắn đúng mốc được hỏi.

questions.prompt: Listen to the chef announce to students. When is lunch ready?
questions.explanation:
Attention, students, a quick announcement about today's schedule from the kitchen. I know the timetable on the wall still says lunch at twelve thirty — please ignore it, that was last term. And no, the rumour about one fifteen is wrong too; that's when the second-year group eats. For everyone in this hall, lunch will be ready at two o'clock sharp. The menu today is chicken rice and vegetable soup. Two o'clock, main dining room. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 2:00 p.m.
• Vì sao đúng: "For everyone in this hall, lunch will be ready at two o'clock sharp... Two o'clock, main dining room".
• 12:30 p.m sai: là lịch cũ còn dán trên tường ("the timetable on the wall still says lunch at twelve thirty — please ignore it, that was last term").
• 1:15 p.m sai: là giờ ăn của khối năm hai, không phải nhóm này ("that's when the second-year group eats").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo trong trường hay gài "giờ trên bảng" và "giờ của nhóm khác". Chỉ lấy giờ đi kèm đúng đối tượng được hỏi ("for everyone in this hall").

questions.prompt: A woman tells her friend about her plans for the day. What is the woman going to do?
questions.explanation:
So my plan for today, since you ask! This morning I'm treating myself properly: I'm meeting my sister at that new place by the river to have coffee — they roast their own beans, apparently the smell alone is worth the visit. We'll sit outside if the sun holds. Lunch I'll just grab something small at home later, nothing planned. And you know I'm not a tea person at all — one coffee done well beats a whole teapot. Wish me a sunny morning!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Have coffee.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm meeting my sister at that new place by the river to have coffee — they roast their own beans".
• Have lunch sai: bữa trưa không có kế hoạch, chỉ ăn tạm ở nhà ("Lunch I'll just grab something small at home later, nothing planned").
• Drink tea sai: cô khẳng định không thích trà ("you know I'm not a tea person at all — one coffee done well beats a whole teapot").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi kế hoạch — chọn hoạt động có chi tiết cụ thể (đi với ai, ở đâu). Hoạt động đi kèm "nothing planned" hoặc lời phủ định sở thích chắc chắn là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Linda is talking about her mother. What do mother and daughter have in common?
questions.explanation:
People who meet my mother and me always look for the resemblance and give up — she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark, nothing alike on the outside. And our characters? Complete opposites: she's calm as a lake, I explode like a kettle. But spend one Sunday with us and you'll see what we truly share: the same passions. Gardening, old detective novels, hill walking, terrible historical films — we love every one of them together. Same interests, different everything else!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Similar interests.
• Vì sao đúng: "you'll see what we truly share: the same passions. Gardening, old detective novels, hill walking, terrible historical films".
• Similar appearance sai: ngoại hình hoàn toàn khác ("she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark, nothing alike on the outside").
• Similar personalities sai: tính cách trái ngược ("Complete opposites: she's calm as a lake, I explode like a kettle").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "have in common" — quét các cụm tương phản (nothing alike, complete opposites) để loại, rồi bắt cụm khẳng định "what we truly share is...".

questions.prompt: Listen to the speaker talking on the radio. What is she talking about?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, listeners! Today I want to share something ordinary that changed my mornings completely: the way I get to work. For years it was forty grumpy minutes on a packed bus. Then I moved, and now my journey is a walk along the canal, past the boats and the fishermen, twenty-five minutes door to door. I arrive calmer than any meditation app ever made me. Tomorrow I'll talk about my weekend plans, but today — it's all about that daily journey.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Her journey to work.
• Vì sao đúng: "Today I want to share something ordinary that changed my mornings completely: the way I get to work" và chốt "today — it's all about that daily journey".
• Her weekend plans sai: đó là chủ đề của NGÀY MAI ("Tomorrow I'll talk about my weekend plans").
• Her favorite hobby sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "what is she talking about" — bám mốc thời gian today/tomorrow. Chủ đề gắn với "tomorrow I'll talk about" luôn là bẫy.

questions.prompt: Listen to the woman talking about her holiday plans. Where is she going next?
questions.explanation:
My holiday map is filling up nicely this year! In spring I did the east coast — the fishing villages, the morning markets, wonderful seafood. Last month I went north for the mountain festivals, and nearly froze, but the views repaid every shiver. Now I'm packing again: next week I'm heading to the south, finally. Everyone praises the southern beaches and the little islands, and I've booked a boat trip between them. The south in September — they say it's perfect!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The south.
• Vì sao đúng: "next week I'm heading to the south, finally... The south in September — they say it's perfect!".
• The east sai: chuyến đi mùa xuân, đã xong ("In spring I did the east coast — the fishing villages, the morning markets").
• The north sai: chuyến tháng trước, cũng đã xong ("Last month I went north for the mountain festivals").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "where next" — lọc theo thì của động từ: did / went = đã đi (loại); I'm heading, next week = sắp đi (chọn).

questions.prompt: Listening to a woman's announcement. Where will they wait for the bus?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, everyone, your attention please for tomorrow's departure. About the bus: I know some groups wait behind the hotel where the staff car park is — not us, the coach cannot turn there. And please don't gather at the side entrance either; it will be locked before breakfast. We will all wait by the hotel's main entrance, under the big clock, at eight sharp. By the main entrance, luggage ready. The driver will not wait for latecomers!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the hotel's main entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "We will all wait by the hotel's main entrance, under the big clock, at eight sharp. By the main entrance, luggage ready".
• Behind the hotel's main entrance sai: phía sau khách sạn là bãi đỗ xe nhân viên, xe khách không quay đầu được ("not us, the coach cannot turn there").
• By the hotel's side entrance sai: cửa hông sẽ bị khóa trước bữa sáng ("please don't gather at the side entrance either; it will be locked before breakfast").
👉 Mẹo: các phương án chỉ khác nhau ở giới từ (behind / by) và bộ phận (main / side). Phải nghe trọn cụm giới từ + danh từ, đừng dừng ở từ "entrance".

questions.prompt: Listen to a woman giving advice on saving money. What advice does she give to save money?
questions.explanation:
Today's money tip for my listeners, and it's the one I repeat the most! People expect me to say buy in bulk — but half those giant packets go stale before you finish them, I've wasted more rice than I can admit. And putting money into the bank? Sensible, but with today's interest it's storage, not saving. My real advice: use public transport! Add up petrol, parking, insurance and repairs — a monthly travel card costs a fraction of all that. Hundreds saved, every month, guaranteed.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Use the public transport.
• Vì sao đúng: "My real advice: use public transport! Add up petrol, parking, insurance and repairs — a monthly travel card costs a fraction of all that".
• Buy in bulk sai: bị bác vì đồ mua nhiều hay hỏng trước khi dùng hết ("half those giant packets go stale before you finish them").
• Put money into the bank sai: lãi suất hiện tại quá thấp, chỉ là cất giữ chứ không sinh lời ("with today's interest it's storage, not saving").
👉 Mẹo: bài tư vấn trên radio thường mở đầu bằng "People expect me to say..." — mọi thứ sau cụm đó là bẫy. Đáp án nằm sau "My real advice is".

questions.prompt: Two colleges talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
questions.explanation:
Man: We really need to sit down about the project. When works for you?
Woman: This week is madness. Saturday? I'm free after lunch.
Man: Saturday I'm at my nephew's birthday, sadly. Sunday then?
Woman: Sunday my parents visit, it's sacred. What about next week, early?
Man: Tuesday? The office is quiet on Tuesdays, we'd have the meeting room to ourselves.
Woman: Tuesday... yes, actually. Nine o'clock, before the phones start ringing?
Man: Perfect. Tuesday at nine, meeting room, coffee on me.
Woman: Deal. I'll bring the folders.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Tuesday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Tuesday? The office is quiet on Tuesdays, we'd have the meeting room to ourselves" – "Tuesday... yes, actually" – "Perfect. Tuesday at nine".
• On Saturday sai: anh bận dự sinh nhật cháu ("Saturday I'm at my nephew's birthday, sadly").
• On Sunday sai: cô có bố mẹ tới thăm, không thể đổi ("Sunday my parents visit, it's sacred").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "when do they meet" — theo dõi tới khi thấy một mốc được CẢ HAI đồng ý và kèm chi tiết bổ sung (giờ cụ thể, phòng họp). Đó mới là chốt.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his teacher to meet for the assignment. When is the meeting?
questions.explanation:
Man: Good afternoon, Professor. I'm calling about my assignment — could we meet to discuss it?
Woman: Of course. Let me look at my diary. Tuesday morning I have a faculty meeting, so that's out.
Man: I understand. What about Thursday? I'm free all day.
Woman: Thursday afternoon I teach until six... but Thursday morning is open. Ten o'clock?
Man: Thursday morning at ten, perfect. Your office?
Woman: My office, third floor. Bring your draft and the reading list.
Man: I will. Thank you, Professor — see you Thursday morning!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Thursday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "Thursday morning is open. Ten o'clock?" – "Thursday morning at ten, perfect".
• On Tuesday morning sai: cô giáo có họp khoa ("Tuesday morning I have a faculty meeting, so that's out").
• On Thursday afternoon sai: chiều thứ Năm cô dạy đến 6h ("Thursday afternoon I teach until six").
👉 Mẹo: khi các phương án cùng một ngày nhưng khác buổi, phải nghe trọn cụm "ngày + morning/afternoon". Chỉ nghe được chữ "Thursday" là dính bẫy ngay.

questions.prompt: Listen to the conversation between Douglas and Kay. Why does Douglas call Kay?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Hello, Kay speaking.
Man: Kay! It's Douglas. Do you have a minute?
Woman: For you, always. Is this about borrowing my projector again?
Man: No no, no favors today, I promise. And before you ask — I'm not calling to arrange another meeting either; our calendar is full enough.
Woman: Now I'm curious!
Man: I'm calling to say thank you, properly. The report you helped me fix last week — the directors loved it. It got approved this morning, and that was your doing.
Woman: Douglas, that's so kind! You did the hard part.
Man: We both know better. Lunch is on me next week — no favors, no meetings, just gratitude.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – say thank you.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm calling to say thank you, properly. The report you helped me fix last week — the directors loved it".
• ask for a favor sai: anh phủ nhận ngay từ đầu ("No no, no favors today, I promise").
• suggest a meeting sai: cũng bị anh loại trước ("I'm not calling to arrange another meeting either; our calendar is full enough").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "why does X call" — người gọi thường loại trừ hai mục đích giả trước. Nghe được cụm "I'm calling to..." là chốt được ngay.

questions.prompt: Listen to the conversation about the directions. Where is the library located?
options: On the left of the square
questions.explanation:
Man: Excuse me, could you help me? I'm looking for the city library.
Woman: Of course! You're almost there. You see the main square ahead?
Man: Yes, with the fountain. Someone told me the library is behind the square somewhere.
Woman: That's the old building — it's a museum now. And it's not the big white one in front of the square either; that's the town hall.
Man: So where do I go?
Woman: Look to the left of the square — the red brick building with the tall windows. That's the library, entrance under the arch.
Man: On the left, red brick. Wonderful, thank you so much!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On the left of the square.
• Vì sao đúng: "Look to the left of the square — the red brick building with the tall windows. That's the library" và người hỏi nhắc lại "On the left, red brick".
• In front of the square sai: tòa nhà trắng phía trước là tòa thị chính ("it's not the big white one in front of the square either; that's the town hall").
• Behind the square sai: đó là tòa nhà thư viện CŨ, nay thành bảo tàng ("That's the old building — it's a museum now").
👉 Mẹo: bài hỏi đường luôn có hai tòa nhà nhiễu kèm chức năng khác (museum, town hall). Hãy ghép cặp "vị trí + đặc điểm tòa nhà" (bên trái + gạch đỏ) rồi mới chọn.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about online shopping. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: Between two jobs and three children, my week has no spare hours in it. A trip to the shopping centre used to swallow an entire Saturday morning — the drive, the parking, the queues at every till. Now I do the same list from my phone during my lunch break, in eleven minutes flat. Those rescued Saturday mornings belong to the playground now. For a person whose diary is full, that change is worth more than any discount.
Speaker B: I am the one in my family who compares everything, and the numbers always tell the same story. The jacket in the high-street window costs a third more than the identical one on my screen, and with the discount codes my daughter finds me, the gap grows even wider. Last month I furnished half the kitchen for what one shop wanted for the oven alone. My friends laugh at my spreadsheet — until they see my receipts.
Speaker C: My building has no lift and my knees are past their best, so what won me over is simple: everything arrives at my door. The rice, the washing powder, even the new armchair — a nice young man carries it up the stairs, and I sign with a smile. My daughter set the whole thing up for me two years ago. I have not dragged a heavy bag up those four floors since, and I do not miss it at all.
Speaker D: I live in a small town with exactly two clothes shops, and both stock the same five brands. Online, the shelf is endless — colours, sizes, styles, brands from countries I could not place on a map. Last week I found the exact model of running shoe my podiatrist recommended, in my width. The lady in our local shop just laughed and said she had never heard of it. That endless variety is what keeps me clicking.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = It saves time (PARAPHRASE: "eleven minutes flat... rescued Saturday mornings"). B = It is cheaper (PARAPHRASE: "costs a third more in the window... see my receipts"). C = Products are delivered (keyword "everything arrives at my door"). D = There are more choices (keyword "the shelf is endless... endless variety"). Nhiễu: easy to return, safer to pay online.

questions.prompt: Exhibitions should be different and diverse
questions.explanation:
M: I called in at the cultural centre on Saturday — it's the third show about the same pottery collection this year.
W: That's precisely my complaint about the place. What it badly needs is far more variety: a different subject every month, different communities, photography one week and textiles the next.
M: Hmm, I don't agree with you there, honestly. A small centre does far better going deep into one thing. Chopping and changing every few weeks would only baffle the regulars.
W: Baffle them? It would bring new faces through the door, which is rather the point.
M: We'll have to differ on that. What did strike me, though, is how little the old customs seem to mean to anyone now. They're quietly draining away — people go through the motions without the faintest idea why.
W: Yes, exactly, I'd say the very same. My grandmother could talk you through every stage of the harvest supper. Ask anybody under thirty and you get a blank look.
M: Which is why I'd go further, actually. Give it twenty years and the local festivals will have vanished completely. Gone, the lot of them.
W: Now hang on, I can't go along with that. Smaller crowds, yes, I'll accept that entirely. But disappearing altogether? No — they change shape and carry on. The village parade has been dying since my mother was a girl.
M: We'll see. My money's on the last one being somewhere around 2045.
W: You're such a pessimist.
M: Realistic. Anyway, the genuine answer to all this is schools. That's where the next generation is really formed, so if children are taught it properly at eleven, the whole thing survives.
W: I'm not convinced, to be honest. Schools are stretched to breaking point as it is, and children pick that sort of thing up at home, from their own families, not from a timetabled lesson.
M: Plenty of families pass nothing on at all these days, though.
W: Then that's where the centre should be putting its effort, not in a classroom.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: Triển lãm nên đa dạng = Woman · Phong tục truyền thống đang mất dần ý nghĩa = Both · Lễ hội địa phương sẽ biến mất = Man · Trường học quan trọng trong việc hình thành thế hệ sau = Man

1. Exhibitions should be different and diverse → Woman: người phụ nữ nêu "What it badly needs is far more variety: a different subject every month, different communities, photography one week and textiles the next." Người đàn ông phản đối: "Hmm, I don't agree with you there, honestly. A small centre does far better going deep into one thing."

2. Traditional customs are gradually losing their significance → Both: người đàn ông nêu "how little the old customs seem to mean to anyone now. They're quietly draining away", người phụ nữ tán thành rõ ràng: "Yes, exactly, I'd say the very same."

3. Local festivals will disappear in the near future → Man: người đàn ông nêu "Give it twenty years and the local festivals will have vanished completely. Gone, the lot of them." Người phụ nữ phản đối: "Now hang on, I can't go along with that... But disappearing altogether? No — they change shape and carry on."

4. Schools are important in shaping future generations → Man: người đàn ông nêu "the genuine answer to all this is schools. That's where the next generation is really formed, so if children are taught it properly at eleven, the whole thing survives." Người phụ nữ phản đối: "I'm not convinced, to be honest... children pick that sort of thing up at home, from their own families, not from a timetabled lesson."

👉 Mẹo: Bẫy chính ở ý 3 — người phụ nữ nhượng bộ "Smaller crowds, yes, I'll accept that entirely" rồi bác bỏ chính điều cần chọn (lễ hội biến mất), nên đáp án là Man chứ không phải Both.

questions.prompt: Traditional customs are gradually losing their significance
Local festivals will disappear in the near future
Schools are important in shaping future generations
What are the critic's opinions about the restaurant?
questions.explanation:
I have reviewed restaurants for many years, so I was genuinely looking forward to my evening at La Bella Bistro. Let me be fair first. The food was perfectly fine — the fish arrived fresh, the vegetables were crisp, and nobody could complain about the plate in front of them. The chef clearly knows what he is doing; you can taste years of experience in the sauces. So no, the kitchen is not the problem. The problem, and it is a serious one, is the service. From the moment I sat down, the staff seemed either too busy or too poorly trained to look after their guests. I waited twenty minutes for a glass of water, my questions about the menu were answered in a hurry, and when the main course finally arrived, the waiter had already turned away before I could say thank you. Good cooking cannot rescue an evening like that.
And this matters more than ever, because restaurants today are competing with food delivery apps. Some owners think the answer is organic ingredients, and others are experimenting with ready-made packs that customers can finish cooking at home. Those ideas are fine, but they miss the real point. The one thing an app can never deliver is the feeling of being truly valued and welcomed. A warm greeting at the door, a waiter who remembers your name, the sense that your visit actually matters — that is what makes people leave their sofa and book a table. Until La Bella Bistro understands this, its dining room will stay half empty.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The service is not good. Bẫy: "food is not fresh" bị phủ định ("arrived fresh"), "chef lacks experience" bị phủ định ("years of experience"). Phương án 3 sửa lại chính tả từ "The chief lack of experience".
2. Đáp án: Customers feel valued and welcome. Bẫy: "organic ingredients" và "ready-made pack" đều được nhắc là ý tưởng của chủ quán khác rồi bị gạt ("miss the real point").

questions.prompt: What can compete with online food delivery?
options: Providing a ready-made pack for customers

questions.prompt: What was the lecturer's opinion about both authors' past work?
options: They have both been overlooked by ACADEMICS.
They make reference to each other's work.
One was less successful than the other.
questions.explanation:
Today I want to talk about two writers who shaped modern literature, one from England and one from Argentina. Let me correct two common ideas about them straight away. First, some students think these authors have been overlooked by academics. In fact, universities on both sides of the Atlantic have studied their books for decades. Second, people sometimes assume that one of them was far less successful than the other. Not true either — both enjoyed large audiences during their lifetimes and both are still in print today. What genuinely connects them is something much more interesting: they make references to each other's work. In one writer's short stories you will find characters and ideas borrowed, with respect, from the other; and in the second writer's essays, whole passages reply to the first. Reading them side by side feels like listening to a long, friendly conversation carried on across an ocean.
There is one more thing every new reader should know. Some critics argue their reputation now goes far beyond their original target audience, and others complain that, given their talent, they should have been even more popular. Perhaps. But the honest warning is this: their books are not always easy, and the meanings are not always easily identified. Both writers loved symbols, hidden jokes and ideas buried under the surface of the story. You may need to read a chapter twice, or come back to a book years later, before it opens up. That difficulty is not a fault. It is exactly why readers and critics still argue about these two writers today.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: They make reference to each other's work. Bẫy: "overlooked by academics" bị phủ định ("universities have studied their books for decades"), "one was less successful" bị phủ định ("Not true either").
2. Đáp án: It is not always easy for the meanings to be identified. Bẫy: "reputation beyond target audience" và "should have been more popular" đều là ý kiến của người khác ("Perhaps") — người nói chốt ở độ khó của tác phẩm.

questions.prompt: What did the lecturer say about both authors?
options: Their reputation goes beyond their target audience.
They should have been more popular.
It is not always easy for the meanings to be IDENTIFIED.

questions.prompt: A woman is calling her husband. What time is lunch ready?
questions.explanation:
Hi darling, it's me. Change of plan for lunch, listen carefully! I told you one o'clock this morning, but the plumber is still here fixing the sink, so the kitchen is a battlefield. I first thought I'd push everything to three, but then your mother called — she's dropping by at three thirty. So: lunch will be ready at two, on the dot. Two o'clock, and don't be late, the fish doesn't wait. Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 2pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "So: lunch will be ready at two, on the dot. Two o'clock, and don't be late, the fish doesn't wait".
• 1pm sai: giờ hẹn ban đầu, hỏng vì thợ sửa ống nước còn đang làm ("I told you one o'clock this morning, but the plumber is still here fixing the sink").
• 3pm sai: có nghĩ tới nhưng bỏ vì mẹ chồng ghé lúc 3h30 ("I first thought I'd push everything to three, but then your mother called").
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn đổi giờ luôn theo mô-típ "giờ cũ – giờ định dời – giờ chốt". Chọn giờ đi kèm từ chốt "So:" và được nhắc lại ngay sau đó.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
questions.explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her job. How is being a writer different from other jobs?
options: She works at a desk all day
questions.explanation:
People imagine a writer's life as very organised, but let me describe my week honestly. My sister works nine to five and knows exactly when her day ends — I have never once had that. Nor do I sit at a desk all day like people think; half my writing happens walking, in cafés, on trains. The truth about this job is that the hours obey the story, not the clock. Some days I write from dawn; other days the words only arrive at midnight. Irregular — that is the writer's schedule.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – She works at irregular times.
• Vì sao đúng: "the hours obey the story, not the clock... Irregular — that is the writer's schedule".
• She works 9 to 5 sai: đó là công việc của EM GÁI cô ("My sister works nine to five and knows exactly when her day ends — I have never once had that").
• She works at a desk all day sai: bị phủ định, nửa thời gian cô viết khi đi bộ, ở quán, trên tàu ("Nor do I sit at a desk all day like people think").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "how is it different" — đáp án là câu tổng kết ở cuối bài. Chú ý cấu trúc đảo ngữ phủ định "Nor do I..." vì nó đang gạch một phương án.

questions.prompt: A receptionist is checking the client list of a clinic. How many American clients are there?
questions.explanation:
Right, doctor, tomorrow's client list before I lock up. Eight appointments. The Silva family — three of them — they're Brazilian, the little one needs the translator again. Then the two Canadians from the ski accident, both for check-ups. Mr. Miller at four — everyone assumes he's American, but he's corrected me twice: Australian. So across the whole list, exactly one American client: Mrs. Baker at ten, for her knee. Just the one. See you at eight, doctor!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – One.
• Vì sao đúng: "across the whole list, exactly one American client: Mrs. Baker at ten, for her knee. Just the one".
• Two sai: con số hai gắn với hai khách người Canada ("the two Canadians from the ski accident"), không phải người Mỹ.
• Three sai: con số ba gắn với gia đình Silva người Brazil ("The Silva family — three of them — they're Brazilian").
👉 Mẹo: dạng đếm theo quốc tịch luôn cài số của quốc tịch khác. Nghe được con số nào cũng phải tự hỏi "số này gắn với nước nào?" trước khi chọn. Cẩn thận Mr. Miller: ai cũng tưởng Mỹ nhưng bài nói rõ ông là người Úc.

questions.prompt: Listen to a girl calling the cafe. Where did she ask the coffee shop to look for her lost item?
questions.explanation:
Hello, Riverside Café? Thank goodness you picked up. I was there an hour ago and I've lost my purse — small, red leather. Could you check for me? Not by the counter where I paid, I already know I had it after that. And I doubt it's near the door, we didn't stop there. Please look in the corner, at the little table under the lamp where we sat all afternoon — I think it slipped behind the cushion. Yes, the corner table. I'll hold, thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – In the corner.
• Vì sao đúng: câu hỏi hỏi nơi cô NHỜ tìm — "Please look in the corner, at the little table under the lamp where we sat all afternoon... Yes, the corner table".
• On the counter sai: cô khẳng định sau khi trả tiền ở quầy thì ví vẫn còn ("Not by the counter where I paid, I already know I had it after that").
• Near the door sai: cô cho là khó xảy ra vì họ không dừng ở đó ("I doubt it's near the door, we didn't stop there").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "where did she ASK them to look" — chỉ lấy nơi đi kèm lời nhờ ("Please look in..."), không lấy những nơi cô tự loại trừ dù chúng cũng được nhắc tên.

questions.prompt: What is not original?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to the open house! Let me be transparent about this property, as the family asked. The home itself — walls, roof, those beautiful ceilings — all completely original from 1925, never rebuilt. Even the old bicycle in the garden shed belonged to the first owner; his grandson insists it stays with the house, original and still working! The furniture, however, is another story: everything you see was bought new by the current owners — not a single original piece remains. Shall we begin upstairs?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Furniture.
• Vì sao đúng: câu hỏi hỏi thứ KHÔNG nguyên bản — "The furniture, however, is another story: everything you see was bought new by the current owners — not a single original piece remains".
• Home sai: bản thân ngôi nhà nguyên bản từ 1925 ("walls, roof, those beautiful ceilings — all completely original from 1925, never rebuilt").
• Bicycle sai: chiếc xe đạp cũ cũng là đồ nguyên bản của chủ đầu tiên ("belonged to the first owner... original and still working").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi phủ định "What is NOT original?" — nghe từ nối đảo hướng "however", "but". Thứ đứng ngay sau nó chính là ngoại lệ cần chọn.

questions.prompt: What did she advice for people who lack motivation at work?
questions.explanation:
A listener asks what to do when motivation at work disappears — a question I hear every week! First, what NOT to do. Don't pile on additional responsibilities hoping pressure will wake you up; a tired mind just drowns faster. And a time management workshop? Useful for the organised, useless for the unmotivated — you'll plan beautifully and still feel empty. What actually works, in case after case: request a transfer. A new team inside your own company restarts the engine while keeping your security. Try that first.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Request a transfer.
• Vì sao đúng: "What actually works, in case after case: request a transfer. A new team inside your own company restarts the engine while keeping your security".
• Take on additional responsibilities sai: bị bác vì càng thêm áp lực càng đuối ("Don't pile on additional responsibilities hoping pressure will wake you up; a tired mind just drowns faster").
• Attend a time management workshop sai: chỉ hữu ích với người đã ngăn nắp, vô dụng với người mất động lực ("Useful for the organised, useless for the unmotivated").
👉 Mẹo: bài tư vấn thường tuyên bố rõ "First, what NOT to do". Mọi ý sau câu đó là nhiễu; đáp án nằm sau "What actually works".

questions.prompt: Where does she go shopping?
questions.explanation:
My shopping routine changed completely this spring! For years I dragged myself to the old department store in the centre — decent, but the same tired brands on every floor. My neighbour swears by the local market, and I do buy vegetables there, but for clothes and homeware? No. Since they opened the new shopping mall by the river, that's my place: eighty shops, a cinema, that glass roof! I go every Saturday morning now, before the crowds. My husband calls it my second home!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – at a new shopping mall.
• Vì sao đúng: "Since they opened the new shopping mall by the river, that's my place: eighty shops, a cinema... I go every Saturday morning now".
• at a department store sai: đó là thói quen CŨ nhiều năm trước, hàng hóa nhàm chán ("For years I dragged myself to the old department store in the centre — the same tired brands").
• at a local market sai: cô chỉ mua rau ở đó, không mua quần áo và đồ gia dụng ("I do buy vegetables there, but for clothes and homeware? No").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi thói quen hiện tại — bám cụm "since... now", loại "for years / used to". Cũng cảnh giác phương án đúng một phần (chợ: chỉ mua rau) vì vẫn tính là sai.

questions.prompt: What is her favorite thing to do in her spare time?
questions.explanation:
My free time is precious, so I spend it carefully. My husband is happiest watching films on the sofa, and I join him sometimes, but falling asleep before the ending every single time tells me something. Sports? My knees retired before I did.
