No — my heart belongs to the theatre. Every second Saturday, the red seats, the programme in my hand, that moment when the lights dim. Live actors, live mistakes, live magic. Films can wait at home; the stage cannot.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – going to the theatre.
• Vì sao đúng: "my heart belongs to the theatre. Every second Saturday, the red seats, the programme in my hand, that moment when the lights dim".
• watching a movie at home sai: đó là sở thích của CHỒNG cô, còn cô thì toàn ngủ gật ("My husband is happiest watching films on the sofa... falling asleep before the ending every single time").
• playing sports sai: cô đã bỏ vì đầu gối ("My knees retired before I did").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi sở thích cá nhân — loại ngay hoạt động gắn với người thân (my husband, my brother) và hoạt động nói ở thì quá khứ.

questions.prompt: What time is the meeting?
questions.explanation:
Man: Hi Susan, about the project meeting tomorrow — I have conflicting notes. Is it at two?
Woman: It was at two originally, but the clients' train doesn't arrive until half past.
Man: Ah. Someone in the office said three, then?
Woman: That was the backup plan, but the meeting room is booked by accounts at three.
Man: So where did we land?
Woman: Four o'clock, final answer. Room B, projector booked, and I've ordered coffee for five people.
Man: Four it is. I'll print the reports in the morning. Thanks, Susan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 4pm.
• Vì sao đúng: người phụ nữ chốt cuối cùng "Four o'clock, final answer" — và người đàn ông xác nhận lại "Four it is".
• 2pm sai: đó là giờ họp BAN ĐẦU, đã bị hủy vì tàu của khách hàng 2h30 mới tới ("It was at two originally, but...").
• 3pm sai: chỉ là phương án dự phòng, bị loại vì phòng họp đã có bộ phận kế toán đặt ("That was the backup plan, but...").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ/ngày luôn nhắc đủ 3 mốc. Bám vào từ chốt hạ như "final answer", "let's go with", "so we land at" và bỏ qua mốc nào đi kèm "originally", "backup", "but".

questions.prompt: Where do they go when they travel to India?
questions.explanation:
W: India in three weeks! Have you two planned the days yet?
M: Almost. Everyone keeps telling us to go to the mountains in the north...
W: The Himalayas! Surely that's the dream?
M: It was — until we counted the travel: two extra days on trains each way. Our week is just too short.
W: The beaches in the south, then? Palm trees, warm sea...
M: In THIS season? Forty degrees and full of jellyfish, my cousin warned us off completely.
W: So what's left?
M: The famous city park! The huge old gardens with the monuments and the parrots — we'll go to the park every single morning, it's ten minutes from the hotel.
W: A week of gardens and parrots... actually, that sounds perfect.
M: Exactly. The park is the plan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go to the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The famous city park! The huge old gardens with the monuments and the parrots — we'll go to the park every single morning" và chốt "Exactly. The park is the plan!".
• Go to the mountains sai: bị loại vì mất thêm hai ngày tàu mỗi chiều, chuyến đi chỉ có một tuần ("It was — until we counted the travel: two extra days on trains each way. Our week is just too short").
• Go to the beach sai: mùa này quá nóng và nhiều sứa ("In THIS season? Forty degrees and full of jellyfish, my cousin warned us off completely").
👉 Mẹo: dạng chọn điểm đến — mỗi nơi bị loại đều kèm một trở ngại cụ thể (thời gian di chuyển, thời tiết). Nơi đúng đi kèm câu chốt "... is the plan" hoặc "that's settled".

questions.prompt: Where did they meet?
questions.explanation:
Woman: You found the theatre alright last night? I looked for you at the interval!
Man: We nearly missed each other completely! I waited at the back entrance first — someone said the tickets were collected there.
Woman: Oh no, the back is only for the actors! And the side entrance?
Man: Locked, with a little sign pointing around the building. Very helpful in the rain!
Woman: Ha! So where did you finally find them?
Man: The front entrance, of course — under the big lights, where any sensible person would look first. My cousin was already there laughing at me, holding both tickets.
Woman: The front entrance, like every theatre since Shakespeare. You explorer!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The front entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The front entrance, of course — under the big lights... My cousin was already there laughing at me, holding both tickets".
• The back entrance sai: lối đó chỉ dành cho diễn viên ("Oh no, the back is only for the actors!").
• The side entrance sai: bị khóa, chỉ có tấm biển chỉ vòng ra chỗ khác ("Locked, with a little sign pointing around the building").
👉 Mẹo: các phương án chỉ khác nhau một tính từ (back/front/side). Nghe kỹ tính từ ngay trước danh từ chung, và bám vào nơi họ THỰC SỰ gặp nhau chứ không phải nơi tìm hụt.

questions.prompt: What time do they meet?
questions.explanation:
Man: Dinner tonight is confirmed! Now — the time. Eight o'clock like last month?
Woman: Eight was a disaster, remember? The kitchen was closing and we ate like racehorses.
Man: True. Seven, then? That's the classic hour.
Woman: Seven I'm still on the bus from my mother's, I'd arrive frazzled and starving.
Man: Then let's split the difference backwards — six thirty. The restaurant is quiet then, we get the window table, and the whole evening is ours.
Woman: Six thirty is perfect, actually. Early dinner, long talk, home before eleven like the adults we pretend to be.
Man: Six thirty, window table. Booked!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6.30pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "let's split the difference backwards — six thirty. The restaurant is quiet then" và chốt "Six thirty, window table. Booked!".
• 8.00pm sai: lần trước 8h là thảm họa vì bếp sắp đóng cửa ("Eight was a disaster, remember? The kitchen was closing and we ate like racehorses").
• 7.00pm sai: giờ đó cô còn trên xe buýt từ nhà mẹ về ("Seven I'm still on the bus from my mother's, I'd arrive frazzled and starving").
👉 Mẹo: giờ chốt thường đi kèm hành động đặt chỗ ("Booked!", "I'll book a table"). Nghe thấy động từ này là dừng phân vân, không cần nghe lại.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about protecting the environment. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: My rule is simple: nothing usable leaves this house in a rubbish bag. The clothes my sons outgrow go to the church collection, the old bookshelf went to a student down the road, and my ancient laptop now lives at the community centre. Last month a young couple collected our spare bed within an hour of my posting it. Watching things start a second life in someone else's home feels far better than watching a skip swallow them.
Speaker B: I read labels the way detectives read clues. Before anything enters my basket, I check where it was made, what the packaging is, whether the company behaves itself. I pay a little more for washing liquid that rivers can forgive and coffee that farmers were fairly paid for. My husband groans at how long shopping takes, but every purchase is a small vote, and I intend to vote well.
Speaker C: In my kitchen, nothing with a lid gets thrown away. The big yoghurt pots hold my soup portions in the freezer, glass jars keep the rice and lentils, and the ice-cream tubs — washed, of course — carry my lunches to work. My cupboard looks like a museum of old packaging, I admit. But I have not bought a plastic box in six years, and my leftovers never see a rubbish bin.
Speaker D: I stopped trusting those bright bottles under the sink years ago. Vinegar and baking soda handle my kitchen, lemon juice brightens the taps, and the floors get plain hot water with a drop of olive soap. The chemical sprays with their skull warnings have not entered this flat since my daughter was born. My windows shine just as well, and the air in here smells of lemons instead of a laboratory.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = give away used items (PARAPHRASE: "second life in someone else's home" — cho đồ cũ). B = buy environmentally friendly products (PARAPHRASE: "washing liquid that rivers can forgive... every purchase is a small vote"). C = reuse containers for storing food (keyword "pots hold... jars keep... carry my lunches"). D = not buy commercial cleaning products (keyword "bright bottles... chemical sprays... not entered this flat"). Nhiễu: recycle waste, public transport.

questions.prompt: Community design can influence people's behavior.
questions.explanation:
Woman: Have you walked through the new quarter by the river? Benches facing each other, wide steps where people sit with coffee, one little square where three streets meet. Since it opened, strangers actually talk to each other there. The way a place is laid out quietly steers what people do in it.
Man: I noticed the same thing on my own street, oddly enough. When they widened the pavement and added those two long tables, neighbours who had nodded at each other for years finally sat down together. Bricks and benches really do write the rules of behaviour. What people forget, though, is the clock. Everyone expects a neighbourhood to feel like family within a season. From what I have seen, real bonds between neighbours grow the way trees do — years, not months.
Woman: Perhaps, though I have seen friendships spark quickly too, so I would not insist on the years. Here is a thought you will probably fight me on: I think the group you belong to at the office and the group you belong to on your street are basically the same animal. Same trust, same favours, same gossip.
Man: There I do fight you! One is held together by salary and deadlines, the other by choice. Leave a job and watch how many colleagues remain in your life. But let us end on common ground: our phones have completely rewritten how groups form at all. My cycling club found each other online before we ever met.
Woman: True — half my closest circle began as usernames. The front door is digital now.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: B-M-W-B (giữ nguyên). Paraphrase:
1. "Design influences behavior" → B: "the way a place is laid out quietly steers what people do" + "Bricks and benches write the rules".
2. "Creating community takes time" → M: "grow the way trees do — years, not months" — W "would not insist on the years".
3. "Work = social communities" → W: "basically the same animal" — M "There I do fight you!".
4. "Technology changed how community forms" → B: "phones have rewritten how groups form" + "half my closest circle began as usernames".

questions.prompt: Creating community can take time.
Work communities and social communities are the same.
Technology has changed how community forms.
What should students do when choosing a career?
options: Choose the same career as their friends
Focus only on the salary offered
questions.explanation:
Good morning, graduates. Life after university can be exciting, but I will not pretend it is easy, so let me offer some honest advice about choosing a career. The most common mistake I see is students choosing the same career as their friends, simply because it feels safe to move in a group. The second mistake is looking only at the salary in the job advertisement and ignoring everything else about the role. I understand both temptations, but neither leads to a happy working life. A big salary in a job you hate becomes small very quickly, and your friends cannot live your career for you. What you should do instead is stay flexible and open-minded. Explore different industries, try roles you had never considered, and remember that your first job is only the first step on a much longer road. The people who do best after university are almost never the ones with a fixed plan; they are the ones who keep their eyes and options open.
Now, a word about the job market itself, because you deserve the truth. Yes, there are more opportunities for networking than ever before, with online platforms and career events everywhere. And yes, some jobs offer great benefits, from travel to flexible hours. But the single characteristic you must prepare for is this: the market is more competitive than it has ever been. Dozens of candidates apply for every good position, and a degree alone is no longer enough. Bring skills, bring experience, bring a positive attitude — and show clearly what makes you different.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: Be flexible and open minded. Bẫy: "choose the same career as friends" và "focus only on the salary" đều được nhắc là SAI LẦM phổ biến.
2. Đáp án: More competitive. Bẫy: "networking" và "great benefits" đều được công nhận có thật nhưng đặc điểm phải chuẩn bị là tính cạnh tranh ("the single characteristic you must prepare for").

questions.prompt: What is a common characteristic of the job market after university?
What is the main issue with the product's promotion campaign?
options: It is using outdated advertising methods
It is not targeting the correct market
questions.explanation:
Let me use a real example in today's marketing class: a fitness supplement called PowerBoost, launched three months ago. Its promotion campaign is in trouble, and it is worth understanding why. Some students suggested the company was using outdated advertising methods — but no, the campaign runs on all the modern channels, from short videos to influencer posts. Others guessed it was not targeting the correct market — wrong again; the ads reach exactly the young, active audience the product is made for. The real issue is that the advertisements make exaggerated claims. They promise a dramatic increase in strength within days, and when customers do not feel that miracle, they stop trusting the brand. A bold promise gets attention, but a broken promise loses a customer forever, and the online reviews now say exactly that.
The product has a second problem: it is struggling to stand out on the shelves. You might assume it is priced too high, but its price is almost identical to its competitors. You might think it is hard to find, but it is already available in most big stores. The truth is less comfortable: PowerBoost is simply too similar to many existing products. Same ingredients, same packaging style, same promises as a dozen other supplements. When customers cannot see what makes a product unique, they pick whichever one they already know. So the lesson for the company is clear — stop shouting louder, and start being genuinely different. Honest claims plus a real point of difference: that is what this campaign needs.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: They use exaggerated claims. Bẫy: "outdated advertising methods" bị phủ định ("runs on all the modern channels"), "not targeting the correct market" bị phủ định ("wrong again").
2. Đáp án: It is too similar to many existing products. Bẫy: "priced too high" bị phủ định ("almost identical"), "not available in enough stores" bị phủ định ("available in most big stores").

questions.prompt: Why is the product struggling to stand out in the market?
options: It is priced too high compared to its competitors
It is too similar to many existing products
It is not available in enough stores

questions.prompt: Which sports is she good at?
questions.explanation:
Sports day is coming and everyone assumes I'll enter everything — if only they knew! Running? I look enthusiastic for exactly one hundred metres, then the wheels fall off. Swimming lessons were even worse; the instructor said I fight the water instead of moving through it. But football — football is my kingdom. Left wing, eight years, top scorer for the district two seasons running. Put me on the grass with a ball and everything suddenly makes sense.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Football.
• Vì sao đúng: "football is my kingdom. Left wing, eight years, top scorer for the district two seasons running".
• Running sai: chỉ giữ được sức đúng 100m rồi đuối ("I look enthusiastic for exactly one hundred metres, then the wheels fall off").
• Swimming sai: huấn luyện viên nhận xét cô chống lại nước chứ không bơi ("the instructor said I fight the water instead of moving through it").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "good at" — tìm bằng chứng thành tích cụ thể (số năm, vị trí thi đấu, top scorer). Lời tự trào hài hước luôn báo hiệu môn KHÔNG giỏi.

questions.prompt: A mom is talking to her son. What does the son like to study?
questions.explanation:
Sweetheart, sit down, your school report came and I want to understand something. Your math teacher says you daydream through every equation, and the science marks are... let's not discuss the science marks. But then there's this note from Miss Vega: she says you're the most gifted student she's had in years, that you stay after class to keep painting, that your sketchbook never leaves your bag. Art, my love — is that what makes you happy? Then art is what we'll nurture.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art.
• Vì sao đúng: "she says you're the most gifted student she's had in years, that you stay after class to keep painting, that your sketchbook never leaves your bag. Art, my love".
• Math sai: cậu bé lơ đãng suốt giờ toán ("Your math teacher says you daydream through every equation").
• Science sai: điểm môn này tệ tới mức mẹ không muốn bàn ("the science marks are... let's not discuss the science marks").
👉 Mẹo: khi phụ huynh đọc học bạ, môn bị chê đứng trước, môn được khen đứng sau "But then there's this note from...". Bám từ nối "but" để định vị đáp án.

questions.prompt: How does he travel?
questions.explanation:
People always ask how I manage my monthly trips to see my parents, four hundred kilometres away. Driving I gave up years ago — the motorway traffic on Fridays turns three hours into six, and I arrive furious. Flying sounds fast, but with the airport transfers and the waiting, door to door it saves nothing. No, I've become a train man, completely. The seven o'clock express, a window seat, my book and a coffee — three peaceful hours and I step off rested. By train, always.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – By train.
• Vì sao đúng: "I've become a train man, completely. The seven o'clock express, a window seat, my book and a coffee... By train, always".
• By car sai: anh bỏ lái xe từ lâu vì kẹt xe thứ Sáu ("Driving I gave up years ago — the motorway traffic on Fridays turns three hours into six").
• By plane sai: tính cả di chuyển ra sân bay và thời gian chờ thì không nhanh hơn ("with the airport transfers and the waiting, door to door it saves nothing").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi phương tiện — mỗi lựa chọn bị loại đều kèm một bất lợi cụ thể (kẹt xe, chờ đợi). Đáp án đi kèm cảm xúc tích cực và trạng từ khẳng định "always, completely".

questions.prompt: What did the mother call her daughter to help her buy?
questions.explanation:
Hi sweetheart, thank goodness I caught you before the shop closes! Listen, I'm halfway through grandma's cake recipe and I've just opened an empty egg box — completely empty, and I need six! Don't worry about bread, the neighbour brought us a fresh loaf this morning, and we have two full bottles of milk. Just the eggs, darling — a dozen of the large ones, and check they're not cracked. Run before they close! You're saving Sunday dessert!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – eggs.
• Vì sao đúng: "I've just opened an empty egg box — completely empty, and I need six!... Just the eggs, darling — a dozen of the large ones".
• bread sai: hàng xóm đã mang bánh mì mới sang ("the neighbour brought us a fresh loaf this morning").
• milk sai: trong nhà còn nguyên hai chai ("we have two full bottles of milk").
👉 Mẹo: nghe cấu trúc "Don't worry about X... we have Y... Just the Z". Món đứng sau chữ "just" luôn là món cần mua.

questions.prompt: Where does Malik want to go?
questions.explanation:
It's Malik, leaving a message about this afternoon. Everyone keeps suggesting places and I want to be clear about where I actually need to go! The library — no, I returned all my books on Tuesday, nothing for me there. And the park picnic can wait for the weekend, tell the others. I need the town hall, before it closes at four! My residence permit is ready for collection, and if I miss today the office closes until Monday. So: town hall, half past three. Who's driving me?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "I need the town hall, before it closes at four! My residence permit is ready for collection" và chốt "So: town hall, half past three".
• The library sai: cậu đã trả hết sách hôm thứ Ba, không còn việc gì ở đó ("I returned all my books on Tuesday, nothing for me there").
• The park sai: buổi picnic để cuối tuần ("the park picnic can wait for the weekend, tell the others").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "where does he WANT to go" — chọn nơi gắn với động từ nhu cầu "I need..." và một việc gấp có hạn chót. Nơi đi kèm "can wait" là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: What area is he describing?
questions.explanation:
Let me describe my new neighbourhood, because people keep guessing wrong! It's not a shopping district — there's one bakery and a kiosk, that's the entire retail empire. And despite the quiet streets, it's no ordinary residential area either; nobody here is retired, believe me. This is a university area through and through: two faculties within walking distance, cheap cafés full of laptops, bicycles chained to every fence, and the streets buzzing with students until midnight. The average age must be about twenty-one!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A university area.
• Vì sao đúng: "This is a university area through and through: two faculties within walking distance, cheap cafés full of laptops, bicycles chained to every fence".
• A shopping district sai: cả khu chỉ có một tiệm bánh và một ki-ốt ("there's one bakery and a kiosk, that's the entire retail empire").
• A residential neighborhood sai: bị phủ định thẳng vì dân cư toàn người trẻ ("it's no ordinary residential area either; nobody here is retired").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "what area" — nghe các chi tiết định danh (faculties, students, bicycles) thay vì chờ tên gọi. Hai phương án nhiễu thường bị bác bằng "it's not... either".

questions.prompt: A man is talking to a friend about his plan to move abroad. What is his biggest problem?
questions.explanation:
The Canada plan is moving, my friend, but let me tell you where it hurts. The money side, surprisingly, is solved — the bank approved my financing last week, better rate than I hoped. Finding the right house? Easy, my cousin in Vancouver has already shortlisted three near his street. No, the wall I keep hitting is at my own dinner table. My wife's parents call it abandonment, my daughter cries about her friends. Persuading my family — that is the whole battle now.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "the wall I keep hitting is at my own dinner table... Persuading my family — that is the whole battle now".
• Finding the right house sai: anh họ ở Vancouver đã chọn sẵn ba căn ("my cousin in Vancouver has already shortlisted three near his street").
• Getting the financing sai: ngân hàng đã duyệt với lãi suất tốt hơn kỳ vọng ("the bank approved my financing last week, better rate than I hoped").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "biggest problem" — mọi thứ đi kèm "solved / already / approved" đều bị loại. Vấn đề thật đi kèm ẩn dụ khó khăn: the wall, the battle, the mountain.

questions.prompt: How much can Max pay for the computer?
questions.explanation:
Hey, it's Max again about the computer! I've done my sums properly this time, so here's my honest offer. Three hundred, like you're asking — I simply don't have it, not this month. And forget my first silly offer of two hundred, that was before payday, I apologise. Right now, cash in hand, I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, final and real. If that works, I'll collect it tonight and even bring the pizza. Let me know!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Right now, cash in hand, I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, final and real".
• 200 pounds sai: là lời trả giá đầu tiên đã bị chính Max rút lại ("forget my first silly offer of two hundred, that was before payday, I apologise").
• 300 pounds sai: là giá người bán đưa ra, Max không kham nổi ("Three hundred, like you're asking — I simply don't have it, not this month").
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt ba vai của con số: giá người bán đòi (you're asking), giá trả hụt (my first offer), giá thật (I can pay). Câu hỏi "how much can he pay" chỉ lấy vai thứ ba.

questions.prompt: Where does he want to go tomorrow?
questions.explanation:
Tomorrow is my precious day off, and I've been negotiating with myself all evening! The park was the first idea — but they're forecasting rain from noon, and wet grass is nobody's friend. Then the new cinema crossed my mind; tempting, but the film I want only starts next Friday. So the decision is made, and it's the sensible one: the town hall. The photography exhibition upstairs closes this week, free entry, and the building itself is beautiful. Town hall tomorrow — culture wins!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the decision is made, and it's the sensible one: the town hall. The photography exhibition upstairs closes this week, free entry".
• The park sai: dự báo mưa từ trưa ("they're forecasting rain from noon, and wet grass is nobody's friend").
• The cinema sai: bộ phim anh muốn xem tuần sau mới chiếu ("the film I want only starts next Friday").
👉 Mẹo: nghe thấy "So the decision is made" thì tập trung tối đa — địa điểm ngay sau đó là đáp án, mọi thứ trước đó chỉ là ý tưởng đã bị loại.

questions.prompt: When do they meet each other?
questions.explanation:
Woman: We need to go through the contract together. When are you free this week?
Man: Let me look... Monday morning I'm at the dentist, sadly. Nothing moves that appointment.
Woman: And I fly to the conference on Wednesday, so Wednesday morning is gone for me.
Man: That leaves Thursday. My morning is completely clear — nine, ten, whenever suits.
Woman: Thursday morning works! Nine thirty at my office? I'll have the papers ready.
Man: Nine thirty, Thursday morning. I'll bring my reading glasses and my patience!
Woman: You'll need both. See you then!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Thursday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "That leaves Thursday. My morning is completely clear" – "Thursday morning works! Nine thirty at my office?".
• On Monday morning sai: anh có hẹn nha sĩ không thể dời ("Monday morning I'm at the dentist, sadly. Nothing moves that appointment").
• On Wednesday morning sai: cô bay đi dự hội nghị ("I fly to the conference on Wednesday, so Wednesday morning is gone for me").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại sắp lịch loại dần từng ngày. Nghe cụm "That leaves..." là biết ngày còn lại chính là đáp án, không cần chờ hết bài.

questions.prompt: How many weeks did they spend in India?
questions.explanation:
Man: The India photos are finally sorted! Want to hear how the plan grew?
Woman: I remember you originally booked just one week, right?
Man: One week, yes — Delhi and the Taj, the classic. Then my brother said one week for India is like one minute in a museum.
Woman: So you stretched it. To three weeks? You were gone forever!
Man: Everyone thinks that! No — three weeks was the dream, but my leave didn't stretch that far.
Woman: So how long was it in the end?
Man: Two weeks exactly. Delhi, Jaipur, then five days in the south. Two packed, perfect weeks — and honestly, my feet needed the flight home.
Woman: Two weeks well spent. The photos prove it!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Two weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "Two weeks exactly. Delhi, Jaipur, then five days in the south. Two packed, perfect weeks".
• One week sai: là kế hoạch đặt vé ban đầu ("I remember you originally booked just one week, right?" – "One week, yes — Delhi and the Taj, the classic").
• Three weeks sai: chỉ là mong ước, số ngày phép không đủ ("three weeks was the dream, but my leave didn't stretch that far").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "how long" ở thì quá khứ — bỏ con số đi kèm "originally booked" và "was the dream", lấy con số đi kèm "exactly / in the end".

questions.prompt: A man is ordering a drink. What does he want?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Good evening! What can I get you to drink?
Man: What a day... My friend says your beer selection is excellent.
Woman: It is! We have six kinds on tap, very popular tonight.
Man: Tempting, but I'm driving, so beer is off the table, sadly. What else?
Woman: Plain water? Sparkling or still, with lemon.
Man: Water feels a bit sad after the day I've had. That drink on the next table, with the mint —
Woman: The iced tea! House special, brewed fresh, peach and mint. Big glass?
Man: The iced tea, big glass, extra ice. Exactly what this evening needs.
Woman: One iced tea coming up!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "The iced tea, big glass, extra ice. Exactly what this evening needs" — nhân viên xác nhận "One iced tea coming up!".
• Water sai: anh thấy nước lọc quá buồn tẻ sau một ngày mệt ("Water feels a bit sad after the day I've had").
• Beer sai: anh phải lái xe nên loại ("Tempting, but I'm driving, so beer is off the table, sadly").
👉 Mẹo: gọi đồ uống/đồ ăn — món đúng nằm ở lượt thoại chốt kèm chi tiết cụ thể (big glass, extra ice) và thường được nhân viên nhắc lại.

questions.prompt: What will they bring to the picnic?
questions.explanation:
Man: Sunday picnic is confirmed! Now, who brings what? I heard Tom's already claimed something.
Woman: Tom's bringing all the drinks — lemonade, juice, his famous iced coffee. Don't touch drinks.
Man: And Priya said something about snacks yesterday?
Woman: Crisps, nuts, those little crackers — all hers, it's decided. So guess what's left for us.
Man: The main event. The actual food!
Woman: Exactly — sandwiches, the cold chicken, my potato salad, and fruit for after. The serious food is our department.
Man: I'll do the chicken tonight and the sandwiches in the morning. We're the kitchen heroes of this picnic!
Woman: Heroes with cool bags. Eleven o'clock at the gate!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Food.
• Vì sao đúng: "The main event. The actual food!" – "Exactly — sandwiches, the cold chicken, my potato salad... The serious food is our department".
• Drinks sai: Tom đã nhận phần đồ uống ("Tom's bringing all the drinks — lemonade, juice, his famous iced coffee. Don't touch drinks").
• Snacks sai: Priya lo phần này ("Crisps, nuts, those little crackers — all hers, it's decided").
👉 Mẹo: dạng chia việc mang đồ — ghép nhanh "tên người + món" khi nghe. Phần của người nói nằm sau "what's left for us / our department".

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about running. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: Call me odd, but I do my kilometres right through the middle of town, on the pavements, dodging lamp posts and prams. I love running in the street — the shop windows, the smells from the bakeries, the little nods from the regulars I pass at the same corner every morning. Friends warn me about the traffic and the hard ground, and fair enough. But out there among the crowds and the noise, I never once feel bored.
Speaker B: I am lucky enough to live ten minutes from the coast, and that decides everything. Every morning I jog along the sand with the waves on one side and the cliffs on the other, gulls complaining overhead. When the tide is out I run on the firm wet sand, which is kind to the ankles. In winter the wind can be brutal, but watching the sun climb out of the water makes every frozen ear worth it.
Speaker C: I train for competitions, so guesswork is not good enough for me — I need exact distances and a clock I can trust. That is why you will find me at the stadium oval three evenings a week, counting laps on the rubber surface with my stopwatch. Four hundred metres, no surprises, no puddles, no dogs. My friends call it running in circles. I call it knowing precisely how fast I am getting.
Speaker D: I gave up on outdoor jogging the winter I turned forty — the dark evenings and icy paths defeated me. Now I do my five kilometres on the machine at the gym, warm and dry, with the television screens in front of me and a proper shower afterwards. The trainers there adjust my programme every month too. My friends tease me about running to nowhere, but nowhere has excellent air conditioning.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = prefer running in the street (keyword "running in the street"). B = at the seaside (PARAPHRASE: "along the sand... waves... tide" — không có chữ seaside). C = on the running track (PARAPHRASE: "stadium oval... counting laps... four hundred metres"). D = in the fitness center (keyword-lite: "machine at the gym" — bắt được qua gym). Nhiễu: in the park, mountain trail.

questions.prompt: Continuity is very important in the workplace.
questions.explanation:
Man: It seems like every workplace is going through so many changes lately. But honestly, I think Continuity is still very important. When things are done consistently, it gives people a sense of security. If everything changes too fast, it is hard for employees to keep up and the organisation can lose its way. Continuity is important in keeping everyone focused
Woman: I get where you're coming from, but I feel like these days, nothing is certain. Job security isn't something we can rely on anymore. There's always the risk of layoffs, especially with the economy being unpredictable. People are moving from job to job more than ever before, and you can't always count on staying in one place for long
Man: That's definitely a concern. But regardless of job security or stability, one thing we both can agree on is that job satisfaction is a huge motivator. When people love what they do, they're more likely to stay even when times get tough. It's the main reason many of us keep pushing through the challenges.
Woman: Absolutely! I think when people are satisfied with their work, they're willing to go the extra mile. It's not just about the paycheck, it's about feeling fulfilled. That's what really makes the difference in the workplace.
Man: You're right. And another thing that's making a difference is technology. It's been a game-changer for the economy, making things more efficient. The growth we've seen in so many Industries is because of how we've embraced new technologies. It's definitely helping businesses thrive.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Người nam nêu cao tính liên tục: "But honestly, I think Continuity is still very important."
2. Người phụ nữ nói công việc không còn an toàn ổn định tuyệt đối: "Job security isn't something we can rely on anymore."
3. Người nam gợi ý: "...one thing we both can agree on is that job satisfaction is a huge motivator." Người phụ nữ ủng hộ mạnh mẽ: "Absolutely! I think when people are satisfied with their work, they're willing to go the extra mile."
4. Người nam khẳng định vai trò của công nghệ: "technology. It's been a game-changer for the economy, making things more efficient."

questions.prompt: Job security cannot always be guaranteed.
Job satisfaction is an important motivator.
Technology is good for the entire economy.
How does the speaker recommend saving money effectively?
options: Saving a large amount only on a daily basis.
Use credit cards to manage expenses.
questions.explanation:
Good afternoon, everyone. Today I want to share some simple ideas about managing your money, because saving is a skill anyone can learn. Let me start with the most common questions I get. Some people try to save a large amount in one go — they put aside a big sum after a bonus, feel proud for a week, and then save nothing for months. Others believe the answer is using credit cards to manage their expenses, telling themselves they will pay everything back later. In my experience, both approaches usually end in disappointment. What actually works is much less exciting: save a fixed amount regularly. Choose a number you can manage, even a small one, and move it into your savings account every single month. Better still, make the transfer automatic, so the money is gone before you have a chance to spend it. If you wait until the end of the month and save whatever is left, there will usually be nothing left. Regular beats big, every time.
And who actually succeeds with money? I have watched hundreds of savers over the years. It is not the people who keep all their savings in one account, and it is certainly not the ones who avoid making any long-term plans because planning feels stressful. The people who save most successfully are the ones who get advice from people with real experience — a parent who has managed a household budget for thirty years, a colleague who has already bought a home, or a professional adviser. Money wisdom is learned fastest from those who already have it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: Save a fixed amount regularly. Bẫy: "saving a large amount" và "use credit cards" đều được nhắc rồi bị loại ("both approaches usually end in disappointment").
2. Đáp án: Get advice from people that have experience. Bẫy: "keep all savings in a single account" và "avoid long-term plans" đều bị phủ định trực tiếp.

questions.prompt: Who does the speaker believe can save money most successfully?
options: Get advice from people that have experience
Keep all your savings in a single account
Avoid making any long-term financial plans

questions.prompt: What is the speaker's opinion about security cameras at work?
options: People are unnecessarily worried about them
Most people don't even realize cameras are present.
Cameras should be placed to ensure complete coverage.
questions.explanation:
I have noticed that some of my co-workers get nervous about the security cameras in our office. They say things like, "It feels like we are being watched all the time," or "I do not like feeling that I am not trusted." Some of them even walk a longer way to the printer just to avoid the camera in the corridor — as if anyone were sitting there watching them collect paper. And before you ask: no, people certainly do notice the cameras; the idea that most staff do not even realise they are present is simply not true in our office. There is also a colleague who keeps saying the cameras should be placed to cover every single corner of the building, which I find equally unnecessary. My honest opinion is different from all of these: people are unnecessarily worried about them. The cameras are not there to spy on us or to catch small mistakes. They are there to keep us safe.
Think about what the cameras actually do. If a theft or an accident happened, would you not want a record of it? And their presence quietly prevents trouble before it starts. I know some people find them intimidating, and others insist they are only useful after something bad has already happened. I would ask those colleagues to look at it differently. Instead of feeling watched, we should feel reassured about their presence. The company is not doubting us — it is looking after us. Once you see the cameras that way, walking past one stops feeling uncomfortable and starts feeling, honestly, a little safer.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: People are unnecessarily worried about them. Bẫy: "most people don't realize cameras are present" bị phủ định ("simply not true"), "cameras should be placed to ensure complete coverage" là ý của một đồng nghiệp và bị chê ("equally unnecessary").
2. Đáp án: People should feel reassured about their presence. Bẫy: "intimidating and invasive" và "only useful after incidents" đều là quan điểm của người khác mà người nói phản bác.

questions.prompt: How does the speaker suggest people should feel about security cameras at work?
options: People often find them intimidating and invasive.

People should feel reassured about their presence

questions.prompt: How many people live in the town?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to Oakbridge, my friends! A little history before we enter the walls. A century ago this was a village of five thousand souls, mostly farmers and weavers. The mayor dreams aloud of reaching twenty thousand one day — you'll see his ambitious posters everywhere. But the honest number, from this year's census, is ten thousand residents exactly. Ten thousand people, two beautiful squares, and the best honey cake in the region, which we will taste in one hour!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: "the honest number, from this year's census, is ten thousand residents exactly. Ten thousand people, two beautiful squares".
• 5,000 sai: đó là dân số của một thế kỷ trước ("A century ago this was a village of five thousand souls, mostly farmers and weavers").
• 20,000 sai: chỉ là mục tiêu thị trưởng mơ tới ("The mayor dreams aloud of reaching twenty thousand one day").
👉 Mẹo: số liệu dân số hay bị gài mốc quá khứ và mục tiêu tương lai. Chọn số đi kèm "today / this year's census / exactly".

questions.prompt: Where are they going to meet?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's me, leaving a message about tomorrow! Let me fix the meeting place before you suggest the station again — I know it's convenient, but the renovation noise there gives me a headache in minutes. And the university café closes for the holidays, I checked. So: the park, main gate, under the clock tower, eleven sharp. The weather forecast is perfect, the roses are out, and I'm bringing a thermos of that coffee you like. The park, eleven — don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – at the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "So: the park, main gate, under the clock tower, eleven sharp... The park, eleven — don't be late!".
• at the station sai: tuy tiện nhưng đang sửa chữa rất ồn ("I know it's convenient, but the renovation noise there gives me a headache in minutes").
• at the university sai: quán cà phê trong trường đóng cửa nghỉ lễ ("the university café closes for the holidays, I checked").
👉 Mẹo: trong tin nhắn thoại, địa điểm đúng đi kèm chi tiết định vị rất cụ thể (main gate, under the clock tower) và được nhắc lại ở câu cuối.

questions.prompt: What career did he choose?
questions.explanation:
People still ask about my career choice, five years on. Everyone assumed I'd become a teacher like both my parents — the family trade, they called it — but standing before thirty teenagers never called to me. My professor pushed research; the laboratory route, publications, conferences. Fascinating, but the university salary made my landlord laugh. So I chose business, and I've never once regretted it. My own small trading company now, eleven employees, and every morning still feels like a beginning.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – to work in business.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I chose business, and I've never once regretted it. My own small trading company now, eleven employees".
• to become a teacher sai: đó là giả định của mọi người dựa trên nghề của bố mẹ, còn anh không thích đứng lớp ("standing before thirty teenagers never called to me").
• to become a researcher sai: giáo sư có khuyên nhưng lương đại học quá thấp ("the university salary made my landlord laugh").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi nghề đã chọn — tìm động từ quyết định ở quá khứ ("I chose") kèm bằng chứng hiện tại (công ty riêng, số nhân viên).

questions.prompt: When is the assignment due?
questions.explanation:
Quick reminder about the essay deadline, everyone, because the class chat is full of wrong dates! Somebody wrote Friday — no, Friday is only the last consultation hour, when I answer questions until five. Somebody else spread Sunday, which would be lovely, but the system locks submissions before then. The true deadline is Saturday, twelve noon, through the online portal. Saturday by noon — after that, the upload button simply disappears. Plan your Friday night wisely!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – on Saturday.
• Vì sao đúng: "The true deadline is Saturday, twelve noon, through the online portal. Saturday by noon — after that, the upload button simply disappears".
• on Friday sai: thứ Sáu chỉ là buổi tư vấn cuối, không phải hạn nộp ("Friday is only the last consultation hour, when I answer questions until five").
• on Sunday sai: là tin đồn sai, hệ thống đã khóa nộp bài trước đó ("Somebody else spread Sunday, which would be lovely, but the system locks submissions before then").
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo hạn nộp luôn có tin đồn sai lan trong lớp. Bám cụm "The true deadline is" và bỏ mọi ngày đi kèm "somebody wrote / somebody spread".

questions.prompt: What did she like best about the film?
questions.explanation:
The film last night — let me tell you my honest ranking! Everyone praises the action scenes, and yes, the chase across the rooftops was well made, but my heart was beating for another reason entirely. The ending? Frankly, it collapsed — twenty minutes of explanations nobody needed. No, what I loved, what I still see when I close my eyes, were the mountain scenes. Those silent shots of the peaks at dawn, the tiny climbers against all that snow... I'd watch the whole film again just for those.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – the mountain scenes.
• Vì sao đúng: "what I loved, what I still see when I close my eyes, were the mountain scenes... I'd watch the whole film again just for those".
• the action scenes sai: cô công nhận làm tốt nhưng đó không phải điều cô thích nhất ("the chase across the rooftops was well made, but my heart was beating for another reason entirely").
• the ending sai: cô chê thẳng là hỏng ("Frankly, it collapsed — twenty minutes of explanations nobody needed").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "liked BEST" — một phương án được khen nhẹ (well made) vẫn là bẫy. Chọn thứ gắn với ngôn ngữ cảm xúc mạnh nhất: what I loved, I still see, I'd watch again.

questions.prompt: A girl is calling her mother. Which dress does she want?
questions.explanation:
Mum, it's me, calling from the dress shop — I need your yes before they close! Remember the short blue one from the catalogue? I tried it — awful on me, we bury that idea. The long white one fits beautifully, but Aunt Vi says white at a wedding is war with the bride, so no. Which leaves the one I'm wearing right now: long, deep red, and mum — I look like a film star. It's the red one I want. Can I? Call me back in five minutes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Long and red.
• Vì sao đúng: "the one I'm wearing right now: long, deep red, and mum — I look like a film star. It's the red one I want".
• Short and blue sai: cô mặc thử và thấy rất tệ ("I tried it — awful on me, we bury that idea").
• Long and white sai: dáng đẹp nhưng mặc trắng đi đám cưới là phạm kỵ với cô dâu ("Aunt Vi says white at a wedding is war with the bride, so no").
👉 Mẹo: mỗi phương án là cặp "dáng + màu". Đừng chốt khi mới nghe đúng một nửa; đợi câu có đủ cả hai đặc điểm kèm "It's the... I want".

questions.prompt: How does she go to school?
questions.explanation:
My journey to school surprises everyone at the office when I mention it. No, I don't drive — I sold the car in spring, parking near the school was theft in slow motion. And the bus? I tried it for a term: two changes, twenty minutes of waiting, packed like sardines. So now I simply walk. Thirty-five minutes through the old town, past the bakery that gives me the day's first smile. I arrive awake, warm and cheerful — my colleagues arrive from traffic jams looking like storm clouds!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She walks.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I simply walk. Thirty-five minutes through the old town, past the bakery that gives me the day's first smile".
• She drives sai: cô đã bán xe hồi mùa xuân vì phí đỗ xe quá đắt ("I sold the car in spring, parking near the school was theft in slow motion").
• She takes the bus sai: chỉ thử một học kỳ rồi bỏ vì phải đổi tuyến và chờ lâu ("I tried it for a term: two changes, twenty minutes of waiting, packed like sardines").
👉 Mẹo: dạng phương tiện đi lại — từ khóa "now / these days" chỉ hiện tại; "sold", "I tried it for a term" là quá khứ đã bỏ.

questions.prompt: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave the station?
questions.explanation:
Your attention please, passengers for the coastal express. There has been a platform change and a small schedule correction this morning. The departure board still shows nine o'clock — that was cancelled after the engineering delay. And ignore the nine thirty rumour circulating in the waiting hall; that is tomorrow's schedule. Today, the train leaves the station at nine fifteen precisely, from platform six. Nine fifteen, platform six. Please board at least five minutes early. Thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: "Today, the train leaves the station at nine fifteen precisely, from platform six. Nine fifteen, platform six".
• 9:00 sai: là giờ trên bảng điện tử nhưng đã bị hủy ("The departure board still shows nine o'clock — that was cancelled after the engineering delay").
• 9:30 sai: là lịch của NGÀY MAI, chỉ là tin đồn trong phòng chờ ("ignore the nine thirty rumour circulating in the waiting hall; that is tomorrow's schedule").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nhà ga có ba lớp thông tin: bảng điện tử (cũ), tin đồn, và giờ thật. Chọn giờ đi kèm "Today... precisely" và được lặp lại cùng số sân ga.

questions.prompt: A person calls a friend about his new car. What is the price of the small car?
questions.explanation:
Hello, it's me! The car saga is finally over — I signed this afternoon! So, prices, since you love details. The dealer's first sticker said three thousand five hundred and fifty, take it or leave it. I countered with three thousand flat, which he called an insult to the vehicle. One coffee and much sighing later, we shook hands at three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. Three two five zero — my new little car! Pick you up Saturday for the maiden voyage?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3,250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "we shook hands at three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. Three two five zero — my new little car!".
• 3,550 pounds sai: là giá niêm yết ban đầu của người bán ("The dealer's first sticker said three thousand five hundred and fifty, take it or leave it").
• 3,000 pounds sai: là giá người mua trả xuống và bị chê ("I countered with three thousand flat, which he called an insult to the vehicle").
👉 Mẹo: bài mặc cả có ba con số theo thứ tự: giá chào (first sticker) – giá trả (I countered) – giá chốt (we shook hands). Luôn lấy con số đi kèm cái bắt tay.

questions.prompt: What color top is he going to buy?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Back again! Still thinking about that top for the party?
Man: Still torn, honestly. The green one fits well...
Woman: It does! Although — between us — green does wash you out a little under evening lights.
Man: My sister said the same, wonderful. What about the red one in the window?
Woman: Bold choice! But red at a work party... your colleagues will find you before you find the snacks.
Man: Fair point, I'd rather not glow. That leaves the quiet option.
Woman: The black. Classic, slimming, and it forgives every spilled drink.
Man: Sold. The black one, medium, and a bag I can hide it in until payday is forgotten!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sold. The black one, medium" — sau khi nhân viên gợi ý "The black. Classic, slimming, and it forgives every spilled drink".
• Green sai: nhân viên nói màu này làm anh trông nhợt nhạt dưới đèn buổi tối ("green does wash you out a little under evening lights").
• Red sai: quá nổi cho tiệc công ty ("your colleagues will find you before you find the snacks").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại chọn màu — nghe từ chốt giao dịch "Sold", "I'll take it", kèm cỡ áo. Màu đi cùng câu đó chính là đáp án.

questions.prompt: What elements of the film do they agree on?
questions.explanation:
Man: So, verdict time — the film. I say the soundtrack was the weakest part. Those drums!
Woman: Funny, I loved the drums! We'll never agree on music, we never do.
Man: True. And the characters — I found the sister completely unbelievable.
Woman: The sister was my favourite! Written exactly like my own sister, actually. So that's two disagreements.
Man: Then let me try the last card: the ending. The lights on the empty pier, no words, just the waves —
Woman: Perfect. Absolutely perfect. I cried, you went silent — I heard you stop chewing!
Man: I did. Finest ending in years. So we agree on exactly one thing: that ending.
Woman: One thing is enough for a second date at the cinema!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – the ending.
• Vì sao đúng: "So we agree on exactly one thing: that ending" — cả hai đều khen cảnh cuối trên cầu tàu ("Perfect. Absolutely perfect. I cried, you went silent").
• the soundtrack sai: hai người trái ngược — anh chê tiếng trống, cô lại thích ("I say the soundtrack was the weakest part. Those drums!" / "Funny, I loved the drums!").
• the characters sai: anh thấy nhân vật người chị vô lý, cô lại coi đó là nhân vật yêu thích ("I found the sister completely unbelievable" / "The sister was my favourite!").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "agree on" — đếm các cụm bất đồng ("Funny, I...", "we'll never agree"). Bài thường tự tổng kết ở cuối bằng "we agree on exactly one thing".

questions.prompt: Why does Douglas call Kay?
questions.explanation:
W: Douglas! Twice in one week — what's going on?
M: Nothing bad, Kay, I promise. Quite the opposite.
W: Let me guess: your printer died and you need mine again?
M: No favours today! The printer lives, everything works.
W: Then you want to talk about the project ideas? I haven't finished reading them yet...
M: Not that either — the ideas can wait. Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly.
W: Thank me? For what?
M: For last week — you drove my mother to the hospital while I was stuck abroad. She told me you stayed the whole afternoon. I'll never forget that.
W: Oh Douglas, anyone would have done it.
M: Nobody else did. Dinner's on me Friday — no arguments!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – to say thank you.
• Vì sao đúng: "Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly... For last week — you drove my mother to the hospital while I was stuck abroad".
• to ask for a favor sai: anh phủ nhận ngay ("No favours today! The printer lives, everything works").
• to discuss ideas sai: cũng bị loại, để bàn sau ("Not that either — the ideas can wait").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi — người gọi thường bác bỏ hai suy đoán của người nghe trước. Đáp án luôn nằm sau "I'm calling to...".

questions.prompt: A man is calling his wife. Where do the couple meet?
questions.explanation:
Man: Hi love, I've escaped the office early! Where shall we meet for the evening?
Woman: Wonderful! I thought the new restaurant — but I called, they're fully booked until nine.
Man: Nine is too late, I'm starving already. The station, then? It's halfway for both of us.
Woman: The station at rush hour? We'd spend the evening being bumped by suitcases, no thank you.
Man: Then our old classic: outside the bookshop — I mean the big shop on Market Street, by the blue doors.
Woman: Outside the shop, like our first date! I'll be there at six, don't get lost in the crime section before I arrive.
Man: No promises. Six o'clock, blue doors!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside a shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "outside the bookshop — I mean the big shop on Market Street, by the blue doors" và cô đồng ý "Outside the shop, like our first date!".
• At the restaurant sai: nhà hàng kín chỗ tới 9h, mà 9h thì quá muộn ("they're fully booked until nine" – "Nine is too late, I'm starving already").
• At the station sai: giờ cao điểm quá đông ("The station at rush hour? We'd spend the evening being bumped by suitcases, no thank you").
👉 Mẹo: địa điểm chốt thường đi kèm mô tả nhận diện (by the blue doors) và một câu hồi tưởng ("like our first date"). Đó là dấu hiệu chắc chắn nhất.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about their studying habits. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: People laugh when they see my rucksack — my books live in it because my study spot changes daily. Monday might be the kitchen table, Tuesday the bus, Wednesday a café, Thursday the steps outside the lecture hall if the sun is out. Staying in one seat makes my brain fall asleep; a fresh background keeps the material fresh too. My record is five different spots in a single day of revision, and that was my best exam ever.
Speaker B: For me, the enemy is sound. One conversation through the wall, one motorbike outside, and the sentence I was holding shatters. So I have built myself a little fortress: the back corner of the top floor of the library, behind the old journals nobody touches. Not a whisper reaches there. My friends know that between two and six I simply disappear from the world — that silence is where my concentration lives.
Speaker C: My housemates find it strange, but I cannot open a textbook without my headphones on. Soft piano for reading, something with a beat for writing notes — the melodies wrap around me like a wall and the hours slide by. In a silent room my thoughts wander everywhere; give them a soundtrack and they march in line. My playlist for the final exams lasted nine hours, and I knew every note by the end.
Speaker D: My day belongs to everyone else — work, family, dinner, dishes. My books only get me after the house goes quiet, usually from eleven until two in the morning. There is something magical about being the only mind awake on the street: no messages, no doorbells, just me and the pages in a pool of lamplight. My mother worries about the dark circles under my eyes. I tell her that is when my brain finally switches on.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = At various places (PARAPHRASE: "study spot changes daily... five different spots"). B = In a quiet place (PARAPHRASE: "little fortress... Not a whisper reaches there"). C = With music (keyword "headphones... melodies... playlist"). D = Late at night (keyword "from eleven until two in the morning"). Nhiễu: in a group, early morning.

questions.prompt: Future generations may struggle with information overload caused by technology.
questions.explanation:
Man: My little nephew asked me yesterday how people found addresses before phones, and I could not stop thinking about it afterwards. We built these tools, but the children who inherit them will swim in a flood we never knew. I worry the next generation will drown in the endless stream — more updates, more feeds, more alerts than any human mind was built to sort.
Woman: Funny, when I look at the same picture I mostly see the bright side. Since the digital wave arrived, whole industries have appeared out of nothing. My town alone has three software companies where the old mill used to stand, and the shops around them are full again. Whatever else these machines do, they have filled a lot of pay packets.
Man: The jobs are real, I will not argue there — though I notice you skipped my flood.
Woman: I did, because I trust people to build boats! And here is another hill I will stand on: nothing built from chips and wires will ever match what sits between our ears. A machine calculates; it does not wonder, doubt, or dream. The most powerful computer on earth is still a very fast filing clerk.
Man: I would be careful — the filing clerks are learning quickly. But let me raise the subject that actually keeps me up at night: everything we do is recorded by somebody. Our purchases, our routes, our conversations.
Woman: On that, no argument at all. The rules guarding our personal lives are years behind the machines. Both of us, for once, want the same thing: stronger walls around what belongs to each of us.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: M-W-W-B (giữ nguyên). Paraphrase:
1. "Future generations struggle with information overload" → M: "the next generation will drown in the endless stream" — W "I mostly see the bright side".
2. "Revolution good for economy" → W: "whole industries appeared... filled a lot of pay packets".
3. "No computer superior to human brain" → W: "nothing built from chips and wires will ever match what sits between our ears" — M "I would be careful".
4. "More should be done to protect privacy" → B: "everything we do is recorded" + "On that, no argument... stronger walls".

questions.prompt: The technological revolution is good for the economy.
No computer is superior to the human brain.
More should be done to protect individual privacy.

title: Đề 09 - A life of a scientist

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say about the way of writing?
options: It is focused on technical details
It is more of a textbook than a biography
questions.explanation:
I have just finished a new biography of a famous physicist, and I want to recommend it to all of you. Let me deal with the doubts first, because I had them too. When I picked it up, I was afraid it would be focused on technical details — page after page of equations that only a physicist could love. I also worried it might read more like a textbook than the story of a real person's life. I am happy to report that neither fear came true. The book is genuinely exciting to read. The author tells the scientist's life like an adventure story: the failed experiments, the rivalries, the night the famous discovery finally worked. I found myself reading until two in the morning, which almost never happens with science books.
Why does the book work so well? The secret is who it was written for. Some biographies of great scientists are really only suitable for experts in the field — full of special terms, with no explanations for the rest of us. And some, to be fair, are accurate but completely lack engaging storytelling. This one is different: it has been written for a general audience from the very first page. Complex ideas are explained through simple pictures from everyday life, so you need no scientific background at all. That choice explains why it has already become a bestseller, and why experts predict it will be as successful as the author's previous book. If you enjoyed that one, you will certainly enjoy this.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It is exciting to read. Bẫy: "focused on technical details" và "more of a textbook" đều là NỖI LO ban đầu và bị phủ định ("neither fear came true").
2. Đáp án: It has been written for a general audience. Bẫy: "only suitable for experts" và "lacks engaging storytelling" được nhắc là đặc điểm của các sách KHÁC ("Some biographies...").

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say about the overall content of the book?
options: It has been written for a general audience
It is only suitable for experts in the field

questions.prompt: What occurs when things don't go according to plan in a team?
options: The team members become more assured.
The team members start again from the beginning.
questions.explanation:
Leading a team toward a shared goal is never a straight road, and today I want to talk about what happens when a project runs into trouble. Imagine your team misses an important deadline. What happens next? You might expect everyone to calmly go back to the beginning and start the plan again. Some managers even assume that a good team simply becomes more confident, more determined, after a setback. My twenty years of experience say otherwise. In most cases, the opposite happens: morale drops sharply, people begin to doubt their own abilities, and the team members lose confidence. That loss of belief, not the delay itself, is the real damage, because a team that stops trusting itself works slower and makes more mistakes.
So how should a leader respond? I often hear two answers. The first: increase the project budget significantly, as if money could buy back motivation. The second: watch each person closely and focus on individual performance only, turning the office into an examination room. Both methods fail, and usually quickly, because neither touches the real problem. What genuinely helps a leader maintain team motivation is far simpler — set a realistic goal. Break the big target into steps the team can actually reach, and let people feel the taste of success again, even a small one. Each completed step rebuilds the confidence that the setback destroyed. Money runs out and supervision creates fear, but realistic goals create momentum — and momentum is what carries a team through hard times.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The team members lose confidence. Bẫy: "start again from the beginning" là điều "you might expect", "become more assured" là giả định của một số quản lý — cả hai bị bác ("My experience says otherwise").
2. Đáp án: Set a realistic goal. Bẫy: "increase the project budget" và "focus on individual performance only" đều được nhắc rồi bị loại ("Both methods fail").

questions.prompt: In the speaker's view, what helps a leader maintain team motivation?
Listen to a voice message. How does Evan feel?
questions.explanation:
Team, it's Evan, voice message because typing feels like mountaineering today. First — no, I'm not just tired, I wish! I slept ten hours and feel worse. And despite the beach photos from last week, nobody is happy over here anymore, believe me. The clinic confirmed it: a proper virus, fever, the full package. I'm in bed, contagious and useless, until Thursday minimum. Push my meetings, water my desk plant, and stay away from my office chair!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "The clinic confirmed it: a proper virus, fever, the full package" — phòng khám xác nhận anh nhiễm virus, sốt, phải nằm nhà tới ít nhất thứ Năm.
• Tired sai: chính anh bác bỏ ngay đầu bài — "no, I'm not just tired, I wish! I slept ten hours and feel worse".
• Happy sai: chỉ được nhắc để phủ định — "despite the beach photos from last week, nobody is happy over here anymore".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi cảm xúc/trạng thái luôn thả đủ 3 tính từ. Chọn tính từ nằm trong câu KHẲNG ĐỊNH có bằng chứng cụ thể (bác sĩ, triệu chứng); bỏ tính từ đi kèm "not", "I wish", "despite".

questions.prompt: Who does she live with? / A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between Lisa and the speaker?
questions.explanation:
Everyone at the resort mistook Lisa and me for family! The waiter guessed sisters — apparently we order identically. The lady at the pool insisted we must be cousins, something about our matching sunburns. We just laughed. The truth: we met at our first job, twenty-two years old, sharing one tiny desk and one stapler. The stapler caused our first argument and our friendship. Two decades of holidays together since. Best friends — chosen family, the finest kind!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: cô ấy tự kể sự thật — "we met at our first job, twenty-two years old, sharing one tiny desk" và chốt "Best friends — chosen family, the finest kind!".
• Cousins sai: chỉ là phỏng đoán của một người lạ ở hồ bơi — "The lady at the pool insisted we must be cousins".
• Sisters sai: cũng chỉ là phỏng đoán, của người phục vụ — "The waiter guessed sisters".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi quan hệ, để ý động từ phỏng đoán (guessed, insisted, assumed). Sự thật luôn nằm sau "The truth:" hoặc "Actually".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his jobs. What does the man want to do next?
questions.explanation:
My job history makes interviewers blink. First career: chef — twelve years, two restaurants, one permanently aching back that finally forced the knives into retirement. Second act: history teacher, which I truly loved until the weekend marking swallowed my whole life. Now everyone bets on which uniform I'll wear next. Neither, my friends! The kitchens and classrooms filled three notebooks with stories, and I'm finally typing them properly. Next stop: writer. The publisher liked my first chapters!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Become a writer.
• Vì sao đúng: "Next stop: writer. The publisher liked my first chapters!" — anh đang gõ lại ba cuốn sổ ghi chép thành sách.
• Become a chef sai: là nghề ĐẦU TIÊN, đã bỏ vì đau lưng — "First career: chef — twelve years... one permanently aching back that finally forced the knives into retirement".
• Become a history teacher sai: là nghề thứ hai, cũng đã qua — "Second act: history teacher, which I truly loved until the weekend marking swallowed my whole life".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "next / want to do" thì bám mốc thời gian: "first career", "second act" = quá khứ; "Now", "Next stop" = đáp án.

questions.prompt: What will she do?
questions.explanation:
What a gift of a Saturday! The office actually rang this morning — some emergency spreadsheet — and for once I said the beautiful word: no. Then the sofa and my new novel made their offer, tempting, but the sky outside is criminally blue. So the decision is made: I'm taking the car for a proper drive — the coast road, the cliff viewpoint, lunch at that harbour café with the terrible parking and the perfect fish. Windows down, music up. The book keeps till evening!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go for a drive.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the decision is made: I'm taking the car for a proper drive — the coast road, the cliff viewpoint, lunch at that harbour café".
• Go to work sai: công ty có gọi nhưng cô ấy từ chối — "The office actually rang this morning... and for once I said the beautiful word: no".
• Stay home sai: có nghĩ tới nhưng gác lại đến tối — "the sofa and my new novel made their offer, tempting, but the sky outside is criminally blue"; "The book keeps till evening!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "What will she do?", bắt cụm ra quyết định "the decision is made", "so I'm...". Ý nào đứng trước "but" hay đi kèm "tempting" đều là mồi nhử.

questions.prompt: How much are the eggs?
questions.explanation:
Fresh eggs, lovely people, fresh from the farm this morning! Yes dear, let me explain the prices, everyone asks. The supermarket across the road charges two pounds for eggs that saw a chicken last month, maybe. That fancy organic place? Three pounds, and they gift-wrap the box like jewellery! Mine — golden yolks, laid at dawn — one pound fifty. One fifty, honest price for honest eggs. Two boxes, my dear? I'll pick you the biggest ones!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1.50 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: người bán nói về trứng của MÌNH — "Mine — golden yolks, laid at dawn — one pound fifty. One fifty, honest price for honest eggs".
• 2 pounds sai: đó là giá của siêu thị đối diện — "The supermarket across the road charges two pounds".
• 3 pounds sai: đó là giá cửa hàng organic — "That fancy organic place? Three pounds, and they gift-wrap the box like jewellery!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giá, mỗi con số luôn gắn với một NƠI BÁN khác nhau. Bám từ sở hữu "Mine", "ours", "here" để biết giá nào là của người đang nói.

questions.prompt: A woman is calling her husband. What time is lunch ready?
questions.explanation:
Darling, listen before your next meeting! Lunch plans have moved twice, so here's the final version. One o'clock is dead — the oven decided to sulk and the repairman only just left. I nearly said three, but your father called; he's picking us up at three fifteen for grandma's, remember? So lunch lands at two. Two o'clock sharp, soup and the good bread, and if you're late I'm starting without you. Two! Love you, bye!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 2pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "So lunch lands at two. Two o'clock sharp, soup and the good bread" — cuối bài cô ấy còn nhắc lại "Two!".
• 1pm sai: đã hủy vì lò nướng hỏng, thợ vừa mới về — "One o'clock is dead — the oven decided to sulk and the repairman only just left".
• 3pm sai: suýt chọn rồi bỏ, vì 3h15 bố đến đón đi nhà bà — "I nearly said three, but your father called; he's picking us up at three fifteen".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ, bắt cụm chốt "lands at", "sharp" và con số được LẶP LẠI. Mốc đi kèm "is dead", "I nearly said", "but" là mốc bị loại.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
questions.explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her job. How is being an artist different from other jobs?
options: She works at a desk all day
questions.explanation:
Being an artist confuses my family endlessly. My brother clocks in nine to five, sees his desk, knows his lunch hour — my mother wishes I had that. Others imagine I sit at some desk all day sketching; in truth I barely own a desk, I paint standing, walking, on trains. The real shape of my job? There is none. When a commission burns, I work eighteen-hour days; between projects, I wander galleries on a Tuesday noon. Irregular hours — that's the artist's clock.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – She works at irregular times.
• Vì sao đúng: "When a commission burns, I work eighteen-hour days; between projects, I wander galleries on a Tuesday noon. Irregular hours — that's the artist's clock".
• She works 9 to 5 sai: đó là giờ giấc của em trai cô ấy, không phải của cô — "My brother clocks in nine to five, sees his desk, knows his lunch hour".
• She works at a desk all day sai: cô bác bỏ — "Others imagine I sit at some desk all day sketching; in truth I barely own a desk, I paint standing, walking, on trains".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "How is X different from...", cẩn thận thông tin gán cho NGƯỜI KHÁC (my brother, others imagine). Đáp án luôn là câu nói về chính người kể.

questions.prompt: What is the way to exercise? / What is she going to do? / What does she do on her holidays?
questions.explanation:
My holiday exercise plan, since you're curious! The hotel rents bicycles, and I did consider cycling the island — until I saw those hills and remembered my knees' opinion. Running on the beach looks romantic in films; in reality, sand in the shoes and sweat before breakfast, no thank you. So my choice, every single morning: walking. Two slow hours along the cliff path, camera in hand, coffee stop halfway. Walking — the holiday pace of champions!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Walking.
• Vì sao đúng: "So my choice, every single morning: walking. Two slow hours along the cliff path, camera in hand, coffee stop halfway".
• Cycling sai: mới chỉ cân nhắc rồi bỏ vì đồi dốc và đầu gối — "I did consider cycling the island — until I saw those hills and remembered my knees' opinion".
• Running sai: bị chê là chỉ đẹp trên phim — "Running on the beach looks romantic in films; in reality, sand in the shoes and sweat before breakfast, no thank you".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi hoạt động sẽ làm, khoanh cụm "my choice", "every single morning". Hai phương án kia hay đi kèm "did consider", "until", "no thank you".

questions.prompt: Which room will they study in? / Where will the first lesson of computer science take place?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Excuse me, are you also looking for the computer science lesson?
Man: Yes! First day chaos. The email said Room 203, I think?
Woman: That was the old email — 203 flooded last week, there's still a fan drying the carpet.
Man: Lovely. Someone in the corridor mentioned Room 101?
Woman: That's the maths lecture — I peeked in, whiteboards full of equations, definitely not us.
Man: So where do we actually go?
Woman: The notice board says Room 301, third floor, the new lab with the fast machines. I just checked it.
Man: Room 301 it is. Stairs or do we trust that elevator?
Woman: Stairs. Always stairs on the first day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Room 301.
• Vì sao đúng: "The notice board says Room 301, third floor, the new lab with the fast machines. I just checked it" — và chốt lại "Room 301 it is".
• Room 203 sai: là phòng ghi trong email CŨ, đã bị ngập nước — "That was the old email — 203 flooded last week, there's still a fan drying the carpet".
• Room 101 sai: đó là lớp toán, không phải lớp của họ — "That's the maths lecture — I peeked in, whiteboards full of equations, definitely not us".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phòng/địa điểm, tin nào MỚI NHẤT và đã được kiểm chứng ("notice board", "I just checked") thì đúng; số nào gắn với "the old email", "last week" thì loại.

questions.prompt: How long does it take to get to the station?
questions.explanation:
Man: You're coming Saturday, right? Tell me how long you need from your place to the station.
Woman: That's the eternal debate! My mother swears it's fifteen minutes, but she walks like an athlete.
Man: And your brother said twenty-five when he visited?
Woman: He got lost twice and stopped for coffee — twenty-five is HIS record, not the route's.
Man: So realistically?
Woman: Twenty minutes, measured by me, with a suitcase, at human speed. Twenty exactly.
Man: Then leave at nine forty for the ten o'clock train, and breathe.
Woman: Nine forty, noted. And I'm leaving my brother's navigation genes at home!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 20 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "Twenty minutes, measured by me, with a suitcase, at human speed. Twenty exactly" — chính cô ấy tự đo.
• 15 minutes sai: là con số của mẹ cô, người đi bộ nhanh như vận động viên — "My mother swears it's fifteen minutes, but she walks like an athlete".
• 25 minutes sai: là của ông anh, người bị lạc hai lần và dừng uống cà phê — "He got lost twice and stopped for coffee — twenty-five is HIS record, not the route's".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi mất bao lâu, mỗi con số gắn với một NGƯỜI. Chọn số mà chính người trả lời tự đo — nghe cụm "realistically", "measured by me".

questions.prompt: What time is the meeting?
questions.explanation:
Man: Quick check about tomorrow's meeting — my calendar says two, my memory says otherwise.
Woman: Your memory wins. Two o'clock was the original slot, but the director flies in from Munich at one thirty.
Man: Cutting it close. Someone mentioned three as the backup?
Woman: We tried three, but the sales team owns the big room at three, and we need the screen.
Man: So we land at...?
Woman: Four o'clock. Room A, screen booked, and the director gets time to breathe after landing.
Man: Four it is. I'll move my dentist. The things I do for quarterly reports!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 4pm.
• Vì sao đúng: người phụ nữ chốt "Four o'clock. Room A, screen booked, and the director gets time to breathe after landing" — người đàn ông xác nhận lại "Four it is".
• 2pm sai: đó là giờ họp BAN ĐẦU, bị bỏ vì giám đốc 1h30 mới bay từ Munich về — "Two o'clock was the original slot, but the director flies in from Munich at one thirty".
• 3pm sai: chỉ là phương án dự phòng, bị loại vì phòng lớn đã bị bộ phận sales đặt — "We tried three, but the sales team owns the big room at three, and we need the screen".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ luôn nhắc đủ 3 mốc. Bám mốc cuối cùng đi kèm chi tiết cụ thể (phòng, thiết bị) hoặc cụm "so we land at"; loại mốc có "original", "backup", "but".

questions.prompt: Two colleagues talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
questions.explanation:
Woman: We really must sit down about the budget before month-end. What suits you?
Man: This week is a minefield. Monday I'm training the new interns all day.
Woman: And Wednesday I'm out — the supplier visit in Birmingham, remember, whole day gone.
Man: That squeezes us. What about Tuesday? My calendar shows... actually nothing before noon.
Woman: Tuesday morning! Perfect — the office is quiet, the coffee machine has no queue.
Man: Tuesday at nine, small meeting room, spreadsheets and pastries?
Woman: Pastries are mandatory. Tuesday at nine, done!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Tuesday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Tuesday at nine, small meeting room, spreadsheets and pastries?" — cô ấy chốt "Tuesday at nine, done!".
• Monday sai: người đàn ông bận đào tạo thực tập sinh cả ngày — "Monday I'm training the new interns all day".
• Wednesday sai: người phụ nữ đi gặp nhà cung cấp ở Birmingham — "Wednesday I'm out — the supplier visit in Birmingham, remember, whole day gone".
