1. There is too much information on the Internet → Woman: người phụ nữ nêu "there's an endless mountain of stuff online — far more than any human being could ever wade through". Người đàn ông phản đối: "I'm not so sure that's the real trouble, though."

2. Finding information on the Internet requires skills → Both: người phụ nữ nêu "fishing out something you can actually trust online is a proper skill in its own right", người đàn ông tán thành rõ ràng: "Oh, I agree with you there completely."

3. The use of the Internet affects the way we think. → Man: người đàn ông nêu "I think all this scrolling is genuinely rewiring the way we reason things out". Người phụ nữ phản đối: "Hmm, I don't see it that way, I'm afraid."

4. The Internet makes young people less patient. → Both: người đàn ông nêu "youngsters today simply won't wait for anything", người phụ nữ đồng ý: "Now that I do agree with, one hundred per cent."

👉 Mẹo: Cả ý 1 và ý 3 đều có bẫy nhượng bộ một nửa —"I'll grant you it looks overwhelming" và "I'll accept our habits have shifted" nghe như tán thành, nhưng ngay sau đó người nói bác bỏ đúng phần cốt lõi, nên không phải Both.

questions.prompt: Finding information on the Internet requires skills
The use of the Internet affects the way we think.
The Internet makes young people less patient.
Why do residents oppose this plan?
options: It will remove several public parks in the area
It makes public transportation more expensive for residents
It doesn't do enough to promote alternatives to driving
questions.explanation:
Good evening, and thank you for joining tonight's town hall about the Regional Development Plan. Before we open the floor, let me address what people are actually angry about, because the newspapers have confused things. No, the plan will not remove any public parks — I have read all two hundred pages, and every park in this district is protected. And no, it will not make public transportation more expensive; fares are set by a different authority entirely. The genuine complaint, the one written on the posters outside, is that the plan does not do enough to promote alternatives to driving. Page after page describes new roads and bigger junctions, yet the sections on bus routes, cycle paths and walkable streets are thin. Residents who hoped to leave their cars at home feel the city is planning a future with even more traffic, not less, and frankly, reading the document, it is hard to argue with them.
The council members I have spoken to have a different, quieter worry. It is not about opposition from local businesses — most shops along the high street actually welcome the plan. Nor has the project exceeded its budget; the accounts are still healthy. Their concern is about land. The city centre is full of empty warehouses and abandoned plots that could be rebuilt first, yet the plan pushes outward into green fields at the edge of town. Several councillors argue that this is simply not an efficient use of the land we already have, and they intend to demand changes before any vote takes place.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
(Bản variant của Đề 06 bài 1 — cùng câu hỏi và đáp án, lời khác để hai đề không trùng script.)
1. Đáp án: It doesn't do enough to promote alternatives to driving. Bẫy: "remove public parks" và "more expensive" đều bị bác ngay đầu.
2. Đáp án: The plan is not making efficient use of existing land. Bẫy: "opposition from businesses" và "exceeded budget" đều bị phủ định.

questions.prompt: What difficulties is the city council having with this plan?
options: It has faced strong opposition from local businesses
The plan has already exceeded its budget by a large margin
The plan is not making efficient use of existing land

questions.prompt: What will this musician do in the near future?
options: He will probably retire from singing
He plans to release a new album
He wants to collaborate with younger artists
questions.explanation:
Welcome back to Music Legends. Tonight we look at a singer who has stood on the world's stages for more than forty years — and at the question everyone is asking: what comes next? The rumours have been flying. Several young artists have said publicly how much they would love to collaborate with him, and his fan clubs are convinced a new album is on the way. I have to disappoint both groups. In his interview last week, the singer said clearly that he has no plans to return to the studio and no interest in new projects. He wants a quieter life away from the lights. His farewell concert takes place next month, and after that, he will most probably retire from singing completely. He admits his voice is no longer what it was, and he would rather stop at a high point than fade slowly.
Looking back at his career, how does he judge it himself? Here his honesty surprised me. He does not regret choosing this profession — music, he says, gave him everything. And he laughed at the suggestion that he reached his peak too early; in his own view, his best albums came in his forties. But he admits one quiet thought that stays with him: he believes he could have been more successful. There were offers he turned down, tours he cancelled, years he wasted on arguments with record labels. Fame at his level, he says, is a wonderful thing — but the thought of what might have been never fully leaves an artist.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: He will probably retire from singing. Bẫy: "new album" là niềm tin của fan, "collaborate with younger artists" là mong muốn của nghệ sĩ trẻ — cả hai bị chính ca sĩ bác bỏ.
2. Đáp án: He could have been more successful. Bẫy: "regrets choosing his profession" bị phủ định ("music gave him everything"), "reached the peak too early" bị phủ định ("he laughed at the suggestion").

questions.prompt: What is his opinion about the musician?
options: He could have been more successful
He believes he reached the peak too early

questions.prompt: Greg is talking about a working day in his life. How does he go to work?
questions.explanation:
People often ask how I manage my mornings, so here's my working day. I used to drive, but since the office moved to the centre, the car just sits in traffic for an hour, so that's finished. My wife keeps saying I should cycle — good exercise, she says — but with our winters, I'd arrive soaked three days out of five. So now I go to work by bus. Twenty minutes, a warm seat, and I read my book the whole way. Best decision I've made in years.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – By bus.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I go to work by bus. Twenty minutes, a warm seat, and I read my book the whole way".
• By car sai: đã bỏ vì văn phòng chuyển vào trung tâm, xe kẹt cả tiếng — "I used to drive, but since the office moved to the centre, the car just sits in traffic for an hour, so that's finished".
• By bike sai: chỉ là gợi ý của vợ, bị loại vì mùa đông — "My wife keeps saying I should cycle... but with our winters, I'd arrive soaked three days out of five".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phương tiện đi lại, bám cụm "So now I...". Phương tiện gắn với "I used to" (quá khứ) hay "my wife says I should" (ý người khác) đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Listen to a nutrition expert. What time is the best for children to eat fruit?
questions.explanation:
A parent wrote in this week asking when children should eat fruit, and it's a lovely question. The answer from our research is clear: the morning is the best time. After a night's sleep, the body takes in the natural sugars and vitamins most effectively, and the energy carries the child through the school day. So put the banana or the apple on the breakfast table, not in the evening snack box. A simple change, and it makes a real difference.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – In the morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "The answer from our research is clear: the morning is the best time. After a night's sleep, the body takes in the natural sugars and vitamins most effectively".
• In the evening sai: bị loại thẳng — "So put the banana or the apple on the breakfast table, not in the evening snack box".
• In the afternoon sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "thời điểm tốt nhất", bắt cụm "the best time is". Câu "on the breakfast table, not in the evening" là bằng chứng kép: vừa xác nhận đáp án vừa loại nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Listening to a tour guide talking about Rock City. How old is the city?
questions.explanation:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Rock City, one of the oldest places you will ever stand in! Now, how old is it? The first guidebooks, a century ago, guessed one thousand years — far too careful. Some local legends even claim two thousand, which makes a better story than it does history. The real answer, confirmed by the archaeologists who worked here for a decade: this city is one thousand five hundred years old. Fifteen centuries of lives lived between these stones. Follow me through the gate!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1500 years.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real answer, confirmed by the archaeologists who worked here for a decade: this city is one thousand five hundred years old. Fifteen centuries".
• 1000 years sai: là phỏng đoán trong sách hướng dẫn cách đây một thế kỷ — "The first guidebooks, a century ago, guessed one thousand years — far too careful".
• 2000 years sai: chỉ là truyền thuyết địa phương — "Some local legends even claim two thousand, which makes a better story than it does history".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi tuổi/niên đại, chọn con số gắn với NGUỒN KHOA HỌC ("confirmed by the archaeologists"). Số đi kèm "guessed", "legends claim" là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Listen to the instructions of a university. Where is the main office?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to the university, everyone — a few practical directions before we start the tour. The most important place for you this week is the main office, where you'll register and collect your student cards. You'll find it on the first floor of this building, directly at the top of the main stairs — you can't miss the blue sign. It's open from eight thirty to five. Registration takes about ten minutes if you bring your documents. Right — let's begin!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – on the first floor.
• Vì sao đúng: "You'll find it on the first floor of this building, directly at the top of the main stairs — you can't miss the blue sign".
• in the basement sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• on the second floor sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ nêu duy nhất tầng một.
👉 Mẹo: bài hướng dẫn không cài bẫy thì chỉ cần bắt cụm chỉ vị trí ngay sau "You'll find it..." và giữ lại chi tiết xác nhận (top of the stairs, blue sign).

questions.prompt: Listen to the director talking about sales of his company. How many copies of Freeze Frame magazine were sold?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for coming to our annual results meeting. Let me start with the number you're all waiting for: Freeze Frame magazine. Some of you will remember we sold just over two hundred thousand copies two years ago, and our target for this year was half a million — ambitious, I admit, and no, we didn't quite reach it. But we did sell over three hundred thousand copies — our best result ever, and fifty percent growth. Congratulations to the whole team!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Over 300,000 copies.
• Vì sao đúng: "But we did sell over three hundred thousand copies — our best result ever, and fifty percent growth".
• Over 200,000 copies sai: là kết quả của HAI NĂM TRƯỚC — "we sold just over two hundred thousand copies two years ago".
• Over 500,000 copies sai: chỉ là mục tiêu đặt ra và chưa đạt — "our target for this year was half a million — ambitious, I admit, and no, we didn't quite reach it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi doanh số, tách rõ ba loại số: kết quả cũ, mục tiêu, kết quả thật. Chỉ con số sau "we did sell" mới là đáp án.

questions.prompt: What did he leave at a friend’s house? / What did the man lose?
questions.explanation:
Hi Dan, it's me — small favour to ask! I got home from your dinner party last night and started reading in bed, and that's when I realised: my glasses are still at your house. I remember taking them off when we watched that video in the kitchen. Could you have a look on the shelf by the window? I feel lost without them — I've been holding the newspaper at arm's length all morning. I can drop by after work to collect them. Thanks a million!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Glasses.
• Vì sao đúng: "my glasses are still at your house. I remember taking them off when we watched that video in the kitchen".
• Wallet sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Phone sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; chi tiết xác nhận là anh phải cầm báo xa tầm tay vì thiếu kính — "I've been holding the newspaper at arm's length all morning".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi đồ bỏ quên, nghe danh từ ngay sau "that's when I realised" hoặc "... is still at your house", rồi kiểm chứng bằng hệ quả kể sau đó.

questions.prompt: Listen to David talking about the conference. How long did he talk in the speech?
questions.explanation:
The conference went really well, thanks for asking! Funny thing about my speech, though. The organisers originally gave me twenty minutes — that's what the printed programme said. Then, the evening before, they emailed: too many speakers, could I cut it to ten? I spent half the night shortening my slides. But on the day, the first speaker didn't arrive, so in the end I talked for fifteen minutes exactly — and honestly, it was the perfect length. The audience even laughed at my jokes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 15 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "on the day, the first speaker didn't arrive, so in the end I talked for fifteen minutes exactly — and honestly, it was the perfect length".
• 20 minutes sai: là thời lượng ban đầu in trong chương trình — "The organisers originally gave me twenty minutes — that's what the printed programme said".
• 10 minutes sai: là yêu cầu cắt ngắn qua email tối hôm trước, nhưng thực tế không xảy ra — "could I cut it to ten? I spent half the night shortening my slides".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "How long DID he talk?" hỏi thực tế đã diễn ra. Bám cụm "in the end", "on the day"; bỏ số gắn với "originally", "they asked me to cut it to".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her family’s weekend. What does the family do most weekends?
questions.explanation:
People ask what our family does at the weekend, and the answer is wonderfully simple. Most Saturdays and Sundays, we all put on our boots after breakfast and go for a walk together — the long path along the river, or the trail behind the hill if the weather is fine. The kids race ahead, the dog goes mad with joy, and my husband and I finally get to talk. Two hours later we come home hungry and happy. It never gets old.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "Most Saturdays and Sundays, we all put on our boots after breakfast and go for a walk together — the long path along the river".
• Go to the beach sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Visit relatives sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ kể cả nhà đi bộ, bọn trẻ chạy trước, hai vợ chồng trò chuyện.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "most weekends" thì bắt đúng cụm tần suất "Most Saturdays and Sundays" rồi lấy động từ ngay sau đó.

questions.prompt: Soobin is talking about his favorite room. What is Soobin's favorite room?
questions.explanation:
People always laugh when I tell them my favourite room in our house. It's not the kitchen, even though I love cooking, and it's not the living room with the big TV. It's the bathroom! Sounds strange, I know — but hear me out. It's the only place where nobody follows me, the light is soft, and a long hot bath after work fixes almost any bad day. I've even got a little shelf there for my music player. My private kingdom!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Bathroom.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's the bathroom!... It's the only place where nobody follows me, the light is soft, and a long hot bath after work fixes almost any bad day".
• Kitchen sai: bị loại dù người nói rất thích nấu ăn — "It's not the kitchen, even though I love cooking".
• Living room sai: cũng bị loại ngay — "it's not the living room with the big TV".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "phòng yêu thích", bài thường loại trừ trước bằng chuỗi "It's not... and it's not...". Đáp án nằm ngay sau chuỗi phủ định đó.

questions.prompt: Listen to a woman explaining her morning routine to her friend. Why do women get up early?
options: To take care of their kids
questions.explanation:
M: You're up at five thirty every day? Seriously? Why do you do that to yourself?
W: Everyone asks me that! They assume it's for work, but I don't start until nine — I could sleep till eight if I wanted.
M: The kids, then? Getting them ready for school?
W: They're teenagers now — they get themselves up, mostly by shouting at each other.
M: So what on earth gets you out of bed at half past five?
W: Peace and quiet! That hour is the only time the house is completely silent. I drink my coffee slowly, I read, I think. Nobody needs anything from me.
M: Huh. When you put it that way... maybe I should try it.
W: Start with six o'clock. Five thirty is for professionals!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – To have some quiet time.
• Vì sao đúng: "Peace and quiet! That hour is the only time the house is completely silent. I drink my coffee slowly, I read, I think. Nobody needs anything from me".
• To go to work sai: cô 9h mới bắt đầu làm, ngủ tới 8h vẫn kịp — "They assume it's for work, but I don't start until nine — I could sleep till eight if I wanted".
• To take care of their kids sai: các con đã là thiếu niên và tự dậy — "They're teenagers now — they get themselves up".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lý do, người đối thoại thường đưa hai giả định sai trước ("They assume...", "The kids, then?"). Đáp án là câu trả lời sau "So what on earth...?".

questions.prompt: A man is talking to his friend. Why does he need to learn to drive?
options: To go on a road trip
To take his family on vacations
He has to drive to work
questions.explanation:
W: I heard you signed up for driving lessons at last! Planning a big road trip?
M: Ha! No, a road trip would be nice, but that's not the reason. I get car sick on long drives anyway.
W: Then it's for the family holidays, surely — driving everyone to the seaside in summer?
M: Also no — we always take the train for holidays, the kids love it.
W: So why now, after all these years?
M: The company is moving to the industrial park next month. There's no bus route out there at all, so I simply have to drive to work. No choice.
W: Ah, that explains it. Well, good luck with the parking test!
M: Don't remind me. I start on Monday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He has to drive to work.
• Vì sao đúng: "The company is moving to the industrial park next month. There's no bus route out there at all, so I simply have to drive to work. No choice".
• To go on a road trip sai: anh bác bỏ và còn bị say xe đường dài — "a road trip would be nice, but that's not the reason. I get car sick on long drives anyway".
• To take his family on vacations sai: cả nhà luôn đi tàu — "Also no — we always take the train for holidays, the kids love it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lý do, đếm số lần người trả lời nói "No". Lý do thật đi kèm ràng buộc bắt buộc: "have to", "no choice", "there's no bus route".

questions.prompt: Two friends are talking with each other. What did they both buy?
questions.explanation:
W: You went to the big sale too? Show me what you got!
M: I couldn't resist. I went in for books, actually — but the queue at the bookshop was out the door.
W: Same with the shoes for me! Nothing left in my size but bright orange trainers.
M: So in the end I went to the clothes floor — two jumpers and a winter coat, half price.
W: No way — I bought clothes as well! Three shirts and a jacket. Great minds think alike.
M: So we both came home with clothes. The bags gave us away, I suppose.
W: The sale is on until Sunday, you know. Round two for the books?
M: Tempting. Very tempting.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Clothes.
• Vì sao đúng: anh mua "two jumpers and a winter coat, half price", cô mua "Three shirts and a jacket", và họ tổng kết "So we both came home with clothes".
• Books sai: anh định mua sách nhưng hàng người xếp dài ra tận cửa — "I went in for books, actually — but the queue at the bookshop was out the door".
• Shoes sai: cô không mua được vì hết size — "Nothing left in my size but bright orange trainers".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "What did they BOTH buy?" là hỏi điểm CHUNG. Đừng chốt sau lượt nói đầu tiên — nghe hết cả hai người rồi bắt câu tổng kết "we both...".

questions.prompt: Listen to the conversation. Who is she taking a photo of?
questions.explanation:
M: You've had that camera out all morning! Who are you photographing?
W: I'm on a mission for the school website. They need one good team photo from today.
M: The boys' team just won their match — they're doing a victory dance over there. Perfect moment!
W: Tempting, but no — the boys had their photo taken last month, remember the big poster?
M: True. What about the coaches, then? All four of them are standing together by the bench for once.
W: The coaches hate cameras, they'd never smile. No — I'm taking a photo of the girls' team. They just won the cup, and they're not even on the website yet!
M: Fair enough. They've lined up already — go, go!
W: Wish me luck. Everybody say cheese!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The girl's team.
• Vì sao đúng: "No — I'm taking a photo of the girls' team. They just won the cup, and they're not even on the website yet!".
• The boys' team sai: đội nam đã được chụp từ tháng trước — "the boys had their photo taken last month, remember the big poster?".
• The coaches sai: các huấn luyện viên ghét máy ảnh, không chịu cười — "The coaches hate cameras, they'd never smile".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "chụp ai", người kia sẽ gợi ý hai đối tượng và cả hai đều bị từ chối. Bám câu "No — I'm taking a photo of..." của chính người cầm máy.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about their journey to work. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: My office is twenty-five minutes from home on foot, and my neighbour Marta works in the same building, so every morning at eight we set off together. We solve the world's problems before nine — her divorce, my roses, everyone's politics. Honestly, the conversation is better exercise than the walking. On days she is ill, the same pavement feels twice as long, and I arrive at my desk with nobody's opinions but my own.
Speaker B: I am a devoted passenger of the seven-forty. Top deck, second row, window seat — my little office in the sky. While the traffic crawls underneath, I read my novel or answer messages, and somebody else worries about the driving. A monthly ticket costs less than a week of parking in my part of town. Colleagues complain about their steering wheels; I turn pages. I know who wins.
Speaker C: My commute is my meditation, and it only works because I do it with nobody. Thirty-five minutes on foot, headphones optional, thoughts wandering where they like. I rehearse difficult conversations, plan the weekend, sometimes just count magpies. People offer me lifts constantly and I refuse them all — those solitary steps between home and work are where I become ready for other humans.
Speaker D: I resisted for years, but the school run defeated me: two children, two schools, one office, three different directions. So now it is the family wagon every morning — bags in the boot, arguments about the radio station, goodbye kisses at two different gates, then the ring road to work. Parking costs a fortune and the traffic tests my soul. But with our timetable, four wheels are not a choice; they are survival.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = Walk with friends (PARAPHRASE: "set off together... conversation is better exercise"). B = Go by bus (PARAPHRASE: "passenger of the seven-forty... top deck... monthly ticket"). C = Walk alone (PARAPHRASE: "on foot... with nobody... solitary steps"). D = Drive car (keyword-lite "family wagon... parking... four wheels"). Nhiễu: bike, train.

questions.prompt: Future generations may struggle to keep up with information technology development.
questions.explanation:
M: They've rolled out three new systems at our office since January. I can barely keep track of them.
W: It's the same everywhere, I think. Nobody's given any time to learn anything properly.
M: To be honest, it makes me wonder how our grandchildren will manage. The pace is so fierce now that I'd say the generation after us will really struggle to stay on top of it all.
W: Do you think so? I'm not so sure. Children absorb this sort of thing in an afternoon — my niece set up my phone faster than I could open the manual. If anything they'll find it easier than we do.
M: They handle the gadgets, certainly. Understanding the systems underneath is quite another matter.
W: Well, we'll see. What does worry me is employment. I'm fairly convinced all this clever software is going to leave an enormous number of people without a job.
M: Hmm, I don't see it that way at all. I'll accept that particular trades disappear, of course — that's always happened. But the overall number of jobs? No, that doesn't fall. Roles shift, and new ones turn up.
W: Tell that to the staff at the sorting warehouse down the road.
M: Half of them are driving the vans now, from what I hear.
W: Possibly. But here's the thing — I still believe machines will end up as helpers rather than substitutes. A tool sitting on the desk beside you, not somebody in your chair.
M: No, I genuinely can't agree with that. In a great many skilled jobs they won't be assisting anyone at all; they'll be doing the entire task themselves while we glance at the odd result.
W: That's a rather bleak picture.
M: Realistic, I'd call it. Mind you, the thing that actually keeps me awake is privacy. We badly need much tougher rules about what firms are allowed to do with our personal details.
W: Oh, absolutely, I'm with you completely on that one. You tick a single box and your information is sold on to forty companies you've never heard of.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: Thế hệ sau khó theo kịp công nghệ = Man · Công nghệ cao khiến nhiều người mất việc = Woman · Máy móc chỉ hỗ trợ chứ không thay thế con người = Woman · Cần biện pháp mạnh hơn để bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân = Both

1. Future generations may struggle to keep up with information technology development. → Man: người đàn ông nêu "the generation after us will really struggle to stay on top of it all." Người phụ nữ phản đối: "Do you think so? I'm not so sure. Children absorb this sort of thing in an afternoon... If anything they'll find it easier than we do."

2. Advanced technology could put many workers out of a job. → Woman: người phụ nữ nêu "I'm fairly convinced all this clever software is going to leave an enormous number of people without a job." Người đàn ông phản đối: "Hmm, I don't see it that way at all. I'll accept that particular trades disappear, of course... But the overall number of jobs? No, that doesn't fall."

3. Machines will only support people rather than replace them at work. → Woman: người phụ nữ nêu "I still believe machines will end up as helpers rather than substitutes. A tool sitting on the desk beside you, not somebody in your chair." Người đàn ông phản đối: "No, I genuinely can't agree with that... they'll be doing the entire task themselves while we glance at the odd result."

4. Stronger measures are needed to keep personal data private. → Both: người đàn ông nêu "We badly need much tougher rules about what firms are allowed to do with our personal details", người phụ nữ đồng ý: "Oh, absolutely, I'm with you completely on that one."

👉 Mẹo: Bẫy chính ở ý 2 — người đàn ông nói "I'll accept that particular trades disappear, of course" nghe rất giống đồng ý, nhưng ngay sau đó ông phủ nhận kết luận (tổng số việc làm không giảm), nên đáp án là Woman chứ không phải Both.

questions.prompt: Advanced technology could put many workers out of a job.
Machines will only support people rather than replace them at work.
Stronger measures are needed to keep personal data private.
Why is identifying the correct market so important for a company?
options: It helps the company focus its resources and avoid wasting time on low-demand areas.
It guarantees that the business will operate without any rival firms.
It provides a justification for lowering product standards to maximize profit.
questions.explanation:
Welcome to week three of our business strategy course. Today's topic: why identifying the correct market matters so much. Let me first remove two dangerous ideas. Some new founders believe that once they choose a specific market niche, their business will somehow operate without any rival firms. That protection does not exist — competitors follow wherever money appears. Even worse, I occasionally hear that focusing on one market justifies lowering product standards to squeeze out more profit, since customers there have fewer choices. Companies that try this are usually punished within a year. The real reason market identification matters is efficiency: it helps the company focus its resources and avoid wasting time on low-demand areas. A small business has limited money, limited staff and limited hours. Point them at the customers who genuinely want your product, and every dollar works harder. Spread them across markets that barely care, and even a good product dies quietly.
Our second word today is profitability, which is widely misunderstood. Reaching profit does not signal that the company no longer needs market research — customers keep changing whether you study them or not. Nor does it suggest you can now disregard your competitors; they read your success as an invitation. What profitability really proves is more basic and more important: the company can cover its own costs, and its position in the market is strengthening. Profit is oxygen. It does not tell you where to swim, but without it, no other strategic question matters at all.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It helps the company focus its resources and avoid wasting time on low-demand areas. Bẫy: "without any rival firms" và "lowering product standards" đều bị bác ("That protection does not exist", "punished within a year").
2. Đáp án: It proves the company can cover costs and strengthen its position. Bẫy: "no further need for market research" và "disregard competitors" đều bị phủ định.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what is the significance of 'profitability'?
options: It proves the company can cover costs and strengthen the company's position in the market.
It signals that the company has no further need for market research.
It suggests that the company can disregard the activities of its competitors.

questions.prompt: What is the key to a long career in music?
options: Having a large number of fans.
questions.explanation:
People imagine that a long career in music is built on luck, but after twenty years managing artists, I can tell you what actually keeps a singer on stage. It is tempting to point at the obvious things. A large number of fans looks like security — yet I have watched artists with millions of followers disappear within two years because they chased whatever those fans wanted. Winning many awards early looks even better — but early trophies can be a trap, freezing a young artist in the style that won them. The real key, in my experience, is that a singer believes in her own musical instincts. The artists who last are the ones who trust their taste, choose songs that feel true to them, and politely ignore advice that pulls them away from their own sound. Audiences forgive a strange album; they never forgive a fake one.
Now, I will not pretend the industry is kind at the moment. Some outsiders think performers today have a lot of control over their careers, with all these digital platforms. Others complain that modern performers only care about money. Neither matches what I see every week. The honest truth is that performers find it very hard to get started. There are more talented people than ever competing for the same attention, and without strong support behind them, even remarkable voices go unheard. So when a new artist does break through, remember — you are watching someone who survived the hardest entrance exam in entertainment.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: Believing in her musical instincts. Bẫy: "large number of fans" và "winning awards early" đều được nhắc rồi bị loại (fan triệu người vẫn biến mất, giải sớm là cái bẫy).
2. Đáp án: Performers find it hard to get started. Bẫy: "have a lot of control" và "only care about money" là ý kiến người ngoài bị bác ("Neither matches what I see").

questions.prompt: What is the speaker's opinion about the current music industry?
options: Performers find it hard to get started.
Performers have a lot of control.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her weekends. What did she do last week?
questions.explanation:
My weekends are usually quite busy, but last week was different. My friends did call about going out on Saturday — there was a birthday dinner in town — but I was so tired after the work week that I said no. I even walked past that new café everyone talks about and didn't go in. Instead, I stayed at home the whole weekend: slept late, cooked slowly, watched two films under a blanket. And you know what? It was exactly what I needed.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Stayed at home.
• Vì sao đúng: "Instead, I stayed at home the whole weekend: slept late, cooked slowly, watched two films under a blanket".
• Went out with friends sai: có lời rủ nhưng cô từ chối vì quá mệt — "there was a birthday dinner in town — but I was so tired after the work week that I said no".
• Visited a café sai: cô chỉ đi ngang qua chứ không vào — "I even walked past that new café everyone talks about and didn't go in".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "làm gì cuối tuần", bám cụm đảo hướng "Instead, I...". Việc đi kèm "I said no", "didn't go in" là việc KHÔNG làm.

questions.prompt: Listen to a saleswoman talking about a property. Which room is the largest?
questions.explanation:
Come in, come in — let me show you around this lovely property! The living room here is a good size, comfortable for a sofa and two armchairs, and the bedroom upstairs is cosy — perfect for a good night's sleep, though I'll admit it's the smallest room in the house. But the real surprise is through here: the kitchen. It's the largest room in the whole house — the owners knocked two rooms together, so there's space for a big family table and all the cupboards you could want.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Kitchen.
• Vì sao đúng: "the kitchen. It's the largest room in the whole house — the owners knocked two rooms together, so there's space for a big family table".
• Bedroom sai: ngược lại, đây là phòng nhỏ nhất — "the bedroom upstairs is cosy... though I'll admit it's the smallest room in the house".
• Living room sai: chỉ ở mức khá rộng, không phải lớn nhất — "The living room here is a good size, comfortable for a sofa and two armchairs".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi so sánh nhất (largest), phải nghe hết cả ba phòng rồi mới chọn. Bám đúng cụm so sánh nhất "the largest room"; "a good size" chỉ là lời khen chung.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her holiday plan. Where is she going on holidays?
questions.explanation:
Everyone at work is asking about my holiday, so here's the plan! For years we always went to the beach — the same crowded sand, the same sunburn — and this year I finally said no more. I'm going to the mountains! Two weeks in a little wooden cabin, walking trails straight from the front door, cool air, and not a beach umbrella in sight. I've already bought proper boots. Honestly, I've never looked forward to a holiday this much.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The mountains.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm going to the mountains! Two weeks in a little wooden cabin, walking trails straight from the front door" — cô còn "already bought proper boots".
• The beach sai: là thói quen của NHIỀU NĂM TRƯỚC, năm nay đã dứt khoát bỏ — "For years we always went to the beach... and this year I finally said no more".
• The city sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm đến, phân biệt thói quen cũ ("For years we always...") với kế hoạch mới ("I'm going to..."). Chi tiết chuẩn bị (mua giày) là bằng chứng chốt.

questions.prompt: A tour guide is talking about the group's traveling schedule. Where will the group wait for the bus?
questions.explanation:
Good evening, everyone — important details for tomorrow's excursion, so listen carefully! Now, about the meeting point. It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine. And please don't go to the train station like the group last week; our tour doesn't use the train at all. The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp. Main entrance, eight o'clock. Sleep well!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – By the hotel's main entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp".
• In the lobby sai: hôm nay có gặp ở đó nhưng mai sảnh đóng cửa để dọn dẹp — "It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine".
• At the train station sai: tour không dùng tàu, đó là nhầm lẫn của nhóm tuần trước — "our tour doesn't use the train at all".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm hẹn, hướng dẫn viên hay nhấn mạnh "It is NOT...". Chốt ở nơi có mô tả nhận diện cụ thể (cửa kính lớn, đài phun nước) kèm giờ.

questions.prompt: Listen to a tour guide introducing the tour. Where will tea be served?
questions.explanation:
Welcome, everyone, to our city discovery day! A quick outline of the afternoon. We begin with a gentle walk through the old park, then a short stop at the hotel to drop off any shopping. And now the part I'm most excited about: at four o'clock we board the river boat, and that is where tea will be served — sandwiches, scones and a full pot, while the city floats past the windows. Trust me, it's the best table in town. Any questions before we set off?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The river boat.
• Vì sao đúng: "at four o'clock we board the river boat, and that is where tea will be served — sandwiches, scones and a full pot".
• In the park sai: công viên chỉ là chặng đi dạo mở đầu — "We begin with a gentle walk through the old park".
• The hotel sai: khách sạn chỉ là chỗ ghé nhanh để gửi đồ mua sắm — "then a short stop at the hotel to drop off any shopping".
👉 Mẹo: lịch trình tour nêu 3 địa điểm theo thứ tự, nhưng câu hỏi chỉ hỏi nơi diễn ra MỘT hoạt động. Bám cụm "that is where tea will be served".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about the city concert. How will the concert end?
questions.explanation:
The city concert this Saturday is going to be something special, folks! Let me tell you what I've heard about the programme. The rumour about a fireworks display at the end? Not true, sadly — the park is too close to the hospital for fireworks. And the famous singer everyone hoped for is on tour in Japan, so that's off too. But the real ending is better anyway: the city's favourite group — the band that started right here — will close the show with all their big songs.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – With the city's favorite group.
• Vì sao đúng: "the real ending is better anyway: the city's favourite group — the band that started right here — will close the show with all their big songs".
• With a fireworks display sai: chỉ là tin đồn, không bắn được vì công viên quá gần bệnh viện — "Not true, sadly — the park is too close to the hospital for fireworks".
• With a famous singer sai: ca sĩ đó đang lưu diễn ở Nhật — "the famous singer everyone hoped for is on tour in Japan, so that's off too".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "kết thúc bằng gì", bám động từ "close the show". Ý đi kèm "the rumour", "not true", "that's off" đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her family’s holidays. What did the family do last year?
questions.explanation:
Our family takes one big holiday every year, and everyone always wants to hear about last year's. We packed the car with tents and sleeping bags and went camping by the big lake in the national park — a full week under the trees. The kids learned to fish, we cooked everything over the fire, and nobody touched a screen for seven days. It rained one night, half the tent got wet, and it's still everyone's favourite story at dinner. Best week we've ever had.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Camping.
• Vì sao đúng: "We packed the car with tents and sleeping bags and went camping by the big lake in the national park — a full week under the trees".
• Beach trip sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu; cả nhà ở bên hồ trong vườn quốc gia.
• Road trip sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; ô tô chỉ dùng để chở lều tới hồ rồi ở nguyên đó suốt tuần.
👉 Mẹo: bài không cài bẫy thì bắt luôn động từ chính "went camping". Các danh từ lều, túi ngủ, nấu ăn bằng lửa trại là bằng chứng phụ để yên tâm chọn.

questions.prompt: Listen to a weather forecast. Where will the weather be best?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, here is today's weather for the whole country. Starting in the west: heavy showers all day, so keep the umbrella close. The south won't be much better — grey skies and a cold wind coming in from the sea by lunchtime. But the east is the place to be today: clear skies, sunshine from morning to evening, and temperatures up to twenty-two degrees. So if you're planning a day out, head east — the weather there will be the best in the country.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – In the east.
• Vì sao đúng: "the east is the place to be today: clear skies, sunshine from morning to evening, and temperatures up to twenty-two degrees... the weather there will be the best in the country".
• In the west sai: mưa rào cả ngày — "Starting in the west: heavy showers all day, so keep the umbrella close".
• In the south sai: trời xám và gió lạnh từ biển thổi vào — "grey skies and a cold wind coming in from the sea by lunchtime".
👉 Mẹo: bản tin thời tiết đọc lần lượt từng vùng. Câu hỏi "best" thì chỉ giữ vùng có tính từ tích cực (clear, sunshine) kèm mốc nhiệt độ cao.

questions.prompt: Listen to the announcement from a travel agent representative. Why is the air travel cancelled?
questions.explanation:
Ladies and gentlemen, may I have your attention, please. We're very sorry to announce that this afternoon's flights have been cancelled. Let me be clear about the reason, as there are rumours going around. We have a full crew today — this is not a staffing problem — and all aircraft passed their checks this morning, so it's not technical either. The cancellation is due to poor weather conditions: a severe storm is moving across the region, and it is simply not safe to fly. Please see our desk for rebooking.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Poor weather conditions.
• Vì sao đúng: "The cancellation is due to poor weather conditions: a severe storm is moving across the region, and it is simply not safe to fly".
• Staff shortage sai: hôm nay đủ tổ bay — "We have a full crew today — this is not a staffing problem".
• Technical issues sai: toàn bộ máy bay đã qua kiểm tra sáng nay — "all aircraft passed their checks this morning, so it's not technical either".
👉 Mẹo: thông báo hủy chuyến thường dập tin đồn trước rồi mới nêu lý do. Bám cụm "is due to"; hai ý đi kèm "this is not..." là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Two friends are talking about their trip. What will the weather be like?
questions.explanation:
W: Three days until the trip! Have you checked the forecast? I'm hoping for hot and sunny.
M: I just looked... and you should sit down. Remember last year, when it was mild and dry the whole week?
W: Perfect walking weather, yes. Don't tell me...
M: This year is a different story. Cold and wet, all five days. Rain every single afternoon, and ten degrees at best.
W: Ten degrees! There goes my summer dress plan.
M: Pack the raincoat and the warm jumper instead. And proper boots.
W: Fine — but we're booking somewhere sunny next time. Agreed?
M: Agreed. Somewhere the umbrellas stay at home!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Cold and wet.
• Vì sao đúng: "This year is a different story. Cold and wet, all five days. Rain every single afternoon, and ten degrees at best".
• Hot and sunny sai: chỉ là điều cô mong, không phải dự báo — "Have you checked the forecast? I'm hoping for hot and sunny".
• Mild and dry sai: đó là thời tiết của chuyến đi NĂM NGOÁI — "Remember last year, when it was mild and dry the whole week?".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi dự báo thời tiết, loại ngay cụm gắn với "I'm hoping for" (mong muốn) và "last year" (quá khứ). Đáp án nằm sau "This year is a different story".

questions.prompt: A man and woman are discussing their plans for the evening. What do the man and woman decide to do in the evening?
questions.explanation:
M: So — tonight. Any ideas? There's that new film at the cinema, the one everyone's talking about.
W: I checked already: sold out until the weekend. Every single seat.
M: Ah. Then we could just stay at home? Order food, watch something on the sofa?
W: We've done that three nights in a row! I can't look at that sofa any more.
M: Fair point. So no cinema, no sofa... what's left?
W: Honestly? Let's not decide right now. I finish work at five — let's just see how we feel and make plans then.
M: You know what, that's the best idea. No pressure, no booking.
W: Exactly. I'll call you at five!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Make plans later.
• Vì sao đúng: "Let's not decide right now. I finish work at five — let's just see how we feel and make plans then" — anh đồng ý "that's the best idea. No pressure, no booking".
• Go to the movies sai: phim đã hết vé tới cuối tuần — "I checked already: sold out until the weekend. Every single seat".
• Stay at home sai: bị loại vì đã ở nhà ba tối liên tiếp — "We've done that three nights in a row! I can't look at that sofa any more".
👉 Mẹo: đôi khi đáp án là "chưa quyết" chứ không phải một hoạt động cụ thể. Nếu cả hai phương án cụ thể đều bị loại, nghe kỹ câu chốt kiểu "let's decide later".

questions.prompt: Alice is calling her friend. What did she lose?
questions.explanation:
W: Hi, it's Alice — thank goodness you picked up! I need your eyes.
M: You sound stressed. What's happened?
W: I can't find my phone anywhere! I'm calling from my mum's.
M: Your phone? But you had it at the café this afternoon — you showed me the holiday photos on it.
W: Exactly, that's the last time I remember holding it! My book is here, my laptop is here, but the phone is gone.
M: Okay, don't panic. I'll call the café — they usually keep things behind the counter.
W: Would you? I feel lost without it, honestly. My whole life is in that phone.
M: Give me two minutes. If it's there, I'll pick it up on my way over.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Phone.
• Vì sao đúng: "I can't find my phone anywhere!" và "My book is here, my laptop is here, but the phone is gone".
• Book sai: sách vẫn ở chỗ cô, nhà mẹ — "My book is here".
• Laptop sai: máy tính cũng còn nguyên — "my laptop is here".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi đồ bị mất, bài thường liệt kê những món VẪN CÒN để gây nhiễu. Bám cấu trúc "X is here, Y is here, but Z is gone".

questions.prompt: The woman is walking into a local store. How much are the cleaning products?
questions.explanation:
M: Good morning! Looking for anything in particular?
W: Yes — cleaning products. The spray and the wipes, the ones in the green bottles.
M: Ah, good timing! They were three pounds each last month, if you remember.
W: I do — that's why I stopped buying them, to be honest.
M: Well, the regular price came down to two pounds this spring. But this week is even better...
W: Go on, make my day.
M: They're on special offer: one pound fifty each. This week only.
W: One fifty? Wonderful! I'll take four, then — that barely costs more than two used to.
M: Four it is. That's six pounds exactly, please.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – One pound fifty.
• Vì sao đúng: "They're on special offer: one pound fifty each. This week only" — cô mua 4 chai và trả đúng 6 bảng.
• Three pounds sai: là giá của tháng trước, đắt tới mức cô ngừng mua — "They were three pounds each last month"; "that's why I stopped buying them".
• Two pounds sai: là giá NIÊM YẾT thường từ mùa xuân, không phải giá tuần này — "the regular price came down to two pounds this spring. But this week is even better...".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giá, tách rõ ba mốc: giá cũ, giá thường, giá khuyến mãi. Lấy số sau "on special offer" và kiểm tra lại bằng phép nhân (4 × 1.50 = 6 pounds).

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about listening to music. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: Sunday evenings are sacred in my flat: phone in the drawer, lights low, and one full album from start to finish on the good speakers. That hour dissolves whatever the week left in my muscles — I can feel the tension draining somewhere around the third track. Doctors talk about massages and hot baths; my medicine has always been melodies and a closed door. By the final song I am a calmer, kinder version of myself.
Speaker B: My study desk has three permanent residents: my laptop, my coffee, and my headphones. The moment revision starts, so does my instrumental playlist — nothing with lyrics, because sung words elbow the textbook words out of my memory. With the right background running, formulas settle in quietly and essays untangle themselves. My study group finds it funny that I refuse to revise in silence. Silence, for me, is where concentration goes to die.
Speaker C: I cannot keep a tune to myself — the moment I recognise a song, I am part of it. Full performances happen in my shower, duets with the radio while I cook, and my long drives are basically concerts where I hold every part. My family bangs on the bathroom door; my colleagues have votes about my humming. I accept all criticism and change nothing. Music you only listen to is music half-enjoyed.
Speaker D: The first thing my hand touches in the morning is not the snooze button — it is the play button. My wake-up playlist starts gentle and grows louder, and by the fourth song even my teenage son is vertical. Breakfast has a soundtrack, brushing teeth has a soundtrack, finding lost keys has a dramatic soundtrack. Mornings without that music feel like films with the sound off: technically functional, but joyless.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = To relax (PARAPHRASE: "dissolves whatever the week left... tension draining... calmer version"). B = While studying (keyword "revision... textbook... study group"). C = While singing (PARAPHRASE: "I am part of it... performances... hold every part"). D = After waking up (PARAPHRASE: "first thing my hand touches in the morning... wake-up playlist"). Nhiễu: while driving, before bed. (Variant khác lời Đề 16/22.)

questions.prompt: There is too much information on the Internet
questions.explanation:
W: Have you seen the digital skills course they've just put on at the community centre?
M: I have, and I'd say it's long overdue. If you ask me, the real trouble with the web now is the sheer quantity of material — there's far more of it out there than anybody could ever wade through.
W: Hmm, I'm not so sure about that. There's a lot out there, I'll give you that, but I honestly don't think volume is the enemy. Nobody stands in a supermarket complaining that the shelves are too full.
M: In a supermarket you pick one shelf and walk away. Online you've got ten thousand shelves shouting at you at once.
W: Even so. What I'd say the course is genuinely for is that pulling anything useful out of the web is a proper craft. You have to be taught how to do it.
M: Yes, exactly, I'd go along with that entirely. Narrowing a search sensibly, working out whether a site can be trusted — none of that comes naturally to anyone at all.
W: Quite. My dad types a whole sentence into the box and then gives up when the first result is rubbish.
M: Mine reads the advert at the top of the page and treats it as gospel truth.
W: Actually, there's something rather bigger going on as well. I'm convinced that all this scrolling is quietly reshaping the way our minds work — how we reason, how we hold on to an idea.
M: Hang on, I can't go along with that one. Our routines have changed beyond recognition, obviously, and I'll accept that much happily. But the underlying thinking itself? No, I'd say that's much as it ever was.
W: You would say that. I certainly can't follow a complicated argument the way I could ten years ago.
M: That might just be your workload, to be honest. What I will sign up to, though, is that waiting for anything at all has become unbearable for most of us now.
W: Oh, completely, I'm right with you there. A page takes four seconds to load and I've already shut the tab.
M: Same with a queue, or a kettle. We've lost the knack of standing still.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: Quá nhiều thông tin trên Internet = Man · Dùng Internet cần kỹ năng = Both · Internet đang thay đổi cách ta tư duy = Woman · Internet khiến người ta kém kiên nhẫn = Both

1. There is too much information on the Internet → Man: người đàn ông nêu rõ "the real trouble with the web now is the sheer quantity of material — there's far more of it out there than anybody could ever wade through." Người phụ nữ phản đối: "Hmm, I'm not so sure about that. There's a lot out there, I'll give you that, but I honestly don't think volume is the enemy."

2. Using the Internet requires skills → Both: người phụ nữ nêu "pulling anything useful out of the web is a proper craft. You have to be taught how to do it." Người đàn ông tán thành rõ ràng: "Yes, exactly, I'd go along with that entirely."

3. The Internet is changing the way we think → Woman: người phụ nữ nêu "I'm convinced that all this scrolling is quietly reshaping the way our minds work — how we reason, how we hold on to an idea." Người đàn ông phản đối: "Hang on, I can't go along with that one... But the underlying thinking itself? No, I'd say that's much as it ever was."

4. The Internet has made people less patient → Both: người đàn ông nêu "waiting for anything at all has become unbearable for most of us now", người phụ nữ đồng ý: "Oh, completely, I'm right with you there."

👉 Mẹo: Bẫy nằm ở ý 1 và ý 3 — cả hai lần người nghe đều nhượng bộ một phần ("I'll give you that", "I'll accept that much happily") rồi bác bỏ đúng phần cốt lõi, nên đáp án chỉ là Man hoặc Woman chứ không phải Both.

questions.prompt: Using the Internet requires skills
The Internet is changing the way we think
The Internet has made people less patient
How to maximise productivity?
questions.explanation:
Everyone wants to be more productive these days, and there is plenty of advice about how to get more done. Some managers say the answer is to allocate resources more carefully — making sure that money and equipment go where they are needed most. Others believe it is all about how you use your personnel, giving each employee the task that suits them best. Both ideas can help in a large company, but for one person working alone, I don't think either of them is the key. In my experience, what really maximises productivity is effective time management. When you plan your day carefully, decide what is most important, and keep those hours free from interruptions, you simply get more done with the same energy. Studies show the same thing: people who organise their time well perform better than people who only work when they feel motivated.
Having said that, these strategies are not easy. Some people give up because the systems look complicated at the start, although most methods are actually simple once you have tried them for a week. Others say that a method designed for office work will not fit their particular job, and sometimes that is true. But the real problem, the one that catches almost everyone, is that using these strategies well takes real, continuous effort. Writing a plan is easy; following it on a busy afternoon, when emails keep arriving, is much harder. In the end, it is not about being clever — it is about doing the same simple things every day.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: Effective time management. Bẫy: "allocation of resources" và "utilization of personnel" đều được nhắc rồi gạt ("neither of them is the key").
2. Đáp án: Using them effectively requires effort. Bẫy: "too complicated for beginners" bị hạ ("actually simple once you have tried"), "not suitable for every kind of job" được công nhận một phần nhưng không phải vấn đề chính ("the real problem... is effort").

questions.prompt: What is the problem of the productivity strategies?
options: They are not suitable for every kind of job
They are too complicated for beginners to follow

questions.prompt: Why did the new podcast fail?
options: The creators did not promote their show effectively.
questions.explanation:
You may have heard about the podcast that started here last spring with a lot of excitement — and quietly disappeared six months later. People have given different reasons for this. Some listeners felt the episodes were too long, and it is true that a few of them lasted over an hour. But the numbers show that people who started an episode usually listened to the end, so length was not the real problem. Others say there was too much competition, with thousands of shows fighting for attention. Competition is real, of course, but plenty of small podcasts in even busier areas have grown steadily. No — the reason this one failed is simpler: the creators hardly told anyone it existed. There was nothing on social media, no visits to other shows, no attempt to reach the people who might have been interested. However good your episodes are, an audience cannot find a show it has never heard of. Promotion is not an extra — it is half the job.
Still, one failed show should not change our view of podcasting itself. I know some people say podcasting is a waste of time, and others see it as nothing more than light entertainment for the journey to work. I see it differently. A good podcast brings people together around something they share, lets them hear each other's ideas, and slowly builds a loyal community that few other formats can create. That, to me, is its real value.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The creators did not promote their show effectively. Bẫy: "content too long" bị bác bằng số liệu, "too much competition" (phương án mới thay cho "too many listeners" vô lý) bị bác bằng ví dụ.
2. Đáp án: It is a great way to build a community. Bẫy: "waste of time" và "only useful for entertainment" đều là ý người khác bị phản bác.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker's opinion about podcasting?
options: It is a waste of time.
It is a great way to build a community.
It is only useful for entertainment.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his trip. What did he enjoy last year?
questions.explanation:
People keep asking about my trip last year, so here's the honest version. The hotel offered three activities. I tried hiking on the first day — beautiful views, but my knees complained for a week afterwards. Swimming was on the list too, but the lake was freezing even in July, so I gave up after one dip. What I really enjoyed was the cycling. They gave me a good bike, the paths were flat and quiet, and I rode for hours every day. I've even bought my own bike since!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Cycling.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I really enjoyed was the cycling" — cấu trúc nhấn mạnh cho biết đây mới là hoạt động anh thích; họ còn cho mượn xe tốt và anh đạp hàng giờ mỗi ngày.
• Hiking sai: có thử ngày đầu nhưng đau gối cả tuần sau đó ("my knees complained for a week afterwards").
• Swimming sai: nước hồ lạnh cóng dù đang tháng Bảy, anh bỏ cuộc sau một lần xuống ("the lake was freezing even in July").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "thích hoạt động nào" luôn nêu đủ 3 hoạt động. Chỉ chọn cái đi sau cụm nhấn mạnh "What I really enjoyed/loved was...", bỏ mọi cái đứng trước "but".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about how he goes to work. Why does he prefer traveling by train?
questions.explanation:
Everyone at the office drives, and they tease me about taking the train every day. Let me explain my choice. It's not about money — with the yearly ticket, the train actually costs me about the same as petrol and parking would. And comfort? Honestly, the seats are hard and in winter the heating is a lottery. No — the reason is that it's practical. The station is five minutes from my house, the train stops right by the office, and I answer all my emails on the way. Simple as that.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Practical (tiện lợi).
• Vì sao đúng: "the reason is that it's practical" — ga cách nhà 5 phút, tàu dừng ngay cạnh văn phòng, anh còn trả lời hết email trên đường.
• It's cheaper sai: anh phủ nhận thẳng ("It's not about money") — vé năm tính ra ngang tiền xăng cộng phí gửi xe.
• It's comfortable sai: ghế cứng, mùa đông hệ thống sưởi hên xui ("the seats are hard and in winter the heating is a lottery").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "Why does he prefer...", hãy săn cụm "the reason is" và gạch bỏ mọi ý bị phủ định bằng "It's not about..." hay "Honestly...".

questions.prompt: A man is calling his friend to meet for coffee. Where is the coffee shop located?
questions.explanation:
Hey Marco, it's Ben! Coffee this afternoon, yes? Let me tell you exactly where the place is, because everyone gets lost the first time. It's NOT the one inside the shopping centre — that one closed last month. You know the little gift shop on King Street, with the postcards in the window? Our coffee shop is directly opposite the gift shop — green door, tables outside. Cross the road from the gift shop and you're there. Four o'clock? First coffee is on me!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Opposite the gift shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "Our coffee shop is directly opposite the gift shop — green door, tables outside" — đối diện tiệm quà lưu niệm trên phố King Street.
• In the shopping center sai: người nói phủ định ngay ("It's NOT the one inside the shopping centre") và quán đó đã đóng cửa tháng trước.
• Next to the bookstore sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi vị trí, nghe nguyên cụm giới từ (opposite / next to / inside) gắn với mốc, đừng chộp mỗi tên cửa hàng nghe được.

questions.prompt: Tom is calling his mom. Who is visiting Tom this weekend?
questions.explanation:
Hi Mum, it's Tom! Quick call about the weekend, because my plans just changed completely. You remember I thought Auntie Rose and Uncle Jim might come? They've moved their visit to next month — Jim's back is playing up again. And no, it's not cousin Danny either, he's still working abroad until Christmas. It's actually my sister and her children! All three of them, Saturday to Monday. So I need your lasagne recipe, urgently — the kids won't eat anything else. Call me back!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – His sister and her children.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's actually my sister and her children! All three of them, Saturday to Monday" — nên Tom mới cần gấp công thức lasagne.
• His aunt and uncle sai: đã dời chuyến thăm sang tháng sau vì lưng chú Jim ("They've moved their visit to next month").
• His cousin sai: Danny vẫn làm việc ở nước ngoài đến Giáng sinh ("he's still working abroad until Christmas").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "Who...", chờ cụm bẻ hướng "It's actually..." hoặc "No, it's..." — người xuất hiện ngay sau đó mới là đáp án.

questions.prompt: A tour guide is talking about birds' behaviors. What do birds do in the winter?
options: They stay together in groups for protection
questions.explanation:
If you look up at the tall trees on your left, you'll see dozens of small nests — and this brings me to a question I get on every tour: what do these birds do in the winter? People expect me to say they fly south, but not these ones. These birds stay right here through the coldest months, and they survive by staying together in groups — sometimes fifty or sixty birds sharing one tree, keeping each other warm and safe from the hawks. Protection in numbers. Nature is clever, isn't it?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – They stay together in groups for protection.
• Vì sao đúng: "These birds stay right here through the coldest months, and they survive by staying together in groups" — hướng dẫn viên chốt lại "Protection in numbers".
• They fly south sai: chính hướng dẫn viên bác bỏ ("People expect me to say they fly south, but not these ones").
• They hunt for food sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi về tập tính động vật hay gài đáp án "ai cũng nghĩ" ở đầu bài. Nghe "People expect me to say... but" là biết ý đó sai.

questions.prompt: A man is giving directions to a friend about how to get to the football club. The football club is near?
questions.explanation:
Alright mate, listen carefully, the football club is easy to find once you know the landmark. Take the number six bus to the last stop, then walk straight down Green Lane for about five minutes. You'll see a big park on your right — the one with the bandstand and the little lake. The club is right next to the park; the entrance faces the park gates. If you reach the supermarket, you've gone too far. Training starts at six, don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The club is right next to the park; the entrance faces the park gates" — công viên có bandstand và hồ nhỏ.
• A river sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu (bài chỉ có "the little lake" trong công viên).
• A shopping mall sai: bài chỉ nhắc siêu thị, và đó là mốc báo ĐI QUÁ ("If you reach the supermarket, you've gone too far").
👉 Mẹo: bài chỉ đường luôn có một mốc kiểu "thấy X là đi quá rồi". Mốc đó không bao giờ là đáp án — chọn mốc gắn với "next to / right by".

questions.prompt: A boy is talking about his cat. What does he feed the cat?
questions.explanation:
My cat Whiskers is the fussiest animal in the world, honestly. My friend's cat eats anything — leftovers, biscuits, whatever falls on the floor. Not mine. I feed him fish, and only fish. Tuna on Mondays, white fish the rest of the week, slightly warmed, in the blue bowl — the green bowl is apparently an insult. If I'm five minutes late, he sits on my homework in protest. My dad says the cat runs the house. My dad is right.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Fish.
• Vì sao đúng: "I feed him fish, and only fish" — thứ Hai cá ngừ, các ngày còn lại cá trắng, hâm ấm, đựng bát xanh dương.
• Mice sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Birds sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi đồ ăn/đồ vật, bám các từ giới hạn "only", "nothing but" — câu chứa chúng chính là câu chốt đáp án.

questions.prompt: Jack is phoning his mom. What does Jack need to buy for his sister?
questions.explanation:
Mum, it's Jack, I need your advice — it's Emma's birthday on Sunday and I still haven't got her anything! I'm at the shops right now. So I remembered what you said: don't buy her clothes, because I always get the size wrong, and she has enough toys to open a shop already. That leaves your suggestion — the chocolates. The fancy ones in the gold box, from that little shop by the market, right? The ones with the cherries inside? Text me quickly before it closes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Chocolates.
• Vì sao đúng: "That leaves your suggestion — the chocolates. The fancy ones in the gold box" — loại sô-cô-la có nhân anh đào ở tiệm gần chợ.
• Clothes sai: mẹ dặn đừng mua vì Jack luôn chọn sai cỡ ("don't buy her clothes, because I always get the size wrong").
• A toy sai: Emma đã có quá nhiều đồ chơi ("she has enough toys to open a shop already").
👉 Mẹo: dạng "cần mua gì", cụm "That leaves..." báo hiệu quá trình loại trừ đã xong — món đứng ngay sau nó là đáp án.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her plan for the holiday. What will she do during the holiday?
questions.explanation:
Two more days until my holiday, and I have made my plans! My sister keeps saying I should go for a run every morning — she's training for a marathon and thinks everyone else should suffer too. My neighbour offered to lend me his bike for a ride along the coast, which was kind, but I haven't cycled in years and I'd like to return from holiday in one piece. No — every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end. Perfect.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end."
• Go for a run sai: đó là ý của chị gái đang tập marathon, cô không nhận ("My sister keeps saying I should go for a run").
• Go for a bike ride sai: hàng xóm cho mượn xe nhưng cô đã lâu không đạp và muốn về nhà nguyên vẹn ("I haven't cycled in years").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi kế hoạch, gạch hết ý do người khác đề xuất; đáp án nằm sau "No —" và đi với chủ ngữ "I will".

questions.prompt: A woman shares her job with her friend. Why does she want to become a writer?
questions.explanation:
M: So I heard the big news — you're really leaving the bank to become a writer?
W: I am! I handed in my notice on Friday. Everyone thinks I've gone mad.
M: Well... a little. Is it the dream of seeing your name everywhere? Becoming famous?
W: Honestly, no — most writers stay completely unknown, and I'm fine with that.
M: It can't be the money either. Books pay terribly, don't they?
W: Terribly! I'll earn half of what I make now, at best. No — remember the letters I got after my article about my mother's illness? People wrote that it helped them through their own worst weeks. That's why. I want to write things that help people.
M: That... is actually a beautiful reason. I'll buy the first copy.
W: You'll get it free. Signed!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Help people.
• Vì sao đúng: sau khi kể về những lá thư độc giả gửi, cô chốt "That's why. I want to write things that help people."
• Become famous sai: cô bác bỏ ngay ("most writers stay completely unknown, and I'm fine with that").
• Earn money sai: thu nhập chỉ bằng một nửa hiện tại ("I'll earn half of what I make now, at best").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do trong hội thoại, người kia thường "mớm" 2 lý do sai trước; đáp án là lý do người trả lời tự đưa ra sau "No —".

questions.prompt: Lucy is calling her brother. What does the brother have to drink?
questions.explanation:
W: Hi, it's Lucy! I'm coming over in ten minutes with the cake. What have you got to drink at yours?
M: Er... let me check the kitchen. Right. So. The tea situation: Mum used the last bags on her book club yesterday.
W: Of course she did. Coffee, then? Cake needs coffee.
M: The jar is... empty. I forgot to buy more, don't shout at me.
W: Brother of the year! So what CAN you offer your favourite sister?
M: Water! Lovely, cold water from the fridge. I have LOTS of water.
W: Water with birthday cake. Wonderful. I'm buying tea on the way, put the kettle on!
M: Knew you would. See you in ten!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Water.
• Vì sao đúng: "Water! Lovely, cold water from the fridge. I have LOTS of water." — đó là thứ duy nhất anh trai còn.
• Tea sai: mẹ đã dùng hết túi trà cuối cùng cho câu lạc bộ sách ("Mum used the last bags on her book club yesterday").
• Coffee sai: hũ cà phê rỗng vì cậu quên mua ("The jar is... empty. I forgot to buy more").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "có gì để uống/ăn", săn các cụm báo HẾT: "used the last", "empty", "run out"; thứ duy nhất còn lại chính là đáp án.

questions.prompt: Lucy is calling her friend. What is her sister like?
options: She is very different from Lucy
questions.explanation:
M: Lucy! How was the weekend with your sister? I've still never met her, you know.
W: Wonderful, as always. People are so surprised when they finally meet her.
M: Why? Is she taller than you? You always say she gets noticed first.
W: Ha! No, we're exactly the same height, actually. It's not about looks at all.
M: Then what surprises everyone?
W: How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences. Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice.
M: That's lovely. So if I like you, I'll like her.
W: Exactly. Double trouble, they call us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – They have similar characters.
• Vì sao đúng: "How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences."
• She is taller than Lucy sai: hai chị em cao bằng nhau ("we're exactly the same height, actually").
• She is very different from Lucy sai: ngược lại hoàn toàn — "Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ngoại hình/tính cách, chú ý cặp đối lập "looks vs inside"; câu "It's not about looks at all" đã loại sạch nhóm ngoại hình.

questions.prompt: A man and a woman are going shopping. What does he buy in the store?
questions.explanation:
W: Right, we're here — now remind me what you actually need?
M: Something for the new job. First impressions and all that.
W: Ooh, look at these T-shirts! This blue one would suit you.
M: For the office? On day one? I'd be sent home before lunch!
W: Fair. Oh — and look at these hats! Try the grey one, go on.
M: You're not taking this seriously at all. I'm not buying a hat.
W: Fine, fine. The suits are over there. That navy one looks sharp.
M: Now we're talking. Navy suit, white shirt... yes. This is the one — I'm buying the suit.
W: Very handsome. Can we look at the hats again now?
M: You buy a hat. I'll wait outside!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A suit for the office.
• Vì sao đúng: "Navy suit, white shirt... yes. This is the one — I'm buying the suit." — mua cho công việc mới.
• A T-shirt sai: không hợp ngày đầu đi làm ("For the office? On day one? I'd be sent home before lunch!").
• A hat sai: anh từ chối thẳng ("I'm not buying a hat") và bảo cô bạn tự mua nếu thích.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại mua sắm, đáp án là món đi kèm câu quyết định ở hiện tại tiếp diễn hoặc "I'll take..."; món chỉ được ướm thử đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about protecting the environment. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: Open my cleaning cupboard and you will find exactly four things: white vinegar, baking soda, a block of plain soap and old cloths cut from worn-out shirts. The supermarket sprays with their skulls and warnings left this house when my asthma got worse, and honestly, nothing has been dirtier since. My mother-in-law inspects my kitchen on every visit hoping to win the argument. Five years running, the vinegar is still champion.
Speaker B: My loft was a museum of forgotten things until last spring. Now there is a rule: whatever we no longer use must find a new owner within the month. The children's bicycles went to the refugee centre, my old tools to the young man fixing up the house opposite, and four boxes of books to the hospital library. Selling never crossed my mind — watching the neighbour's boy ride off on my son's old bike paid better than money.
Speaker C: I have become that person who studies packaging in the supermarket aisle. If the label cannot tell me the cotton was grown responsibly or the paper came from managed forests, the product stays on the shelf. My weekly shop takes twice as long and costs a little extra, but my basket is my ballot paper. Companies count every purchase, so I make every purchase say something.
Speaker D: Nothing that once held food gets binned in my kitchen. The tall pasta jars now organise my whole pantry, margarine tubs stack in the freezer full of portioned stews, and the biscuit tins carry cakes to every school fair in the district. My wife jokes that our shelves are a graveyard of other products' packaging. Perhaps — but we have not bought storage boxes in a decade, and our food waste fits in a teacup.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = Does not use commercial cleaning products (PARAPHRASE: "supermarket sprays... left this house... vinegar is champion"). B = Give away used items (PARAPHRASE: "find a new owner... paid better than money"). C = Buy environmentally friendly products (keyword-lite "grown responsibly... managed forests"). D = Reuse containers for storing food (keyword "jars organise my pantry... tubs... tins"). Nhiễu: walk instead of driving, reusable bags.

questions.prompt: Language is the biggest difficulty when people try to understand a local culture
questions.explanation:
Woman: Back from my month in the highlands, and I have one conclusion: you can smile, point and share meals all you like, but until you can speak with people in their own words, the real life of a place stays behind glass. I watched ceremonies I half-understood and jokes I missed entirely. The tongue is the door, and mine stayed locked.
Man: Funny — I have travelled wordless through plenty of places and felt the doors open anyway, through markets and music and shared work. A phrasebook helps, but I would not call it the main wall. What did strike me on my own trips is how the same shops, the same songs and the same screens now greet you everywhere. The world is blending.
Woman: That blending was everywhere in the highlands too — teenagers in global fashion under grandmother's roof, festival dances rehearsed from online videos. The old patterns are being stirred into one big pot, village by village. We watched it happen in different countries and brought home the same photograph.
Man: We did. And I will say the harder thing: the grandchildren are letting go. The old crafts, the ceremonies, the recipes — the young people I met shrugged at all of it. Their eyes point at the cities and the future, not the family altar.
Woman: Some shrug, but I met plenty of young people fighting to keep the old flames lit — recording the songs, learning the weaving. I refuse to sign their surrender yet. So how should an outsider truly learn another way of life, in your view?
Man: Boots on the ground — nothing else comes close. One week walking someone's streets teaches more than a shelf of books or a hundred documentaries. Go there, eat there, get lost there.
Woman: Books and films have taught me plenty from my own sofa, so I will keep both tickets, thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: W-B-M-M (giữ nguyên). Paraphrase:
1. "Language biggest difficulty" → W: "The tongue is the door, and mine stayed locked" — M "I would not call it the main wall".
2. "Globalisation changing local traditions" → B: "The world is blending" + "stirred into one big pot... same photograph".
3. "Younger generation does not care" → M: "the grandchildren are letting go... shrugged at all of it" — W "I refuse to sign their surrender".
4. "Visiting in person most effective" → M: "Boots on the ground — nothing else comes close" — W "I will keep both tickets".

questions.prompt: Globalisation is changing local traditions and ways of life
The younger generation does not care as much about their traditional culture
Visiting places in person is the most effective way to learn about different cultures
What is the speaker's advice?
options: Be well informed of the places you are going to visit.
Always carry extra water and food supplies.
questions.explanation:
Last year I cycled from Vietnam to Portugal, and since then everyone asks me for advice about long cycling trips. Most people expect me to talk about equipment. They assume the golden rule is to always carry extra water and food supplies, enough for several days. Others tell me the secret must be planning a route that avoids rough terrain completely.
