Honestly, neither is my main advice. You can buy water in almost every village on Earth, and some of my best days were on terrible roads. My real advice is this: be well informed about the places you are going to visit. Before I set off, I spent two months reading about every region on my route — where the borders close early, which areas flood in spring, where to find a mechanic. That knowledge saved me more times than any spare tyre ever did.
And if I zoom out to the bigger lesson of the whole journey, it is about people. Some cyclists plan trips around the weather, only visiting places in the perfect season. Others tell you to just cycle at your own pace and not worry about the destination. Fine — but both miss what actually makes a trip unforgettable: knowing the people and cultures of the different countries you cross. Learn twenty words of each language. Accept the tea you are offered. Ask the old man at the petrol station about his village. The kilometres disappear from your memory within a year; the people never do.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: Be well informed of the places you are going to visit. Bẫy: "extra water and food" và "avoid rough terrain" đều bị gạt ("neither is my main advice").
2. Đáp án: Knowing the people and cultures in the different countries. Bẫy: "good weather conditions" và "cycle at your own pace" được nhắc rồi bị loại ("both miss what actually makes a trip unforgettable").

questions.prompt: What is the speaker's advice in general?
options: Knowing the people and cultures in the different countries.
Only visit places with good weather conditions.
Cycle at your own pace without worrying about the destination.

questions.prompt: What is the strength of the book?
options: It is a very short story.
It has a good description of a specific period of time.
It focuses only on famous people.
questions.explanation:
This new biography has been getting a lot of attention, so let me tell you what I think after reading it twice. First, do not be fooled by what you may have heard. Some people call it a very short story — in fact it runs to six hundred pages. Others complain that books like this focus only on famous people, but the author gives just as much space to the subject's unknown childhood friends and forgotten colleagues as to the celebrities he later met. The genuine strength of the book is its description of a specific period of time. The author rebuilds the nineteen-fifties in extraordinary detail — the prices in the shops, the songs on the radio, the fears people carried through the decade. Reading it, you do not just learn about one man's life; you walk through the world he lived in, street by street.
The critics have had plenty to say as well, and their discussion is interesting. A few worried at first that the book would be too difficult to understand, and one reviewer even suspected it contained too many fictional details. Both concerns faded once they read it carefully — the language is clear and every scene is supported by documents. What the critics actually agree on is this: it is an unconventional biography. It ignores the traditional rules of the genre, jumps through time, and sometimes lets minor characters tell whole chapters. That unusual structure is exactly what makes it stand out from every other biography this year.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It has a good description of a specific period of time. Bẫy: "very short story" bị phủ định ("six hundred pages"), "focuses only on famous people" bị phủ định.
2. Đáp án: It is an unconventional biography. Bẫy: "too difficult to understand" và "too many fictional details" là lo ngại ban đầu đã bị xóa ("Both concerns faded").

questions.prompt: What do the critics say about the book?
options: It is too difficult to understand.
It contains too many fictional details.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about shopping places. Where is she going to go shopping?
questions.explanation:
Saturday is shopping day, and this time I have a plan! Normally I just go to the mall — it's close, but honestly I know every shop in there by heart now. My sister keeps talking about that little boutique on Rose Street, but their prices make my eyes water, one dress costs my whole weekend budget. So instead I'm going to the new shopping centre by the river — it opened last month, over a hundred shops, and everything has opening discounts. I'll be there when the doors open!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At a new shopping center.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm going to the new shopping centre by the river — it opened last month, over a hundred shops, and everything has opening discounts".
• At the mall sai: cô đã chán vì quá quen ("I know every shop in there by heart now").
• At a boutique sai: là gợi ý của chị gái nhưng giá quá đắt ("their prices make my eyes water, one dress costs my whole weekend budget").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi nơi chốn, đáp án thường nằm sau "So instead I'm going to..."; hai nơi nêu trước chỉ để loại trừ.

questions.prompt: A man is describing his school. What color is the teacher's building?
questions.explanation:
Let me describe my school, because it's surprisingly colourful! The main building where we have lessons is green — bright green, you can spot it from the bus stop. Behind it stands the sports hall, painted blue like our team shirts. And then there's the teachers' building, the neat little one by the garden — that one is white. Completely white, with a red roof; the teachers say it stays cool in summer. White walls, quiet rooms — and woe to any student who leaves fingerprints on them!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – White.
• Vì sao đúng: "there's the teachers' building, the neat little one by the garden — that one is white. Completely white, with a red roof".
• Green sai: đó là màu tòa nhà học chính ("The main building where we have lessons is green").
• Blue sai: đó là màu nhà thể thao, sơn theo áo đội tuyển ("the sports hall, painted blue like our team shirts").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi màu sắc, mỗi màu được gán cho một tòa nhà khác nhau. Nghe kỹ DANH TỪ đứng trước màu, đừng chộp màu nghe được đầu tiên.

questions.prompt: James is talking about his family members. In what way does his mother and his aunt alike?
questions.explanation:
Looking at these old family photos always makes me smile. Here's my mother and my aunt at the seaside, years before I was born. Funny thing — people never guessed they were sisters. Different hairstyles their whole lives: Mum short and curly, Auntie with the long plait. Different eyes too — one brown pair, one grey. But one thing they shared completely: both were remarkably thin. Thin as reeds, all their lives, however much grandma fed them. In every photo they look like two elegant matchsticks!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They were thin.
• Vì sao đúng: "one thing they shared completely: both were remarkably thin. Thin as reeds, all their lives".
• They had similar hair styles sai: tóc khác nhau cả đời ("Different hairstyles their whole lives: Mum short and curly, Auntie with the long plait").
• They had similar eye colors sai: mắt cũng khác nhau ("Different eyes too — one brown pair, one grey").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi điểm GIỐNG nhau thì săn cụm "one thing they shared", "both were"; mọi chi tiết đi sau "Different" đều là bẫy.

questions.prompt: Listen to Sarah talking about her hobby. What does she do in her free time?
options: Go to the beach and swim
Go to theater and play sports
questions.explanation:
People think I just sit at home because I work in a library, but my free time is the opposite! Two things fill my evenings and weekends. First, the theatre — I never miss a new play, I've seen everything our city theatre has staged this year, even the strange modern ones. And second, sports — tennis on Tuesdays, volleyball with the girls on Fridays. Going to the theatre and playing sports — one for the mind, one for the body, as my grandmother used to say!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go to theater and play sports.
• Vì sao đúng: cô tự tổng kết đúng hai việc: "Going to the theatre and playing sports — one for the mind, one for the body".
• Go to the beach and swim sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Watch TV and read books sai: bài chỉ nói người ta TƯỞNG cô ngồi nhà vì làm ở thư viện, rồi bác ngay ("my free time is the opposite").
👉 Mẹo: phương án có HAI hoạt động thì phải đúng cả hai. Bám cụm đếm "Two things fill my evenings... First... And second...".

questions.prompt: A tour guide is talking about the vacation list of activities. What can people do in the afternoon?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, everyone, let me walk you through today's activity list! The mornings this week are for the museums — the art gallery today, the history museum tomorrow, always before lunch when the rooms are quiet. Now, the afternoons: I know the programme mentioned swimming, but the pool is closed for repairs until Friday, I'm sorry. Instead, the afternoon activity is golf! The hotel course is beautiful, clubs are free for our group, and beginners are very welcome. We meet at the course at two o'clock!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Play golf.
• Vì sao đúng: "the afternoon activity is golf! The hotel course is beautiful, clubs are free for our group" — hẹn ở sân lúc 2 giờ.
• Visit museums sai: đó là hoạt động buổi SÁNG ("The mornings this week are for the museums").
• Go swimming sai: có in trong chương trình nhưng bể đang sửa đến thứ Sáu ("the pool is closed for repairs until Friday").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lịch trình, khóa mốc thời gian trong câu hỏi (afternoon) trước khi chọn; hoạt động in sẵn trong programme thường đã bị thay đổi.

questions.prompt: Listen to a teacher talking about meeting preparations. What is the teacher preparing for the meeting now?
questions.explanation:
Quick update on tomorrow's parents' meeting, so everyone knows where we stand. The documents are done — I printed all forty copies this morning, they're in the blue folder on my desk. The seating is also finished; the caretaker arranged the hall yesterday, five rows, plenty of space. What I'm doing right now is ordering the food — sandwiches, fruit, and coffee for about fifty people. I'm on the phone with the caterer the moment I finish this message. We'll be ready!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Order the food.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I'm doing right now is ordering the food — sandwiches, fruit, and coffee for about fifty people".
• Print the documents sai: đã in xong sáng nay ("The documents are done — I printed all forty copies this morning").
• Arrange the seating sai: bác bảo vệ đã xếp hội trường từ hôm qua ("the caretaker arranged the hall yesterday").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "now" thì phải phân biệt thì. Việc chia quá khứ (printed, arranged) là đã xong; chọn việc đi với "right now / I'm ...ing".

questions.prompt: Listen to an actor discussing his hobbies. What does the actor like to do in his free time?
questions.explanation:
Everyone assumes actors spend their evenings watching films — studying the craft, you know. Honestly? After twelve hours on set, the last thing I want is another screen. My nephew keeps trying to get me into video games too, and I'm hopeless, he beats me in about a minute. What I really love is drawing. Give me a pencil, a sketchbook and a quiet café, and I'm happy for hours. I draw the crew, the sets, strangers on trains. It empties my head like nothing else.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Drawing.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I really love is drawing. Give me a pencil, a sketchbook and a quiet café, and I'm happy for hours."
• Watching movies sai: sau 12 tiếng quay phim anh không muốn nhìn màn hình nữa ("the last thing I want is another screen").
• Playing video games sai: cháu trai rủ nhưng anh chơi rất dở ("I'm hopeless, he beats me in about a minute").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi sở thích, câu mở đầu "Everyone assumes..." là dấu hiệu ý đó SAI; đáp án nằm sau "What I really love is".

questions.prompt: Listen to a principal talking about new school facilities. What new facility will the school have?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, everyone — I have exciting news about our school's future! As you know, we asked for your ideas last term. Many parents suggested a new library, but the town built one just two streets away, so we'd rather not repeat it. The students, of course, voted for another sports field — but we simply don't have the land, I'm afraid. What we WILL have, from next September, is a performance space! A proper stage, lights, two hundred seats — for our plays, our concerts, everything. Construction starts this summer!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – A performance space.
• Vì sao đúng: "What we WILL have, from next September, is a performance space! A proper stage, lights, two hundred seats" — khởi công mùa hè này.
• A new library sai: thị trấn vừa xây một thư viện cách hai dãy phố nên trường không làm lại ("the town built one just two streets away").
• A sports field sai: học sinh bầu chọn nhưng trường không đủ đất ("we simply don't have the land, I'm afraid").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi công trình sẽ có, bám thì tương lai "will have"; ý gắn với "suggested" hay "voted for" chỉ là đề xuất đã bị loại.

questions.prompt: Listening to a man talking about his business trip. What does he like in Dubai?
questions.explanation:
People ask how the business trip to Dubai is going, so here's my report from the hotel! It's certainly an experience. The famous shopping? Not for me — the malls are enormous and I get lost and bored in about twenty minutes. And the weather, goodness — forty-two degrees today, I practically run between air-conditioned buildings. But the work! The project here is fascinating, the team is brilliant, and every day brings a new challenge. I genuinely enjoy my job here — so much that I might extend the contract.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – He enjoys his job here.
• Vì sao đúng: "I genuinely enjoy my job here — so much that I might extend the contract" (dự án hay, đội ngũ giỏi).
• He enjoys shopping sai: anh thấy trung tâm mua sắm quá rộng, lạc và chán ("I get lost and bored in about twenty minutes").
• He enjoys the weather sai: 42 độ, anh phải chạy giữa các tòa nhà có điều hòa.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What does he like", đáp án thường nằm sau "But" ở cuối bài; hai ý trước bị hạ bằng "Not for me" hoặc lời than.

questions.prompt: Jorge is calling his friend about their plan for the weekend. What time does the football match start?
questions.explanation:
M: Hey, it's Jorge! Are we still going to the football match tomorrow?
W: Absolutely! But I keep hearing different kick-off times. Someone said three?
M: Three was last week's game. This one is different — it's the cup, so they moved everything.
W: Then my brother said five pm. He swears he read it somewhere.
M: He read the OLD poster! They changed it for the TV broadcast. The match starts at one pm sharp.
W: One?! In the middle of lunch! We'll have to eat at the stadium then.
M: Exactly the plan — hot dogs at half twelve, seats by quarter to one.
W: Deal. Pick me up at noon, and don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "The match starts at one pm sharp" — giờ bị đổi để phù hợp lịch phát sóng truyền hình.
• 3pm sai: đó là giờ của trận TUẦN TRƯỚC ("Three was last week's game").
• 5pm sai: em trai đọc trên poster CŨ ("He read the OLD poster! They changed it for the TV broadcast").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ, mỗi mốc sai đều kèm dấu hiệu lỗi thời ("last week's", "the OLD poster"); chốt bằng cụm "starts at ... sharp".

questions.prompt: A woman is discussing with her team. How many chairs does she need?
questions.explanation:
W: Right, team — the workshop on Saturday. Let's talk chairs.
M: The big list says twenty-five people registered, so twenty-five chairs?
W: That was Monday's number. Five people cancelled yesterday — the ones from the north office, their train line is closed.
M: Ah, so we're down to twenty. Should we just set out fifteen? People always drop out on the day.
W: Too risky — last time we did that, three people stood for an hour and complained for a week.
M: Fair. So the final number is...?
W: Twenty. Twenty chairs, in four rows of five, facing the screen. I need them set up by nine.
M: Twenty chairs by nine. Consider it done, boss!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 20.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the final number is...? Twenty. Twenty chairs, in four rows of five, facing the screen."
• 25 sai: là số đăng ký hôm thứ Hai, sau đó 5 người ở văn phòng phía bắc hủy ("Five people cancelled yesterday").
• 15 sai: là đề xuất bị bác vì lần trước thiếu ghế ("Too risky — last time we did that, three people stood for an hour").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi số lượng luôn có phép cộng/trừ. Nghe "cancelled", "dropped out" để tính lại, rồi bám cụm "the final number is".

questions.prompt: Adam is calling his friend. When will he need the computer?
questions.explanation:
M: Hey, it's Adam! Big favour to ask — could I borrow your computer this week?
W: Probably! Mine's free most days. When exactly do you need it?
M: So, my presentation for the club was supposed to be Tuesday...
W: Was? What happened?
M: The hall is being painted, so Tuesday is cancelled. Then they offered Thursday, but the chairman can't make Thursday.
W: This club of yours is chaos. So when is it actually happening?
M: Friday! Confirmed this morning, seven o'clock. So I'd need the computer on Friday — I'll pick it up after lunch and return it the same night.
W: Friday works. It'll be charged and ready for you.
M: You're a lifesaver. Pizza's on me next week!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Friday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Friday! Confirmed this morning, seven o'clock. So I'd need the computer on Friday".
• Thursday sai: có được đề nghị nhưng chủ nhiệm câu lạc bộ bận ("the chairman can't make Thursday").
• Tuesday sai: buổi ban đầu bị hủy vì hội trường đang sơn ("The hall is being painted, so Tuesday is cancelled").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ngày, săn từ khóa xác nhận "Confirmed", "It's settled"; ngày đi với "cancelled" hay "can't make" luôn bị loại.

questions.prompt: Listen to a conversation between the teacher and a parent. What will the father do?
questions.explanation:
W: Thank you for coming in, Mr. Collins. I wanted to talk about Ben's maths — he's fallen behind this term.
M: I know, we've seen it in his homework too. My wife even wondered about moving him to another school.
W: Honestly, I wouldn't. He's happy here, his friends are here — changing schools would solve nothing.
M: That's what I told her. What about the after-school programme, the homework club?
W: It's full until January, I'm afraid — there's a waiting list.
M: Hmm. Then we'll go with the other option we discussed at home: I'll arrange private classes for him. My colleague knows an excellent maths tutor, two evenings a week.
W: That would be ideal — one-to-one attention is exactly what Ben needs right now.
M: I'll call the tutor tonight. Thank you, Miss Reed.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Arrange private classes.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll arrange private classes for him. My colleague knows an excellent maths tutor, two evenings a week."
• Change schools sai: cô giáo khuyên không nên và người bố đồng ý ("changing schools would solve nothing").
• Enroll in after-school programs sai: câu lạc bộ làm bài tập đã kín chỗ đến tháng Một ("It's full until January, there's a waiting list").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What will the father do", chỉ chọn việc do CHÍNH người bố hứa làm ("I'll..."), không chọn ý được gợi ý rồi bị bác.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his holiday. How is he going to travel to the city?
questions.explanation:
The holiday is booked at last — one week in the capital! Now, the travel plan. Driving is out: parking in the city costs a fortune, and I'd spend half the holiday looking for a space. The train was my first choice, honestly, but there are engineering works that week and the line is closed on both weekends. So I'm going by bus — the express coach, six in the morning, straight to the city centre in four hours. Cheap ticket, and I'll sleep the whole way!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By bus.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I'm going by bus — the express coach, six in the morning, straight to the city centre in four hours".
• By car sai: bị loại ngay từ đầu ("Driving is out: parking in the city costs a fortune").
• By train sai: tuần đó thi công đường ray, tuyến đóng cả hai cuối tuần ("the line is closed on both weekends").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phương tiện, săn cụm loại trừ "is out", "is closed"; đáp án đi với "So I'm going by...".

questions.prompt: Lily is talking about her daily routine. What does she do in the evening?
questions.explanation:
My daily routine is quite ordinary until the evening — that's when I have my little ritual. After dinner, I change into comfortable clothes, put my phone in the drawer, and go for a walk. Every single evening, forty minutes, the same loop through the quiet streets and along the canal. Summer or winter, rain or clear sky — the walk happens. It clears my head after work better than anything else I've tried. My neighbours say they could set their clocks by me!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Goes for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "After dinner, I change into comfortable clothes, put my phone in the drawer, and go for a walk. Every single evening, forty minutes".
• Does yoga sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Watches TV sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; bài chỉ nói cô cất điện thoại vào ngăn kéo trước khi ra ngoài.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi thói quen, khóa mốc thời gian trong câu hỏi (evening) rồi bắt động từ đứng ngay sau mốc đó trong bài.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his mother. How long will he be late?
questions.explanation:
Hi Mum, it's me — don't take the roast out yet! I'm still at the office; the printer decided to die exactly five minutes before my report was due, typical. The good news: everything is sent now and I'm packing my bag as I speak. The traffic app says the roads are clear, so I'll only be about ten minutes late — ten, no more, I promise. Keep my plate warm and don't let Dad eat my potatoes! See you very soon!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 10 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll only be about ten minutes late — ten, no more, I promise" — đường đang thông thoáng.
• 15 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• 20 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi số phút trễ, đừng chộp con số đầu tiên; người nói thường nhắc lại con số đúng ngay sau đó ("ten, no more").

questions.prompt: A woman is going to the cinema with her husband. What time does the movie begin?
questions.explanation:
Darling, it's me — change of plan for the cinema tonight, listen carefully! I know we talked about the nine twenty show, but that finishes after midnight and you have your early meeting tomorrow. And the seven o'clock one is completely sold out — I just checked, not a single pair of seats together. So I've booked the early show instead: it begins at six forty. Six forty sharp, so leave the office by six at the latest. I'll get the popcorn — see you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6:40.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I've booked the early show instead: it begins at six forty. Six forty sharp".
• 7:00 sai: suất đó đã bán hết vé, không còn hai ghế cạnh nhau ("completely sold out").
• 9:20 sai: là suất bàn ban đầu nhưng kết thúc sau nửa đêm, trong khi chồng có họp sớm hôm sau.
👉 Mẹo: giờ tiếng Anh hay đọc rời "six forty"; nghe từng chữ số và bám động từ quyết định "I've booked".

questions.prompt: A man is calling his friend. Where will they meet?
questions.explanation:
Hey Chris, it's Alex — about tomorrow! Small change: we're NOT meeting at the school gates like usual, the whole street is dug up for pipe works and it's chaos. I also thought about the café, but Saturday mornings there are madness, we'd queue for an hour just for the table. So let's make it simple: meet me by the park — the main entrance, next to the fountain, eleven o'clock. We can decide about lunch from there. Text me if that's a problem!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "So let's make it simple: meet me by the park — the main entrance, next to the fountain, eleven o'clock".
• At school sai: cả con phố đang bị đào để làm đường ống ("the whole street is dug up for pipe works").
• In the cafe sai: sáng thứ Bảy quán quá đông, phải xếp hàng cả tiếng chỉ để có bàn.
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn đổi kế hoạch luôn mở đầu bằng "we're NOT meeting at..."; địa điểm đúng nằm sau "So let's make it simple".

questions.prompt: Dan is going to university. Where should Dan turn right?
questions.explanation:
Dan, listen carefully, the university is easy to find if you follow this exactly. Go straight down Main Street — don't turn there, whatever the sat-nav says, that route takes you through the market and you'll sit in traffic forever. You'll pass the hospital on your left; keep going, don't turn at the hospital either. When you reach the traffic lights — the big junction with the petrol station — turn right there. The campus gates are two hundred metres ahead. Traffic lights, right turn. Good luck on your first day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At the traffic lights.
• Vì sao đúng: "When you reach the traffic lights — the big junction with the petrol station — turn right there".
• At the Main Street sai: được dặn đi thẳng, không rẽ ("Go straight down Main Street — don't turn there").
• At the hospital sai: cũng được dặn không rẽ ("keep going, don't turn at the hospital either").
👉 Mẹo: bài chỉ đường luôn cài 2 mốc gắn "don't turn". Chỉ mốc đi kèm "turn right/left there" mới là đáp án.

questions.prompt: A saleswoman is talking to her customer. How much is the cheapest computer in the shop?
questions.explanation:
Welcome in, and you're asking about our computers — let me give you the honest picture. The one in the window, with the big screen, is one hundred and fifty-five pounds — lovely machine, but that's our top model. The silver one on the middle shelf is one hundred and forty-five. But if you want the best price in the shop, look at this one here: one hundred and thirty-five pounds — our cheapest computer, and honestly, for emails and studying it does everything the expensive ones do. And it comes with a free mouse this week!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 135 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "look at this one here: one hundred and thirty-five pounds — our cheapest computer".
• 145 pounds sai: đó là máy màu bạc ở kệ giữa ("The silver one on the middle shelf is one hundred and forty-five").
• 155 pounds sai: đó là máy trong tủ kính, model cao cấp nhất ("that's our top model").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá RẺ NHẤT thì phải nghe hết cả ba mức rồi mới chọn; bám tính từ so sánh nhất "cheapest / top model" gắn với từng con số.

questions.prompt: A tour guide is introducing a famous building. What is this building currently used for?
questions.explanation:
And here we are in front of the most photographed building in our city! A quick history: it opened a century ago as a grand cinema — a thousand seats, red velvet, the works. Between the wars it even served as a museum of science for a decade. But today? Walk through those doors and you'll find six floors of shopping — it's now a department store, one of the biggest in the country. They kept the beautiful old ceiling, though. Shall we go in and look?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A department store.
• Vì sao đúng: "But today? Walk through those doors and you'll find six floors of shopping — it's now a department store, one of the biggest in the country."
• A museum sai: chỉ là công năng trong thời kỳ giữa hai cuộc chiến ("Between the wars it even served as a museum of science for a decade").
• A cinema sai: đó là công năng khi khánh thành một thế kỷ trước ("it opened a century ago as a grand cinema").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "currently" thì phải bắt thì hiện tại. Mọi công năng kể ở quá khứ (opened as, served as) đều là bẫy.

questions.prompt: David is in an interview. What was his last job?
questions.explanation:
Thank you for asking about my background — let me walk you through it. People see engineering on my certificate and assume that was my last position, but that degree is from years ago; I never actually worked as an engineer. After university I spent two years as a maths teacher, which taught me patience, believe me. But my most recent job, the one I've just left after six years, was as an electrician — wiring new houses for a building company. That hands-on experience is exactly what I'd bring to this role.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – An electrician.
• Vì sao đúng: "my most recent job, the one I've just left after six years, was as an electrician — wiring new houses for a building company".
• An engineer sai: chỉ là tấm bằng, anh chưa từng làm nghề đó ("I never actually worked as an engineer").
• A teacher sai: là việc cũ hơn, hai năm ngay sau đại học ("After university I spent two years as a maths teacher").
👉 Mẹo: "last job" là hỏi việc GẦN NHẤT. Bám cụm "most recent", "I've just left"; bằng cấp không phải nghề nghiệp.

questions.prompt: A man is talking to his friend. Why does he choose to be a doctor?
options: To make a lot of money
questions.explanation:
W: So, Doctor Matthews! I still remember you in school saying you'd never touch medicine. What changed?
M: Everyone reminds me of that! And they all have theories about why I did it.
W: Your parents, surely. Your mum tells the whole town about her son the doctor.
M: She does, bless her — but making the family proud was never the reason. They'd be proud if I baked bread.
W: The money, then? Doctors don't exactly starve.
M: Ha! After ten years of training and student loans, trust me, there are easier ways to get rich. No — it was the summer I volunteered at the clinic. I watched a nurse calm a frightened old man, and I thought: I want to do THAT. I chose it to help people. Simple as it sounds.
W: That's the best answer you could give.
M: It's the only one I have!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To help people.
• Vì sao đúng: sau mùa hè tình nguyện ở phòng khám anh chốt "I chose it to help people. Simple as it sounds."
• To make his family proud sai: anh phủ nhận ("making the family proud was never the reason. They'd be proud if I baked bread").
• To make a lot of money sai: sau 10 năm học và nợ sinh viên thì có nhiều cách làm giàu dễ hơn ("there are easier ways to get rich").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "Why", nghe đủ 3 lý do rồi mới chốt; lý do do người kia đoán và bị bác bằng "never the reason" đều sai.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking to the police. What did she lose?
questions.explanation:
M: Good afternoon, madam. Take a seat — what can we help you with?
W: Thank you, officer. I've lost something on the bus this morning and I'm quite shaken.
M: Let's get the details. A wallet? We've had three handed in today.
W: No — my wallet was in my coat pocket the whole time, thank goodness, cards and all.
M: Good. A necklace, then? Chains snap on crowded buses more often than you'd think.
W: Not that either — I don't wear jewellery on workdays. It's my bag, officer. The brown leather handbag — I set it on the seat beside me, the bus braked hard, and in the confusion I stepped off without it.
M: A brown leather handbag, the number seven route... let me ring the depot; drivers check the seats at the terminus.
W: Please do — my diary and my glasses are in there. My whole week is in that bag!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A bag.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's my bag, officer. The brown leather handbag — I set it on the seat beside me" rồi xuống xe mà quên.
• A necklace sai: cô không đeo trang sức vào ngày đi làm ("I don't wear jewellery on workdays").
• A wallet sai: ví vẫn nằm trong túi áo khoác suốt hành trình ("my wallet was in my coat pocket the whole time").
👉 Mẹo: dạng khai báo mất đồ, cảnh sát sẽ đoán sai vài món trước; chỉ nhận món đi kèm khẳng định của người mất "It's my...".

questions.prompt: Tom is talking with his friend about his teachers. What is his favourite teacher?
questions.explanation:
W: So how's the new school year, Tom? Any good teachers this time?
M: Mixed bag, honestly. Everyone loves Miss Taylor, the music teacher.
W: But not you?
M: She's nice, but singing isn't my thing — I just mime at the back. And then there's Mr. Styles for sport.
W: You love sport! Surely he's your favourite?
M: He makes us run in the rain! In JANUARY! No — my favourite is Miss Brown, the science teacher.
W: Science? You? Since when?
M: Since her! She does actual experiments — last week we made a tiny volcano, and she let ME light it. She makes you feel clever instead of stupid when you ask questions.
W: A teacher like that is worth gold. Invite her to teach maths too!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Miss Brown.
• Vì sao đúng: "my favourite is Miss Brown, the science teacher" — cô cho làm thí nghiệm thật và khiến học sinh thấy mình thông minh.
• Miss Taylor sai: cả trường thích cô giáo nhạc nhưng Tom không hợp ("singing isn't my thing — I just mime at the back").
• Mr. Styles sai: thầy bắt chạy dưới mưa giữa tháng Một ("He makes us run in the rain! In JANUARY!").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi người yêu thích, ghim từng tên với từng môn ngay khi nghe; đáp án đứng sau "my favourite is".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking to a shop assistant. Why does the woman return the dress?
questions.explanation:
M: Good morning! How can I help you today?
W: I'd like to return this dress, please. I bought it on Saturday.
M: Of course. May I ask what the problem is? Is it the colour? Some customers find this red quite strong.
W: Oh no, the colour is gorgeous — it's exactly why I picked it off the rail.
M: The pattern, perhaps? The flowers are quite bold...
W: The pattern is lovely too, honestly. No — the problem is the size. I took my usual size, but this dress comes up far too small; I couldn't even close the zip. And you don't have it in the next size up, I already checked.
M: Ah, I see — this range does run small, I'm sorry. Would you like a refund, then?
W: Yes, please. And a little warning sign on that rail wouldn't hurt!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Because of its size.
• Vì sao đúng: "the problem is the size. I took my usual size, but this dress comes up far too small; I couldn't even close the zip."
• Because of its color sai: cô khen màu ("the colour is gorgeous — it's exactly why I picked it off the rail").
• Because of its pattern sai: cô cũng khen họa tiết ("The pattern is lovely too, honestly").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do trả hàng, nhân viên sẽ đoán 2 lý do sai trước; đáp án nằm sau "No — the problem is...".

questions.prompt: Louis is having dinner in a new restaurant. What does he complain about?
questions.explanation:
So here I am at that new restaurant everyone's been posting about, and I have thoughts. Credit where it's due: the food is delicious — my soup was perfect, and this steak melts like butter. The price is fair too, cheaper than I expected for this part of town. But the service! I waited forty minutes for the starter, another thirty for the main, and I've been holding this empty glass for a quarter of an hour. The service is just too slow. Lovely food — bring a book!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The service is slow.
• Vì sao đúng: "But the service! I waited forty minutes for the starter, another thirty for the main" và anh chốt "The service is just too slow".
• The price is cheap sai: giá đúng là rẻ nhưng đó chỉ là lời khen dạo đầu trước "But" ("The price is fair too, cheaper than I expected").
• The food is delicious sai: đồ ăn ngon thật ("the food is delicious"), nhưng ý kiến Louis muốn nhấn mạnh nằm sau "But".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi nhận xét về nhà hàng/dịch vụ, hai ý đầu thường là khen; quan điểm bài muốn hỏi nằm sau "But" và được nhắc lại ở câu chốt.

questions.prompt: A teacher is talking to her students. Where are the students now?
questions.explanation:
Gather round, everyone, and put your worksheets away for a moment! I know we usually have this lesson at school, but today is special. We are standing in a real Victorian townhouse — an actual family home from a hundred and fifty years ago, kept exactly as it was. This is not a museum, remember — a family still owns it, and they've kindly let our class visit. So no touching, gentle voices, and look at the kitchen first — see how they cooked without electricity!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In a townhouse.
• Vì sao đúng: "We are standing in a real Victorian townhouse — an actual family home from a hundred and fifty years ago".
• At school sai: cô giáo nói rõ hôm nay khác lệ thường ("I know we usually have this lesson at school, but today is special").
• In a museum sai: bị phủ định thẳng ("This is not a museum, remember — a family still owns it").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "Where are they now", bám động từ hiện tại "We are standing in..."; nơi đi với "usually" hay "not a..." đều bị loại.

questions.prompt: What is the woman doing?
questions.explanation:
Don't come into the kitchen with your shoes on — I'm warning you! I've been cleaning since eight this morning and I'm not done yet. The windows are washed, the shelves are dusted, the oven — oh, the oven took me two whole hours, I nearly gave up. Now I'm scrubbing this floor, and when it dries, the whole room has to shine. Your mother is visiting tomorrow, and this time she will NOT find a single spot of dust. Hand me that bucket, please!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Cleaning.
• Vì sao đúng: "I've been cleaning since eight this morning and I'm not done yet" — lau cửa sổ, phủi kệ, cọ lò nướng, giờ đang cọ sàn.
• Swimming sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Crying sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What is she doing", bắt các thì đang tiếp diễn ("I've been ...ing", "Now I'm ...ing") — đó là hành động thực sự đang xảy ra.

questions.prompt: Listen to a man talking about his journey to work. How does the man usually go to work?
questions.explanation:
My journey to work — everyone asks because I live so far out. When I was younger I rode a motorbike, rain or shine, but after two winters of frozen fingers I sold it and never looked back. People say take the train, and I would, but the nearest station is a thirty-minute walk from my house, which defeats the point. So these days I usually go by car. Forty minutes with my podcasts and my coffee in the holder — honestly, it's the calmest part of my day.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By car.
• Vì sao đúng: "So these days I usually go by car. Forty minutes with my podcasts and my coffee in the holder".
• By motorbike sai: đã bán sau hai mùa đông tê cóng tay ("I sold it and never looked back").
• By train sai: ga gần nhất cách nhà 30 phút đi bộ nên đi tàu là vô nghĩa ("which defeats the point").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "usually" thì chọn phương tiện gắn với hiện tại ("these days I usually..."), bỏ mọi thứ chia ở quá khứ.

questions.prompt: Listen to the man talking. What did he leave in the yard?
questions.explanation:
Oh no. Oh no, no, no. I knew I'd forgotten something! I was sitting in the yard this afternoon, reading in the sun — took my shoes off to feel the grass, you know how I do. Then the phone rang, and I ran inside to answer it... and now it's pouring with rain, and my shoes — my good leather shoes! — are still out there in the yard, filling up with water. They'll be ruined! Where's the umbrella? I have to rescue them, right now!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – shoes.
• Vì sao đúng: "my shoes — my good leather shoes! — are still out there in the yard, filling up with water".
• a laptop sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• a shirt sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi đồ để quên, tìm câu than "Oh no" rồi bắt danh từ đi cùng "still out there" — đó là món bị bỏ lại.

questions.prompt: Listen to an instruction. Which light shows that the computer is on?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to your new computer — let me explain the lights on the front, because they confuse everyone at first. You'll see three small lights. The green one only means the cable is plugged into the wall — the machine can be completely off and green still shows. The red one is a warning light: it blinks when the battery is low. The one that matters is the blue light: when the blue light is shining, your computer is on and ready to use. Blue means on. Simple!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Blue.
• Vì sao đúng: "when the blue light is shining, your computer is on and ready to use. Blue means on."
• Green sai: chỉ báo dây đã cắm vào ổ điện, máy vẫn có thể đang tắt ("the machine can be completely off and green still shows").
• Red sai: là đèn cảnh báo, nháy khi pin yếu ("it blinks when the battery is low").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hướng dẫn thiết bị, ghi nhanh cặp màu–chức năng rồi đối chiếu đúng chức năng câu hỏi hỏi (ở đây là "on").

questions.prompt: Listen to a person talking about a picnic. What did the speaker bring?
questions.explanation:
The picnic on Sunday was wonderful — we finally got the whole gang together by the river! Everyone had a job, of course. Maria made her famous sandwiches, three whole boxes, cheese and ham and the fancy ones with salmon. Tom brought the drinks — lemonade and about a hundred bottles of water, he never learns how much is enough. And me? I brought the fruit! Strawberries, grapes, and a watermelon so big I could barely carry it. It was gone in ten minutes. Best picnic of the summer!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Fruit.
• Vì sao đúng: "And me? I brought the fruit! Strawberries, grapes, and a watermelon so big I could barely carry it."
• Sandwiches sai: là phần của Maria ("Maria made her famous sandwiches, three whole boxes").
• Drinks sai: là phần của Tom ("Tom brought the drinks — lemonade and about a hundred bottles of water").
👉 Mẹo: dạng "ai mang gì", ghim tên với món ngay khi nghe; câu hỏi hỏi "the speaker" nên chỉ lấy món sau "And me? I brought...".

questions.prompt: Listen to a man talking. What is not working?
questions.explanation:
Sarah, it's me from the office — we have a situation this morning. Before you panic: the wifi is fine, I'm on it right now, emails are flying in as usual. The printer is also behaving for once, I tested it with two pages. It's the computer — the main one at reception. It won't start at all: black screen, no sound, nothing. I've tried the cable, tried holding the power button, everything. The computer is completely dead. Can you send the technician before the customers arrive?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The computer.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's the computer — the main one at reception. It won't start at all: black screen, no sound, nothing... completely dead."
• The Wifi sai: vẫn chạy tốt ("the wifi is fine, I'm on it right now, emails are flying in as usual").
• The printer sai: hoạt động bình thường, đã thử in 2 trang ("The printer is also behaving for once").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What is not working", dùng các cụm khen ("is fine", "is behaving") để loại; thứ đi với "won't start / dead" mới là đáp án.

questions.prompt: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave the station?
questions.explanation:
Attention, please, passengers for the express service to the capital. There has been a small change this morning, so please listen carefully. The timetable on the board still shows the old departure at nine o'clock — that is no longer correct. And despite the rumour on the platform, the train has NOT been delayed to nine thirty. The train will leave the station at nine fifteen — nine one five, from platform four. Please make your way there now with your tickets ready. Thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: "The train will leave the station at nine fifteen — nine one five, from platform four."
• 9:00 sai: là giờ CŨ vẫn hiện trên bảng ("The timetable on the board still shows the old departure at nine o'clock — that is no longer correct").
• 9:30 sai: chỉ là tin đồn trên sân ga ("the train has NOT been delayed to nine thirty").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nhà ga luôn nêu giờ cũ và tin đồn trước. Bám thì tương lai "will leave" và cách đọc lặp lại từng số ("nine one five").

questions.prompt: Listen to a girl calling with her mother. Why did she call her mother to pick up at the airport?
questions.explanation:
W2: Mum? Hi, it's me — I've just landed. Can you come and pick me up at the airport?
W1: Sweetheart! Of course, but... you sound strange. Aren't you happy to be home?
W2: I am happy, Mum, really. That's not it.
W1: Then you must be exhausted from the long flight. Twelve hours!
W2: I actually slept the whole way, so I'm not tired either. The thing is... I think I caught something on the plane. My head is burning, my throat hurts, and I've been shivering since we landed. I feel really sick, Mum.
W1: Oh, my poor girl! Stay right there by gate two — I'm leaving now, and I'm bringing you a warm coat and some medicine.
W2: Thank you, Mum. Please hurry.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "My head is burning, my throat hurts, and I've been shivering since we landed. I feel really sick, Mum."
• Happy sai: cô có vui nhưng đó không phải lý do gọi ("I am happy, Mum, really. That's not it").
• Tired sai: cô ngủ suốt chuyến bay ("I actually slept the whole way, so I'm not tired either").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do/cảm giác, đếm chuỗi phủ định "That's not it", "I'm not ... either"; đáp án nằm sau "The thing is...".

questions.prompt: Listen to a conversation. What is the woman's most important task for the upcoming conference?
questions.explanation:
M: The conference is only two weeks away! How's your list looking?
W: Long! But let's sort out what matters most.
M: Well, there's the welcome dinner on the first evening — you're organizing that, aren't you?
W: The informal dinner, yes, but honestly the restaurant does most of that work — I just confirm the numbers.
M: And the invitations to the guest speakers?
W: Already sent, weeks ago — all confirmed except one professor. No, my biggest task is something else entirely: the opening day speech. I'm giving the formal address to the whole conference — four hundred people, all the sponsors, the cameras...
M: THE main speech? That's huge!
W: Exactly why I practise every evening. If that goes well, the whole event goes well.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Giving a formal address.
• Vì sao đúng: "my biggest task is something else entirely: the opening day speech. I'm giving the formal address to the whole conference — four hundred people".
• Organizing an informal event sai: tiệc tối chào mừng do nhà hàng lo phần lớn, cô chỉ chốt số lượng ("the restaurant does most of that work").
• Sending out invitations sai: đã gửi từ nhiều tuần trước và gần như đủ xác nhận ("Already sent, weeks ago").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi việc QUAN TRỌNG NHẤT thì bỏ việc đã xong và việc nhẹ; bám so sánh nhất "my biggest task is".

questions.prompt: What do they need to repair for the building?
questions.explanation:
M: Right, the inspection report for the building came back. Want the good news first?
W: Always. This building is a hundred years old — I fear the bad news.
M: Good news: the doors are fine. All of them — the inspector even praised the big oak ones at the front.
W: Wonderful. And the gate? It squeaks like a horror film.
M: Squeaky but solid — it just needs oil, that's not a repair. No, the real problem is the windows.
W: All of them?
M: Eleven of the twenty. The frames are rotten, two don't close at all, and the heating bill shows it. The windows need repairing before winter — that's the priority.
W: Windows it is, then. Get three quotes, and let's start with the north side.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Windows.
• Vì sao đúng: "The windows need repairing before winter — that's the priority" — 11 trong 20 khung bị mục, 2 cái không đóng được.
• Doors sai: tất cả đều ổn, còn được khen ("the doors are fine. All of them").
• Gate sai: chỉ kêu cót két, tra dầu là xong ("Squeaky but solid — it just needs oil, that's not a repair").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi hạng mục cần SỬA, phân biệt "bảo dưỡng nhẹ" với "hư hỏng thật"; bám cụm "that's the priority" và số liệu cụ thể.

questions.prompt: What did she advice for people who lack motivation at work?
questions.explanation:
M: Half my team has gone flat lately — no fire, no ideas. You handled this last year, didn't you?
W: I did, and I tried everything, so learn from my scars.
M: The time management workshop? Everyone recommends that first.
W: We ran one. Beautiful calendars, same empty eyes. Planning doesn't create motivation, it only organises it.
M: Then maybe I should give them bigger challenges — more responsibilities?
W: To demotivated people? You'll just drown them and they'll resent you. No — what actually worked was simpler: I helped my two most bored people request a transfer. New department, same company.
M: And it worked?
W: Both of them woke up within a month — one got promoted by spring. Movement creates energy, trust me.
M: A transfer... alright, I'll talk to HR tomorrow.
W: Do it gently — and keep the door open for them to come back!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Request a transfer.
• Vì sao đúng: "what actually worked was simpler: I helped my two most bored people request a transfer. New department, same company." — cả hai hồi sinh trong một tháng.
• Attend a time management workshop sai: đã thử và vô ích ("We ran one. Beautiful calendars, same empty eyes").
• Take on additional responsibilities sai: cô bác bỏ vì sẽ khiến họ quá tải và bực bội ("You'll just drown them and they'll resent you").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lời khuyên, chọn giải pháp người nói khẳng định ĐÃ hiệu quả ("what actually worked was"), không chọn ý bị phản bác ngay sau khi nêu.

questions.prompt: What is her favorite thing to do in her spare time?
questions.explanation:
People assume I spend my evenings on the sofa watching films at home, and yes, that happens on lazy Sundays — but it's not what I love most. My brother keeps dragging me to play sports with his team, and I go sometimes, mostly for the pizza afterwards. But my real passion, the thing I save my money for, is going to the theatre. Live actors, the lights, that moment when the curtain rises — nothing on a screen comes close. I've already booked three plays for next month!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Going to the theatre.
• Vì sao đúng: "my real passion, the thing I save my money for, is going to the theatre" — đã đặt vé ba vở cho tháng sau.
• Watching a movie at home sai: chỉ xảy ra vào Chủ nhật lười và bị hạ thấp ngay ("it's not what I love most").
• Playing sports sai: đi cùng anh trai cho có, chủ yếu vì bữa pizza sau đó ("mostly for the pizza afterwards").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi sở thích SỐ MỘT, tìm cụm cường độ mạnh "my real passion", "what I love most"; ý gắn với "sometimes" luôn bị loại.

questions.prompt: Where does she go shopping?
questions.explanation:
Saturday means shopping, and everyone always asks where I go. The old department store in the centre? I stopped going years ago — same clothes on the same racks since forever. The local market is charming for vegetables, but you can't buy shoes between the tomatoes, can you? No — I do my shopping at the new shopping mall by the motorway. It has everything under one roof, the parking is free, and there's a lovely café on the top floor for when my feet give up!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At a new shopping mall.
• Vì sao đúng: "I do my shopping at the new shopping mall by the motorway. It has everything under one roof, the parking is free".
• At a department store sai: cô bỏ từ nhiều năm vì hàng không đổi mới ("same clothes on the same racks since forever").
• At a local market sai: chỉ hợp mua rau, không mua được giày ("you can't buy shoes between the tomatoes, can you?").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi nơi mua sắm, đáp án nằm sau "No — I do my shopping at..."; hai nơi trước đó luôn kèm một lời chê.

questions.prompt: Why does Douglas call Kay?
questions.explanation:
Kay, it's Douglas — please don't delete this message before hearing it all! I'm not calling to ask for anything, I promise — no favours this time, your car and your ladder are safe from me. And no, it's not about the project ideas either, we can talk about those any day. I'm calling to say thank you. Properly. What you did for my family last week, taking Mum to the hospital when I was stuck abroad — I will never forget it. Dinner is on me, any restaurant you choose. Thank you, Kay.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – To say thank you.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm calling to say thank you. Properly." — cảm ơn vì Kay đã đưa mẹ anh đi viện khi anh kẹt ở nước ngoài.
• To ask for a favor sai: anh phủ nhận ngay ("I'm not calling to ask for anything, I promise — no favours this time").
• To discuss ideas sai: cũng bị gạt ("no, it's not about the project ideas either, we can talk about those any day").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi, bắt đúng cụm "I'm calling to..."; những ý đi với "I'm not calling to" là bẫy đặt ngay đầu bài.

questions.prompt: A girl is calling her mother. Which dress does she want?
questions.explanation:
Mum? It's me, I'm at the dress shop for the graduation — I need your card details and your blessing! Okay, so they have three that fit me. There's a short blue one — cute, but Grandma would faint, it's VERY short. Then a long white one, which is elegant, but white at a graduation? One drop of juice and it's over. The one I actually want is the long red one — deep red, floor-length, and it fits like it was made for me. The red one, Mum. Please say yes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Long and red.
• Vì sao đúng: "The one I actually want is the long red one — deep red, floor-length, and it fits like it was made for me."
• Short and blue sai: quá ngắn, bà sẽ ngất ("Grandma would faint, it's VERY short").
• Long and white sai: màu trắng quá rủi ro ở lễ tốt nghiệp ("One drop of juice and it's over").
👉 Mẹo: khi phương án ghép ĐỘ DÀI + MÀU thì phải khớp cả hai; nghe kỹ "long/short" đứng ngay trước màu chứ đừng chỉ bắt màu.

questions.prompt: Listen to a voice message. How does Evan feel?
questions.explanation:
Hey, it's Evan, returning your call. Sorry I couldn't pick up — and sorry in advance for this voice. Yes, I sound terrible, and no, it's not because I'm tired — I've actually slept about eleven hours a day since Tuesday. That's kind of the problem. The doctor says it's a proper flu: fever, cough, the whole package. I'm sick as a dog, mate. So the gym plan this week is cancelled, and you should probably keep your distance for a few days. I'll call when I'm human again!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "The doctor says it's a proper flu: fever, cough, the whole package. I'm sick as a dog, mate."
• Happy sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Tired sai: anh phủ nhận vì đã ngủ 11 tiếng mỗi ngày ("it's not because I'm tired — I've actually slept about eleven hours a day").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cảm giác, đừng đoán theo giọng nói; bám triệu chứng cụ thể (fever, cough) và thành ngữ "sick as a dog".

questions.prompt: Which sports is she good at?
questions.explanation:
Sports day is coming, and my family has opinions about what I should enter. Dad keeps saying running, because he ran marathons — but honestly, I'm the slowest in my class, they time me with a calendar. Mum says swimming, and I do love the pool, but love and skill are different things; I still swallow half the water. No — what I'm actually good at is football. Top scorer two seasons in a row, captain since March. So football it is, and Dad can cheer from the fence!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Football.
• Vì sao đúng: "what I'm actually good at is football. Top scorer two seasons in a row, captain since March."
• Running sai: bố gợi ý nhưng cô chạy chậm nhất lớp ("I'm the slowest in my class").
• Swimming sai: mẹ gợi ý, cô thích bơi nhưng không giỏi ("love and skill are different things").
👉 Mẹo: "good at" khác "like". Bỏ môn chỉ được "love"; chọn môn có bằng chứng thành tích (top scorer, captain).

questions.prompt: What career did he choose?
questions.explanation:
People ask why I'm in a suit these days, so here's the story of my big decision. At university, everyone expected me to become a researcher — I loved the laboratory, but the idea of the same experiments for thirty years... no. My mother, a teacher herself, hoped I'd teach; I tried one term as an assistant and the children ate me alive, honestly. So I chose to work in business. I joined a trading company, and I love it — every day is different, every deal is a puzzle. No regrets!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To work in business.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I chose to work in business. I joined a trading company, and I love it — every day is different."
• To become a teacher sai: mẹ mong vậy nhưng anh thử một học kỳ làm trợ giảng và thất bại ("the children ate me alive").
• To become a researcher sai: mọi người kỳ vọng, anh thích phòng thí nghiệm nhưng không chịu nổi việc lặp lại suốt 30 năm.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi nghề đã chọn, bám động từ quyết định "I chose"; kỳ vọng của người khác ("everyone expected", "my mother hoped") đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: An expert is talking about lack of satisfaction at work. What should be the solution?
questions.explanation:
Today I want to talk about something many workers write to me about: losing satisfaction at work. First, what NOT to do. Don't rush to find a new job — you often carry the same problem to a new desk, plus new stress. And a vacation? It helps for exactly two weeks, then the same emails are waiting. My advice, based on twenty years of research: request a transfer within your company. A new team and new tasks — but with your reputation and relationships intact. It refreshes everything while risking almost nothing.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Request a transfer.
• Vì sao đúng: "My advice, based on twenty years of research: request a transfer within your company. A new team and new tasks — but with your reputation and relationships intact."
• Take a vacation sai: chỉ hiệu quả đúng hai tuần rồi email cũ vẫn chờ ("It helps for exactly two weeks").
• Find a new job sai: chuyên gia cảnh báo bạn mang theo cùng vấn đề sang chỗ mới ("you often carry the same problem to a new desk").
👉 Mẹo: bài kiểu chuyên gia luôn nói "what NOT to do" trước rồi mới tới lời khuyên. Chỉ lấy ý sau "My advice".

questions.prompt: A girl is talking about a show she will attend. What will it end with?
questions.explanation:
I finally got tickets to the summer show on Saturday — best seats, row five! I've been reading everything about the programme. Someone online claimed it ends with a firework display, but that's last year's show — the park banned fireworks after the dry summer. And it's definitely not ending with a boring speech, thank goodness; the director does his talking at the START this year. The real ending is a surprise performance! Nobody knows who it is — a secret guest star. The whole town is guessing. Two more days!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A surprise performance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real ending is a surprise performance! Nobody knows who it is — a secret guest star."
• A speech sai: năm nay giám đốc phát biểu ở ĐẦU chương trình ("the director does his talking at the START this year").
• A firework display sai: là chương trình năm ngoái, công viên đã cấm pháo hoa sau mùa hè khô hạn.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi phần KẾT, phân biệt "start" và "end"; thông tin đọc trên mạng hay của năm ngoái đều là bẫy kinh điển.

questions.prompt: When do they meet each other?
questions.explanation:
M: We really need to catch up properly — it's been months! When are you free this week?
W: Let me look... Monday morning I have the dentist, sadly. Root canal. Pray for me.
M: Ouch! Monday's out then. Wednesday morning? The café by the bridge does that breakfast you like.
W: Wednesday I'm driving my aunt to the airport at dawn — I'll be a zombie after.
M: Hmm. That leaves... what about Thursday morning? I'm free after nine.
W: Thursday morning is perfect! No dentist, no airport, nothing but coffee.
M: Thursday it is — nine thirty, café by the bridge, first round of pancakes on me.
W: You had me at pancakes. See you Thursday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Thursday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "Thursday morning is perfect!... Thursday it is — nine thirty, café by the bridge".
• On Wednesday morning sai: cô phải chở dì ra sân bay từ sáng sớm và sẽ đờ đẫn cả buổi.
• On Monday morning sai: cô có hẹn nha sĩ lấy tủy răng ("Monday morning I have the dentist, sadly").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hẹn lịch, loại dần từng ngày theo lý do bận; ngày đúng đi với "perfect" hoặc cấu trúc chốt "... it is".

questions.prompt: What will they bring to the picnic?
questions.explanation:
W: The neighbourhood picnic is Sunday! Did you see the list of what's left for us?
M: Just looked. I was praying for drinks — drinks is just carrying bottles.
W: Dream on — the Novak twins grabbed drinks within five minutes of the list going up.
M: Of course they did. Snacks, then? Crisps and those little biscuits?
W: Mrs. Lee took snacks AND salads — she's treating it as a competition, as always.
M: So that leaves us with...
W: The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, bread, the lot.
M: The biggest job on the whole list. Naturally.
W: But we have the biggest grill! You shop Saturday morning, I marinate Saturday night.
M: Deal. By Sunday evening we'll be neighbourhood legends — again!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Food.
• Vì sao đúng: "The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, bread, the lot."
• Drinks sai: cặp sinh đôi nhà Novak đã nhận ngay khi danh sách vừa dán ("The Novak twins grabbed drinks within five minutes").
• Snacks sai: bà Lee đã lấy cả snacks lẫn salad ("Mrs. Lee took snacks AND salads").
👉 Mẹo: dạng chia phần việc, gạch tên người đã nhận từng món; phần còn lại sau "So that leaves us with..." chính là đáp án.

questions.prompt: Two colleagues talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
questions.explanation:
M: We need to schedule the planning meeting this week. Any preferences?
W: Not Monday, please. Mondays are chaos — my inbox alone takes until lunch.
M: Agreed, Monday is survival day. I'd say Wednesday, but the director booked the meeting room all day for interviews.
W: The whole day? With the good chairs and everything?
M: The whole day. So that leaves Tuesday. Morning or afternoon?
W: Tuesday afternoon, two o'clock? Reports done, coffee had, brains working.
M: Tuesday at two works perfectly. I'll book the small room and send the invites.
W: Done deal. And Tuesday means we'll actually be prepared for once!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Tuesday.
• Vì sao đúng: "So that leaves Tuesday... Tuesday at two works perfectly. I'll book the small room and send the invites."
• Monday sai: đầu tuần quá bận, riêng hộp thư đã ngốn cả buổi sáng ("Mondays are chaos").
• Wednesday sai: giám đốc đã đặt phòng họp nguyên ngày để phỏng vấn.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại chọn lịch thường loại 2 ngày rồi mới chốt; nghe "So that leaves..." là biết câu ngay sau chứa đáp án.

questions.prompt: How many weeks have they been in India?
questions.explanation:
W: So! How is India treating you both? It feels like you left ages ago.
M: That's what everyone says! People think we've been here a month already.
W: Haven't you? Your photos could fill four weeks easily — the palaces, the markets, that train ride...
M: Ha! We're just very fast tourists. Some friends even guessed three weeks.
W: So how long has it actually been?
M: Exactly two weeks today. We landed on the eighth — two weeks, and it honestly feels like two days.
W: Two weeks and all THAT? I need your energy.
M: Come join us for the last month — we'll wear you out in a weekend!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 2 weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "Exactly two weeks today. We landed on the eighth — two weeks, and it honestly feels like two days."
• 4 weeks sai: chỉ là suy đoán của mọi người khi xem ảnh ("People think we've been here a month already").
• 3 weeks sai: cũng là phỏng đoán của bạn bè ("Some friends even guessed three weeks").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi khoảng thời gian, bỏ mọi con số đi kèm "think", "guessed", "told me"; chỉ lấy số có "Exactly" hoặc "actually".

questions.prompt: What does he advise young people to do to save money?
questions.explanation:
Young listeners keep writing to ask how to save money, so here's my honest advice after thirty years of budgets. Everyone tells you to use public transport, and sure, it helps — but a bus ticket here and there is small change. Buying second-hand is fine too, though a cheap broken chair is no bargain, believe me. The real saver, the one that changes everything, is this: cook for yourself. Eating out three times a week quietly eats half a salary. Learn five simple dishes, and watch your bank account grow.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Cook for yourself.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real saver, the one that changes everything, is this: cook for yourself." — ăn ngoài 3 lần/tuần ngốn nửa tháng lương.
• Use public transportation sai: có giúp nhưng chỉ là tiền lẻ ("a bus ticket here and there is small change").
• Buy second-hand items sai: cũng ổn nhưng đồ rẻ mà hỏng thì không hời ("a cheap broken chair is no bargain").
👉 Mẹo: dạng lời khuyên, đáp án là ý được nâng lên bằng so sánh nhất "The real saver", "the one that changes everything".

questions.prompt: Listen to a woman explaining why she was late. What is the main reason she gets late?
questions.explanation:
I'm so sorry everyone had to wait — let me explain this disaster of a morning. No, the car didn't break down, before anyone asks; it's in the garage all week anyway, that's old news. And the traffic was actually fine for once — the roads were practically empty. The truth is simpler and more embarrassing: I missed the train. By THIRTY seconds. I was on the platform watching it leave, and the next one wasn't for forty minutes. So here I am, with apologies and pastries for everybody!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Missed the train.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth is simpler and more embarrassing: I missed the train. By THIRTY seconds." — chuyến sau 40 phút mới có.
• Car broke down sai: xe nằm gara cả tuần rồi, không liên quan hôm nay ("the car didn't break down... that's old news").
• Heavy traffic sai: đường hôm đó vắng ("the traffic was actually fine for once — the roads were practically empty").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do đi trễ, bám cụm "The truth is..."; các lý do kinh điển (xe hỏng, tắc đường) thường bị phủ định ngay đầu bài.

questions.prompt: What is not original?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to my little historical corner! Everyone who visits asks the same question: is it all really original? Mostly, yes! The home itself is completely authentic — these walls went up in the eighteen sixties, and even the floorboards are the ones the first family walked on. The old bicycle in the hallway is genuine too — my great-grandfather's, still with his initials. But the furniture, I must confess, is not original. The real pieces were sold long before my time, so these are careful copies, made from old photographs.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Furniture.
• Vì sao đúng: "But the furniture, I must confess, is not original... these are careful copies, made from old photographs."
• Home sai: ngôi nhà là đồ thật, xây từ thập niên 1860 ("The home itself is completely authentic").
• Bicycle sai: xe đạp của cụ cố, còn nguyên chữ khắc tên ("The old bicycle in the hallway is genuine too").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi dạng phủ định ("What is NOT original") thì chọn thứ DUY NHẤT bị chê; săn cụm "But... is not" ở cuối bài.

questions.prompt: A man is ordering a drink. What does he want?
questions.explanation:
Good evening! Give me a second, it's been a long hot day... Right, drinks. My wife would tell me to just have water, and normally I would, but tonight deserves better than water, honestly. And before you suggest it — no beer for me, I'm driving the whole family home later, so that's completely out. What I'd really love is your iced tea — the homemade one with lemon I saw on the board outside? A tall glass, lots of ice, please. Actually, make it two — I'll be quick with the first!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I'd really love is your iced tea — the homemade one with lemon... A tall glass, lots of ice, please."
• Water sai: vợ anh sẽ bảo uống nước lọc nhưng tối nay anh muốn hơn thế ("tonight deserves better than water").
• Beer sai: anh phải lái xe chở cả nhà về ("no beer for me, I'm driving the whole family home later").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi món gọi, bắt câu có động từ đặt hàng ("I'd love...", "make it two"); món gắn với lý do từ chối (đang lái xe) luôn sai.

questions.prompt: How does he travel?
questions.explanation:
My work takes me across the country twice a month, and people always assume I fly. I did try the plane for a while — but between getting to the airport two hours early and the delays, it's honestly no faster door to door. Driving? Five hours behind the wheel and I arrive useless, fit only for a nap. So now I always travel by train. Three and a half hours, a table to myself, wifi that mostly works — I finish my reports on the way and arrive fresh. The train wins every time.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – By train.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I always travel by train. Three and a half hours, a table to myself" — anh làm xong báo cáo trên tàu.
• By car sai: lái 5 tiếng thì đến nơi kiệt sức ("I arrive useless, fit only for a nap").
• By plane sai: đã thử nhưng cộng thời gian chờ và trễ chuyến thì không nhanh hơn ("it's honestly no faster door to door").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi phương tiện hiện tại, bám trạng từ tần suất "always / now"; phương tiện đi với "I did try... but" là thứ đã bỏ.

questions.prompt: What did the mother call her daughter to help her buy?
questions.explanation:
Sweetheart, it's Mum — catch this message before you leave the office! Small kitchen emergency: I'm in the middle of baking the birthday cake for Grandpa, and I've just realised I'm short on eggs. I need six more — six large eggs, the free-range ones from the corner shop if they have them. That's all, just the eggs! We have plenty of bread, don't buy more, it'll only go hard. Milk we're fine for too, the fridge is full. Just the eggs, darling — quick as you can! Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Eggs.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm short on eggs. I need six more — six large eggs" và mẹ nhắc lại "Just the eggs, darling".
• Bread sai: nhà còn nhiều, mẹ dặn đừng mua thêm kẻo cứng ("We have plenty of bread, don't buy more").
• Milk sai: tủ lạnh vẫn đầy ("Milk we're fine for too, the fridge is full").
👉 Mẹo: dạng nhờ mua đồ, bám cụm giới hạn "just / only"; món đi với "don't buy" hay "we're fine for" là bẫy.

questions.prompt: Where does Malik want to go?
questions.explanation:
Excuse me! Sorry to stop you — I'm Malik, I'm new to this neighbourhood, and my phone has just died completely. Could you point me somewhere? I'm trying to get to the town hall — I have an appointment at the residents' office in twenty minutes to register my new address. I know the library is somewhere on this street, and the park is behind me, but the town hall has me completely lost. Is it far? Should I take a bus, or can I walk from here? Thank you so much!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm trying to get to the town hall — I have an appointment at the residents' office in twenty minutes to register my new address."
• The library sai: chỉ là mốc anh đã biết vị trí ("I know the library is somewhere on this street").
• The park sai: cũng chỉ là mốc, đang ở ngay sau lưng anh ("the park is behind me").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi đích đến, chọn nơi đi với "I'm trying to get to"; những nơi người nói đã biết vị trí chỉ là mốc định hướng.

questions.prompt: What area is he describing?
questions.explanation:
Let me describe the area where I've just moved, because it has a very particular energy. Don't picture a shopping district — there's just one small supermarket and a kiosk, that's the whole retail scene. And it's not a quiet residential neighbourhood either, definitely not; nobody here is retired, trust me. This is a university area through and through: three faculties within ten minutes' walk, bookshops and cheap cafés on every corner, bicycles everywhere, and the streets full of students until two in the morning. The average age here must be twenty-two!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A university area.
• Vì sao đúng: "This is a university area through and through: three faculties within ten minutes' walk... the streets full of students until two in the morning."
• A shopping district sai: bị phủ định ngay ("Don't picture a shopping district — there's just one small supermarket and a kiosk").
• A residential neighborhood sai: cũng bị phủ định ("it's not a quiet residential neighbourhood either, definitely not").
👉 Mẹo: dạng miêu tả khu vực, đếm hai câu "Don't picture..." / "it's not..." để loại; đáp án là câu khẳng định "This is a...".

questions.prompt: A man wants to buy a new house. What is his biggest problem?
questions.explanation:
So, the big house-buying project — everyone asks how it's going. Here's the funny thing: the parts I feared went smoothly. Finding the right house? Done in a month — a lovely place near the school, garden and all. The financing scared me most, but the bank approved the loan in two weeks, no drama. No — my real problem is persuading my own family! My wife says the kitchen is too small, my daughter refuses to change schools, and even the dog seems against it. Wish me luck at dinner tonight — final negotiations!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "my real problem is persuading my own family!" — vợ chê bếp nhỏ, con gái không chịu đổi trường.
• Finding the right house sai: đã xong trong một tháng ("Done in a month — a lovely place near the school").
• Getting the financing sai: ngân hàng duyệt khoản vay trong hai tuần, không rắc rối ("no drama").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "biggest problem", bỏ mọi việc đã hoàn tất; bám cụm "my real problem is" đứng ngay sau "No —".

questions.prompt: What time do they meet?
questions.explanation:
M: Tonight's dinner — what time should we meet at the restaurant?
W: Well, the table is booked for eight, so we could just meet then?
M: Eight is when we SIT, though. If we meet at eight we'll be flustered and hungry.
W: True. Seven, then? That gives us an hour to spare.
M: Seven I can't do — my train only gets in at ten past.
W: Hmm. So... what about half past six — wait, no, that's before your train. Six thirty won't work for YOU.
M: Actually it will! There's an earlier train at five forty — I'll just take that one. Six thirty at the little bar next door, drinks before dinner?
W: Perfect. Six thirty at the bar, eight at the table. It's a plan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6.30pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "Six thirty at the little bar next door, drinks before dinner?" — cô chốt "Six thirty at the bar, eight at the table".
• 8.00pm sai: đó là giờ ĐẶT BÀN chứ không phải giờ gặp nhau ("Eight is when we SIT, though").
• 7.00pm sai: tàu của anh 7 giờ 10 mới tới ("my train only gets in at ten past").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "What time do they MEET" khác giờ đặt bàn. Xác định đúng động từ trong câu hỏi rồi mới chọn mốc tương ứng.

questions.prompt: A mom is talking to her son. What does the son like to study?
questions.explanation:
W: Sweetheart, we need to talk about your subjects for next year. Your dad thinks you should focus on math.
M: Mum, we both know I count on my fingers. Math and I are not friends.
W: Science, then? Uncle Pete could help you — he loves his laboratory.
M: The experiments are okay... but honestly, I only enjoy drawing the diagrams, not doing the science.
W: Wait — drawing the diagrams? Is that a hint?
M: It's more than a hint, Mum. What I really like to study is art. It's the only class where three hours feel like ten minutes. My teacher says my portfolio is the best in the year.
W: She actually told me the same at the parents' evening. Alright, my artist — art it is. Your dad will survive.
M: Thanks, Mum! First portrait is of you, I promise.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I really like to study is art. It's the only class where three hours feel like ten minutes."
• Math sai: bố gợi ý nhưng cậu thừa nhận rất kém ("we both know I count on my fingers").
• Science sai: cậu chỉ thích phần vẽ sơ đồ chứ không thích làm khoa học ("I only enjoy drawing the diagrams, not doing the science").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi môn yêu thích, ý kiến của bố mẹ hay chú bác luôn là nhiễu; chọn môn đứng sau "What I really like to study is".

questions.prompt: How many weeks did they spend in India?
questions.explanation:
W: You two are finally back from India! It felt like you were gone a whole month.
M: Everyone says a month! Our photos do make it look that way.
W: So it wasn't? Your sister told me three weeks.
M: She's wrong too — she never listens. We originally planned just one week, you know, a quick city trip.
W: One week for India? Impossible.
M: Exactly what we realised! So before flying we changed the tickets, and in the end we spent two weeks there. Two full weeks — north the first, south the second.
W: Two weeks... and was it enough?
M: Not even close. Next time, we're doing the full month everyone already believes in!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Two weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "in the end we spent two weeks there. Two full weeks — north the first, south the second."
• Three weeks sai: là lời chị gái nói lại và bị bác ngay ("She's wrong too — she never listens").
• One week sai: chỉ là kế hoạch BAN ĐẦU, họ đã đổi vé trước khi bay ("We originally planned just one week").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thời lượng thực tế, bỏ số gắn với "planned", "someone told me"; chọn số đi với "in the end / actually".

questions.prompt: How much can Max pay for the computer?
questions.explanation:
M: So, Max — you said you're finally replacing that ancient laptop. What's the budget?
W: Wait, I heard the good ones start at three hundred pounds. Can you even afford that?
M: Three hundred is the shop price for the new model, yes — completely out of my league right now.
W: What about that refurbished one your cousin offered? Two hundred, wasn't it?
M: It was, but he sold it last week — I was too slow, story of my life.
W: So what CAN you actually spend?
M: I've done the maths this morning: with my savings plus selling the old one, I can pay two hundred and fifty. That's my absolute ceiling — two fifty, not a penny more.
W: Two fifty is workable! The computer fair is on Saturday — you'll find something good for that.
M: Saturday it is. Come with me and stop me from overspending!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "with my savings plus selling the old one, I can pay two hundred and fifty. That's my absolute ceiling — two fifty, not a penny more."
• 200 pounds sai: là giá chiếc máy tân trang của người anh họ nhưng đã bán mất ("he sold it last week").
• 300 pounds sai: là giá máy mới ngoài cửa hàng, vượt khả năng ("completely out of my league right now").
👉 Mẹo: "How much CAN he pay" là hỏi khả năng chi trả, không phải giá niêm yết; bám cụm "I can pay", "my ceiling".

questions.prompt: Where does he want to go tomorrow?
questions.explanation:
Tomorrow is my only free day this month, and everyone has suggestions. My sister says the park — but I was there twice last week with the dog, I know every bench by name now. My flatmate is pushing for the cinema, except there's nothing good on until the new releases on Friday. No — tomorrow I want to go to the town hall. They've opened the old tower to visitors for the first time in years, and you can climb right to the clock. The view over the whole town — I've waited months for this!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "tomorrow I want to go to the town hall. They've opened the old tower to visitors for the first time in years, and you can climb right to the clock."
• The park sai: chị gái gợi ý nhưng anh đã đi hai lần tuần trước ("I was there twice last week with the dog").
• The cinema sai: bạn cùng nhà rủ nhưng không có phim hay đến tận thứ Sáu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi nơi muốn đến, bỏ nơi do người khác đề xuất; đáp án nằm sau "No — tomorrow I want to go to".

questions.prompt: How many people live in the town?
