questions.explanation:
Let me tell you a bit about our town, because the numbers surprise people. If you read the old guidebook, it says five thousand people — but that was written forty years ago, before the new factory and the housing estates. Some locals proudly claim we've reached twenty thousand, which is... optimistic, let's say. The latest census gives the real figure: ten thousand people live here now. Exactly the right size, if you ask me — big enough for two supermarkets, small enough that the baker knows your name.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: "The latest census gives the real figure: ten thousand people live here now."
• 5,000 sai: là số trong sách hướng dẫn viết cách đây 40 năm, trước khi có nhà máy và khu dân cư mới.
• 20,000 sai: là con số dân địa phương nói quá ("which is... optimistic, let's say").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi số liệu dân số, chọn con số gắn với nguồn chính thức: "the latest census", "the real figure".

questions.prompt: When is the assignment due?
questions.explanation:
One moment before you all disappear — the essay deadline, because the corridor rumours have gone wild! Some of you are panicking about Friday: relax, Friday is only when the topic list closes, nothing is due then. And whoever invented Sunday — no. I do not read essays on Sundays, ever. The assignment is due on Saturday. Saturday, by ten in the morning, printed on my desk or uploaded to the portal. Saturday at ten. Plan your week backwards from there — and Milo, write it down!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – On Saturday.
• Vì sao đúng: "The assignment is due on Saturday. Saturday, by ten in the morning, printed on my desk or uploaded to the portal."
• On Friday sai: thứ Sáu chỉ là hạn chốt danh sách đề tài ("Friday is only when the topic list closes, nothing is due then").
• On Sunday sai: giáo viên bác thẳng ("I do not read essays on Sundays, ever").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi hạn nộp, cẩn thận với các mốc khác trong bài (chốt đề tài, phát đề); chỉ chọn ngày đi kèm từ "due".

questions.prompt: What did she like best about the film?
questions.explanation:
I finally saw that film everyone's been recommending, and I have opinions! People kept raving about the action scenes, but honestly, they were too loud and far too long — my ears needed a holiday afterwards. The ending? Predictable, I saw it coming an hour away. But what I truly loved — what made the whole ticket worth it — were the mountain scenes. Filmed in real snow, with that golden morning light on the peaks... I actually forgot to eat my popcorn. I'd watch it again just for those mountains.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The mountain scenes.
• Vì sao đúng: "what I truly loved — what made the whole ticket worth it — were the mountain scenes. Filmed in real snow".
• The action scenes sai: quá ồn và quá dài ("they were too loud and far too long").
• The ending sai: dễ đoán, cô biết trước cả tiếng ("Predictable, I saw it coming an hour away").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "liked best", tìm cụm cực cấp "what I truly loved"; mọi thứ đi với "too + tính từ" đều là lời chê.

questions.prompt: How does she go to school?
questions.explanation:
People ask how I get to school, expecting something boring — and my answer surprises them! Mum offered to drive me every morning, but sitting in the school traffic queue makes me carsick, honestly. The bus? It's fine in winter, but it takes the long route through three villages and I'd rather sleep those extra minutes. So I walk! Twenty-five minutes through the fields, every single day, rain or shine. My friends think I'm mad, but I arrive awake, and I know every cat on the route by name.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She walks.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I walk! Twenty-five minutes through the fields, every single day, rain or shine."
• She drives sai: mẹ đề nghị chở nhưng xếp hàng vào trường khiến cô say xe ("makes me carsick").
• She takes the bus sai: xe buýt đi vòng qua ba ngôi làng nên cô thà ngủ thêm.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cách di chuyển, đề nghị của người khác ("Mum offered to drive me") luôn là nhiễu; chọn động từ chủ ngữ "I" ở hiện tại đơn.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his wife. Where do the couple meet?
questions.explanation:
Darling, it's me — small change to tonight's plan, listen carefully! I know we said we'd meet at the restaurant, but they called: our table isn't ready until eight, so no point standing there hungry. And don't wait at the station like last time — your train gets in too early and it's freezing on that platform. Here's the plan: meet me outside the big bookshop on Mill Street — the one with the green awning. I'll be there at seven. We'll walk to dinner together from there. Kisses!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside a shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "meet me outside the big bookshop on Mill Street — the one with the green awning. I'll be there at seven." Hiệu sách chính là một cửa hàng.
• At the restaurant sai: bàn chưa sẵn sàng trước 8 giờ ("our table isn't ready until eight").
• At the station sai: tàu của vợ đến quá sớm và sân ga rất lạnh ("it's freezing on that platform").
👉 Mẹo: phương án có thể diễn đạt KHÁI QUÁT hơn bài nghe (bookshop → a shop). Hiểu nghĩa chứ đừng chỉ dò từ trùng khớp.

questions.prompt: A person calls a friend about his new car. What is the price of the small car?
questions.explanation:
Mike, you'll never guess where I've been — the car showroom, and I have news! You know I've been torn between the two models for weeks. The big family one is out: they want three thousand five hundred and fifty for it, and that's just beyond me this year. So I focused on the small car. The sticker said three thousand — but wait for it — with the winter tyres and the delivery, the real price of the small one comes to three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. Signed this morning. I pick it up Tuesday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3,250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "with the winter tyres and the delivery, the real price of the small one comes to three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds".
• 3,550 pounds sai: là giá chiếc xe gia đình cỡ lớn, vượt khả năng ("that's just beyond me this year").
• 3,000 pounds sai: chỉ là giá trên tem, chưa gồm lốp và phí giao ("The sticker said three thousand — but wait for it").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá, phân biệt giá niêm yết với giá thực trả; săn các cụm "comes to", "the real price", "final price".

questions.prompt: Which room will they study in? / Where will the first lesson of computer science take place?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to Computer Science, everyone — your first lesson is tomorrow, so write this down! There's been some confusion about the room, and I want no lost students wandering the corridors. The timetable you printed in summer says Room 101 — that's outdated, the computers were moved out last month. And please ignore Room 203, that's the biology lab; you'll find only frogs there, no keyboards. Your lesson is in Room 301, top floor, next to the library. Room three-oh-one, nine o'clock sharp. Don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Room 301.
• Vì sao đúng: "Your lesson is in Room 301, top floor, next to the library. Room three-oh-one, nine o'clock sharp."
• Room 101 sai: là thời khóa biểu in hồi hè đã lỗi thời, máy tính đã được chuyển đi ("that's outdated").
• Room 203 sai: là phòng thí nghiệm sinh học ("you'll find only frogs there, no keyboards").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi số phòng, người nói thường đọc lại theo kiểu đánh vần ("three-oh-one"); số đi với "outdated" hay tên môn khác đều sai.

questions.prompt: The daughter is calling her father. What did she buy?
questions.explanation:
Daddy! Don't be angry, but I've just used the birthday money — all of it, and it's wonderful! I went in for a pair of shoes, you know, the white ones I showed you — but they only had giant sizes left, like boats. Then I tried a blouse, the silky one, but it looked terrible under the shop lights, all wrong. And THEN I saw it: the dress. Dark blue, knee-length, perfect for Anna's wedding next month. I bought the dress, Daddy, and I look AMAZING. You'll see tonight!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A dress.
• Vì sao đúng: "And THEN I saw it: the dress. Dark blue, knee-length... I bought the dress, Daddy".
• A pair of shoes sai: cửa hàng chỉ còn cỡ quá to ("they only had giant sizes left, like boats").
• A blouse sai: đã thử nhưng nhìn tệ dưới ánh đèn cửa hàng ("it looked terrible under the shop lights").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi món ĐÃ mua, bám thì quá khứ khẳng định "I bought"; món chỉ được "tried" hay "went in for" là chưa mua.

questions.prompt: Where are they going to meet?
questions.explanation:
M: So, tomorrow's study session — where should we meet before heading in?
W: The station? It's easy for both our buses.
M: True, but it's chaos in the morning — we'd never find each other in that crowd.
W: The university steps, then? Right where the lecture is?
M: The problem is my bus gets in early and I'd just stand there for half an hour.
W: Okay, compromise: the park. It's between the station and the university, five minutes from each.
M: The park is perfect! The bench by the fountain — I'll bring coffees.
W: Nine o'clock at the park, then. If it rains, we run for the library!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The park is perfect! The bench by the fountain — I'll bring coffees." và chốt "Nine o'clock at the park, then."
• At the station sai: buổi sáng quá đông, hai người sẽ không tìm được nhau ("we'd never find each other in that crowd").
• At the university sai: xe buýt của anh đến sớm, phải đứng chờ nửa tiếng.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại hẹn địa điểm luôn chốt ở cuối. Nghe cụm "compromise" hoặc "... is perfect" rồi mới điền đáp án.

questions.prompt: What color top is he going to buy?
questions.explanation:
W: Good afternoon! Can I help you find something?
M: Yes — I need a new top for the weekend. Something simple but sharp.
W: This green one is very popular right now — fresh colour, twenty percent off this week.
M: Green's not really me, to be honest. My girlfriend says it clashes with everything I own.
W: Understood! What about red, then? This one is pure cotton, lovely quality.
M: Red is a bit... loud for me. I'd feel like a traffic light. What's that darker one behind you?
W: Ah, the black one — same cut as the red, and we have every size in stock.
M: Perfect. Black goes with everything. I'll take the black one in a medium, please.
W: Great choice! That's eighteen pounds at the till.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll take the black one in a medium, please."
• Green sai: anh không hợp màu xanh lá ("Green's not really me... it clashes with everything I own").
• Red sai: quá chói với anh ("Red is a bit... loud for me. I'd feel like a traffic light").
👉 Mẹo: mua sắm hỏi màu/cỡ, chỉ chốt khi nghe "I'll take..."; khuyến mãi hay lời khen của nhân viên chỉ là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: What elements of the film do they agree on?
questions.explanation:
M: So — the film last night! Where do we even start?
W: The soundtrack, obviously. That piano theme was gorgeous, it carried every scene.
M: See, I barely noticed the music — for me it was all about the characters. The old captain? Best character in years.
W: Really? I found him overacted, honestly. And the sister was so flat.
M: We clearly watched different films! Is there ANYTHING we agree on?
W: Hmm... what about the ending? That last scene on the bridge, with no dialogue at all...
M: Okay, YES. The ending was perfect. I actually sat in silence through the credits.
W: Same! So: soundtrack, no. Characters, no. But the ending — the ending we both loved.
M: Agreed. And that's rarer than it sounds with us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The ending.
• Vì sao đúng: "Okay, YES. The ending was perfect." và cô tổng kết "the ending — the ending we both loved".
• The soundtrack sai: cô khen nhạc piano nhưng anh gần như không để ý ("I barely noticed the music").
• The characters sai: anh khen ông thuyền trưởng còn cô lại chê diễn quá ("I found him overacted, honestly").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "agree on" cần ý mà CẢ HAI cùng khen. Nghe các câu phản bác ("Really? I found him...") để loại, rồi bắt "YES / Same!".

questions.prompt: What country will they study next semester?
questions.explanation:
W: Did you hear? They announced the country study for next semester!
M: Finally! Please tell me it's Germany — I've been practising my German for nothing otherwise.
W: Sorry to break your heart... Germany was LAST year's programme, remember? The exchange students told us all about it.
M: Right. Then Spain? Someone in the canteen swore it was Spain.
W: That rumour started because of the new Spanish teacher — but no, she's teaching language, not the study programme.
M: So what IS it then? Don't make me beg.
W: France! The whole semester — French history, French cinema, and a two-week trip to Paris in May!
M: PARIS? Okay, forget German. Where do I sign up?
W: The list opens Monday morning. I'm queueing at eight, join me!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – France.
• Vì sao đúng: "France! The whole semester — French history, French cinema, and a two-week trip to Paris in May!"
• Germany sai: là chương trình của NĂM NGOÁI ("Germany was LAST year's programme").
• Spain sai: chỉ là tin đồn vì trường có giáo viên tiếng Tây Ban Nha mới ("That rumour started because of the new Spanish teacher").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi kế hoạch kỳ tới, loại ngay ý gắn với "last year's" và "rumour"; đáp án thường được reo lên kèm chi tiết cụ thể.

questions.prompt: A woman is chatting with a friend about her afternoon plans. What is she going to do this afternoon?
questions.explanation:
You caught me at the perfect time — I'm just deciding my afternoon! My body says sleep at home, honestly, after this crazy week — but if I nap now I'll be awake until three in the morning, so no. My neighbour invited me to the cinema, but it's that three-hour war film, and I'm not in the mood for explosions. So I've decided: I'm going on the city tour! The open-top bus one — I've lived here six years and never done it. Tourist in my own town, here I come!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Go on a city tour.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I've decided: I'm going on the city tour! The open-top bus one — I've lived here six years and never done it."
• Sleep at home sai: cô tự loại vì ngủ giờ này sẽ thức tới 3 giờ sáng ("if I nap now I'll be awake until three in the morning, so no").
• Go to the cinema sai: hàng xóm rủ nhưng đó là phim chiến tranh dài ba tiếng, cô không có hứng.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi kế hoạch, bám "So I've decided"; ý gắn với "My body says..." hoặc lời rủ của người khác đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: What is the way to exercise? / What is she going to do? / What does she do on her holidays?
questions.explanation:
The doctor said I need regular exercise, and I've finally found my thing! Everyone had suggestions, of course. Cycling first — but the city traffic terrifies me on two wheels, I lasted exactly one day. Then running, which looks so easy when other people do it... my knees disagreed loudly after a week. What actually stuck is walking. An hour every evening, fast enough to feel it, slow enough to enjoy it. Three months now without missing a day, and I've never felt better!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Walking.
• Vì sao đúng: "What actually stuck is walking. An hour every evening" — ba tháng liền không bỏ ngày nào.
• Cycling sai: sợ giao thông trong thành phố, chỉ trụ đúng một ngày ("I lasted exactly one day").
• Running sai: đầu gối phản đối sau một tuần ("my knees disagreed loudly after a week").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cách tập hiện tại, chọn ý đi với "what actually stuck"; hoạt động kèm mốc ngắn (one day, a week) là đã bỏ.

questions.prompt: What is Mary's number?
questions.explanation:
Hello dear, it's Auntie June — you asked for Mary's telephone number for the wedding invitations, so grab a pencil! Ready? It's five five five, three nine two zero. I'll say it once more, slowly, because you know what happened with the last invitations: five, five, five... three, nine, two, zero. That's her home line — she gave up the mobile, says it rings too much. Call her before Thursday, she's off to her sister's after that. Good luck with the planning, sweetheart!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 555 3920.
• Vì sao đúng: bà đọc rõ hai lần "It's five five five, three nine two zero" rồi lặp lại chậm "five, five, five... three, nine, two, zero" — tức 555 3920.
• 335 3902 sai: đảo thứ tự chữ số, không khớp dãy được đọc.
• 333 3029 sai: bài không hề có chuỗi "three three three".
👉 Mẹo: dạng số điện thoại luôn được đọc lại lần hai chậm hơn. Ghi lần một, đối chiếu lần hai, chú ý cụm lặp "five five five" và chữ "zero" ở cuối.

questions.prompt: What type of location does the speaker enjoy living in most?
questions.explanation:
Where do I love living? People assume the answer is the countryside, because I paint landscapes — but two summers in a village taught me that I need more than cows for conversation. The suburbs seemed like a good middle path once: nice lawns, friendly neighbours... and absolutely nothing happening after eight pm. The truth is, I'm a city person to my bones. Give me the crowded markets, the late-night galleries, the noise, the mess, all of it. The city is where I feel alive.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The city.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth is, I'm a city person to my bones... The city is where I feel alive."
• The countryside sai: hai mùa hè ở làng cho thấy cô cần người để trò chuyện ("I need more than cows for conversation").
• The suburbs sai: từng có vẻ là lựa chọn trung dung nhưng "absolutely nothing happening after eight pm".
👉 Mẹo: hỏi nơi thích sống, "People assume the answer is..." là dấu hiệu ý đó SAI; đáp án nằm sau "The truth is".

questions.prompt: Why did she return to the shop?
questions.explanation:
What a morning I've had! Remember the shirt I bought my husband for our anniversary? The striped one, from the shop by the bank? Well, he tried it on last night, and the sleeves ended somewhere around his elbows — completely the wrong fit. So I went back to the shop first thing to exchange the shirt for a bigger size. Luckily they had one left, and the lady even ironed it for me. Disaster averted — the anniversary dinner is saved. Now I just need to hide it until Friday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To exchange a shirt.
• Vì sao đúng: "I went back to the shop first thing to exchange the shirt for a bigger size" — chiếc áo sơ mi kẻ sọc tặng chồng bị ngắn tay.
• To buy a skirt sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• To exchange a dress sai: món đồ là áo sơ mi ("the shirt I bought my husband"), không phải váy.
👉 Mẹo: khi các phương án chỉ khác nhau một danh từ (shirt / skirt / dress), nghe kỹ phụ âm đầu và dựa vào bối cảnh (tay áo, quà cho chồng).

questions.prompt: Listen to a man talking about the game he is playing. What is the game stopping him from doing?
questions.explanation:
My brother gave me this puzzle game for my birthday, and it has taken over my life — in the most frustrating way. Don't get me wrong: playing is a joy, I'm on it every lunch break. And the game lets you change characters whenever you like — I switch between the robot and the fox constantly, that part's brilliant. But winning? The game will simply not let me win! Level ninety-nine, the final door, and every single time the bridge collapses. Sixty tries. I dream about that bridge now.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Win.
• Vì sao đúng: "But winning? The game will simply not let me win! Level ninety-nine, the final door" — 60 lần thử đều thua.
• Play sai: anh chơi rất thoải mái, ngày nào cũng chơi giờ nghỉ trưa ("playing is a joy").
• Change characters sai: đổi nhân vật tùy thích và anh còn khen phần đó ("the game lets you change characters whenever you like... that part's brilliant").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "stopping him from doing" là dạng phủ định — chọn việc KHÔNG làm được; hai việc còn lại luôn được khen ngay trước đó.

questions.prompt: What's the main change managers are going to do?
questions.explanation:
Everyone, thirty seconds of your attention — news from this morning's management meeting! First, the things NOT changing, because the gossip machine is already running: the budget is safe, nobody is cutting anything this quarter. The meeting location also stays here in the main hall — the idea of moving to the branch office was voted down. The one real change is to the schedule: from next week, team meetings move from Friday mornings to Tuesday mornings, and the monthly review shifts to the first Monday. New calendars are in your inboxes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Adjust the schedule.
• Vì sao đúng: "The one real change is to the schedule: from next week, team meetings move from Friday mornings to Tuesday mornings".
• Reduce the budget sai: ngân sách được giữ nguyên ("the budget is safe, nobody is cutting anything this quarter").
• Relocate the meeting sai: ý chuyển sang văn phòng chi nhánh đã bị bác ("the idea of moving to the branch office was voted down").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nội bộ hay liệt kê "những gì KHÔNG đổi" trước để gài bẫy. Bám cụm "The one real change is".

questions.prompt: What is the woman doing?
questions.explanation:
Whoever is at the door, come back later — or roll up your sleeves! I've declared war on this house today. Started at seven with the bedrooms, and I'm now on my knees in the hallway with a brush and a bucket. The carpets are beaten, the mirrors are polished, the fridge is emptied of its... science experiments. Two more hours of cleaning and this place will finally look like humans live here. My sister's family arrives tomorrow, and her house always looks like a magazine. Not this time!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Cleaning.
• Vì sao đúng: "Two more hours of cleaning and this place will finally look like humans live here" — đã đập thảm, lau gương, dọn tủ lạnh.
• Swimming sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Crying sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: nếu lỡ động từ chính, gom các danh từ đi kèm (brush, bucket, carpets, mirrors) để suy ra hành động đang diễn ra.

questions.prompt: Listen to a man talking about his journey to work. How does the man usually go to work?
questions.explanation:
Ah, the daily commute question — my colleagues argue about this constantly! Here's my situation. I loved my motorbike years ago, but when the second baby arrived my wife made me sell it — too dangerous, and honestly she's right. The train would be lovely except our line only runs once an hour, and one missed connection ruins the whole morning. So I usually go by car. Thirty-five minutes, my own music, my own temperature, and the big car park behind the office. Boring but reliable — like me, my wife says!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By car.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I usually go by car. Thirty-five minutes, my own music, my own temperature, and the big car park behind the office."
• By motorbike sai: đã bán khi có con thứ hai ("my wife made me sell it — too dangerous").
• By train sai: tuyến chỉ chạy một chuyến mỗi giờ, lỡ nối chuyến là hỏng cả buổi sáng.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thói quen đi làm, bám "usually"; phương tiện gắn với quá khứ ("I loved my motorbike years ago") là bẫy.

questions.prompt: What does her sister drink?
questions.explanation:
M: I'm doing a coffee run before the meeting — what do you and your sister want?
W: You're a hero! Just a black coffee for me, please.
M: Done. And your sister — water? She had water last time, I remember.
W: Only because she was on that detox thing. That's long over, thankfully.
M: Coffee for her too, then? Two birds, one machine.
W: Oh no, never coffee — it gives her headaches, she hasn't touched it in years. She drinks tea. Green tea if they have it, regular if not.
M: One coffee, one tea. Any cake interest while I'm there?
W: You know us too well. Two of those almond things, please!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "She drinks tea. Green tea if they have it, regular if not."
• Water sai: chỉ vì đợt detox đã kết thúc từ lâu ("Only because she was on that detox thing. That's long over").
• Coffee sai: cà phê làm cô ấy đau đầu, nhiều năm không uống ("it gives her headaches, she hasn't touched it in years").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi về NGƯỜI THỨ BA (her sister), không phải người đang nói. Tách rõ ai uống gì trước khi chọn.

questions.prompt: Which door do they need to take to get to Edinburgh?
questions.explanation:
W: Right, coach station chaos as usual. Which door for Edinburgh, can you see?
M: Give me a second... the big screen shows Edinburgh but the gate number keeps flickering.
W: The man over there is waving people to door four — should we follow?
M: No, wait — door four is boarding for Manchester, I can see the sign on the coach itself.
W: Then three? The queue at three is enormous, that must mean something.
M: That's the London queue — it's always enormous. Look, it's settled: door two. The screen just fixed itself — Edinburgh, half past ten, door two.
W: Door two! Come on, before the queue discovers it too.
M: Right behind you — grab the window seats!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Two.
• Vì sao đúng: "it's settled: door two. The screen just fixed itself — Edinburgh, half past ten, door two."
• Three sai: đó là hàng chờ đi London ("That's the London queue — it's always enormous").
• Four sai: cửa đó đang cho lên xe đi Manchester ("door four is boarding for Manchester").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cửa/sân ga, ghim từng số với từng điểm đến; thông tin từ đám đông hay người vẫy tay thường sai — bám "it's settled".

questions.prompt: When did they decide to meet?
questions.explanation:
M: We still haven't fixed a time for the pottery class visit! This week, yes?
W: Yes! I looked at the schedule. There's an early slot — Friday at seven in the morning.
M: Seven am?! Before work? I'd be shaping clay with my eyes closed.
W: Ha! Fine. They also run Saturday at nine.
M: Saturday's no good — it's my nephew's football final, I promised to be there with the banner.
W: You and that banner! Okay, last option: Sunday at nine.
M: Sunday at nine is actually perfect. Coffee at eight thirty first, next door?
W: Deal — Sunday, nine o'clock, and don't you dare cancel!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 9am on Sunday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sunday at nine is actually perfect" và chốt "Deal — Sunday, nine o'clock, and don't you dare cancel!"
• 7am on Friday sai: quá sớm, trước giờ làm ("Seven am?! Before work? I'd be shaping clay with my eyes closed").
• 9am on Saturday sai: vướng trận chung kết bóng đá của cháu trai.
👉 Mẹo: phương án ghép GIỜ + NGÀY thì phải khớp cả hai. Đừng chọn vội khi nghe "nine" vì bài có tới hai mốc 9 giờ ở hai ngày khác nhau.

questions.prompt: What do they need to repair for the building?
questions.explanation:
W: The building survey arrived this morning. Shall I give you the summary?
M: Please. And start with the gate — that thing groans like a ghost every time it opens.
W: Funny you say that: the gate passed! It needs grease, not repairs — five minutes with an oil can.
M: Small mercies. The doors, then? The back one sticks in the rain.
W: Sticking, yes, but structurally the doors are all sound — the surveyor barely mentioned them.
M: So what's the bad news? There's always bad news.
W: The windows. Nearly half the frames have rot, and three panes are cracked. The report says repair them before the cold season or the heating costs will double.
M: Windows first, then. Get the carpenter in this week — north side before the frost.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Windows.
• Vì sao đúng: "The windows. Nearly half the frames have rot, and three panes are cracked. The report says repair them before the cold season".
• Doors sai: về kết cấu vẫn tốt, chỉ hơi kẹt khi trời mưa ("structurally the doors are all sound").
• Gate sai: chỉ cần tra dầu, không phải sửa chữa ("It needs grease, not repairs — five minutes with an oil can").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi hạng mục cần SỬA, phân biệt "bảo dưỡng nhẹ" với "hư hỏng thật"; bám các từ hư hại rot, cracked.

questions.prompt: Listen to an instruction. Which light shows that the computer is on?
questions.explanation:
Before I leave you with your new office computer, one important lesson: the three lights on the tower, because the manual explains them terribly. The green light near the cable? That only tells you power is arriving from the wall — the machine itself can still be fast asleep. The little red one blinks when something needs attention, usually a low battery in the backup. The one you actually want every morning is the blue light: blue shining means the computer is on and working. No blue, no work. Any questions?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Blue.
• Vì sao đúng: "The one you actually want every morning is the blue light: blue shining means the computer is on and working. No blue, no work."
• Green sai: chỉ báo có điện từ ổ cắm, máy vẫn có thể đang tắt ("the machine itself can still be fast asleep").
• Red sai: là đèn cảnh báo, nháy khi có gì đó cần chú ý, thường là pin dự phòng yếu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hướng dẫn thiết bị, ghi nhanh cặp màu–chức năng rồi chọn đúng chức năng câu hỏi hỏi (ở đây là trạng thái "on").

questions.prompt: Listen to a man talking. What is not working?
questions.explanation:
Morning, Jenny — before you get here, a report from the front line. Mixed news. The wifi, miracle of miracles, is working perfectly — full signal in every room, even the kitchen. The printer behaved too: I printed the whole agenda without a single paper jam, first time this year. But the computer — the big one in the meeting room — is another story. It starts up, shows the logo, and then freezes solid. I've restarted it four times. The computer is properly broken, so bring your laptop, we'll present from that.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The computer.
• Vì sao đúng: "It starts up, shows the logo, and then freezes solid... The computer is properly broken, so bring your laptop."
• The Wifi sai: chạy hoàn hảo, phủ sóng cả bếp ("working perfectly — full signal in every room").
• The printer sai: in trọn bản chương trình mà không kẹt giấy ("I printed the whole agenda without a single paper jam").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thứ KHÔNG hoạt động, dùng các cụm khen ("working perfectly", "behaved") để loại; đáp án nằm sau "But".

questions.prompt: How many pages of the assignment?
questions.explanation:
One moment before the bell — the geography assignment, because I keep getting the same question! Yes, the cover sheet from the department says six pages, but that sheet is for the advanced class, not you. And no, Milo, five pages is not 'the usual' — I don't know where that number came from. For this class, the assignment is four pages. Exactly four: introduction, two pages of analysis, one page of conclusions. Four pages, double-spaced, Friday morning. Now off you go — and Milo? FOUR.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 4 trang.
• Vì sao đúng: "For this class, the assignment is four pages. Exactly four: introduction, two pages of analysis, one page of conclusions."
• 6 sai: là yêu cầu của lớp nâng cao, ghi trên tờ bìa của khoa ("that sheet is for the advanced class, not you").
• 5 sai: chỉ là con số truyền miệng, giáo viên không biết từ đâu ra ("I don't know where that number came from").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi số lượng, đáp án thường được nhắc lại rồi bẻ nhỏ ra ("Exactly four: introduction, two pages... one page").

questions.prompt: Listen to a man calling his friend. Why does he make the call?
options: To tell her he will be late
questions.explanation:
Nadia, hi, it's Sam — don't hang up, this is a thirty-second call! First: no, I haven't got lost again, I know exactly where the theatre is this time, I even checked the parking. And I'm not calling with another invitation — we're already set for tonight, aren't we, no changes there. It's just... the client meeting is running over, badly. I'll be late — maybe twenty-five minutes. Go in without me, leave my ticket at the desk, and I'll slide into my seat at the interval if I must. Sorry!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – To tell her he will be late.
• Vì sao đúng: "the client meeting is running over, badly. I'll be late — maybe twenty-five minutes. Go in without me."
• To ask for directions sai: anh khẳng định đã biết đường ("I know exactly where the theatre is this time, I even checked the parking").
• To invite her out sai: hai người đã hẹn sẵn tối nay ("I'm not calling with another invitation — we're already set for tonight").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi, hai câu mở đầu thường phủ định đúng 2 phương án; đáp án nằm sau "It's just...".

questions.prompt: Listen to a student explaining the project. Why did the students do the experiment on the tree?
options: To study the effects of pollution
To measure the speed of the plant's growth
To observe how trees absorb water
questions.explanation:
For the science fair, our group chose the big pine tree by the car park — and everyone asks why. Simple: we wanted to study the effects of pollution. The tree stands right where all the parents' cars idle every morning, so we compared its needles with a tree from the quiet side of the school. We measured, photographed, and tested for six weeks. The difference was bigger than we expected — you can literally see the traffic in the needles. Our poster is in the main hall if you want the details!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To study the effects of pollution.
• Vì sao đúng: "we wanted to study the effects of pollution" — nhóm so lá thông cạnh bãi đỗ xe với cây ở phía yên tĩnh của trường.
• To measure the speed of the plant's growth sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• To observe how trees absorb water sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi mục đích thí nghiệm, bắt cụm "we wanted to..." / "the aim was"; phần mô tả đo đạc, chụp ảnh chỉ là phương pháp.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his day. What did he do in the morning?
options: Go for a walk in the park
questions.explanation:
My day started better than any day in months, let me tell you. I was up before the alarm, drove out to the headland — you know, where the lighthouse is — and just stood there looking at the view. The sun coming up over the bay, the fishing boats heading out, the islands still half in mist... I didn't take a single photo. I just looked, for a whole hour. Everything else today — the emails, the meetings — none of it touched me. That view fixed my whole week.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Look at a view.
• Vì sao đúng: "drove out to the headland — you know, where the lighthouse is — and just stood there looking at the view... I just looked, for a whole hour."
• Have breakfast at a cafe sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Go for a walk in the park sai: anh lái xe ra mũi đất chỗ ngọn hải đăng và đứng nhìn, bài không nói đi dạo công viên.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi việc đã làm buổi sáng, bám chuỗi động từ quá khứ trong bài; đừng suy diễn thêm hoạt động bài không nêu.

questions.prompt: Listen to the man talking. What did he leave in the yard?
questions.explanation:
You know that sinking feeling when the weather changes? I'm living it right now. This afternoon was glorious, so I did my exercises out in the yard — barefoot on the grass, lovely. Carried everything back inside afterwards: the mat, the water bottle, the towel, the radio... everything except one thing. My shoes! My brand-new running shoes are sitting out there in the yard, and it has just started to absolutely pour. They'll be two little swimming pools by now. Excuse me while I go perform a rescue.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Shoes.
• Vì sao đúng: "everything except one thing. My shoes! My brand-new running shoes are sitting out there in the yard".
• A laptop sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• A shirt sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; đồ anh mang vào gồm thảm, bình nước, khăn và radio.
👉 Mẹo: bài hay liệt kê một loạt đồ ĐÃ mang vào rồi mới nêu thứ bị bỏ quên. Chờ cụm "everything except".

questions.prompt: Listen to a person talking about a picnic. What did the speaker bring?
questions.explanation:
Sunday's beach picnic — what a day! Fifteen of us in the end, and the food table was a work of art. Elena turned up with two coolers of drinks, enough lemonade to fill the sea. The office boys were on sandwich duty and, surprisingly, delivered — proper ones, with three fillings. My contribution? The fruit! I raided the market at seven am: peaches, cherries, two melons, and a pineapple that I carried like a baby on the bus. Every last piece disappeared. Next time I'm bringing a wheelbarrow!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Fruit.
• Vì sao đúng: "My contribution? The fruit! I raided the market at seven am: peaches, cherries, two melons, and a pineapple".
• Sandwiches sai: do nhóm đồng nghiệp nam phụ trách ("The office boys were on sandwich duty").
• Drinks sai: Elena mang hai thùng đồ uống ("Elena turned up with two coolers of drinks").
👉 Mẹo: dạng "ai mang gì", câu hỏi hỏi "the speaker" nên chỉ lấy món sau "My contribution?" hoặc "I brought".

questions.prompt: A person calls a friend about his new car. How much does the small car cost him?
questions.explanation:
Tony! Call me back when you hear this — the car saga is OVER. So, the showroom had the two models side by side. The big estate was gorgeous, but they wanted four thousand two hundred and fifty — for that money I'd need to sell a kidney. The salesman started the small one at three thousand five hundred and fifty, and then we had coffee, and we talked, and we walked away twice... Final handshake price: three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. The small car is MINE, Tony. Collection on Thursday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Final handshake price: three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. The small car is MINE".
• 3550 pounds sai: là giá người bán CHÀO ban đầu cho xe nhỏ, trước khi mặc cả ("The salesman started the small one at three thousand five hundred and fifty").
• 4250 pounds sai: là giá chiếc estate cỡ lớn ("for that money I'd need to sell a kidney").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá phải trả, phân biệt giá chào và giá chốt; săn "final price", "handshake price", "we settled on".

questions.prompt: Listen to two friends talking about their plans for the holiday. What are they going to do on this holiday?
questions.explanation:
W: Holiday brainstorm, right now! We have ten days and I refuse to waste them.
M: I vote camping — the forest lakes, a tent, total silence...
W: You said that last year, and then it rained for a week and you sulked in the tent. Remember?
M: ...We agreed never to mention that. Fine. Traveling abroad? Flights to Lisbon are cheap right now.
W: I checked yesterday — cheap until you add bags, hotels, and eating out. My savings said no.
M: So what's YOUR big idea then?
W: The language school by the lake — they need volunteers to teach English at their summer camp. Free room, free meals, afternoons off by the water.
M: Teaching kids... on a lake... for free? Actually, that sounds brilliant.
W: Doesn't it? I'll email them tonight — we're teaching this holiday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Teaching.
• Vì sao đúng: "they need volunteers to teach English at their summer camp" và cả hai chốt "I'll email them tonight — we're teaching this holiday!"
• Going camping sai: năm ngoái mưa cả tuần, cô nhắc lại để bác bỏ ("then it rained for a week and you sulked in the tent").
• Traveling abroad sai: vé rẻ nhưng cộng hành lý, khách sạn, ăn uống thì quá tốn ("My savings said no").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại lên kế hoạch, ý nêu ĐẦU tiên gần như luôn bị bác; đáp án là ý cuối cùng cả hai đồng thuận.

questions.prompt: Listen to a girl calling with her mother. Why did she call her mother to pick up at the airport?
questions.explanation:
W2: Mum, hi — the plane just landed. Could you come get me? Please?
W1: Darling, welcome back! You don't sound like someone back from holiday. Wasn't it wonderful?
W2: It was, Mum, the trip was perfect — I'm not sad, I promise.
W1: Jet lag, then? You must be shattered after that overnight flight.
W2: Weirdly, no — I slept like a rock the whole way, both seats to myself. It's something else... my throat started burning over the ocean, and now I'm all shivery and my head is pounding. I think I'm properly sick.
W1: Oh, sweetheart. Right — arrivals hall, the bench by the flower shop, don't move. I'm bringing paracetamol and your big scarf.
W2: You're the best. Hurry, Mum.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "my throat started burning over the ocean, and now I'm all shivery and my head is pounding. I think I'm properly sick."
• Happy sai: chuyến đi rất vui nhưng đó không phải lý do gọi ("the trip was perfect — I'm not sad, I promise").
• Tired sai: cô ngủ rất ngon suốt chuyến bay ("Weirdly, no — I slept like a rock the whole way").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do, người mẹ sẽ đoán sai 2 lần trước; đáp án nằm sau "It's something else...".

questions.prompt: Listen to a conversation. What is the woman's most important task for the upcoming conference?
questions.explanation:
M: Two weeks to the conference! Give me your status — I promised the board an update.
W: Then write this down. The welcome evening — the informal barbecue — is basically done; the venue handles everything, I just approve the menu Friday.
M: Good. Invitations?
W: Went out three weeks ago. Two hundred and ten confirmed, including all the keynote guests. Done and dusted.
M: So what's keeping you up at night?
W: The same thing that would keep YOU up: the opening address. I'm giving the formal speech this year — the full welcome, in front of every partner and sponsor we have.
M: Ah yes. THE speech. How's it coming?
W: Fourth draft. By the conference it'll be perfect — it has to be. Everything else is details; that speech is the event.
M: Then I'll tell the board the important thing is in the best possible hands.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Giving a formal address.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm giving the formal speech this year — the full welcome, in front of every partner and sponsor we have" và cô chốt "that speech is the event".
• Organizing an informal event sai: tiệc nướng chào mừng do đơn vị tổ chức lo hết, cô chỉ duyệt thực đơn ("the venue handles everything").
• Sending out invitations sai: đã gửi ba tuần trước, 210 người xác nhận ("Done and dusted").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi việc quan trọng nhất, loại ngay việc "done and dusted"; bám câu chốt kiểu "Everything else is details".

questions.prompt: Two people are talking about meeting for dinner. What time does Ahmed meet Rose?
questions.explanation:
M: Rose, it's Ahmed — about dinner tonight. When shall we say?
W: I finish work at seven, so... quarter past seven at the restaurant?
M: Quarter past is tight for me — my last meeting ends at seven, and it's across town.
W: Hmm. Half past seven, then? That's what we did last time.
M: Last time you sat waiting fifteen minutes because my bus vanished, remember. Let's be honest with ourselves.
W: Ha! True. So what's realistic?
M: Quarter to eight. That gives me a real chance to arrive calm, on time, and with flowers.
W: Flowers! Well then, quarter to eight it is. I'll move the booking.
M: Quarter to eight, table by the window. I won't be late this time — I promise!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Quarter to eight (7 giờ 45).
• Vì sao đúng: "Quarter to eight. That gives me a real chance to arrive calm, on time" — cô đồng ý "quarter to eight it is. I'll move the booking."
• Half past seven sai: là giờ của lần trước và Rose đã phải chờ 15 phút ("Last time you sat waiting fifteen minutes").
• Quarter past seven sai: quá gấp vì họp của Ahmed 7 giờ mới xong và ở đầu kia thành phố ("Quarter past is tight for me").
👉 Mẹo: học chắc cách nói giờ kiểu Anh — "quarter past" là hơn 15, "half past" là rưỡi, "quarter to" là kém 15. Nghe nhầm past/to là mất điểm ngay.

questions.prompt: A man calls the teleshop. What is the teleshop number?
questions.explanation:
Hello, hello — is this thing recording? Right. I'm calling about the blender from your TV advert, and I want to check I've got the right number, because I've dialled wrong twice already. The first time I tried one-zero-two-zero-three-zero, which turned out to be a pizza place — nice people, wrong products. Then somebody gave me three-zero-one-zero-two-zero, also wrong, that's a taxi firm. The number on my screen right now says: two-zero-one-zero-three-zero. Two, zero, one, zero, three, zero. If this is finally the teleshop — call me back about the blender!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 201030.
• Vì sao đúng: "The number on my screen right now says: two-zero-one-zero-three-zero. Two, zero, one, zero, three, zero." — tức 201030.
• 102030 sai: là số ông gọi nhầm lần đầu, hóa ra là tiệm pizza ("which turned out to be a pizza place").
• 301020 sai: là số người khác đưa, hóa ra là hãng taxi ("also wrong, that's a taxi firm").
👉 Mẹo: dạng dãy số, ghi cả ba dãy rồi mới chọn; đáp án là dãy gắn với hiện tại ("right now") và được đọc lại lần hai.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his sister. Where will they meet?
questions.explanation:
M: Hi, how are you?
W: Oh! Are you calling from America?
M: No, I've been visiting the London office for a few days. Do you want to meet up? I have to catch a train at three.
W: Yes! There's a park near my flat. The weather's lovely and sunny, and there are lots of people around. Do you want to meet there?
M: Sure. Then I can walk you to your university afterwards — I don't have to be at the station until three.
W: OK, see you soon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At the park.
• Vì sao đúng: cô đề nghị "There's a park near my flat... Do you want to meet there?" và anh đồng ý "Sure".
• At the station sai: đó là nơi anh phải đến lúc 3 giờ SAU khi gặp.
• At the university sai: anh chỉ đi bộ đưa cô đến đó sau, không phải điểm hẹn.
👉 Mẹo: cả 3 địa điểm đều xuất hiện — chọn nơi có "meet there" + "Sure".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between the speaker and Lisa?
questions.explanation:
Everyone keeps asking about my vacation photos, especially about Lisa — who is this woman in every single picture? So let me clear it up! No, she's not my daughter, though she does steal my chips like one. And people at the hotel kept assuming she was my old teacher because she lectures me about sunscreen. The truth: Lisa and I are best friends — thirty years now, since we sat together on the first day of secondary school. Every summer, one trip, just the two of us. Same again next year, Lisa!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth: Lisa and I are best friends — thirty years now, since we sat together on the first day of secondary school."
• Mother and daughter sai: bị phủ định thẳng ("No, she's not my daughter, though she does steal my chips like one").
• Teacher and student sai: chỉ là người ở khách sạn tưởng vậy vì Lisa hay nhắc bôi kem chống nắng ("people at the hotel kept assuming").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi quan hệ giữa hai người, bám cụm "The truth:"; quan hệ đi với "people assumed" hoặc "she's not" đều là bẫy.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her house. What is she going to change in their house?
questions.explanation:
We finally decided what to change in the house this year — the budget allows exactly one big project, so the family voted! My husband campaigned hard for a new car, but the old one passed its inspection fine, so that argument died. The kids demanded a new computer — of course they did — but theirs is barely three years old. The winner is the window! The big one in the living room: it's single glass from the seventies, rattles in every storm, and lets all our heating money fly outside. New window before winter!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The window.
• Vì sao đúng: "The winner is the window! The big one in the living room: it's single glass from the seventies... New window before winter!"
• The car sai: chồng vận động mạnh nhưng xe cũ vẫn qua đăng kiểm nên lý lẽ đó không còn ("the old one passed its inspection fine").
• The computer sai: máy của bọn trẻ mới dùng chưa đầy ba năm ("theirs is barely three years old").
👉 Mẹo: dạng bình chọn trong gia đình, bám cụm "The winner is"; mỗi đề xuất còn lại đều bị bác bằng một lý do cụ thể.

questions.prompt: A receptionist is checking the client list of a clinic. How many clients are Americans?
questions.explanation:
Right, doctor — quick summary of tomorrow's client list before you go home. Eight appointments in total. The Silva family, that's three of them, they're Brazilian — the little one needs the translator again. Then we have two Canadians, the couple from the ski accident. The gentleman at four o'clock, Mr. Miller — people always assume he's American, but he corrected me twice: Australian. So of all eight, exactly one is American: Mrs. Baker at ten, the knee check-up. Just the one American. See you at eight!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – One.
• Vì sao đúng: "So of all eight, exactly one is American: Mrs. Baker at ten, the knee check-up. Just the one American."
• Two sai: hai người Canada là cặp đôi bị tai nạn trượt tuyết ("we have two Canadians"), không phải người Mỹ.
• Three sai: ba người nhà Silva là người Brazil ("The Silva family, that's three of them, they're Brazilian").
👉 Mẹo: dạng đếm theo điều kiện, kẻ nhanh bảng quốc tịch–số người; các số 3 và 2 trong bài thuộc nhóm khác, đừng chộp bừa. Chú ý bẫy "people always assume he's American" (ông Miller thực ra là người Úc).

questions.prompt: Listen to Anna talking about her routine. Where does Anna go for a walk every morning?
questions.explanation:
My name is Anna, and people say my mornings are boringly perfect! Here's the routine. Up at six, tea first — always tea, never coffee. Then my morning walk, and everyone assumes I go to the park, but the park doesn't open its gates until eight, far too late for me. Around the neighbourhood, you ask? Too many dogs chasing my ankles, tried it once. No — every morning I walk around the college. The old campus is open at dawn, the paths are wide, and the ivy walls are beautiful in the early light.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – College.
• Vì sao đúng: "every morning I walk around the college. The old campus is open at dawn, the paths are wide".
• Park sai: công viên 8 giờ mới mở cổng, quá muộn với cô ("the park doesn't open its gates until eight, far too late for me").
• Neighborhood sai: đã thử một lần nhưng nhiều chó rượt ("Too many dogs chasing my ankles, tried it once").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi địa điểm quen thuộc, bỏ nơi gắn với "everyone assumes" và "tried it once"; chọn nơi đi với "every morning I walk".

questions.prompt: Helen is calling a friend about the place her whole family is standing while seeing her off to college. Where are they standing?
questions.explanation:
Hi! It's Helen — yes, THE day is finally here, they're seeing me off to college! The whole family came, all seven of them, Grandma included. Guess where we're all standing right now? Not the library complex — that's closed for renovation, big fences everywhere. And we left the university area itself because Dad said it was too crowded for a proper goodbye. So we're in the residential area just behind the campus — the quiet streets with the little gardens, right by my new student house. Grandma is already crying. Wish me luck!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Residential area.
• Vì sao đúng: "So we're in the residential area just behind the campus — the quiet streets with the little gardens, right by my new student house."
• Library complex sai: đang đóng cửa sửa chữa, rào chắn khắp nơi ("that's closed for renovation, big fences everywhere").
• University area sai: cả nhà đã rời khỏi đó vì bố chê quá đông để chia tay tử tế ("too crowded for a proper goodbye").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi vị trí HIỆN TẠI, bám thì hiện tại "we're in..."; nơi đi với "closed" hoặc "we left" đều đã bị loại.

questions.prompt: Listen to a man talking about their train journey. What time did the train depart?
questions.explanation:
What a journey that was — let me tell you about the start of it! We'd booked the early train, the nine o'clock, and were very proud of ourselves. Then at the station, the board announced a delay — signal problems up the line. Some passengers panicked and rebooked onto the ten o'clock for extra money. We waited it out with coffee, and good thing too: our train departed at nine thirty, only half an hour behind, and we still made the ferry connection with time to spare. Patience pays, my friend!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 9:30.
• Vì sao đúng: "our train departed at nine thirty, only half an hour behind, and we still made the ferry connection".
• 9:00 sai: là giờ trên vé đã đặt nhưng bị hoãn vì lỗi tín hiệu ("We'd booked the early train, the nine o'clock").
• 10:00 sai: là chuyến mà vài hành khách hoảng loạn đổi sang, phải trả thêm tiền ("Some passengers panicked and rebooked onto the ten o'clock").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giờ khởi hành THỰC TẾ, bỏ giờ in trên vé và giờ của người khác; chọn số đi với động từ quá khứ "departed".

questions.prompt: Listen to a woman asking about a flight. How much does the flight in the morning cost?
questions.explanation:
Good afternoon, I'm calling about flights to Dublin next Thursday — and thank you for the patience, I know I ask a lot of questions! So, to repeat what you've told me: the evening flight is three hundred pounds, that's the cheapest, but it lands close to midnight — too late for my meeting. The midday one at four hundred is honestly more than I want to pay. So the morning flight, the eight fifteen — that one is three hundred and fifty pounds, correct? Yes? Then book me the morning one, please. Three fifty it is.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 350 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the morning flight, the eight fifteen — that one is three hundred and fifty pounds, correct?... Then book me the morning one".
• 300 pounds sai: là chuyến TỐI, rẻ nhất nhưng hạ cánh gần nửa đêm nên lỡ cuộc họp.
• 400 pounds sai: là chuyến giữa trưa, đắt hơn mức cô muốn trả ("more than I want to pay").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá của MỘT chuyến cụ thể, ghim cặp buổi–giá (evening 300 / midday 400 / morning 350) rồi mới trả lời.

questions.prompt: A man is talking to a shopping assistant. What color top is he going to buy?
questions.explanation:
W: Welcome! Looking for something for yourself today?
M: Yes — a decent top, something I can wear to the office and after.
W: Then you're lucky: these green ones came in yesterday, and the colour is THE colour this season.
M: Mm, my colleague has that exact green. We'd look like a uniform. What else?
W: This blue is lovely — soft cotton, and it would suit you. Though... I only have small and extra large left.
M: And I'm neither, story of my life. That dark one on the end rail?
W: The black! Same fabric as the blue, every size, and it never goes out of style.
M: Sold. The black one, medium, please — and could you cut the tag off? I'll wear it out.
W: Of course! The fitting room is just behind you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sold. The black one, medium, please — and could you cut the tag off? I'll wear it out."
• Green sai: đồng nghiệp của anh đã có đúng màu đó, mặc vào trông như đồng phục ("We'd look like a uniform").
• Blue sai: đẹp nhưng chỉ còn cỡ S và XL, không có cỡ của anh ("I only have small and extra large left").
👉 Mẹo: mua sắm, mỗi màu bị loại vì một lý do riêng (trùng người khác, hết cỡ). Chỉ chốt khi nghe câu đặt hàng kèm cỡ.

questions.prompt: Listen to a girl calling the cafe. What did she forget, and where did she leave it?
questions.explanation:
M: Riverside Café, good afternoon!
W: Hi! I was there about an hour ago — table by the big plant — and I think I left my scarf. The blue woolly one?
M: A blue scarf... let me have a look around. On the counter I only see somebody's glasses, I'm afraid.
W: No, not the counter, I never went up there — my friend ordered for us.
M: What about near the door? There's a coat stand — people forget things on it every day.
W: I didn't use the stand... wait, I remember now! We were at the corner table — I hung it on the chair. Could you check in the corner?
M: The corner by the window... one moment... yes! Blue scarf, still on the chair, safe and sound.
W: Wonderful! I'll come by before you close. Guard it with your life!
M: It'll be behind the till with your name on it. See you soon!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In the corner.
• Vì sao đúng: "We were at the corner table — I hung it on the chair" và nhân viên xác nhận "The corner by the window... yes! Blue scarf, still on the chair".
• On the counter sai: trên quầy chỉ có cặp kính của người khác, và cô chưa từng lên quầy ("I never went up there — my friend ordered for us").
• Near the door sai: cô không dùng giá treo áo cạnh cửa ("I didn't use the stand").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi vị trí đồ bỏ quên, đáp án thường xuất hiện muộn, ngay sau khi người nói chợt nhớ ra ("wait, I remember now!").

questions.prompt: The woman is calling a friend about meeting for dinner. How long does it take to get to the station?
questions.explanation:
W: Hi! About dinner tonight — I'm trying to time everything. How long to get to the station from yours?
M: Depends who you ask! The taxi app promises thirty minutes.
W: Thirty? That sounds suspiciously optimistic for a Friday evening.
M: Exactly — that's thirty on an empty Sunday morning, maybe. And my neighbour claims he once did it in... well, he says twenty-five, but he drives like a maniac.
W: So what's the honest number for tonight?
M: With Friday traffic and the roadworks on the bridge: forty minutes. I've done it every week this month — forty, reliably.
W: Forty it is. So if dinner is at eight, you leave at quarter past seven.
M: Already setting the alarm. Station café at eight — first one there orders the wine!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 40 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "With Friday traffic and the roadworks on the bridge: forty minutes. I've done it every week this month — forty, reliably."
• 30 minutes sai: là con số ứng dụng gọi xe hứa, chỉ đúng khi đường vắng ("that's thirty on an empty Sunday morning, maybe").
• 50 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu (bài chỉ có thêm con số 25 phút của ông hàng xóm).
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thời gian di chuyển thật, bỏ số của app và của người khác; chọn số kèm điều kiện thực tế ("with Friday traffic").

questions.prompt: Listen to a friend talking about selling her music player. How much did she sell it for?
questions.explanation:
M: Hey, did you ever sell that old music player of yours? The little silver one?
W: I did! This weekend, at the flea market. Sold it in the first hour.
M: Nice! You wanted sixty for it, didn't you? That was your big plan.
W: Sixty was my dream price, yes — the young collector guy looked at it, but he walked away laughing.
M: Ouch. So down to forty? That's what your brother said it was worth.
W: My brother undervalues everything I own! No — a lovely woman offered forty-five, we haggled the OTHER way for once, and we settled on fifty. Fifty dollars, cash.
M: Selling UP from the offer? Teach me your ways!
W: Charm and a working pair of headphones, my friend. That's the secret!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 50 dollars.
• Vì sao đúng: "a lovely woman offered forty-five, we haggled the OTHER way for once, and we settled on fifty. Fifty dollars, cash."
• 60 dollars sai: là giá cô mơ ước, người sưu tầm trẻ xem rồi bỏ đi ("Sixty was my dream price, yes — but he walked away laughing").
• 40 dollars sai: là mức em/anh trai cô định giá ("That's what your brother said it was worth"), cô bác bỏ ngay.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá bán cuối, bám "we settled on"; giá mơ ước và giá người khác định đều khác giá chốt.

questions.prompt: Listen to a woman explaining why he was late. What is the main reason he gets late?
questions.explanation:
Let me explain about my husband before you all judge him — he'll be here any minute! It's not what you think. He didn't oversleep; he was actually up at six, I heard him making coffee before my alarm even rang. And he didn't forget anything either — the presents, the flowers, the folder for later, everything was packed by the door since last night. What happened is simpler: he missed the train. The one before it was cancelled, the platform was packed, and he just couldn't squeeze on. The next train gets in at ten past — save him some cake!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Missed the train (lỡ tàu).
• Vì sao đúng: người vợ nói thẳng "What happened is simpler: he missed the train" — tàu trước bị hủy, sân ga đông nghịt nên anh không chen lên được.
• Overslept sai: bị phủ định ngay từ đầu "He didn't oversleep; he was actually up at six" — anh dậy từ 6 giờ, còn pha cà phê.
• Forgot something sai: cũng bị phủ định "he didn't forget anything either" — quà, hoa, tập hồ sơ đã xếp sẵn ở cửa từ tối hôm trước.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LÝ DO thường liệt kê đủ 3 phương án nhưng phủ định 2 cái bằng "didn't...", "it's not..."; chỉ khoanh phương án đi kèm câu khẳng định như "What happened is..." hoặc "The reason is...".

questions.prompt: A mom is calling her son to remind him about picking up groceries. How much is an egg?
questions.explanation:
Sweetheart, it's Mum — grocery reminder, and this time with prices, because last week you came home with the fancy everything! Listen: we need a dozen eggs from the farm stall at the market. They're one pound fifty each — one fifty, the brown ones from the happy chickens, the lady knows me. Do NOT buy the golden organic ones at the deli, those cost nearly double and taste exactly the same. One pound fifty per egg, a dozen of them, and bring the change home. Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – £1.50 (one pound fifty).
• Vì sao đúng: mẹ nói rõ giá trứng ở quầy chợ "They're one pound fifty each", rồi nhắc lại chắc nịch "One pound fifty per egg, a dozen of them".
• £2.50 sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• £3.50 sai: cũng không có con số này; bài chỉ nói loại organic ở deli "cost nearly double" (đắt gần gấp đôi) chứ không đọc ra giá cụ thể.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIÁ hay bẫy bằng hai mặt hàng khác nhau. Bám vào món mà người nói yêu cầu mua (eggs from the farm stall) và bỏ qua giá của món bị cấm mua ("Do NOT buy...").

questions.prompt: A man is calling his wife. Where will they meet?
questions.explanation:
Love, it's me — change of plan for this afternoon, listen before you leave! I know I said I'd come home first and we'd go together, but the meeting is running long and I'd never make it. And waiting in the garden makes no sense now — the forecast says rain from four. So: meet me outside the shop — the big furniture place on Kings Road where we're choosing the sofa. I'll be by the main entrance at half past four. Bring the measurements! And the umbrella, apparently. See you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside the shop (trước cửa hàng).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chồng chốt "meet me outside the shop — the big furniture place on Kings Road", hẹn cụ thể "by the main entrance at half past four".
• At home sai: đó là kế hoạch cũ đã bỏ "I said I'd come home first and we'd go together, but the meeting is running long and I'd never make it".
• In the garden sai: bị loại vì thời tiết "waiting in the garden makes no sense now — the forecast says rain from four".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐỊA ĐIỂM luôn có tín hiệu đổi kế hoạch ("change of plan", "but", "makes no sense now"). Nơi đúng là nơi xuất hiện SAU các từ này và đi kèm chi tiết cụ thể (tên đường, cửa chính, giờ hẹn).

questions.prompt: A tour guide is introducing a tourist destination. How many people live in the town?
questions.explanation:
As our bus rolls into the valley, let me introduce the little town where we'll spend the afternoon! Now, the numbers — because our brochure is embarrassingly out of date. It still prints eight thousand residents, but that count is from before the riverside district was built. Last year a newspaper claimed nine thousand, also wrong — they missed the two new apartment blocks entirely. The town hall's official register, updated this spring, says ten thousand people live here now. Ten thousand — and one very good chocolate shop, which we will visit!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên dẫn nguồn chính thức "The town hall's official register, updated this spring, says ten thousand people live here now".
• 8,000 sai: là số in trong tờ rơi đã lỗi thời "It still prints eight thousand residents, but that count is from before the riverside district was built".
• 9,000 sai: là số báo đăng năm ngoái và bị bác bỏ "Last year a newspaper claimed nine thousand, also wrong — they missed the two new apartment blocks".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SỐ LIỆU dân số/số lượng luôn cho 3 con số kèm nguồn khác nhau. Chọn con số gắn với nguồn mới nhất và chính thức nhất ("official", "updated this spring"), loại ngay số đi cùng "out of date", "wrong", "claimed".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his routine after work. What is the man going to do after work?
questions.explanation:
People ask how I survive the stress of this job, and the answer happens every day at five thirty sharp. First, what I DON'T do: I don't cycle home anymore — I sold the bike, the traffic ruined the fun. And no more evening clients either; I made that rule in January and my doctor approves. What I do is go running. Straight from the office, along the canal, forty-five minutes, every single workday. Rain, wind, doesn't matter. The run washes the whole day off me before I walk through my front door.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Goes running (đi chạy bộ).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "What I do is go running. Straight from the office, along the canal, forty-five minutes, every single workday" — chạy ngay sau giờ làm, mỗi ngày.
• Cycles home sai: đã bỏ hẳn "I don't cycle home anymore — I sold the bike, the traffic ruined the fun".
• Meets his client sai: cũng đã cấm "no more evening clients either; I made that rule in January".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi AI LÀM GÌ / thói quen, hãy nghe cấu trúc đối lập "what I DON'T do... What I do is...". Đáp án luôn nằm ở vế khẳng định, và thường được xác nhận bằng tần suất ("every single workday").

questions.prompt: A man is calling his friend, Maria. When will he see her?
questions.explanation:
Maria! It's Leo, confirming the weekend plan — grab a pen, because we've changed this three times! Forget Saturday at ten completely, that was the old plan — my cousin's wedding rehearsal swallowed the whole of Saturday, sorry again. And it's NOT eight on Sunday either — the pool doesn't even open until half past, we'd be standing in the car park like fools. Final answer: Sunday at nine am. Nine o'clock, Sunday, at the pool entrance, towels and coffee in hand. Confirm by text or I'll panic!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – at 9 am on Sunday (9 giờ sáng Chủ nhật).
• Vì sao đúng: Leo chốt hạ "Final answer: Sunday at nine am. Nine o'clock, Sunday, at the pool entrance".
• at 10 am on Saturday sai: là lịch cũ đã hủy "Forget Saturday at ten completely, that was the old plan" vì vướng buổi tổng duyệt đám cưới.
• at 8 am on Sunday sai: bị loại vì bể bơi chưa mở "the pool doesn't even open until half past".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ/NGÀY hẹn thường đổi lịch 2-3 lần. Chỉ ghi nhận mốc đứng sau từ chốt "Final answer", "So it's...", và gạch bỏ mốc đi kèm "Forget...", "that was the old plan", "NOT".

questions.prompt: A man is calling his colleague about a meeting with clients. When will the meeting start?
questions.explanation:
Hi Karen, it's Marcus — meeting update, and please pass it to the team! So, this morning's chaos, in order: the clients' flight was delayed, which killed our nine fifteen slot — that's definitely off. Their assistant then suggested eleven fifteen, but our conference room is booked from eleven, so that never made sense. We've landed in the middle: the meeting will start at ten fifteen. Ten fifteen, main room, coffee ready by ten. I need the printed contracts on the table before they arrive. Thanks, Karen!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – at 10.15.
• Vì sao đúng: Marcus nói "We've landed in the middle: the meeting will start at ten fifteen. Ten fifteen, main room, coffee ready by ten".
• at 9.15 sai: đã bị hủy vì máy bay khách trễ "the clients' flight was delayed, which killed our nine fifteen slot — that's definitely off".
• at 11.15 sai: chỉ là đề xuất của trợ lý khách và bất khả thi "our conference room is booked from eleven, so that never made sense".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ HỌP, hãy chờ động từ chốt kèm chủ ngữ "we" ("we've landed in", "the meeting will start at"). Mốc bị "killed", "off", "never made sense" thì loại ngay dù được nhắc nhiều lần.

questions.prompt: A customer is calling the hotline of a department store. Which number to press in order to buy a computer?
questions.explanation:
Thank you for calling Hartman's Department Store! Please listen to all options, as our menu changed this week. For questions about clothing, shoes and accessories, press one. For furniture, kitchens and home delivery, press two. To speak to our electronics team — including televisions, phones, and computer purchases — press three. That's three for buying a computer. For all other enquiries, please hold the line and one of our assistants will be with you shortly. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Three (bấm số 3).
• Vì sao đúng: tổng đài đọc "To speak to our electronics team — including televisions, phones, and computer purchases — press three. That's three for buying a computer" — máy tính thuộc nhóm điện tử.
• One sai: số 1 dành cho "clothing, shoes and accessories".
• Two sai: số 2 dành cho "furniture, kitchens and home delivery".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BẤM SỐ MẤY, đừng nghe số trước — hãy bắt từ khóa của món cần mua (computer) rồi mới lấy số đi kèm. Menu tổng đài đọc rất nhanh nên ghi nhanh cặp "nhóm hàng – số".

questions.prompt: An expert is talking about the lack of satisfaction at work. What should be the solution?
questions.explanation:
A listener wrote in: 'I'm good at my job, but the joy is gone. What now?' A question half the country recognises! Let's clear away the wrong answers first. A pay rise? Money soothes for a month or two, then the emptiness returns with better shoes. Quitting for a new job entirely? Risky — you lose your network, your history, and often land in the same boredom elsewhere. The solution I've seen work again and again: request a transfer. Same company, different department. New faces, new problems, old security. Try that BEFORE anything drastic.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Request a transfer (xin chuyển bộ phận).
• Vì sao đúng: chuyên gia chốt giải pháp "The solution I've seen work again and again: request a transfer. Same company, different department" — giữ được thâm niên mà vẫn có môi trường mới.
• Raise the salary sai: chỉ đỡ tạm thời "Money soothes for a month or two, then the emptiness returns with better shoes".
• Seek a new job sai: bị đánh giá quá rủi ro "Risky — you lose your network, your history, and often land in the same boredom elsewhere".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIẢI PHÁP/LỜI KHUYÊN, người nói thường "dọn sạch" các phương án sai trước ("Let's clear away the wrong answers first"). Đáp án nằm sau cụm "The solution is...", "What works is...", "I'd recommend...".

questions.prompt: Julie is asking her professor about the assignment. When is the work due?
questions.explanation:
W: Professor! Julie, from the Tuesday seminar — quick question about the essay deadline?
M: Ah, Julie. Good that you asked, because the portal is showing nonsense again.
W: Exactly! Half the class swears it's Thursday morning, and I nearly cancelled my weekend.
M: Thursday is when the topic consultations end — nothing is handed in on Thursday.
W: And Friday morning? That's what the portal says.
M: The portal shows last year's setting; the technicians keep promising to fix it. No — the work is due Saturday morning. Ten o'clock, printed AND uploaded.
W: Saturday morning at ten... so we DO have the extra days. The group chat will celebrate.
M: The group chat should spend those days writing. See you Tuesday, Julie!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Saturday morning (sáng thứ Bảy).
• Vì sao đúng: giáo sư khẳng định "the work is due Saturday morning. Ten o'clock, printed AND uploaded" — nộp cả bản in lẫn bản tải lên.
• On Thursday morning sai: thứ Năm chỉ là hạn tư vấn đề tài "Thursday is when the topic consultations end — nothing is handed in on Thursday".
• On Friday morning sai: đó là lỗi hiển thị của hệ thống "The portal shows last year's setting; the technicians keep promising to fix it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẠN NỘP trong hội thoại thầy–trò, luôn tin lời người có thẩm quyền (giáo sư) chứ không tin nguồn mà sinh viên nhắc (portal, group chat, bạn cùng lớp) — nguồn đó thường chính là bẫy.

questions.prompt: Two friends are talking about their favorite activities. What is the woman's favorite form of entertainment?
questions.explanation:
M: Long week done! What's your perfect way to switch off?
W: Guess! You've known me two years now.
M: Books. You always have one in your bag — I'd bet on reading.
W: Good guess, but the book in my bag is mostly for the bus, honestly. It's not the thing I LOVE.
M: Then... chess with that cousin of yours? You mentioned your matches once.
W: Ha! Those ended years ago — she moved to Canada and she cheats online anyway. No — my real love is the theatre. I go almost every week: plays, musicals, even the tiny student productions above the pub.
M: Every week? That's dedication!
W: It's the live-ness of it — anything can happen, and you're breathing the same air as the story. Come with me on Friday, there's a comedy on!
M: You know what? Deal. My first play since school!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Going to the theatre (đi xem kịch).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "my real love is the theatre. I go almost every week: plays, musicals, even the tiny student productions" — và giải thích lý do thích: "It's the live-ness of it".
• Reading books sai: sách chỉ để giết thời gian trên xe buýt "the book in my bag is mostly for the bus, honestly. It's not the thing I LOVE".
• Playing chess with her cousin sai: đã dừng từ lâu "Those ended years ago — she moved to Canada".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SỞ THÍCH, người đàn ông đoán sai 1-2 lần rồi cô gái mới nói thật. Bắt cụm sở hữu mạnh "my real love is...", "the thing I love is..." và loại các hoạt động gắn với quá khứ ("ended years ago") hay lý do phụ ("mostly for the bus").

questions.prompt: Two friends are talking about their school days. What was the woman good at?
questions.explanation:
M: Look at this — my old school sports day photo! Were you sporty back then?
W: Very! Though not at what people guessed.
M: Let me try: swimming? You're always at the pool these days.
W: That's a NOW thing — at school I could barely float, embarrassing but true.
M: Running, then? You've got the build for it.
W: Terrible at it! Last in every race — I once got overtaken by a girl with her shoelaces untied.
M: So what WAS it?
W: Football! I played football, and I was genuinely good — captain of the girls' team two years running, top scorer in the county cup. The boys begged me to join their lunchtime games.
M: Captain AND top scorer? I'm impressed!
W: Ask my dad — he still keeps the little trophy on his shelf!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Plays football (chơi bóng đá).
• Vì sao đúng: cô khẳng định "Football! I played football, and I was genuinely good — captain of the girls' team two years running, top scorer in the county cup".
• Swimming sai: đó là chuyện hiện tại, không phải hồi đi học "That's a NOW thing — at school I could barely float".
• Running sai: cô tự nhận rất tệ "Terrible at it! Last in every race".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HỒI ĐI HỌC giỏi gì, chú ý mốc thời gian: "now" ≠ "at school". Đáp án đi kèm bằng chứng cụ thể (chức đội trưởng, cúp, giải thưởng), còn phương án nhiễu đi kèm lời tự chê ("terrible", "barely").

questions.prompt: Pierre and Emma are talking together about the picnic on the weekend. What will they bring to the picnic?
questions.explanation:
M: Emma, the picnic list went up — did you see what's left for us?
W: Just checked, Pierre. The choices were drinks, salads, or the main food.
M: Please say drinks. Drinks is just carrying bottles!
W: Exactly why they went first — the Novak twins claimed drinks within a minute.
M: The salads, then? Your garden tomatoes are famous.
W: Kind of you, but Mrs. Lee took salads — she's doing three kinds, apparently it's a competition now.
M: So we're left with...
W: The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, the bread, all of it.
M: That's the biggest job on the list!
W: It is — but we have the biggest grill. Saturday morning, you shop, I marinate. We'll be legends by sunset!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Food (đồ ăn chính).
• Vì sao đúng: Emma chốt "The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, the bread, all of it" vì hai mục kia đã có người nhận.
• Drinks sai: bị nhận mất ngay "the Novak twins claimed drinks within a minute".
• Salads sai: đã có người khác lo "Mrs. Lee took salads — she's doing three kinds".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MANG GÌ/PHÂN CÔNG, hãy nghe theo kiểu loại trừ: mỗi món bị "claimed/took/already has someone" là loại một. Món còn lại cuối cùng, thường đi kèm câu than "That's the biggest job", chính là đáp án.

questions.prompt: Listen to an announcement. Which platform to wait for the train?
questions.explanation:
Your attention please, passengers for the fourteen twenty service to the coast. Please note the platform information, as there have been changes this afternoon. This train normally departs from platform five — not today; platform five is closed for urgent repairs. Earlier announcements mentioned platform eight; that arrangement has also been cancelled. The fourteen twenty will now depart from platform two. Platform two, at the far end of the main hall, past the ticket office. Please allow extra time to reach it. Thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Platform 2.
• Vì sao đúng: thông báo chốt "The fourteen twenty will now depart from platform two. Platform two, at the far end of the main hall".
• Platform 5 sai: đó là sân ga thường ngày nhưng hôm nay đóng cửa "platform five is closed for urgent repairs".
• Platform 8 sai: là thông báo cũ đã bị hủy "Earlier announcements mentioned platform eight; that arrangement has also been cancelled".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo nhà ga, chú ý trạng từ thời gian: "normally/earlier" = thông tin cũ, "now" = thông tin đúng. Chỉ khoanh số đi kèm "will now depart from".

questions.prompt: An artist is talking about her job. What is the difference in her job?
questions.explanation:
People imagine being an artist is like any other job, and then they see my calendar and gasp! Here's the honest difference. My office friends work nine to five — I never do; some days I don't touch a brush until midnight, when the idea finally arrives. And weekends off? There's no such thing — if the light is beautiful on a Sunday morning, I'm painting on Sunday morning. That's the real difference: I work completely irregular hours. The painting decides my schedule, not the clock. Chaos — but I chose it, and I love it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She works irregular hours (giờ giấc thất thường).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "That's the real difference: I work completely irregular hours. The painting decides my schedule, not the clock".
• She works from 9 to 5 sai: đó là bạn bè làm văn phòng, không phải cô "My office friends work nine to five — I never do".
• She doesn't work on weekends sai: ngược lại, cô vẫn làm cuối tuần "And weekends off? There's no such thing — if the light is beautiful on a Sunday morning, I'm painting on Sunday morning".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐIỂM KHÁC BIỆT, bám đúng câu có từ "difference"/"the real difference is". Cẩn thận phương án lấy thông tin của NGƯỜI KHÁC (office friends) gán cho người nói.

questions.prompt: Anne is calling her daughter Sally. What does Anne need?
questions.explanation:
Sally, darling, it's Mum — please listen to this before you drive over! You asked what to bring for the baking afternoon. We're actually fine for most things: I bought two loaves of bread this morning, still warm from the bakery, and the milk delivery came yesterday, the fridge is full of it.
