Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In this picture, I can see two young children who are painting together at a table. They look about six or seven years old. One child is holding a small brush and painting a little model very carefully. The other child is resting her chin on her hand and thinking about the next colour. There are paint pots, brushes and some paper spread around them. Both children look quiet and very focused on their work. It looks like an art lesson or a fun afternoon at home.

questions.prompt: Do you think children should learn to draw by themselves or in a class with a teacher? Why?
questions.explanation: I think children should learn to draw in a class with a teacher. A teacher can show them how to hold a brush and mix colours correctly. When children learn alone, they often repeat the same mistakes and give up quickly. For example, my little cousin joined an art class and improved after only two months. Having said that, drawing at home freely is still useful, because children can try their own ideas. So the best way is a class first, then free practice at home.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of learning art for young children?
questions.explanation: I think art brings young children many benefits. First, it trains their hands and eyes, because painting small details needs control. It also teaches patience, since a picture cannot be finished in one minute. Art is also a way for children to show feelings that they cannot say in words. For example, my nephew draws his whole day at school every evening. So I believe every child should have paper and colours at home.

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In this picture, I can see four people who are doing yoga in a gym. They are bending forward on their mats in exactly the same position. All of them are wearing sports clothes, and they look relaxed but focused. Behind them there are shelves with towels and exercise things. The room is bright, with a warm wooden floor. It looks like a morning class with a small friendly group.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of doing exercise regularly?
questions.explanation: I think regular exercise brings both the body and the mind big benefits. It keeps the heart strong and helps people control their weight. Exercise also reduces stress, because the body produces happy chemicals when we move. For example, my mother walks every morning and she has slept much better since she started. Having said that, people should start slowly, because too much exercise at once causes injuries. So a little movement every day is worth more than one hard session a month.

questions.prompt: Why do many people prefer exercising in a gym rather than at home?
questions.explanation: I think many people choose the gym because it keeps them serious. At home there is always a sofa, a fridge and a phone waiting. A gym also has machines and teachers that most houses cannot have. For example, my brother paid for a gym card and now he goes four times a week, just because he paid. Having said that, home exercise is free and saves travelling time. So the gym wins for motivation, but home wins for convenience.

title: Đề 47 - Football for children vs football for adults

questions.prompt: Describe the two pictures.
questions.explanation: Both pictures show people playing football, but at very different ages. In the first picture, a group of young children are chasing the ball on a grass pitch. They are wearing small colourful shirts and running in every direction. The second picture shows adult players who are competing in a real match. They wear proper uniforms and fight for the ball seriously. Around them I can see a big pitch with white lines. So the two pictures show the same game at two stages of life.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of playing football for children and for adults?
questions.explanation: I think football gives each age group a different gift. For children who join a team early, it builds strong bodies and teaches them to share and lose politely. They also make their first real friends in a team. For adults, football keeps the heart healthy and washes away the stress of work. For example, my uncle plays every Sunday and calls it his weekly medicine. So the game trains children and repairs adults.

questions.prompt: Why do you think football is popular with people of all ages?
questions.explanation: I think football is popular with all ages because it is simple. Anyone who has a ball and a small piece of ground can start a game. The rules are easy, so children and grandparents understand the same match. Watching football also brings people together, because everyone can share one team. For example, my whole family watches the national team, from my nephew to my grandfather. So football is cheap, easy and social, and that is hard to beat.

title: Đề 48 - Playing football vs doing the high jump

questions.prompt: Describe the two pictures.
questions.explanation: Both pictures show sport, but of two very different kinds. In the first picture, a young football player in a white shirt is about to kick the ball on a grass pitch. He has swung his leg back, so the shot is coming. Some people are watching the match from behind the fence. The second picture shows an athlete doing the high jump. He is flying over the bar with his back curved. So one picture is a footballer at his big moment, and the other is one person against a bar.

questions.prompt: Which of these two sports would you prefer to try? Why?
questions.explanation: I would prefer to try football, without much thinking. I have played it since I was small, so the ball feels natural to me. Football also comes with friends included, because you cannot play it alone. The high jump looks amazing, but one small mistake means the whole jump fails. Having said that, I respect jumpers a lot, because that kind of courage is rare. So I would keep football for myself and watch the high jump on television.

questions.prompt: What sports are popular in your local area?
questions.explanation: In my area, football is clearly the most popular sport. Every evening the pitches near my house are full of teams of all ages. Badminton comes second, because people who want something lighter can play it in any yard. Older people prefer walking and morning exercise in the park. For example, my father's group has walked around the lake every morning for years. So my neighbourhood moves a lot, each age in its own way.

title: Đề 49 - Relaxing in a park vs relaxing in a cafe

questions.prompt: Describe the two pictures.
questions.explanation: Both pictures show groups of friends who are relaxing together. In the first picture, three young people are sitting on a picnic blanket on the grass in a park. They are talking and laughing, and a basket of fruit stands between them. The second picture shows two young men who are chatting and laughing in a busy cafe. One of them has a laptop on his knees. So the two pictures show the same happiness in two different places.

questions.prompt: Where do you prefer to meet your friends? Why?
questions.explanation: I prefer meeting my friends in a cafe, to be honest. The weather cannot ruin the plan, and the drinks arrive at the table. A cafe also makes long conversations easy, because everyone sits close together. The park is lovely, but someone has to prepare everything and carry it there. Having said that, when the weather is beautiful, the grass beats any chair. So my honest answer is the cafe by habit and the park on perfect days.

questions.prompt: What activities do you usually do with your friends?
questions.explanation: My friends and I mostly eat, talk and play together. We meet for street food at least once a week, because eating keeps the talk going. We also play badminton or football when someone has energy. Once a month we make a small trip to a cafe far from our area, just to explore. For example, last month we found a rooftop cafe that has become our new favourite. So our activities are simple, but they keep us close.

questions.prompt: Women Mathematicians (Version 2).
options: A long career showing exceptional ability
Labels can change perspective on people
Attempting to create a gender balance
Men use different languages than women
questions.explanation:
1. Chọn tiêu đề này vì đoạn văn nói thành tựu của phụ nữ trong toán học bị xóa khỏi sử sách hoặc bị gán cho đồng nghiệp nam — chính là "thành tựu bị làm mờ vì giới tính".
2. Đoạn nói Sophie Germain tự học, đóng góp lớn cho lý thuyết số và là người phụ nữ ĐẦU TIÊN nhận giải của Viện Hàn lâm Paris — đây là sự công nhận thành tựu của một người tiên phong.
3. Đoạn kể công trình của Maria Agnesi bị dịch sai tên và công lao bị gán cho các nhà toán học nam đi sau — đúng ý "người đàn ông được ghi công không công bằng".
4. Đoạn theo suốt cuộc đời Millicent Fawcett: diễn thuyết về Newton năm 19 tuổi rồi dành hàng chục năm vận động cho giáo dục và quyền bầu cử của phụ nữ — một sự nghiệp dài thể hiện năng lực xuất sắc.
5. Đoạn phân tích cách gọi "women geniuses" hay "female prodigies" khiến người ta nghĩ phụ nữ giỏi toán là chuyện hiếm — nhãn mác làm thay đổi cách nhìn về con người.
6. Đoạn liệt kê các chương trình outreach, học bổng riêng cho nữ và mentorship trong STEM — nỗ lực tạo cân bằng giới.
7. Đoạn nói tiêu chí đánh giá đồng nhất bỏ qua hoàn cảnh khác nhau của từng người, "one-size-fits-all" không tạo ra công bằng thật — sự đồng nhất là một bất lợi.

title: Đề 50 - A barbecue outdoors vs baking in the kitchen

questions.prompt: Describe the two pictures.
questions.explanation: Both pictures show families who are cooking together, but in different places. In the first picture, a family of three is having a barbecue outdoors. The father is holding a little girl in his arms while the mother turns the food on the grill. The second picture shows a family of four in a bright kitchen. The parents and their son and daughter are baking cookies together. Everyone has flour on their hands and they are all smiling. So the two pictures show family cooking outside and inside.

questions.prompt: How are these two activities different?
questions.explanation: I think the two activities feel very different, although both are about food. A barbecue is a small outdoor event, with smoke, sunshine and neighbours who might join. The food is simple, and waiting around the grill is half the fun. Baking in the kitchen is slower and more careful, because a cake needs exact amounts. Children who help with baking learn to measure and follow steps. So the barbecue feels like a picnic, while baking feels like a small lesson.

questions.prompt: Should parents teach their children how to cook? Why?
questions.explanation: I think parents should definitely teach their children how to cook. Cooking is a life skill that every adult needs, like swimming or riding a bike. Children who cook also understand food better and waste less of it. Working in the kitchen together also gives families time to talk every day. For example, my mother taught me to cook rice when I was eight, and I still remember that afternoon. So a child who can cook becomes an adult who can take care of others.

title: Đề 58 - Learning to ride a bicycle (Version 2)

questions.prompt: Describe the picture.
questions.explanation: In this picture, I can see a mother and her little son outside their house. The boy is learning to ride a bicycle for the first time. His mother is holding the bicycle carefully so that he does not fall. The boy is wearing a helmet, which keeps him safe. They are on a small street, right in front of a house. Green plants are growing along the wall behind them. The mother is smiling, and both of them look really happy.

questions.prompt: Tell me about some activities you did when you were a child.
questions.explanation: When I was a child, I did many simple activities with my friends. We rode our bicycles around the neighbourhood almost every afternoon. I also loved playing hide and seek in the park, which was near my house. On rainy days, I stayed at home and drew pictures with my sister. My favourite activity was flying kites in the big field behind our school. Those days were very simple, but I still remember them clearly.

questions.prompt: Why do children like riding bicycles with their friends?
questions.explanation: I think children like riding bicycles with their friends for a few simple reasons. The main reason is that cycling together feels like a small adventure. They can race each other and explore new streets around their homes. It is also a chance to talk and laugh, which children always enjoy. For example, the children in my street ride together every evening after school. So for them, a bicycle is not just transport but also a fun game.

questions.prompt: How much does the book cost?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to the bookshop's morning announcements — well, it's just me talking to the shelves, but you're here now! You asked about the gardening book in the window. So: the big hardback edition next to it is seventeen pounds — beautiful, but heavy enough to press flowers with. The little pocket guide is seven, though honestly it's more pictures than advice. The one you want, the proper paperback everyone buys — that book costs eleven pounds. Eleven, and it includes the planting calendar. Shall I wrap it as a gift?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – £11 (mười một bảng).
• Vì sao đúng: người bán nói về đúng cuốn khách hỏi "The one you want, the proper paperback everyone buys — that book costs eleven pounds. Eleven, and it includes the planting calendar".
• £17 sai: là giá bản bìa cứng khổ lớn "the big hardback edition next to it is seventeen pounds".
• £7 sai: là giá bản bỏ túi "The little pocket guide is seven, though honestly it's more pictures than advice".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIÁ SÁCH/MÓN HÀNG, một sản phẩm có nhiều phiên bản. Ghi nhanh cặp "phiên bản – giá" (hardback / pocket / paperback) rồi chọn giá của bản được nhắc bằng "the one you want".

questions.prompt: How much money is left in the kitchen?
questions.explanation:
Kids, it's Dad — listen to this message before you attack the kitchen! About the money by the bread bin. This morning there were thirty pounds there — I know, I counted, don't get excited. Your mother took twenty for the vet, because SOMEONE's hamster needs a check-up again. So do the maths: there are ten pounds left in the kitchen. Ten. That's for milk and eggs when the shop opens — NOT for the ice cream van, I will check the receipts! Back at six. Behave!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 10 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: bố nói "So do the maths: there are ten pounds left in the kitchen. Ten" (30 ban đầu trừ 20 mẹ lấy).
• 30 pounds sai: là số tiền lúc đầu "This morning there were thirty pounds there — I know, I counted".
• 20 pounds sai: là số mẹ đã lấy đi "Your mother took twenty for the vet".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CÒN LẠI BAO NHIÊU, bài bắt bạn làm phép trừ. Nghe đủ ba con số: tổng ban đầu – phần bị lấy – phần còn lại, và bám cụm "left", "remaining" chứ đừng chọn số nghe đầu tiên.

questions.prompt: What day should the listeners submit the report?
questions.explanation:
Team, end-of-week voice memo — the report deadline, because three people have already asked me! I know the quarterly ones are usually due Fridays; not this time, the directors meet mid-week and need everything beforehand. And whoever wrote Thursday on the whiteboard — close, but still wrong, that's the printing day. Your reports must be submitted on Tuesday. Tuesday, by end of day, in the shared folder AND one printed copy on my desk. Tuesday, people! Now enjoy the weekend — after you start the report!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Tuesday (thứ Ba).
• Vì sao đúng: sếp chốt "Your reports must be submitted on Tuesday. Tuesday, by end of day, in the shared folder AND one printed copy on my desk".
• On Thursday sai: đó là ngày in ấn, không phải hạn nộp "whoever wrote Thursday on the whiteboard — close, but still wrong, that's the printing day".
• On Friday sai: là thông lệ mọi quý nhưng lần này khác "I know the quarterly ones are usually due Fridays; not this time".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẠN NỘP, cẩn thận ngày gắn với việc khác trong quy trình (ngày in, ngày họp, ngày tư vấn). Chỉ khoanh ngày đi kèm động từ "must be submitted", "is due".

questions.prompt: What will the student write about?
questions.explanation:
Good evening, Professor, this is Milo from the environmental studies group, leaving the message you asked for — my project topic decision! I went back and forth all weekend. The cycling infrastructure idea — the bikes — felt exciting, but honestly, three classmates already took it. And the water quality study needs lab access I won't get until next term. So my final choice: I will write about the land. Land use around the town — how the farms became car parks in thirty years, with my grandfather's old field maps as sources. Hope that's approved! Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – land (đất đai/quy hoạch sử dụng đất).
• Vì sao đúng: Milo chốt "So my final choice: I will write about the land. Land use around the town — how the farms became car parks in thirty years".
• bikes sai: bị loại vì trùng đề tài "The cycling infrastructure idea — the bikes — felt exciting, but honestly, three classmates already took it".
• water sai: thiếu điều kiện làm "the water quality study needs lab access I won't get until next term".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỌN ĐỀ TÀI, sinh viên luôn kể đủ 3 ý tưởng. Chỉ lấy ý sau "So my final choice is..." và loại ý bị chặn bởi "already taken", "needs... I won't get".

questions.prompt: What bus number should the girl take?
questions.explanation:
Sweetheart, it's Grandma — your first trip to the swimming pool alone, so let's get the bus right! Now pay attention. The number ten stops near our street, yes, but it turns toward the industrial park — you'd end up among the warehouses, like your uncle did. The nine only runs on schooldays, and today's a holiday, so forget the nine completely. You need the number eight! The eight goes straight past the pool — ask the driver for the sports centre stop. Bus eight, sweetheart. Text Grandma when you arrive!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – eight (xe buýt số 8).
• Vì sao đúng: bà nói "You need the number eight! The eight goes straight past the pool — ask the driver for the sports centre stop".
• ten sai: dừng gần nhà nhưng đi sai hướng "it turns toward the industrial park — you'd end up among the warehouses".
• nine sai: hôm nay là ngày lễ nên không chạy "The nine only runs on schooldays, and today's a holiday, so forget the nine completely".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐI XE BUÝT SỐ MẤY, mỗi số sai đều kèm một điều kiện chặn (sai hướng, không chạy hôm nay). Chọn số đi kèm "You need..." và có đích đến khớp với nơi cần tới.

questions.prompt: What time does the store open?
questions.explanation:
Thank you for calling Fashion Corner — this is a recorded message with our opening hours, updated this week! Please note the changes carefully. Our old opening time of nine am ended last month — the staff now do restocking in that first half hour. And no, we do NOT open at half past ten — that rumour comes from the sale day queue confusion, we apologise again. The store opens at nine thirty. Nine thirty, Monday to Saturday, until eight in the evening. Sundays we rest — even mannequins need a day off! See you soon!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At 9:30.
• Vì sao đúng: tin nhắn tự động nói "The store opens at nine thirty. Nine thirty, Monday to Saturday, until eight in the evening".
• At 9:00 sai: là giờ mở cửa cũ đã bỏ "Our old opening time of nine am ended last month — the staff now do restocking in that first half hour".
• At 10:30 sai: chỉ là tin đồn "we do NOT open at half past ten — that rumour comes from the sale day queue confusion".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ MỞ CỬA, bài luôn cảnh báo "please note the changes". Bám cụm hiện tại "The store opens at..." và loại giờ đi kèm "old", "used to", "that rumour".

questions.prompt: Where is Gordon from?
questions.explanation:
Let me introduce our new colleague Gordon properly, because the office rumour machine has him from three different countries already! Yes, he orders croissants every morning — that's just good taste, he is NOT French, stop telling clients that. And the surname sounds German, I agree, but that's his grandfather's side, four generations back. Gordon himself is from England — born in Manchester, raised in York, supports a football team he made us all promise never to mock. So: English, loves rain, hates our coffee. Make him welcome!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – England (nước Anh).
• Vì sao đúng: người nói khẳng định "Gordon himself is from England — born in Manchester, raised in York" và tổng kết "So: English, loves rain, hates our coffee".
• France sai: chỉ vì anh hay ăn bánh sừng bò "he orders croissants every morning — that's just good taste, he is NOT French".
• Germany sai: chỉ là gốc gác họ từ đời cụ "the surname sounds German, I agree, but that's his grandfather's side, four generations back".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐẾN TỪ ĐÂU, hai quốc tịch nhiễu thường dựa vào thói quen ăn uống hoặc họ tên. Chỉ tin câu có "is from" kèm nơi sinh/nơi lớn lên cụ thể.

questions.prompt: What time does the party start?
questions.explanation:
Attention all cousins, aunties and honorary uncles — this is your party information hotline, also known as me! Grandpa's eightieth, this Saturday, final details. The invitation cards printed five o'clock — IGNORE them, that was before the hall double-booking drama. And the family chat voted for four, but the caterers laughed at us — the food simply can't be ready. So, carved in stone now: the party starts at three o'clock. Three pm sharp, surprise moment at quarter past, so do NOT be the person walking in behind Grandpa. Three o'clock! Bring tissues — Mum will cry!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3 o'clock (3 giờ chiều).
• Vì sao đúng: người thông báo nói "carved in stone now: the party starts at three o'clock. Three pm sharp, surprise moment at quarter past".
• 5 o'clock sai: là giờ in trên thiệp mời đã lỗi thời "The invitation cards printed five o'clock — IGNORE them, that was before the hall double-booking drama".
• 4 o'clock sai: là kết quả bình chọn trong nhóm chat nhưng bên phục vụ không kịp "the family chat voted for four, but the caterers laughed at us — the food simply can't be ready".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi TIỆC BẮT ĐẦU MẤY GIỜ, cảnh giác giờ in trên thiệp và giờ do nhóm tự bàn. Đáp án đi kèm cụm chốt "carved in stone", "final", "sharp".

questions.prompt: Where is the entrance to the shopping center?
questions.explanation:
Welcome to the city information line — you asked about the new shopping centre entrance, an excellent question, since the building confuses everyone! The glass doors in front of the pharmacy look like an entrance, but they are actually the fire exit — pushing them triggers a very embarrassing alarm, ask anyone. The doors next to the café are for deliveries only, vans and crates all day. The real entrance is near the station — follow the covered walkway from platform one, and the big revolving doors are the way in. Near the station! Happy shopping!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Near the station (gần nhà ga).
• Vì sao đúng: tổng đài nói "The real entrance is near the station — follow the covered walkway from platform one, and the big revolving doors are the way in".
• In front of the pharmacy sai: cửa kính đó là lối thoát hiểm "they are actually the fire exit — pushing them triggers a very embarrassing alarm".
• Next to the cafe sai: là cửa dành cho giao hàng "The doors next to the café are for deliveries only, vans and crates all day".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LỐI VÀO Ở ĐÂU, bài gán cho mỗi vị trí một chức năng khác (fire exit, delivery). Nghe từ khóa "the real entrance", "the way in" rồi mới lấy vị trí đi kèm.

questions.prompt: What does the woman need?
questions.explanation:
M: Good morning! Library services — you're here for the new membership?
W: Yes, finally! I brought everything your website listed... I hope.
M: Let's check together. Application form?
W: Filled in, printed, both pages — here you go.
M: Perfect. And you're a student, so... your student card?
W: Right here — it even survived the washing machine, as you can see.
M: Ha! Still readable, that's all we need. Now, the last item...
W: Don't say it. The thing I forgot?
M: I'm afraid so — a photo. Passport-sized, for the membership card. That's the one thing you still need.
W: I KNEW something was missing! Is there a photo booth nearby?
M: In the hall by the lifts, four pounds. I'll keep your forms right here — you'll be a member in ten minutes!
W: Running now. Don't give my membership away!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A photo (một tấm ảnh thẻ).
• Vì sao đúng: nhân viên thư viện nói "a photo. Passport-sized, for the membership card. That's the one thing you still need" và chỉ chỗ chụp ngay trong sảnh.
• An application form sai: cô đã nộp rồi "Filled in, printed, both pages — here you go".
• A student card sai: cũng đã có "Right here — it even survived the washing machine".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CÒN THIẾU GÌ, bài điểm danh từng giấy tờ theo checklist. Các món đã có đi kèm "here you go", "right here"; đáp án nằm ở món cuối cùng với cụm "the one thing you still need".

questions.prompt: Why does the man choose the jacket?
questions.explanation:
W: That's the third time you've circled back to that jacket. Verdict?
M: I'm deciding scientifically! Long winter, cold office.
W: The colour is very you — that forest green.
M: The colour's fine, but I already own two green jackets, as you remind me every winter. Colour is not the argument.
W: The price, then? Look at the tag — seventy per cent off.
M: It is a good price, but I'd never buy a coat just because it's cheap. Price isn't it either.
W: So what's left, professor?
M: The lining. Feel that — my old jacket lets the wind straight through, and I cycle to work at six every morning. This one will actually keep me warm all winter. That's the whole point.
W: Warmth wins, then.
M: Warmth wins. To the till!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – It keeps him warm (vì giữ ấm).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chốt "my old jacket lets the wind straight through, and I cycle to work at six every morning. This one will actually keep me warm all winter. That's the whole point" — lý do duy nhất anh giữ lại.
• He likes the colour sai: chính anh loại "The colour's fine, but I already own two green jackets... Colour is not the argument".
• It's cheap sai: giá rẻ được nhắc rõ (giảm 70%) nhưng anh gạt đi "I'd never buy a coat just because it's cheap. Price isn't it either".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi VÌ SAO CHỌN, người nói tự loại từng lý do bằng "X is not the argument", "X isn't it either". Đừng chọn cái được nói TO nhất (giảm 70%) — hãy chọn cái duy nhất KHÔNG bị phủ định.

questions.prompt: What does the man like about his new workplace?
questions.explanation:
W: Two months at the new company! Honest review — was the change worth it?
M: Completely. Though not for the reasons people guess.
W: Everyone says the new office park is so peaceful — all those trees?
M: Quiet, yes, until the construction crew arrived next door in week two. Drills from nine to five — so much for the peace!
W: Oh no! The stress levels, then? You always said the old place was a pressure cooker.
M: Truthfully, the deadlines here are just as brutal — same industry, same madness. That's not it either.
W: So what's the win?
M: The distance! I travel fifteen minutes now instead of an hour and a quarter. I get two extra hours of LIFE every single day — breakfast with the kids, the gym, actual dinners.
W: Two hours a day... that's a part-time life you got back!
M: Exactly. Shortest commute wins, every time. Best decision I've made in years.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – He travels a shorter distance (quãng đường đi làm ngắn hơn).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "The distance! I travel fifteen minutes now instead of an hour and a quarter. I get two extra hours of LIFE every single day" và kết luận "Shortest commute wins, every time".
• It's a quiet place sai: sự yên tĩnh đã bị phá "Quiet, yes, until the construction crew arrived next door in week two. Drills from nine to five".
• It's less stressful sai: áp lực y hệt chỗ cũ "the deadlines here are just as brutal — same industry, same madness. That's not it either".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi THÍCH ĐIỀU GÌ Ở CHỖ LÀM MỚI, người hỏi nêu hai điều "ai cũng nghĩ" và đều bị bác. Đáp án đi kèm con số so sánh cụ thể (15 phút so với 1 tiếng 15).

questions.prompt: Where are they going to meet?
questions.explanation:
M: Right, tomorrow's picnic with the study group — where do we all gather first?
W: Someone suggested the station, since half the group comes by train.
M: They did, but the station square is dug up this month — fences, mud, machines everywhere. Terrible meeting point.
W: True. The university steps then? Central, everyone knows them.
M: Locked on Sundays, remember? Whole campus is closed — we'd be sitting on the fence like pigeons.
W: Ha! So that leaves the obvious one...
M: The park! The main gate by the flower clock — five minutes from the station AND from the bus stops.
W: The park it is. Eleven o'clock, flower clock, blankets and snacks.
M: I'll message the group. Last one there carries the water bottles!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – at the park (ở công viên).
• Vì sao đúng: hai người chốt "The park! The main gate by the flower clock — five minutes from the station AND from the bus stops" và "Eleven o'clock, flower clock, blankets and snacks".
• at the station sai: quảng trường nhà ga đang thi công "the station square is dug up this month — fences, mud, machines everywhere".
• at the university sai: khuôn viên đóng cửa Chủ nhật "Locked on Sundays, remember? Whole campus is closed".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẸN GẶP Ở ĐÂU, hai địa điểm đầu bị loại vì lý do thực tế (thi công, đóng cửa). Đáp án luôn kèm mốc nhận diện nhỏ (cổng chính, đồng hồ hoa) và giờ hẹn.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about using the Internet. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: I'm not really a fan of talking to people online, so I usually prefer to communicate with my friends face to face, especially when we study together. However, most of my friends live quite far away from me, so I normally travel by bus when I want to meet them. When I'm on the bus, I often use the Internet to check transportation information, especially bus routes and directions. It's really useful because I can find the best route and make sure I don't get lost. I also check the estimated travel time before I leave home, so I know when I'm likely to arrive.
Speaker B: I have quite a lot of friends, and one of the most convenient ways for me to keep in touch with them is through the Internet. Some of my friends live in different countries, so meeting them in person isn't always possible. For example, one of my close friends lives in Sydney. She takes cookery classes there, and we often have online calls to talk about what she has learned. Sometimes, we exchange recipes and discuss different ways of preparing food. I really enjoy these conversations because social media and other online platforms make it easy for us to stay connected, even though we live far apart.
Speaker C: I use the Internet a lot for my schoolwork. At the moment, I'm working on a big assignment about different airlines. I have to collect information about several companies, including their services, prices and destinations. Without the Internet, I would have to ask lots of different people or visit different places to find all this information. Fortunately, I can search for most of what I need online. I can also compare information from different websites and find useful pictures and statistics for my assignment. It saves me a lot of time and makes doing a big project much easier.
Speaker D: I used to spend a lot of time playing computer games, but I think I've grown out of it now. These days, I mainly use the Internet for entertainment, especially for watching films. I don't really need a television because I can watch films on my computer whenever I want. If there's a film I really like, I can download it and watch it later when I have some free time. I usually watch films in the evening, especially at weekends. It's much more convenient for me because I can choose what I want to watch instead of waiting for something interesting to be shown on TV.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
LƯU Ý: Đây là bản ĐẢO SPEAKER của Đề 25 - The Internet (cùng 4 mục thông tin nhưng người nói khác nhau). Đề thi thật 25/8 ra bản này.
A = check transportation information (tra routes trên xe buýt). Bẫy: A nhắc "communication" nhưng là nói chuyện TRỰC TIẾP khi học nhóm, không phải qua mạng.
B = communicate with friends (gọi điện trao đổi công thức với bạn ở Sydney).
C = complete school assignments (bài tập lớn về airlines).
D = watch films (tải phim về máy tính). Bẫy: D nhắc games nhưng đã BỎ ("grown out of it").
"play online games" và "shop online" là 2 mục nhiễu — không ai dùng.

questions.prompt: Listen to the announcement. What time will the train leave?
questions.explanation:
Attention, passengers. The 8.45 train from King's Cross to Luton has been delayed. This means it will now depart at 9.30 instead, and we will reach Luton at 10.30. We apologize for the inconvenience.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 9.30.
• Vì sao đúng: thông báo nói "it will now depart at 9.30 instead" — tàu bị hoãn nên giờ khởi hành MỚI là 9.30.
• 8.45 sai: là giờ khởi hành theo lịch cũ, đã bị hoãn "The 8.45 train from King's Cross to Luton has been delayed".
• 10.45 sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; con số gần giống là 10.30 nhưng đó là giờ ĐẾN Luton "we will reach Luton at 10.30".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ TÀU CHẠY, bài luôn có ba mốc: giờ cũ (tên chuyến), giờ mới (depart), giờ đến (reach/arrive). Chỉ lấy số đi sau động từ "depart/leave", đừng lấy số đi sau "reach/arrive".

questions.prompt: Rob is calling his colleague about a meeting. What did he suggest?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Rob. I'm really sorry, but a client has turned up unexpectedly, so I won't be able to make it to the meeting. Moving it to tomorrow won't work either, because the factory inspection is scheduled for then. The best thing is to just go ahead and have the meeting without me, and update me afterwards. Please apologize to everyone for me.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Having the meeting without him (cứ họp mà không có anh ấy).
• Vì sao đúng: Rob đề nghị "The best thing is to just go ahead and have the meeting without me, and update me afterwards".
• Delaying the meeting sai: chính Rob loại phương án này "Moving it to tomorrow won't work either, because the factory inspection is scheduled for then".
• Canceling the meeting sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu — Rob chỉ vắng mặt chứ không đề nghị hủy.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐỀ NGHỊ ĐIỀU GÌ, nghe cụm "The best thing is to...", "Why don't we...". Phân biệt việc người nói KHÔNG làm được (vắng mặt) với việc họ ĐỀ NGHỊ nhóm làm.

questions.prompt: A tour guide is talking about the schedule. The group will wait for the bus at...
questions.explanation:
Good morning, everyone. For today's trip we won't need to wait for the bus. Instead, we'll walk over to the side entrance of the hotel for lunch. Then this afternoon we'll go on the city tour. Early tomorrow will be the last day of our tour, and our group will wait for the bus at the hotel's front entrance.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – the hotel's front entrance (cổng chính khách sạn).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên nói "our group will wait for the bus at the hotel's front entrance".
• the hotel's side entrance sai: cửa hông chỉ là nơi đi bộ tới ăn trưa hôm nay "we'll walk over to the side entrance of the hotel for lunch".
• the hotel lobby sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỜ XE Ở ĐÂU, bài trộn nhiều địa điểm gắn với nhiều hoạt động khác nhau (ăn trưa, tham quan, chờ xe). Ghi nhanh cặp "hoạt động – địa điểm" và chỉ lấy địa điểm đi kèm đúng động từ "wait for the bus".

questions.prompt: Listen to a tour guide talking about a writer. What was the writer's first job?
questions.explanation:
If you look behind me, you'll see the house of William Roberts. He gave up his job as a news reporter for a local newspaper to start his writing career. At first, his work didn't attract much attention, and he even thought about going back to his earlier teaching job. But then his book about a politician became a best-seller, and he became famous around the world.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – News reporter (phóng viên báo).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên nói "He gave up his job as a news reporter for a local newspaper to start his writing career" — đây là công việc bài nêu ra làm điểm xuất phát trước khi ông theo nghiệp viết văn.
• Teacher sai: nghề dạy học chỉ được nhắc thoáng qua như một lối lui khi sự nghiệp viết chưa khởi sắc "he even thought about going back to his earlier teaching job", không phải nghề bài giới thiệu là khởi đầu.
• Politician sai: chính trị gia chỉ là NHÂN VẬT trong cuốn sách của ông "his book about a politician became a best-seller", không phải nghề của ông.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi NGHỀ ĐẦU TIÊN, đừng chọn danh từ chỉ nghề nghe được cuối cùng — nhiều danh từ trong bài chỉ là chủ đề tác phẩm. Bám cấu trúc "He gave up his job as + nghề + to start...".

questions.prompt: A student is calling his parents. How is he feeling?
questions.explanation:
Hi Mum and Dad, I left the university half an hour ago. My friend is driving me to the bus stop, but I'm afraid we won't make it, because the bus is moving faster than we are. And the next one isn't until 6.45. Could you come and pick me up? I hear it's really cold outside, and I'm not feeling very well.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick (không khỏe).
• Vì sao đúng: cậu sinh viên nói cuối lời nhắn "I'm not feeling very well" — tức là đang mệt/ốm, nên mới nhờ bố mẹ ra đón.
• Well sai: từ "well" CÓ xuất hiện nhưng nằm trong câu phủ định "I'm NOT feeling very well".
• Warm sai: bài chỉ nói thời tiết bên ngoài lạnh "I hear it's really cold outside" — đó là nhiệt độ ngoài trời, không phải cảm giác của cậu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CẢM THẤY THẾ NÀO, bẫy kinh điển là đặt đúng từ trong phương án vào một câu phủ định. Nghe trọn cụm "not feeling well" thay vì bắt mỗi chữ "well".

questions.prompt: A mother is talking to her son. What subject does her son like studying?
questions.explanation:
You really have to study harder, young man. Your teacher just called to tell me about your grades. Your marks in science and maths are very low. Anyway, he said you have a real talent for painting. I know you love drawing, but you still have to do well in all your subjects.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art (môn Mỹ thuật).
• Vì sao đúng: người mẹ nói "he said you have a real talent for painting. I know you love drawing" — vẽ chính là môn Art.
• Science sai: đó là môn cậu bị điểm kém "Your marks in science and maths are very low".
• Maths sai: cũng nằm trong nhóm điểm thấp cùng câu trên.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi THÍCH MÔN NÀO, phương án đúng có thể không được gọi đúng tên môn mà mô tả bằng hoạt động (painting, drawing = Art). Đừng chỉ săn tên môn — nghe cả động từ chỉ sở thích "love", "talent for".

questions.prompt: Listen to a man calling his friend. Why is he calling?
options: To suggest meeting for a drink
To say hello after a trip
questions.explanation:
Hey, I just heard you were in town last week. I had no idea, so I couldn't arrange to see you. Listen, I've heard there's a fantastic tea house here and the tea is really good. Next time you come, give me a call and we can meet up for some drinks.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To suggest meeting for a drink (để rủ đi uống nước lần tới).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chốt lời nhắn bằng đúng đề nghị "Next time you come, give me a call and we can meet up for some drinks", kèm gợi ý địa điểm "there's a fantastic tea house here and the tea is really good".
• To say hello after a trip sai: anh có nhắc chuyện bạn ghé thành phố tuần trước nhưng chỉ để tiếc nuối "I had no idea, so I couldn't arrange to see you" — đó là phần dẫn, không phải mục đích.
• To ask for directions sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GỌI ĐỂ LÀM GÌ, mục đích thật thường nằm ở CÂU CUỐI của lời nhắn, sau từ dẫn "Listen,...". Phần đầu chỉ là lời chào/bối cảnh.

questions.prompt: A girl is calling her friend Emma. What did the girl lose?
questions.explanation:
Thanks, Emma. I'm almost ready for the presentation this afternoon. But there's one thing I need to ask you. I think I left my phone at your house. Could you check for me? I really hope I didn't drop it while I was walking to the car. Thank you so much.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A phone (điện thoại).
• Vì sao đúng: cô gái nói "I think I left my phone at your house. Could you check for me?" và lo thêm "I really hope I didn't drop it while I was walking to the car".
• A book sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Paper sai: cũng không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐỂ QUÊN ĐỒ GÌ, bài rất ngắn nên đồ vật chỉ xuất hiện đúng một lần sau "I left my...". Nghe tập trung ngay khi có cụm "there's one thing I need to ask you" — thông tin quan trọng đến ngay sau đó.

questions.prompt: Stephanie is calling about a childcare job. How old is Stephanie?
questions.explanation:
Hello, I saw the advertisement you posted online looking for someone to look after your children at weekends. I'm an English student, I'm 21 years old, and I speak good English. What's more, I really love children.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 21 tuổi.
• Vì sao đúng: Stephanie tự giới thiệu "I'm an English student, I'm 21 years old, and I speak good English".
• 23 sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• 19 sai: cũng không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BAO NHIÊU TUỔI trong bài giới thiệu bản thân, tuổi luôn nằm trong chuỗi thông tin cá nhân đọc liền mạch (nghề/ngành – tuổi – kỹ năng). Chuẩn bị sẵn bút, con số chỉ đọc một lần và không lặp lại.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking to her husband about a family trip. The woman's family decided to...
questions.explanation:
Honey, the kids are getting older now. We should go somewhere different this year. They want to spend time with their friends too. We go camping every single year. What do you think about going cycling this year instead? I think that's what we should do.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – go cycling (đi đạp xe).
• Vì sao đúng: người vợ đề xuất "What do you think about going cycling this year instead? I think that's what we should do".
• go camping sai: đó là hoạt động lặp lại mọi năm mà cô muốn đổi "We go camping every single year".
• see friends sai: chỉ là mong muốn của bọn trẻ, không phải kế hoạch chuyến đi "They want to spend time with their friends too".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi NĂM NAY QUYẾT ĐỊNH LÀM GÌ, chú ý từ "instead" và "this year" — chúng đánh dấu lựa chọn mới. Hoạt động đi kèm "every year", "as usual" luôn là cái bị thay thế.

questions.prompt: A woman is doing a survey with a man. The man thinks that train travel is...
questions.explanation:
Woman: Hello, could I take a few minutes of your time for a short survey?
Man: Sure, go ahead.
Woman: How frequently do you travel by train?
Man: Every day, to work and back.
Woman: And how do you feel about travelling by train?
Man: Well, first there's the convenience. There are train stations almost everywhere in the city now, so you can catch a train from anywhere. And more importantly, taking the train saves a lot of money compared to flying.
Woman: And how do you avoid boredom on the train?
Man: I usually bring a book to read, but if there's someone to chat with on the train, that's even better.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – economical (tiết kiệm tiền).
• Vì sao đúng: người đàn ông nhấn mạnh ý quan trọng nhất "and more importantly, taking the train saves a lot of money compared to flying" — tức là đi tàu rẻ, kinh tế.
• practical sai: sự tiện lợi có được nhắc nhưng chỉ là ý phụ đứng trước "first there's the convenience. There are train stations almost everywhere" — và người nói tự xếp nó dưới ý về tiền.
• boring sai: ngược lại, anh còn kể cách để không chán "I usually bring a book to read, but if there's someone to chat with on the train, that's even better".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi Ý KIẾN/ĐÁNH GIÁ trong khảo sát, khi bài nêu nhiều ưu điểm hãy bám từ so sánh mức độ "more importantly", "above all", "the main thing" để chọn ý được nhấn mạnh nhất.

questions.prompt: Jorge is calling his friend about the weekend. What time does the game start?
questions.explanation:
Hi Jane, it's Jorge here. I'm so busy this week. On Sunday I'm going to watch a football game, which starts at 1 p.m. I think we can meet at 6 p.m. Would you like to see a film? There's a new one that's just come out at the cinema. Call me back.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1 p.m.
• Vì sao đúng: Jorge nói "a football game, which starts at 1 p.m.". 6 p.m. là giờ hẹn gặp bạn sau trận, không phải giờ trận đấu.

questions.prompt: Anna is calling her brother. What is Anna going to do?
questions.explanation:
Woman: Hello? I need your help with something.
Man: What is it?
Woman: I've got so much work at the office today that I'll probably have to stay late. Could you pick up my daughter from school for me?
Man: Sure, I'm free anyway, so I'll play with her too. Do you want me to cook dinner as well?
Woman: That would be perfect. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Stay late at work (ở lại làm muộn).
• Vì sao đúng: Anna nói "I've got so much work at the office today that I'll probably have to stay late" — đó chính là việc CÔ sẽ làm.
• Pick up her kid sai: đó là việc cô NHỜ em trai làm hộ "Could you pick up my daughter from school for me?".
• Fix the computer sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi NGƯỜI X SẼ LÀM GÌ trong hội thoại nhờ vả, phải tách rõ việc của người nhờ và việc của người được nhờ. Câu "Could you..." luôn là việc của NGƯỜI KIA, không phải đáp án.

questions.prompt: The Early Australians
options: Technology helps uncover the ocean's secret
Determination of the explorers through the ages
questions.explanation:
1. Chọn "An alternative history of settlement" vì câu chủ đề nói lịch sử người Úc cổ xa hơn nhiều so với trước đây (65,000 năm), thách thức quan điểm truyền thống về những người định cư đầu tiên — tức bức tranh lịch sử định cư đang được viết lại. Bẫy "New evidence to speculation" chỉ khớp 1 câu giữa đoạn, không bao được ý chính.
2. Chọn "Natural barrier to resettlement" vì đoạn nhấn mạnh việc vượt biển rộng tới lục địa cô lập là "seemingly impossible" với công nghệ thời đó — biển là rào cản tự nhiên.
3. Chọn "Technology helps uncover the ocean's secret" vì đoạn nói remote sensing và GIS giúp phát hiện chuỗi đảo nối liền thành con đường di cư dưới biển.
4. Chọn "A Journey made by stages" vì đoạn mô tả hành trình island-hopping từng chặng, mỗi đảo là điểm nghỉ và nguồn thức ăn.
5. Chọn "No precise figures available" vì đoạn nói giới khoa học chỉ có thể phỏng đoán số người di cư, "the lack of exact statistics" — không có con số chính xác. Chữ "speculate" trong đoạn là bẫy kéo sang heading "New evidence to speculation".
6. Chọn "Lack of knowledge and skills" vì đoạn nêu ý kiến hoài nghi rằng người cổ không đủ năng lực trí tuệ, kiến thức và kỹ năng hàng hải để vượt đại dương.
7. Chọn "Determination of the explorers through the ages" vì đoạn nói về ý chí khám phá bền bỉ của con người xuyên suốt lịch sử, từ thám hiểm biển sâu tới du hành vũ trụ.
Heading thừa: "New evidence to speculation".

title: Đề 52 - A musician's career + A research into happiness

questions.prompt: What will this musician do in the near future?
options: He will probably retire from singing professionally
He plans to record another album with the Bats
He wants to go on another world tour
questions.explanation:
At a press conference earlier this week, the musician launched his new album — and then surprised everyone in the room. He announced that this will be the last album of his career with the Bats, because he is leaving the band, and he added that he has no plans to sing professionally again. Now, his fans are hoping that this is just like last time. You may remember that a few years ago he walked out in the middle of a world tour, only to return to the stage a few months later. This time, however, he sounded very sure. There will be no new record with the band, and no more touring: he will probably retire from singing altogether.
Looking back, his story is remarkable. He recruited three amateur musicians to form the Bats, and the group was hitting the charts within a year of their first show. Fame came quickly after that. So what stopped him from becoming one of the greatest artists of all time? It wasn't the tour he abandoned, and it wasn't his songs, which fans always loved. The real reason is that he got married and had children, and he chose to spend most of his time with his family rather than in the studio. When he did return to the stage, the fans were excited, but he never made the same impact as before. Even so, we all hope that one day he will surprise us again and come back.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: He will probably retire from singing professionally — "he has no plans to sing professionally again... he will probably retire from singing altogether". Bẫy: "another album" bị phủ định ("There will be no new record with the band"); "world tour" là chuyện QUÁ KHỨ và "no more touring".
2. Đáp án: He spent a lot of time with his family — câu hỏi "what does the speaker suggest" = người nói ngụ ý lý do gì; MC nói "he got married and had children, and he chose to spend most of his time with his family rather than in the studio". Bẫy: bỏ tour và bài hát đều bị loại trực tiếp — "It wasn't the tour he abandoned, and it wasn't his songs, which fans always loved".
👉 Mẹo: Part 4 hay dùng cấu trúc "It wasn't X, and it wasn't Y. The real reason is Z" — đáp án là Z.

questions.prompt: What does the radio presenter say about how the research on happiness has been covered by the media?
options: It has been accurately reported by the media
It has not been accurately reported by the media
It has been ignored completely by the media
questions.explanation:
Today we're going to discuss a recent piece of research on happiness. A great many researchers took part in this project, and it has become a very popular topic of conversation — everybody seems to be talking about it. Now, some newspapers always prefer a shocking headline to a careful story, and that is exactly what happened here. The information given in the newspaper article was very limited, and it did not reflect the research fully or accurately. The researchers spent years collecting data and checking their results with great care, but none of that effort appears in the article. Readers were given a dramatic headline and very little else. So the research has certainly not been ignored — but it has not been reported accurately either.
So what does the research actually tell us? It can certainly help people to think about their own happiness, and it clearly gives the media plenty to discuss. But if you are hoping for a final answer to the question of what makes people happy, you will be disappointed. What determines happiness is, in the end, very difficult to define. Money, health, friendships, family — each of them matters to some people and much less to others, and the balance changes throughout our lives. A conclusive answer, a single formula that works for everyone, is the one thing this research is unlikely ever to give us.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It has not been accurately reported by the media — "The information given in the newspaper article was very limited, and it did not reflect the research fully or accurately". Bẫy: "ignored" bị phủ định ("the research has certainly not been ignored").
2. Đáp án: To find a conclusive answer — "A conclusive answer, a single formula that works for everyone, is the one thing this research is unlikely ever to give us". Bẫy: "personal happiness" và "discuss in the media" đều là điều nghiên cứu LÀM ĐƯỢC ("help people to think about their own happiness", "gives the media plenty to discuss").
👉 Mẹo: bài nói liệt kê những gì nghiên cứu làm được rồi mới tới "the one thing... unlikely" — đáp án nằm ở phần đảo hướng cuối.

questions.prompt: According to the presenter, what is unlikely regarding the research on happiness?
