Describe the picture.
Do you love spending time outside?
Why should people spend time outside?
Singers can be good role models for young people.
questions.explanation:
M: Did you watch that awards show for singers last night?
W: I did. My kids talk about it constantly. And honestly, a lot of those famous singers have become real role models for young people — they talk about staying in school, they give to charity, they seem to care.
M: I don't see it that way at all. Those people spend their time doing charity events and appearing on game shows instead of concentrating on their actual work. And can anyone today sing better than the singers of our generation? I doubt it.
W: You mean it's a question of taste, don't you? I know everyone's taste is different. Kids nowadays like modern music, and our generation liked something else. You, for example, only listen to classical music, so nothing else sounds good to you.
M: That's true, I suppose — taste is personal. But I still think music is a universal language. Whether a song has words or not makes no difference to how we experience it. Even music written in a language we don't understand can move us.
W: Hmm, I'm not sure I'd go that far. But then, I can't claim to know as much as you about this. You have a degree in music, don't you?
M: I do. But here's something I think you'll agree with: music can completely control people's emotions. Film directors and advertisers know exactly which chord to play to make you feel a certain way.
W: Oh, that I do agree with. I never know when I'm going to cry in a film, but the moment the music swells at the dramatic part, the tears just come — whether I want them to or not.
M: Exactly. That's a lot of power in a few notes.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Singers can be good role models for young people → The woman: "a lot of those famous singers have become real role models for young people". Người đàn ông phản đối: "I don't see it that way at all".
2. Taste in music is a highly personal thing → Both: cô nói "I know everyone's taste is different"; anh đồng ý "That's true, I suppose — taste is personal".
3. Music is a universal language → The man: "I still think music is a universal language". Cô không đồng ý hẳn: "I'm not sure I'd go that far".
4. Music can be used to manipulate people's feelings → Both: anh nói "music can completely control people's emotions"; cô đồng ý "that I do agree with... the tears just come".
👉 Mẹo: Part 3 chọn Both khi có câu đồng thuận rõ ("That's true", "I do agree"). Chọn một người khi người kia phản đối hoặc lưỡng lự ("I'm not sure I'd go that far").

questions.prompt: Taste in music is a highly personal thing.
Music is a universal language.
Music can be used to manipulate people's feelings.
Four people are talking about outdoor activities. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: I like sport because it keeps me active, but I've had to be careful about which one. Years ago I fell off a horse and broke my arm, so I gave up riding for good. And climbing is out of the question — I'm terrified of heights. Luckily, there's a forest just behind my house with wide, flat paths, and lots of people jog there. So every morning before work I put on my trainers and run for about forty minutes. It's simple, it's free, and it clears my head.
Speaker B: I've loved horses since I was a little girl. Owning one is far too expensive, of course — the food and the vet bills would eat my whole salary. Many of my friends go skiing in winter, but I've never found snow sports very interesting; I hate the cold. What I'm lucky about is that there are several riding stables near my home, so I don't need a horse of my own. I still spend most weekends there, brushing the horses and riding out through the fields.
Speaker C: Where I live there's a very long beach, and hundreds of people jog along it every morning. I go in the opposite direction. There's a mountain behind the town with steep, rocky trails, and I love riding my bike up there. Pushing up to the top is hard work, but then you get the view — and the ride down is fast and exciting. It's a real challenge every time, and my legs certainly know about it the next day.
Speaker D: I'm getting on a bit now, so I can't do the things I used to. Climbing and cycling are far too much for my knees these days. Jogging isn't a bad idea, I suppose, but I need something slower. So what I do is go for a walk every day in the late afternoon. I follow the path by the river, enjoy the scenery, and by that time of day it's not too hot. It's gentle, but it keeps me fit and happy.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A – going for a run: "every morning before work I put on my trainers and run for about forty minutes". Bẫy: ngựa (đã bỏ vì ngã), climbing (sợ độ cao).
B – horse riding: "there are several riding stables near my home... riding out through the fields". Bẫy: skiing/snow sports là sở thích của BẠN cô ấy.
C – mountain biking: "I love riding my bike up there... the ride down is fast and exciting". Bẫy: jogging là việc người khác làm trên bãi biển.
D – walking: "I go for a walk every day in the late afternoon". Bẫy: climbing, cycling (quá sức), jogging (cần chậm hơn).
Không ai chọn: snow sports, climbing — đều được nhắc như thứ KHÔNG làm.
👉 Mẹo: mỗi người nhắc 2–3 môn nhưng chỉ 1 môn đi với "I do / I go / I love"; các môn khác đi với "gave up", "out of the question", "my friends".

questions.prompt: Tell me about a time when you helped someone.
How did you feel about helping them?
Why should we help other people?
A man is listening to a recorded message. What is the free number of Teleshop? 088 ...
questions.explanation:
Hello, and thank you for calling Teleshop. We offer a wide variety of the newest telephones, and we have the best prices you will find anywhere. You can call at any time to choose the phone you want to buy. Please note that our old number, zero eight eight, thirty twenty ten, is no longer in service. To place an order, call Teleshop free on zero eight eight, twenty, ten, thirty. Again, that's zero eight eight, twenty, ten, thirty. Our lines are open twenty-four hours a day.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 20 10 30.
• Vì sao đúng: "call Teleshop free on zero eight eight, twenty, ten, thirty" và được nhắc lại "Again, that's zero eight eight, twenty, ten, thirty".
• 30 20 10 sai: là số CŨ, đã ngừng dùng — "our old number... thirty twenty ten, is no longer in service".
• 10 20 30 sai: không xuất hiện trong bài, chỉ là đảo thứ tự các cặp số.
👉 Mẹo: số điện thoại trong Aptis đọc theo cặp (twenty – ten – thirty). Ghi nháp lần một, đối chiếu ở lần "Again" rồi mới chốt.

questions.prompt: A girl is calling her friend Emma. What did the girl lose?
questions.explanation:
Thanks, Emma. I'm almost ready for the presentation this afternoon. But there's one thing I need to ask you. I think I left my phone at your house. Could you check for me? I really hope I didn't drop it while I was walking to the car. Thank you so much.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A phone (điện thoại).
• Vì sao đúng: cô gái nói "I think I left my phone at your house. Could you check for me?" và lo thêm "I really hope I didn't drop it while I was walking to the car".
• A book sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Paper sai: cũng không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐỂ QUÊN ĐỒ GÌ, bài rất ngắn nên đồ vật chỉ xuất hiện đúng một lần sau "I left my...". Nghe tập trung ngay khi có cụm "there's one thing I need to ask you" — thông tin quan trọng đến ngay sau đó.

questions.prompt: A guide is showing visitors around an old house. What is not original in the room?
questions.explanation:
Please come in — this is the oldest room in the house, and I always ask visitors to look down first. The floor is original: these oak boards were laid in eighteen seventy and have never been replaced, only polished. The furniture is original too, every piece, from the writing desk to the chairs by the fire — the same family kept it all together for four generations. The one thing that isn't original is the door. So many thousands of visitors have pushed it open that the old one simply wore out, and it was replaced about ten years ago. Everything else you see belongs to the house's first era.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The door.
• Vì sao đúng: "The one thing that isn't original is the door... it was replaced about ten years ago".
• The floor sai: "The floor is original... never been replaced, only polished".
• The furniture sai: "The furniture is original too, every piece".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "not original" — nghe cụm phủ định "the one thing that isn't" hoặc "was replaced". Đừng chọn thứ được KHEN là nguyên bản.

questions.prompt: Listen to an announcement at a railway station. Which platform does the train to Edinburgh leave from?
questions.explanation:
Attention, please. This is a platform announcement. The train from King's Cross is now arriving at platform five. Please stand well back from the edge of platform five. The train to Edinburgh, which was due to leave from platform three, will now depart from platform two. That's platform two for the Edinburgh service, not platform three. Passengers travelling to Edinburgh, please make your way to platform two now, as the train will leave in five minutes. We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Platform 2.
• Vì sao đúng: "The train to Edinburgh... will now depart from platform two. That's platform two for the Edinburgh service".
• Platform 3 sai: là sân ga BAN ĐẦU, đã đổi — "which was due to leave from platform three", "not platform three".
• Platform 5 sai: là nơi tàu TỪ King's Cross đang đến, không phải tàu đi Edinburgh.
👉 Mẹo: thông báo ga tàu luôn có một số bị đổi. Bám cụm "will now depart from" và tên điểm đến trong câu hỏi (Edinburgh).

questions.prompt: A man is calling his friend. Where will they meet?
questions.explanation:
Hi Mark, it's Daniel. About Saturday — I've been thinking about where to meet. I first said the café on the corner, but it's closed for repairs this month, so that's no good. And meeting outside the cinema doesn't work either, because the film starts at six and we won't have time to eat first. So let's meet at the station instead. I'll be by the main entrance, next to the ticket office, at four o'clock. From there we can walk to a restaurant and then go on to the film. See you at the station!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At the station.
• Vì sao đúng: "So let's meet at the station instead. I'll be by the main entrance, next to the ticket office" và chốt lại "See you at the station!".
• At the café sai: quán đóng cửa sửa chữa — "it's closed for repairs this month, so that's no good".
• At the cinema sai: bị loại vì không kịp ăn trước giờ phim — "doesn't work either, because the film starts at six".
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn hẹn gặp thường nêu 2 chỗ bị loại trước, chỗ đúng đứng sau "instead" và được nhắc lại ở câu cuối.

questions.prompt: A woman is leaving a message for her friend. What time does she want to meet?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Laura. I'm calling to tell you that I won't be able to make it at seven, because I have a meeting this afternoon. It's a very long meeting, and it won't end until half past seven, so seven is impossible for me. Let's meet up at a quarter to eight instead. That way we'll still have about fifteen minutes to have some coffee before the show starts. So that's a quarter to eight, at the usual place. Sorry about the change — see you later!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At a quarter to eight (7 giờ 45).
• Vì sao đúng: "Let's meet up at a quarter to eight instead" và nhắc lại "So that's a quarter to eight, at the usual place".
• At seven o'clock sai: giờ hẹn cũ, cô không tới được — "I won't be able to make it at seven".
• At half past seven sai: là giờ cuộc họp KẾT THÚC — "it won't end until half past seven".
👉 Mẹo: học chắc cách nói giờ kiểu Anh: "quarter to eight" = 7:45, "half past seven" = 7:30. Giờ đúng đứng sau "instead".

questions.prompt: Jose is calling his friend about tomorrow. What will Luis and Emma bring?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Jose here. Tomorrow I'm meeting Luis and Emma at the bus stop at five o'clock in the afternoon. They're going to bring the food, so we don't need to worry about lunch or dinner. Do you want to meet us there? If you can, come at about a quarter past five. After that, we can go and buy a few things we still need — some fruit for the journey, and maybe some water. And don't forget to bring your own sleeping bag, because it gets really cold at night. See you tomorrow!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Food.
• Vì sao đúng: "They're going to bring the food, so we don't need to worry about lunch or dinner" — "They" = Luis và Emma.
• Fruit sai: là thứ CẢ NHÓM sẽ đi mua sau — "we can go and buy a few things we still need — some fruit".
• Sleeping bags sai: là thứ NGƯỜI NGHE phải tự mang — "don't forget to bring your own sleeping bag".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi AI mang gì. Ghép đúng chủ ngữ: "they... bring" (Luis & Emma), "we... buy" (cả nhóm), "you... bring" (người nghe).

questions.prompt: Listen to an estate agent showing a family around a house. Which room is the largest?
questions.explanation:
As you can see, the living room is quite spacious and gets plenty of light. Now, if you follow me, we'll go to the bedroom. The room we're standing in would be the largest room if you combined it with the study next door, but on its own it's a normal size. The house has two bathrooms, both with very modern fittings, though they're fairly small. And now, here we are — the kitchen. This is the biggest room in the whole house. I think your family will have some very cosy dinners in here.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The kitchen.
• Vì sao đúng: "the kitchen. This is the biggest room in the whole house".
• The bedroom sai: chỉ lớn nhất NẾU gộp với phòng làm việc — "would be the largest room if you combined it with the study", còn "on its own it's a normal size".
• The bathroom sai: hiện đại nhưng khá nhỏ — "they're fairly small".
👉 Mẹo: dạng so sánh nhất, coi chừng câu điều kiện "would be... if" — đó là giả định, không phải sự thật. Nghe hết cả nhà rồi mới chọn.

questions.prompt: A woman is calling her friend. Why is she calling?
options: To ask where to buy furniture
To give away her old furniture
To invite her friend to see the house
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Karen. We've decided to redecorate the house at last — the last time I did it was years ago. I'm planning to change the wallpaper and buy some new furniture to match the colour of the walls. Don't worry, I'm not going to ask you to take our old sofa; Tom has already given it to his brother. But I know you've just finished doing up your place, and it looks lovely, so I wanted to ask: where did you get your furniture? Is there a good shop somewhere nearby? And once it's all finished, of course, you must come round and see it. Call me back when you can!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To ask where to buy furniture.
• Vì sao đúng: "I wanted to ask: where did you get your furniture? Is there a good shop somewhere nearby?".
• To give away her old furniture sai: cô nói rõ KHÔNG nhờ bạn lấy sofa cũ — "I'm not going to ask you to take our old sofa; Tom has already given it to his brother".
• To invite her friend to see the house sai: chỉ là lời hẹn cho SAU KHI xong, không phải mục đích cuộc gọi — "once it's all finished... you must come round".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "Why is she calling?" → tìm câu có "I wanted to ask" / "I'm calling to". Các ý phụ (từ chối, hẹn sau) là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his colleague Ruth about a meeting. How does he suggest changing the meeting?
questions.explanation:
M: Hi, Ruth. I'm really sorry, but I've just had a call from an important client. They've suddenly come to visit our office, so I don't think I'll be able to make it to the meeting.
W: Oh, that's a problem. Should we delay the meeting until tomorrow?
M: I'd rather not. I've got a factory inspection scheduled for tomorrow morning, so I'll be busy all day.
W: Right, I understand. So what do you suggest?
M: I think the best thing is to have the meeting without me. You can discuss everything with the others and send me the notes afterwards.
W: That sounds sensible. I'll let everyone know.
M: Thanks, Ruth. Sorry about the situation.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Having the meeting without him.
• Vì sao đúng: chính người đàn ông đề xuất "I think the best thing is to have the meeting without me... send me the notes afterwards".
• Delaying the meeting sai: Ruth đề nghị hoãn sang mai nhưng anh từ chối — "I'd rather not. I've got a factory inspection scheduled for tomorrow".
• Cancelling the meeting sai: không ai đề nghị huỷ; cuộc họp vẫn diễn ra với những người còn lại.
👉 Mẹo: phiên bản này ĐẢO VAI so với Đề 37 (ở đó Ruth gọi và đề nghị họp không có cô ấy). Câu hỏi hỏi "how does HE suggest" — bám vào lời đề xuất của người gọi, không phải lời hỏi của Ruth.

questions.prompt: Listen to a weather forecast. Where will the weather be best?
questions.explanation:
And now the weather forecast. The heavy rain we've had all week is continuing across most of the country. In the north there's no sign of it stopping, so keep your umbrella ready. The south stays grey and cloudy, with more showers this afternoon. In the west, though, there are some positive signs: the weather is improving, and the sun has already started to come out in a few places. However, the best weather today is in the east. It's bright and dry there, with no rain at all — perfect for a family picnic.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In the east.
• Vì sao đúng: "the best weather today is in the east. It's bright and dry there, with no rain at all".
• In the west sai: chỉ ĐANG TỐT LÊN, có nắng vài nơi — "the weather is improving" — nhưng câu sau có "However" đảo hướng.
• In the south sai: vẫn xám và có mưa rào — "stays grey and cloudy, with more showers".
👉 Mẹo: bản tin thời tiết đọc lần lượt từng vùng; vùng "tốt lên" là bẫy. Chỉ chốt vùng đi kèm từ so sánh nhất "the best".

questions.prompt: Listen to an announcement in a supermarket. How much are the cleaning products?
questions.explanation:
Good morning, shoppers, and welcome to our biggest sale of the year. In the kitchen section, every item is marked down by twenty per cent today. All our cleaning products are also reduced — they are now just one pound fifty each. That's one pound fifty for any cleaning product. And don't miss the bakery: our cakes are down to only two pounds fifteen, and bread rolls are fifty pence a bag. Offers end at closing time today, so hurry while stocks last. Thank you for shopping with us.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – One pound fifty.
• Vì sao đúng: "All our cleaning products are also reduced — they are now just one pound fifty each", được nhắc lại ngay sau đó.
• Two pounds fifteen sai: là giá BÁNH — "our cakes are down to only two pounds fifteen".
• Fifty pence sai: là giá bánh mì — "bread rolls are fifty pence a bag".
👉 Mẹo: thông báo giảm giá liệt kê nhiều giá liên tiếp. Ghép giá với đúng MẶT HÀNG trong câu hỏi (cleaning products), đừng chộp con số nghe rõ nhất.

questions.prompt: A man and woman are discussing their plans for the evening. What do the man and woman decide to do in the evening?
questions.explanation:
M: So — tonight. Any ideas? There's that new film at the cinema, the one everyone's talking about.
W: I checked already: sold out until the weekend. Every single seat.
M: Ah. Then we could just stay at home? Order food, watch something on the sofa?
W: We've done that three nights in a row! I can't look at that sofa any more.
M: Fair point. So no cinema, no sofa... what's left?
W: Honestly? Let's not decide right now. I finish work at five — let's just see how we feel and make plans then.
M: You know what, that's the best idea. No pressure, no booking.
W: Exactly. I'll call you at five!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Make plans later.
• Vì sao đúng: "Let's not decide right now. I finish work at five — let's just see how we feel and make plans then" — anh đồng ý "that's the best idea. No pressure, no booking".
• Go to the movies sai: phim đã hết vé tới cuối tuần — "I checked already: sold out until the weekend. Every single seat".
• Stay at home sai: bị loại vì đã ở nhà ba tối liên tiếp — "We've done that three nights in a row! I can't look at that sofa any more".
👉 Mẹo: đôi khi đáp án là "chưa quyết" chứ không phải một hoạt động cụ thể. Nếu cả hai phương án cụ thể đều bị loại, nghe kỹ câu chốt kiểu "let's decide later".

title: Đề 36 - Making films + My visit to a new coffee shop

questions.prompt: Put the sentences in the correct order.
options: Things have changed over time, and some of them now earn millions of dollars for appearing in films.
Films from that period were very different from films of today.
This is because they were all in black and white, and they had no sound.
In addition to these technical limitations, the film producers also had a limited budget.
This lack of money mainly affected the actors, and they did not earn a lot of money.
Even though it was crowded, the staff still managed to find a table for me.
It tasted really good with melted cheese on top, and I’ll definitely come back to this place again.
After checking them all, I decided to order the most expensive sandwich.
They handed me the menu, and when I looked through it, I saw quite a variety of dishes.
When I arrived, the place was very crowded, and the staff were extremely busy on the first day.
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
Dạng sắp xếp câu: tìm câu mở đầu (không trỏ ngược), rồi bám vào đại từ, từ chỉ định và từ nối để nối dần.

▸ Making films — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "In 1895, the Grand Café in France showed the first ever commercial film." → câu cho sẵn, nêu mốc thời gian và sự kiện đầu tiên.
  1. "Films from that period were very different from films of today." → "that period" trỏ thẳng về năm 1895 ở câu cho sẵn.
  2. "This is because they were all in black and white, and they had no sound." → "This is because" giải thích cho ý "very different" ở câu trước.
  3. "In addition to these technical limitations, the film producers also had a limited budget." → "these technical limitations" gom lại ý đen trắng và không có tiếng.
  4. "This lack of money mainly affected the actors, and they did not earn a lot of money." → "This lack of money" trỏ về "a limited budget".
  5. "Things have changed over time, and some of them now earn millions of dollars for appearing in films." → "some of them" trỏ về "the actors", chốt bằng tương phản quá khứ với hiện tại.

▸ A new coffee shop — thứ tự đúng:
  1. “When I arrived, the place was very crowded, and the staff were extremely busy on the first day.” → câu mở đầu, nêu bối cảnh.
  2. “Even though it was crowded, the staff still managed to find a table for me.” → “it was crowded” nối tiếp ý đông khách.
  3. “They handed me the menu, and when I looked through it, I saw quite a variety of dishes.” → “They” = the staff.
  4. “After checking them all, I decided to order the most expensive sandwich.” → “them all” = a variety of dishes.
  5. “It tasted really good with melted cheese on top, and I’ll definitely come back to this place again.” → “It” = the sandwich; câu kết.

questions.prompt: Mountain (Version 5)
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. Chọn "Our changing perspective towards mountains" vì đoạn văn so sánh xưa – nay: người ta từng nghĩ leo núi là thú chơi hẹp, nhưng có bằng chứng leo núi đã là môn thể thao nghiêm túc từ lâu; điều KHÁC biệt bây giờ là định nghĩa "chinh phục" = đứng trên đỉnh, tự mình nhìn xuống thay vì nhờ ảnh và lời kể của người khác.
2. Chọn "A unique sense of achievement" vì đoạn văn nói về cảm giác thành tựu sâu sắc (profound sense of accomplishment): hình dáng núi tượng trưng cho chinh phục, vượt nỗi sợ, đẩy giới hạn, cộng thêm adrenaline khiến người leo quay lại mãi.
3. Chọn "Publicising one's achievements" vì đoạn văn nói selfie trên đỉnh gần như bắt buộc — bằng chứng và cách để mọi người biết; sự thoả mãn riêng tư giờ được đăng, gắn giờ, chia sẻ (posted, timestamped and shared).
4. Chọn "The wrong priority" vì đoạn văn chỉ ra người leo tập trung vào bức ảnh hơn ngọn núi, coi hành trình chỉ là chướng ngại, bỏ qua cảnh báo → tai nạn; "personal image ends up mattering more than safety or responsibility" = đặt sai ưu tiên.
5. Chọn "A disturbing revelation" vì đoạn văn mở bằng kỳ vọng Everest vắng vẻ rồi lật lại "The reality is startling": ảnh "traffic jam" trên death zone, rác mỗi mùa, thử thách cá nhân thành cuộc đua thương mại. Bẫy: đoạn 4 cũng nói tai nạn nhưng không "hé lộ" sự thật gây sốc.
6. Chọn "A focus on sustainability" vì đoạn văn nói về cách vận hành expedition đổi theo hướng bảo vệ môi trường: giới hạn permit, đặt cọc trả lại khi mang rác xuống, clean-up climbs, "a mountain should be left cleaner than it was found".
7. Chọn "A more intimate relationship" vì đoạn văn kể Nan Shepherd đi "into the hills rather than up them", biết núi như biết một người bạn — "one visits a friend with no intention but to be with him".
👉 Mẹo: đọc câu đầu + câu cuối mỗi đoạn; các cặp dễ nhầm là đoạn 3/4 (đăng ảnh vs ưu tiên sai) và đoạn 4/5 (tai nạn vs sự thật gây sốc ở Everest).

title: Đề 35 - The Arrival of the Four-Day Work Week (Version 2)

questions.prompt: The Arrival of the Four-Day Work Week (Version 2)
options: A way of life now out of date
Businesses preparing for a new policy
An unfair plan for some people
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
1. "A way of life now out of date" → tuần 40 giờ "anchored in this industrial setting" của Henry Ford một thế kỷ trước, "no longer the norm among 21st-century workers".
2. "Benefits for employees" → "keep the workers away from stress", "more free time", "reduce gender inequality" — toàn lợi ích cho người lao động.
3. "Undesirable financial consequences" → "Employers are motivated by profit", "They fear staff producing 20% less for the same pay", và bài học Nhật 1988: "economic output was 20% lower", "a sharp rise in running costs". Cả đoạn nói về tiền của doanh nghiệp.
4. "Unforeseen challenges for employees" → "a theory called the hedonic treadmill: people will repeatedly return to their baseline of happiness"; công ty Pháp giảm giờ làm nhưng "failed to improve employee happiness"; làm nhanh hơn thì "Accidents may occur", "some people may be asked to leave the company". Bẫy: lợi nhuận của employers đã nằm ở đoạn 3, đoạn này là hệ quả bất ngờ với chính người lao động.
5. "Difficult to change old habits" → "some employees went back to the factory floor of their own accord", "others picked up a second job" — được nghỉ vẫn quay về nếp cũ. Bẫy: hai câu đầu nhắc năng suất tăng trong sáu tháng và "the novelty of change", dễ kéo sang ý khác; trọng tâm đoạn nằm ở nửa sau.
6. "An unfair plan for some people" → "Is it even workable? What about schoolteachers?" — giáo viên không thể làm ít đi vì số học sinh và khối lượng phải dạy vẫn thế; "Hospitals take in the same number of patients... how can doctors and nurses work any less?"; "It is the same for the police and firefighters". Kế hoạch chỉ hợp với một số nghề → bất công với những nghề còn lại. Bẫy: câu cuối nhắc "income" dễ kéo sang "Undesirable financial consequences".
7. "Alternative solutions worth considering" → "Raising the basic income", "adding more national holidays and bank holidays".
Nhiễu: "Businesses preparing for a new policy" — không đoạn nào nói doanh nghiệp đang chuẩn bị áp dụng.
👉 Mẹo: đoạn 3 và đoạn 4 dễ lẫn. Tiền của doanh nghiệp thì về đoạn 3; hạnh phúc, tai nạn, mất việc của người lao động thì về đoạn 4.

questions.prompt: Laila is calling her mum. How much is the bus ticket?
questions.explanation:
Hi Mum, it's Laila. Can you lend me some money until Saturday? I'm going into town to buy my textbooks. I checked the price of the book already and I can pay for that on my card, but I don't have any cash for the bus. The ticket is two pounds fifty each way. I'll give it back on Saturday, I promise. What time will you be home?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Two pounds fifty.
• Vì sao đúng: "The ticket is two pounds fifty each way".
• Two pounds fifteen sai: bẫy âm fifty/fifteen — nghe trọng âm: FIF-ty (nhấn đầu) vs fif-TEEN (nhấn cuối).
• Five pounds sai: không được nhắc trong bài.
👉 Mẹo: số tiền có "-ty" và "-teen" luôn là bẫy phát âm, nghe kỹ âm cuối và trọng âm.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his friend. Where is he going to see a show?
questions.explanation:
Hi Jack, how are you? You know I love seeing shows. There's one at the town hall this Friday and I'm going, but I'd like to go with a friend. They've got some great singers and the tickets don't cost much — only five pounds. What do you think? Call me back.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At the town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "There's one at the town hall this Friday and I'm going".
• At the theatre / At the park sai: không được nhắc — chỉ là nhiễu theo chủ đề "show".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "where" — bắt danh từ chỉ nơi chốn đi ngay sau "at/in".

questions.prompt: Jana is calling her friend. What does her sister look like?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Jana. I'm calling to ask for a favour. I've got an extra class after school today, so could you take my bag to my sister? You can meet her outside the school gate. She looks just like me — she's short and she has black hair. I'll send you a photo of her. And please tell her to take the bag home. Thanks so much!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – She is short.
• Vì sao đúng: "She looks just like me — she's short and she has black hair".
• She is tall sai: ngược lại với "short".
• She is blonde sai: bài nói "black hair".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi ngoại hình — chờ cụm "she looks like / she has".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his new life. What does he usually do after work?
questions.explanation:
I want to tell you about my new life. I really love my new job, but I don't want to stay in the office too long, so I'm always happy when five o'clock comes. I get changed, put my work clothes in the bag on my back and go running. I'm lucky, because my flat is only three miles from the office, so it's not too far to run.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – He goes running.
• Vì sao đúng: "I get changed, put my work clothes in the bag on my back and go running".
• He goes to the gym sai: không nhắc gym.
• He cycles home sai: anh chạy bộ về nhà ("not too far to run"), không đạp xe.
👉 Mẹo: động từ đi sau "get changed... and" chính là hoạt động cần tìm.

questions.prompt: A reporter is interviewing a woman about her shopping habits. Where is the woman going to shop today?
questions.explanation:
M: Excuse me, could I ask you a few questions about your shopping habits?
W: Yes, sure.
M: How often do you usually go shopping?
W: Almost every day. There's a local shop in my area, but today I have a lot of things to buy.
M: What about the open market?
W: I like it, but I don't think it's a good idea on a day like today — it's going to rain.
M: So where are you going to shop?
W: I think I'll try the newly opened shopping centre.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At the shopping centre.
• Vì sao đúng: câu chốt "I think I'll try the newly opened shopping centre".
• At the local shop sai: cô hay đi hằng ngày, nhưng hôm nay cần mua nhiều đồ nên không đi.
• At the open market sai: bị loại vì trời sắp mưa — "not a good idea on a day like today".
👉 Mẹo: dạng phỏng vấn, đáp án nằm ở câu trả lời cho câu hỏi cuối "So where...?".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his family's weekends. What does the family do most weekends?
questions.explanation:
I think we should go bowling this weekend, for a change. We go for a walk together almost every weekend, so this time let's do something different, and just let the children go with their friends afterwards. That would be nice for everyone.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "We go for a walk together almost every weekend" — câu hỏi hỏi thói quen (MOST weekends).
• They go bowling sai: chỉ là đề xuất cho tuần NÀY ("this weekend, for a change").
• They go out with friends sai: là kế hoạch cho bọn trẻ tuần này, không phải thói quen.
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt "this weekend" (kế hoạch) và "almost every weekend" (thói quen) — câu hỏi hỏi cái nào thì chọn cái đó.

questions.prompt: A man is calling his sister. Where will they meet?
questions.explanation:
M: Hi, how are you?
W: Oh! Are you calling from America?
M: No, I've been visiting the London office for a few days. Do you want to meet up? I have to catch a train at three.
W: Yes! There's a park near my flat. The weather's lovely and sunny, and there are lots of people around. Do you want to meet there?
M: Sure. Then I can walk you to your university afterwards — I don't have to be at the station until three.
W: OK, see you soon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At the park.
• Vì sao đúng: cô đề nghị "There's a park near my flat... Do you want to meet there?" và anh đồng ý "Sure".
• At the station sai: đó là nơi anh phải đến lúc 3 giờ SAU khi gặp.
• At the university sai: anh chỉ đi bộ đưa cô đến đó sau, không phải điểm hẹn.
👉 Mẹo: cả 3 địa điểm đều xuất hiện — chọn nơi có "meet there" + "Sure".

questions.prompt: A girl is talking about a new song. Which part of the song interests most people?
questions.explanation:
The band Flower Girls has just released a new song called "Get Moving". But it isn't what the title makes you expect — it's actually quite slow. The tune sounds a lot like the songs the band has released before. It's the words that are different. Lots of people are already trying to guess what the lyrics really mean; it seems there's something hidden underneath.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The words.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's the words that are different. Lots of people are already trying to guess what the lyrics really mean" — lyrics = the words.
• The tune sai: giai điệu "sounds a lot like the songs... before" — không có gì mới.
• The title sai: tên bài gây nhầm ("isn't what the title makes you expect"), không phải phần thu hút.
👉 Mẹo: "lyrics" = "words"; bẫy paraphrase kinh điển của câu này.

questions.prompt: A girl is talking about a film. Which scenes does she think are the best?
questions.explanation:
Today I'd like to talk about my favourite film. Actually, I don't usually like action films, but this one isn't like the others, with car chases and fight scenes that go on forever. What makes it special is the mountains. The best moment is when they climb to the summit at dawn, and the view that opens up is absolutely spectacular. The ending is a bit predictable, but overall it's an amazing piece of work.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The mountain scenes.
• Vì sao đúng: "What makes it special is the mountains. The best moment is when they climb to the summit at dawn".
• The car-chase scenes / The fight scenes sai: được nhắc với ý chê — "go on forever" — và là đặc điểm của phim hành động khác.
👉 Mẹo: cụm "what makes it special" / "the best moment" báo hiệu đáp án.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his plans for the weekend. What will the woman do on Saturday?
questions.explanation:
M: I'm going to celebrate my promotion this Saturday.
W: Oh, what are you going to do?
M: In the morning I'll have coffee with some friends at the hotel, and in the evening there's a party.
W: What about the afternoon?
M: I'll watch the football. And on Sunday I'm driving out to the countryside. Do you want to join me?
W: Sunday? Sorry, I can't make Sunday.
M: Then how about Saturday morning?
W: Yes, that sounds good.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Go for a coffee.
• Vì sao đúng: anh mời "how about Saturday morning?" (= uống cà phê ở khách sạn) và cô nhận "Yes, that sounds good".
• Go to a party sai: là kế hoạch tối thứ Bảy của ANH, cô không nói sẽ tham gia.
• Go for a drive sai: chuyến đi là Chủ nhật, cô từ chối "I can't make Sunday".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi về NGƯỜI PHỤ NỮ — chỉ tính hoạt động cô ấy đồng ý, không phải lịch của anh.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about taking a course. Which course will he take?
questions.explanation:
M: I'd like to take a course this year.
W: Sure. Which one?
M: I was thinking of the management course.
W: Hmm. We don't have many people with computer skills in the company. I think you should go for that one instead.
M: OK — I like technology anyway.
W: That's settled, then. You can always do a leadership course later, when you have more experience.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A computer course.
• Vì sao đúng: sếp gợi ý khoá máy tính ("not many people with computer skills... go for that one") và anh đồng ý "OK — I like technology anyway", rồi "That's settled".
• A management course sai: là ý định BAN ĐẦU, bị đổi.
• A leadership course sai: để "later, when you have more experience".
👉 Mẹo: "That's settled" = chốt; đáp án là thứ vừa được đồng ý ngay trước đó.

questions.prompt: A woman is calling her friend at a restaurant. What does she usually drink with her lunch?
questions.explanation:
Hi Sally, it's me. I'm going to be a little late — I can't find anywhere to park the car. Could you order for me? I'll have the fish; I'm trying to eat healthily. And I usually have tea with my lunch, so could you order me a big cup? See you in about fifteen minutes.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "I usually have tea with my lunch, so could you order me a big cup".
• Milk / Wine sai: không được nhắc.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "usually" — bắt đúng câu có "usually" trong bài.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
questions.explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

title: Đề 53 - Working from home + Two famous writers

questions.prompt: What does she say about working at home?
options: Video calls are superior to face-to-face conversation
questions.explanation:
Before I began working from home, I imagined paradise: no commute, no meetings that could have been emails, and above all, silence. I truly believed there would be no distractions once the chatting colleagues were gone. Reality re-educated me within a week. The distractions did not disappear; they changed uniform. The washing machine calls, the doorbell rings, the fridge whispers, and family members assume that being home means being available. As for video calls — useful, yes, but let nobody tell you they beat face-to-face conversation. Explaining a complicated problem through a frozen screen and a delayed microphone cured me of that idea permanently. So when friends ask for my honest verdict after a full year, I give them three words: not as expected. There are real advantages, but the dream and the reality live at different addresses.
Let me pass on what I have actually learned. First, forget the magazine photos — you do not need a big home office. My best work happens at a small desk in the corner of the bedroom. Second, do not believe anyone who says this lifestyle requires no self-motivation; with nobody watching, discipline is the entire game. And the biggest lesson: there is no universal answer. How well working from home goes depends on your situation and your personality. My neighbour thrives alone; I miss the noise of other humans. Learn which kind of worker you are — preferably before you sign anything.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
(Bản variant của Đề 02 bài 2.)
1. Đáp án: Not good as expected. Bẫy: "no distractions" ("changed uniform") và "video calls superior" ("cured me of that idea").
2. Đáp án: It depends on your situation and personality. Bẫy: "big home office" và "no self-motivation" đều bị phủ định.

questions.prompt: According to the author, working from home:
options: It depends on your situation and personality

questions.prompt: What do these two famous writers have in common?
options: They both wrote in the same genre
They both were born in the same country
They both make references to each other in their work
questions.explanation:
In this week's literature lecture, we look at two writers who changed modern fiction — and at what actually connects them, because students always guess wrong. The first guess is that they wrote in the same genre. In fact, one spent his life on realistic novels while the other moved between fantasy, essays and poetry. The second guess is that they were born in the same country. Also wrong — an ocean separated their birthplaces, and they met in person only twice. What they truly share is more unusual: they make references to each other in their work. Open one writer's short stories and you will find the other's characters walking through them; read the second writer's essays and whole passages answer arguments the first had made years before. Across different languages and continents, their books carried on a lifelong conversation of mutual respect.
Now, what should you expect when you read them? Do not expect simple language and structure — anyone who tells you these are easy books has not read them. And do not assume their works are based on real events; both invented freely, even when history appears in the background. What is genuinely special is that the meaning of their work is not always easily identified. Both writers hid ideas beneath the surface — symbols, private jokes, arguments in disguise. You may finish a chapter unsure of what it truly said, return a year later, and find a different book waiting for you. That richness is exactly why we still study them.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
(Bản variant của Đề 05 bài 2 — nhiễu khác: same genre / same country.)
1. Đáp án: They both make references to each other in their work. Bẫy: "same genre" và "same country" đều bị phủ định ngay đầu.
2. Đáp án: The meaning of their work is not always easily identified. Bẫy: "simple language" và "based on real events" đều bị phủ định.

questions.prompt: What is special about their works?
options: They use simple language and structure
The meaning of their work is not always easily identified
Their works are all based on real events

title: Đề 58 - Famous place, this evening & film

questions.prompt: Tell me about a famous place in your country.
What are you going to do this evening?
Tell me about your favourite film.
Write a short email (about 50 words) to your friend, and a longer email (120-150 words) to the manager of the club.
questions.explanation:
Hi Lan,
Our social club is planning new activities for both young and old members, and they are asking whether events should be indoors or outdoors. I think we should combine the two, so everyone can join. I'm going to write to the manager tonight — want to come to the first event with me?
Best,
Phuong

Dear Manager,
Thank you for asking members about the new programme of activities. I am really pleased that the club wants to bring young and old people together, and I think this is a great chance to make the club more lively.
In my opinion, we should combine indoor and outdoor events rather than choosing only one. Outdoor activities such as walking in the park, picnics or a small sports day are perfect for younger members and for sunny weekends. However, older members may prefer indoor events such as board game evenings, cooking classes or talks, especially in cold or rainy weather.
I would suggest holding one outdoor and one indoor event each month, and choosing activities that need no special skills so that everyone can take part. I would be happy to help organise the first picnic.
Yours sincerely,
Phuong

questions.prompt: You are a member of the travel club. You received this email from the club manager.
A man is asking his colleague about a meeting. When does the meeting take place?
questions.explanation:
M: Hey, my calendar is broken — can you remind me about the upcoming meeting? Have we fixed the day for the project meeting? Is it on Thursday?
W: Definitely not. Our whole team is going on the training course on Thursday, so no one will be in the office.
M: Is it on Monday, then?
W: I think that would be too early, because our boss is still on her holiday on Monday and we can't have the meeting without her. Let me check my diary... The meeting is on Tuesday.
M: Oh right, thank you! I'll update my notes now.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Tuesday. Thursday bị loại ("whole team is going on the training course"), Monday bị loại ("our boss is still on her holiday"). Bẫy: cả 3 ngày đều được nhắc, đáp án là ngày duy nhất không bị phủ định.

questions.prompt: A man is calling a bakery. How many mini cakes are needed for the meeting?
questions.explanation:
M: Hello, is this the bakery? I'd like to order some of your mini cakes for our meeting with a client this afternoon. I believe there will be four people at the meeting; however, I'm not sure whether they're bringing their assistants as well, so let's make it six mini cakes just to be safe. Could you deliver them by two o'clock?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: 6. Người nói nhắc "four people" trước rồi tự sửa "let's make it six mini cakes just to be safe" — đáp án là con số ĐƯỢC CHỐT sau cùng.

questions.prompt: Two friends are talking about a new apartment. What does the man find difficult about his new apartment?
questions.explanation:
W: How's the new apartment? You moved in last month, didn't you?
M: Yes, I moved closer to the city centre. It's far more convenient than my old place.
W: Wow, that's nice. The rent must be pretty expensive, though?
M: Actually, yes, rent around there is quite high. Luckily I know the landlord well and he let me have it at a much cheaper price.
W: So what's the problem?
M: The neighbours next door. They play loud music every night, and when I asked them to turn it down they were quite rude about it.
W: I see.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: The neighbours. Location: "far more convenient" (tốt). Rent: đắt nhưng "he let me have it at a much cheaper price" (không phải vấn đề). Vấn đề thật: "The neighbours next door... play loud music... quite rude".

questions.prompt: Two colleagues are talking about a new job. What does the man love about his new job?
questions.explanation:
W: So how's the new job going?
M: Well, I was used to the hectic pace at my old place, and the heavy workload made me really stressed. This new place is calmer, which is fine, and the work itself is OK.
W: What's the best thing about it, then?
M: The journey. It only takes me twenty minutes to get there now. I enjoy it, and my daughter loves it too, because I can drop her at school and still get to work on time every day.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: The shorter journey. Pace chậm hơn chỉ "fine", work "OK" — chưa phải điều anh ấy yêu thích. Câu hỏi "What's the best thing?" → "The journey. It only takes me twenty minutes".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about a coffee shop. What does the customer complain about?
questions.explanation:
I visited a coffee shop yesterday hoping to spend a few hours working on my laptop. Everything seemed perfect at first — the drinks tasted great, and the place was quiet enough to concentrate. The only problem was the internet. The wifi was incredibly slow, making it almost impossible to join an online meeting or download documents. Even the staff apologised and explained that several customers had experienced the same issue. Because of that, I probably won't return for work anytime soon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: The wifi was too slow. Cà phê "tasted great" và quán "quiet enough" → loại A, C. "The only problem was the internet. The wifi was incredibly slow".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her gym. What does the woman complain about?
questions.explanation:
I went to the gym yesterday evening after finishing work because I had been looking forward to my regular yoga class all day. When I arrived, everything seemed normal at first, and there weren't many people around, so I thought it would be a relaxing session. However, as I walked towards the studio, I saw a notice on the door saying that the class had been cancelled because the instructor was ill. I was quite disappointed, especially since nobody had sent us a message or email to let us know beforehand. If I had known earlier, I probably would have stayed at home instead of making the journey.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Her yoga class was cancelled. "there weren't many people around" → không đông (loại A); không nhắc phí (loại C). "a notice on the door saying that the class had been cancelled".

questions.prompt: Mark is leaving a message for Helen. What is he going to do to prepare for the event?

Hi Helen, it's Mark. Regarding the upcoming event, Sarah is already handling the order to buy new office equipment, and John is in charge of inviting more guests. As for me, my main job today is to change the time of the meeting on the official calendar, because the main hall is unavailable in the morning. I'll notify everyone once it's done.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Change the time of the meeting. Bẫy: cả 3 việc đều được nhắc nhưng A là việc của Sarah, B là của John. "As for me, my main job today is to change the time of the meeting".

questions.prompt: A man is buying shoes. What colour shoes did he choose?
questions.explanation:
W: How can I help you today, sir?
M: I'm looking for new sneakers. Do you have these in white?
W: I'm afraid we only have red and blue left in that model.
M: Oh, I already have a red pair at home. I'll take the blue ones, then.
W: Great choice! I'll bring them to the counter for you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Blue. White: hết hàng ("only have red and blue left"). Red: đã có ở nhà. "I'll take the blue ones".

questions.prompt: A tour guide is talking about the group's traveling schedule. Where will the group wait for the bus?
questions.explanation:
Good evening, everyone — important details for tomorrow's excursion, so listen carefully! Now, about the meeting point. It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine. And please don't go to the train station like the group last week; our tour doesn't use the train at all. The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp. Main entrance, eight o'clock. Sleep well!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the hotel's main entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp".
• In the lobby sai: hôm nay có gặp ở đó nhưng mai sảnh đóng cửa để dọn dẹp — "It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine".
• At the train station sai: tour không dùng tàu, đó là nhầm lẫn của nhóm tuần trước — "our tour doesn't use the train at all".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm hẹn, hướng dẫn viên hay nhấn mạnh "It is NOT...". Chốt ở nơi có mô tả nhận diện cụ thể (cửa kính lớn, đài phun nước) kèm giờ.

questions.prompt: Lucy is calling her friend. What is her sister like?
options: She is very different from Lucy
questions.explanation:
M: Lucy! How was the weekend with your sister? I've still never met her, you know.
W: Wonderful, as always. People are so surprised when they finally meet her.
M: Why? Is she taller than you? You always say she gets noticed first.
W: Ha! No, we're exactly the same height, actually. It's not about looks at all.
M: Then what surprises everyone?
W: How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences. Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice.
M: That's lovely. So if I like you, I'll like her.
W: Exactly. Double trouble, they call us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They have similar characters.
• Vì sao đúng: "How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences."
• She is taller than Lucy sai: hai chị em cao bằng nhau ("we're exactly the same height, actually").
• She is very different from Lucy sai: ngược lại hoàn toàn — "Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ngoại hình/tính cách, chú ý cặp đối lập "looks vs inside"; câu "It's not about looks at all" đã loại sạch nhóm ngoại hình.

questions.prompt: Greg is talking about a working day in his life. How does he go to work?
questions.explanation:
People often ask how I manage my mornings, so here's my working day. I used to drive, but since the office moved to the centre, the car just sits in traffic for an hour, so that's finished. My wife keeps saying I should cycle — good exercise, she says — but with our winters, I'd arrive soaked three days out of five. So now I go to work by bus. Twenty minutes, a warm seat, and I read my book the whole way. Best decision I've made in years.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – By bus.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I go to work by bus. Twenty minutes, a warm seat, and I read my book the whole way".
• By car sai: đã bỏ vì văn phòng chuyển vào trung tâm, xe kẹt cả tiếng — "I used to drive, but since the office moved to the centre, the car just sits in traffic for an hour, so that's finished".
• By bike sai: chỉ là gợi ý của vợ, bị loại vì mùa đông — "My wife keeps saying I should cycle... but with our winters, I'd arrive soaked three days out of five".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phương tiện đi lại, bám cụm "So now I...". Phương tiện gắn với "I used to" (quá khứ) hay "my wife says I should" (ý người khác) đều là nhiễu.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her plan for the holiday. What will she do during the holiday?
questions.explanation:
Two more days until my holiday, and I have made my plans! My sister keeps saying I should go for a run every morning — she's training for a marathon and thinks everyone else should suffer too. My neighbour offered to lend me his bike for a ride along the coast, which was kind, but I haven't cycled in years and I'd like to return from holiday in one piece. No — every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end. Perfect.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end."
• Go for a run sai: đó là ý của chị gái đang tập marathon, cô không nhận ("My sister keeps saying I should go for a run").
• Go for a bike ride sai: hàng xóm cho mượn xe nhưng cô đã lâu không đạp và muốn về nhà nguyên vẹn ("I haven't cycled in years").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi kế hoạch, gạch hết ý do người khác đề xuất; đáp án nằm sau "No —" và đi với chủ ngữ "I will".

questions.prompt: Listen to a radio man talking about a new popular song. Which is the most attractive part of the song?
questions.explanation:
The song of the summer, listeners — let's talk about why it owns every radio! Musicians praise the melody, sweet but honestly nothing revolutionary, you've heard that tune's cousins before. The rhythm gets the clubs moving, sure, a solid beat, nothing more. But the words — the words are why grandmothers and teenagers both cry to this song! Poetry about going home after years away, every line a little knife. People tattoo these lyrics, print them at weddings. The words, my friends. That's the magic.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The words.
• Vì sao đúng: "the words are why grandmothers and teenagers both cry to this song! Poetry about going home after years away... The words, my friends. That's the magic".
• The melody sai: bị chê là bình thường, không có gì mới — "the melody, sweet but honestly nothing revolutionary, you've heard that tune's cousins before".
• The rhythm sai: chỉ ở mức tạm ổn — "The rhythm gets the clubs moving, sure, a solid beat, nothing more".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "phần hay nhất", nghe cụm hạ giá trị "nothing revolutionary", "nothing more". Yếu tố được khen bằng từ mạnh ("that's the magic") mới là đáp án.

questions.prompt: A mother is calling her daughter. What time will she meet her daughter?
questions.explanation:
Hi sweetheart, it's Mum. I'm sorry, but I don't think I can get to your school when classes finish at two. I have to go back to the office to finish my report first. I thought it might take me until four, but my manager says I can leave a bit earlier. So I'm going to meet you at three o'clock. Wait for me at the main door, OK? And call me back to let me know you're OK.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 3 o'clock.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I'm going to meet you at three o'clock. Wait for me at the main door".
• 2 o'clock sai: 2 giờ là giờ con tan học, mẹ nói không kịp đến lúc đó ("I don't think I can get to your school when classes finish at two").
• 4 o'clock sai: mẹ tưởng phải làm đến 4 giờ nhưng sếp cho về sớm hơn ("I thought it might take me until four, but...").
👉 Mẹo: nghe hết câu sau "but" và "So I'm going to..." — con số chốt luôn nằm sau từ nối.

questions.prompt: Listen to a news report. What caused the air pollution?
questions.explanation:
Air pollution has been a hot topic on social media this week. Many people have blamed unusual atmospheric conditions, while others have pointed to the rising number of people who own cars. However, new satellite photos taken in the last few days show several hotspots in the countryside, where farmers have been burning their crops. Experts now say these fires are the root cause of the pollution in our city.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Fires in the countryside.
• Vì sao đúng: ảnh vệ tinh cho thấy nông dân đốt rơm rạ ở nông thôn và "Experts now say these fires are the root cause of the pollution".
• Atmospheric conditions sai: chỉ là điều "many people have blamed" — ý kiến trên mạng, bị bác bằng "However".
• Car ownership sai: cũng là ý kiến của "others", không phải kết luận của chuyên gia.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi NGUYÊN NHÂN, ý kiến đám đông đứng trước "However" thường là bẫy; đáp án nằm ở kết luận của chuyên gia.

questions.prompt: Jose is calling his friend about tomorrow. What will Luis and Emma bring?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Jose here. Tomorrow I'm meeting Luis and Emma at the bus stop at five o'clock in the afternoon. They're going to bring the food, so we don't need to worry about lunch or dinner. Do you want to meet us there? If you can, come at about a quarter past five. After that, we can go and buy a few things we still need — some fruit for the journey, and maybe some water. And don't forget to bring your own sleeping bag, because it gets really cold at night. See you tomorrow!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Food.
• Vì sao đúng: "They're going to bring the food, so we don't need to worry about lunch or dinner" — "They" = Luis và Emma.
• Fruit sai: là thứ CẢ NHÓM sẽ đi mua sau — "we can go and buy a few things we still need — some fruit".
• Sleeping bags sai: là thứ NGƯỜI NGHE phải tự mang — "don't forget to bring your own sleeping bag".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi AI mang gì. Ghép đúng chủ ngữ: "they... bring" (Luis & Emma), "we... buy" (cả nhóm), "you... bring" (người nghe).

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about a town. What is the population of the town?
questions.explanation:
This small town has a population of around ten thousand people. Twenty years ago, only about eight thousand people lived here, and many visitors still guess that it's around nine thousand. But it has grown a lot. It has many shops and a train station, which some big towns don't even have. It's a lovely place to live.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: "This small town has a population of around ten thousand people".
• 8,000 sai: là dân số 20 năm trước ("Twenty years ago, only about eight thousand people lived here").
• 9,000 sai: chỉ là con số du khách đoán ("many visitors still guess that it's around nine thousand").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CON SỐ, gắn mỗi số với mốc thời gian/người nói — số hiện tại mới là đáp án.

questions.prompt: Jack is calling his friend. What colour is Jack's house?
questions.explanation:
Hi, it's Jack. I'm calling to let you know that my family has just moved to a new house. Now I live much closer to you, so we can meet up any time. The house is on White Street. There are lots of big houses in this area, but ours is quite small. Don't look for the green door — that's our neighbour's. You can easily find our house because it's red.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Red.
• Vì sao đúng: "You can easily find our house because it's red".
• White sai: "White" là tên đường ("The house is on White Street"), không phải màu nhà.
• Green sai: cửa màu xanh là nhà hàng xóm ("Don't look for the green door — that's our neighbour's").
👉 Mẹo: màu sắc có thể xuất hiện trong tên riêng (White Street) — đừng chọn chỉ vì nghe thấy từ đó.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about buying a house. What is the man's main problem?
questions.explanation:
My ambition is to buy a new house. The market is really expensive at the moment. Experts predict that prices will fall, but they're wrong — prices just keep going up. I'd also like to live somewhere with a pleasant atmosphere and friendly people, and that's not easy to find. Of course, nobody wants to move to a new place and end up with a reduced income. But my main problem is my wife and children. I don't even know if they want to move. First of all, I have to persuade them.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "But my main problem is my wife and children... First of all, I have to persuade them".
• Rising house prices sai: giá nhà tăng là một khó khăn được nhắc, nhưng không phải "main problem".
• Finding a pleasant area sai: tìm khu ở dễ chịu cũng khó, nhưng người nói nhấn mạnh vấn đề chính là gia đình.
👉 Mẹo: bài liệt kê nhiều khó khăn thì nghe cụm "my main problem is..." — đáp án đứng ngay sau.

questions.prompt: A father is talking to his son's teacher. What does the teacher offer to do?
questions.explanation:
M: Hi, I'd like to talk to you about my son's progress at school.
W: Of course. I'm afraid he's finding the lessons quite difficult at the moment.
M: Is there anything we can do? Could you give him some extra exercises?
W: I don't think that's the best idea. His basic knowledge isn't strong enough yet, so more exercises might just confuse him. I'm too busy to teach him myself after class, but why not give him some private lessons?
M: That's a good idea, but I don't know any private teachers.
W: Don't worry. I have the contact details of a very good private teacher near here. I'll send them to you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Help find a private teacher.
• Vì sao đúng: "I have the contact details of a very good private teacher near here. I'll send them to you".
• Give the boy extra exercises sai: đó là đề nghị của phụ huynh, cô giáo từ chối ("I don't think that's the best idea").
• Teach the boy herself sai: cô nói "I'm too busy to teach him myself after class".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi CÔ GIÁO đề nghị gì — bỏ qua đề xuất của người cha, nghe câu "I'll..." của cô.

questions.prompt: Two friends are talking about sports. What was the woman good at?
questions.explanation:
M: Do you remember doing sports at school?
W: Yes, I have good memories of it.
M: What sport did you play?
W: I was in the school football team.
M: Wow. I tried football, but I didn't really like it. I also tried fitness training, but I wasn't strong enough.
W: I tried swimming, but I was a really slow swimmer.
M: Swimming is what I was good at. I won a few competitions.
W: Oh wow! Well, I won a few prizes with my football team too.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Football.
• Vì sao đúng: cô ở đội bóng đá của trường và "I won a few prizes with my football team too".
• Swimming sai: cô bơi chậm ("I was a really slow swimmer"); bơi là môn giỏi của người ĐÀN ÔNG.
• Fitness sai: người đàn ông thử tập thể lực nhưng không đủ sức, cô không nhắc tới.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại 2 người, ghi nhanh môn nào của ai — câu hỏi chỉ hỏi người phụ nữ.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his career. What would he like to be?
questions.explanation:
I'd like to try a different kind of job now. I used to be a chef, and I worked in several hotels. After that, I worked at the post office, and my time there was amazing. I've also been a teacher. But now I'm interested in becoming a writer. I know it's a job where you have to be really creative, but I'd really like to give it a try.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A writer.
• Vì sao đúng: "But now I'm interested in becoming a writer... I'd really like to give it a try".
• A teacher sai: là công việc anh đã từng làm ("I've also been a teacher").
• A chef sai: cũng là việc cũ ("I used to be a chef").
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt quá khứ (used to, have been) với mong muốn hiện tại (now I'm interested in, I'd like to).

questions.prompt: A student is talking to her teacher. When is the assignment due?
questions.explanation:
W: Excuse me, sir. Can I talk to you for a moment?
M: Sure. What would you like to talk about?
W: It's about the assignment you gave us. I don't think I can finish it by Thursday.
M: But I said you had until the end of the week to hand it in.
W: Oh, right. So we have one more day, until Friday? I think I can finish it by then.
M: No, you don't have to hand it in until Saturday, so you have two more days.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Saturday.
• Vì sao đúng: thầy chốt "you don't have to hand it in until Saturday, so you have two more days".
• Thursday sai: là ngày học sinh tưởng phải nộp.
• Friday sai: học sinh đoán thêm một ngày, thầy sửa lại "No...".
👉 Mẹo: khi có "No," ở lượt cuối, đáp án là thông tin người nói sửa lại ngay sau đó.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her plans. What will she do on Saturday?
questions.explanation:
This year I was planning to go to Spain, but it's far too expensive, so I've decided to go to Wales instead. I'm taking my family there this Saturday. During the week, everyone is so busy that it's really hard to spend time together. My husband works late most evenings, and the kids have after-school clubs almost every day, so we usually only see each other at dinner. I did think about just staying at home and relaxing this weekend, but I think a few days away together will do us all good.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – See her family.
• Vì sao đúng: thứ Bảy cô đưa cả nhà đi Wales vì trong tuần "it's really hard to spend time together" — cuối cùng cũng được ở bên gia đình.
• Go to Spain sai: Tây Ban Nha quá đắt nên cô đã đổi kế hoạch ("far too expensive").
• Stay at home sai: cô có nghĩ tới nhưng bỏ ý đó ("I did think about just staying at home..., but").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi KẾ HOẠCH, các phương án bị loại thường đi kèm "but" hoặc "instead".

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about her job. How is being an artist different from other jobs?
questions.explanation:
Being an artist isn't as different from other jobs as people think. I still have to deal with money — paying bills, paying taxes. Sometimes I feel like I'm working in an office rather than a studio. I also have to go and meet clients, the people who want to buy my work. But there's one thing I love about being a painter: I don't have to get up early. And if I feel inspired in the middle of the night, I can start painting right away.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She works irregular hours.
• Vì sao đúng: cô không phải dậy sớm và có thể vẽ lúc nửa đêm khi có cảm hứng — tức là làm việc giờ giấc thất thường.
• She deals with money sai: trả hoá đơn, đóng thuế giống mọi công việc khác ("like I'm working in an office").
• She meets clients sai: gặp khách hàng cũng là điểm giống các nghề khác.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi điểm KHÁC — các ý "I still have to..." là điểm giống, đáp án nằm sau "But there's one thing...".

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his family's weekends. What does the family do most weekends?
questions.explanation:
I think we should go bowling this weekend, for a change. We go for a walk together almost every weekend, so this time let's do something different, and just let the children go with their friends afterwards. That would be nice for everyone.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "We go for a walk together almost every weekend" — câu hỏi hỏi thói quen (MOST weekends).
• They go bowling sai: chỉ là đề xuất cho tuần NÀY ("this weekend, for a change").
• They go out with friends sai: là kế hoạch cho bọn trẻ tuần này, không phải thói quen.
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt "this weekend" (kế hoạch) và "almost every weekend" (thói quen) — câu hỏi hỏi cái nào thì chọn cái đó.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about listening to music. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: My brother listens to music all the time — in the car, at work, even while he's cooking. I honestly don't know how he does it. For me, it's only after I wake up. Before I even get out of bed, I put on a few songs, and it helps me clear my head and get ready for the day. I never sing along, though. First, it's far too early, and second, my brother says I have a terrible voice. Once I've had breakfast and left the house, the music goes off until the next morning.
Speaker B: A lot of people like listening to music after they wake up, but I only listen when I'm studying. It helps me concentrate so much better — when I'm doing homework, and especially when I'm preparing for my final exams. I usually put my headphones on and focus as hard as I can. But it has to be music without any lyrics, like classical music. Songs with words just distract me.
Speaker C: I like pop music. I often listen to songs and pretend to be my favourite singers, singing along in my bedroom with a hairbrush as a microphone. People tell me I have a lovely voice, and that's exactly what I'm going to do: use my voice to express myself. Last month I joined a small choir at my college, and next year I'm planning to enter a singing competition. When I'm singing, I feel I can say things I could never say in normal words.
Speaker D: After a long day at school, nothing is more relaxing than listening to music and enjoying some time on my own. I usually lie on my bed, put on something slow and soft, and close my eyes. Within a few minutes, all the stress of the day just melts away. Sometimes I fall asleep before the playlist finishes, but I never put music on just to help me sleep — it's simply my way of switching off and calming down.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = After waking up: "For me, it's only after I wake up... it helps me clear my head and get ready for the day." Bẫy: A nhắc anh trai nghe nhạc "in the car" (không phải A) và nói "I never sing along" → không phải While singing.
B = While studying: "I only listen when I'm studying... when I'm preparing for my final exams." Bẫy: câu mở đầu "after they wake up" là thói quen của người khác.
C = While singing: "singing along in my bedroom... use my voice to express myself... When I'm singing, I feel I can say things..."
D = To relax: "nothing is more relaxing than listening to music... all the stress of the day just melts away... my way of switching off and calming down."
Nhiễu: While driving (chỉ anh trai của A nghe trong xe), Before going to bed (D có lúc ngủ quên nhưng "never put music on just to help me sleep").

title: Đề 54 - The importance of sleep + Work from home

questions.prompt: What is the most important thing to help you sleep well?
options: Blocking noise and light is the key
questions.explanation:
Let me begin this health talk with the question I am asked most: what is the single most important thing for a good night's sleep? People arrive with strong opinions. The furniture believers insist the bed is everything — invest in the perfect mattress and sleep will follow by itself. The common-sense camp simply says that resting enough is necessary, which is true but circular: telling a poor sleeper to rest more is like telling a poor swimmer to drown less. What the research actually crowns as most important is neither of these. It is blocking out noise and light. The sleeping brain monitors its surroundings all night, and every beam of light or burst of sound pulls it briefly toward waking. Seal the curtains, silence the notifications, and even an average mattress will serve you well. Comfort helps — darkness and quiet decide.
On insomnia, allow me to correct the record as well. It is not a condition caused only by physical health problems; anxiety, habits and irregular schedules cause at least as many sleepless nights as any illness. And the strange belief that insomniacs secretly sleep too much during the day is simply false — most get less rest in total, not more. What deserves everyone's attention is a quieter discovery: people cannot always recognise the symptoms of their own tiredness. The exhausted brain misreads its fatigue as restlessness, reaches for one more episode, one more scroll — and buries itself deeper in the very problem it cannot feel.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
(Bản variant thứ 4 của Sleep — options bộ Đề 03: Beds / Resting sufficiently.)
1. Đáp án: Blocking noise and light is the key. Bẫy: "beds are best" và "resting sufficiently is necessary" đều được nhắc rồi hạ ("neither of these").
2. Đáp án: People can't always recognize the symptoms of tiredness. Bẫy: "only physical health problems" và "sleep too much" đều bị bác.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker's view on insomnia in general?
options: Insomnia is caused only by physical health problems
Most people with insomnia actually sleep too much
People can't always recognize the symptoms of tiredness

questions.prompt: What does she say about working at home?
options: Video calls are superior to face-to-face conversation
questions.explanation:
Before I began working from home, I imagined paradise: no commute, no meetings that could have been emails, and above all, silence. I truly believed there would be no distractions once the chatting colleagues were gone. Reality re-educated me within a week. The distractions did not disappear; they changed uniform. The washing machine calls, the doorbell rings, the fridge whispers, and family members assume that being home means being available. As for video calls — useful, yes, but let nobody tell you they beat face-to-face conversation. Explaining a complicated problem through a frozen screen and a delayed microphone cured me of that idea permanently. So when friends ask for my honest verdict after a full year, I give them three words: not as expected. There are real advantages, but the dream and the reality live at different addresses.
Let me pass on what I have actually learned. First, forget the magazine photos — you do not need a big home office. My best work happens at a small desk in the corner of the bedroom. Second, do not believe anyone who says this lifestyle requires no self-motivation; with nobody watching, discipline is the entire game. And the biggest lesson: there is no universal answer. How well working from home goes depends on your situation and your personality. My neighbour thrives alone; I miss the noise of other humans. Learn which kind of worker you are — preferably before you sign anything.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
(Bản variant của Đề 02 bài 2.)
1. Đáp án: Not good as expected. Bẫy: "no distractions" ("changed uniform") và "video calls superior" ("cured me of that idea").
2. Đáp án: It depends on your situation and personality. Bẫy: "big home office" và "no self-motivation" đều bị phủ định.

title: Đề 64 - An island city vs a snowy old street

questions.prompt: Describe the two pictures.
Which place do you prefer to live in? Why?
Why do some people move to a new city?
There is too much information on the Internet
questions.explanation:
M: Have you read that piece about how the Internet has changed us? It's been on my mind all week.
W: Go on then. Though my first thought is always the same: there's simply far too much material sitting out there. Nobody could ever get through a fraction of it.
M: I'm not so sure about that, to be honest. You can't really have too much of it. It's just there, quietly waiting. Nothing is forcing you to open all of it.
W: Fair enough, but it does leave me feeling swamped before I've even started.
M: Well, here's what I would say. Digging out something decent takes proper technique. You have to know how to word a search, where to look, when to give up on a page.
W: Exactly, I agree with you there completely. Half the people in my office type in a whole sentence and then wonder why they get rubbish back.
M: Right. It's a skill like any other, and almost nobody sits down and teaches it.
W: Nobody teaches it at school either, which is odd.
M: Here's my bigger worry, though. I reckon all this has genuinely reshaped the way our minds work. We skim, we jump about, we never follow an argument through to the end any more.
W: I don't see it that way, I'm afraid. I'll accept that our habits have shifted, but our actual thinking? That's a huge leap. People were easily distracted long before any of this existed.
M: Hmm. I still think something has changed in here.
W: What I will say is that youngsters now have almost no tolerance for waiting. My nephew sighs if a video takes three seconds to load.
M: Oh, I completely agree with you on that one. I see it constantly at work. If a page doesn't open instantly, they've already given up and wandered off.
W: It's the on-demand culture, isn't it. Everything now, or not at all.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
Key: Quá nhiều thông tin trên mạng = Woman · Tìm thông tin cần kỹ năng = Both · Internet ảnh hưởng cách ta suy nghĩ = Man · Internet khiến giới trẻ kém kiên nhẫn = Both
1. There is too much information on the Internet → Woman: Nữ nêu "there's simply far too much material sitting out there". Nam phản đối rõ: "I'm not so sure about that, to be honest. You can't really have too much of it."
2. Finding information on the Internet requires skills → Both: Nam nêu "Digging out something decent takes proper technique." Nữ tán thành: "Exactly, I agree with you there completely."
3. The use of the Internet affects the way we think. → Man: Nam nêu "I reckon all this has genuinely reshaped the way our minds work." Nữ phản đối: "I don't see it that way, I'm afraid. I'll accept that our habits have shifted, but our actual thinking? That's a huge leap."
4. The Internet makes young people less patient. → Both: Nữ nêu "youngsters now have almost no tolerance for waiting". Nam tán thành: "Oh, I completely agree with you on that one."
👉 Mẹo: Bẫy nằm ở ý 3 — nữ nói "I'll accept that our habits have shifted" nghe như đồng ý, nhưng ngay sau đó bác bỏ kết luận ("but our actual thinking? That's a huge leap"), nên đáp án là Man chứ không phải Both.

questions.prompt: Describe the two pictures.
