Four people are talking about protecting the environment. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: I order a box of food online, and it's delivered to my house every week. I take out what I need and leave the empty box by the door, and the next time the delivery comes, the driver collects the old one. The boxes are made from environmentally friendly material, so they're very easy to recycle. In the past I used to drive to the supermarket three or four times a week, so I'm sure this change helps in some way.

Speaker B: Water is something we all waste without thinking, and I decided I wanted to use less of it at home. The easiest change I made was in the bathroom. I used to fill the bath almost every evening, but now I take a shower instead. A shower is much quicker, and it uses far less water than a bath does. Clean water takes a lot of energy to treat and to pump into our homes, so saving it protects the environment as well as my bills.

Speaker C: My electricity bill used to be very high, but I've changed the way I live, mainly because most of our power still comes from burning fuel. I turn off all the lights whenever I go out, even if I'm only away for a short time. I also unplug the wifi before I go to bed every night. You may think these are small changes, but you'd be surprised. Less electricity used in my house means less pollution somewhere else.

Speaker D: The supermarket is just around the corner, so I walk there every day. I also live close to my office, and that makes a real difference. I don't have to drive to work; I cycle there every day instead. Cars are the main source of dirty air in this city, and short journeys are the worst of all. Since I stopped using my car for these trips, I hardly ever fill up the tank.

questions.prompt: A woman is talking about activities at a hotel. Which outdoor activity is available in the afternoon?
questions.explanation: Good morning. There's a variety of activities on offer for you today. The swimming session runs from seven to nine a.m., but the pool closes at noon for cleaning. In the afternoon there are other activities as well. The city tour is already sold out, but the golf course is available for you to enjoy, and you can rent clubs at the front desk. The clubhouse opens at two p.m. Apart from that, there are dance classes in the studio all day.

questions.prompt: A woman is calling from a clinic. When is the new appointment?
questions.explanation: Hello, I'm calling from the clinic. Your appointment is on Monday, but the doctor will be at a conference that day, so I'm calling to change your appointment. Does Thursday the thirteenth sound OK for you? Please call me back as soon as possible.

questions.prompt: An estate agent is talking about a living room. What is not original?
questions.explanation: As you can see, the owners have tried to keep most of the Victorian features in this house, especially here in the living room. The windows are made of the original stained glass, which lets light and warmth into the room. The patterned furniture makes the room even more attractive, although it was actually made half a century after the house was built. And the sliding door has been kept exactly as it was for nearly two centuries.

title: Đề 61 - Your day, family & a famous place

questions.prompt: Tell me about your day.
Tell me about a member of your family.
Tell me about a famous place in your country.

title: Đề 37 - End of term project + Music show at the park

questions.prompt: Put the sentences in the correct order.
options: It must include relevant pictures along with your own text about the topic.
Your end-of-term project should focus on at least two of these.
Afterwards, your classmates will have the opportunity to ask questions, and you will respond to them.
You will then use these pictures and your written work to create a presentation.
It should last about five minutes.
Because it was free, nearly 5,000 people attended.
The singer performed for two hours, and everyone had great fun.
Although the staff had a busy day, they closed the shops early to watch the singer perform.
They came early and sat in nearby shops where they could see the performances.
The local authorities planned, sponsored and paid for everything.
questions.explanation:
--- GIẢI THÍCH ---
Dạng sắp xếp câu: tìm câu mở đầu (không trỏ ngược), rồi bám vào đại từ, từ chỉ định và từ nối để nối dần.

▸ End of term project — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "This term we have studied several chapters about local history." → câu cho sẵn.
  1. "Your end-of-term project should focus on at least two of these." → "these" trỏ về "several chapters" ở câu cho sẵn: dự án phải chọn ít nhất hai chương.
  2. "It must include relevant pictures along with your own text about the topic." → "It must include" nói tiếp yêu cầu của dự án vừa nêu.
  3. "You will then use these pictures and your written work to create a presentation." → "these pictures and your written work" nhắc lại tranh ảnh và bài viết ở câu trước.
  4. "It should last about five minutes." → "It should last" nói về bài thuyết trình vừa được nhắc.
  5. "Afterwards, your classmates will have the opportunity to ask questions, and you will respond to them." → "Afterwards" là sau khi thuyết trình xong: bạn cùng lớp đặt câu hỏi.

▸ Music show at the park — thứ tự đúng:
  0. "Last Saturday there was a music show in the park." → câu cho sẵn.
  1. "The local authorities planned, sponsored and paid for everything." → "everything" chỉ toàn bộ buổi diễn ở câu cho sẵn; chính quyền tài trợ hết.
  2. "Because it was free, nearly 5,000 people attended." → "Because it was free" là hệ quả của việc chính quyền trả tiền.
  3. "They came early and sat in nearby shops where they could see the performances." → "They" là 5.000 người vừa nhắc; họ đến sớm và ngồi trong các cửa hàng gần đó.
  4. "Although the staff had a busy day, they closed the shops early to watch the singer perform." → "the staff" là nhân viên của các cửa hàng ở câu trước.
  5. "The singer performed for two hours, and everyone had great fun." → Câu kết: ca sĩ biểu diễn 2 tiếng, mọi người đều vui.

questions.prompt: A man is talking to a shop assistant. Why does he want to exchange the jacket?
questions.explanation:
W: Good morning. Can I help you with anything?
M: Yes, I'd like to exchange this jacket, please.
W: Oh, is there a problem with it? Is it faulty?
M: No, there's nothing wrong with the jacket.
W: Is the colour wrong?
M: No, the colour is exactly right, and there isn't any other problem with it. It's just that the arms feel a little uncomfortable when I wear it. It's a bit too tight around the arms, so I'd like to exchange it for another size.
W: Oh, I see. No problem. I'll help you find another size.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The size is too tight.
• Vì sao đúng: Anh nói áo "a bit too tight around the arms" nên muốn đổi cỡ khác. Anh đã phủ nhận cả hai ý áo lỗi ("nothing wrong with the jacket") và sai màu ("the colour is exactly right").

questions.prompt: A man is talking about moving house. How many bedrooms does the new house have?
questions.explanation:
I've lived in my house for several years now, and I really like it because it's in a quiet area and quite close to my workplace. My old house has three bedrooms, which used to be enough when I lived alone. However, things have changed recently because I've got a child now. As you can imagine, we need more space for the family, so I started looking for a bigger place. After looking at several houses, I've finally found a new one. It's much more spacious and comfortable, and it has four bedrooms. I think it'll be much better for my family.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Four
• Vì sao đúng: Nhà mới "has four bedrooms". Ba phòng ngủ là nhà cũ.

questions.prompt: Two students are talking. Where will they have the meeting about the professor's presentation?
questions.explanation:
M: Where should we have the meeting about the professor's presentation?
M2: How about the common room?
M: Yeah, that sounds good.
M2: Wait a minute. The common room is usually quite noisy, especially at this time of day.
M: You're right. We need somewhere quieter.
M2: How about the meeting room?
M: Yes, that's a better idea. Let's have the meeting there.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In the meeting room
• Vì sao đúng: Phòng sinh hoạt chung bị loại vì ồn ("usually quite noisy"); cả hai chốt "the meeting room". Lớp học không được nhắc tới.

questions.prompt: A man is talking about his new job. How much is the bus fare?
questions.explanation:
Hey, I've got some good news. I've just started a new job, and I've decided to take the bus to work instead of driving. It's really convenient, and it's quite cheap as well. The bus fare is only twenty dollars, so I think it's a good way to save money. I'll probably take the bus every day from now on.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – $20
• Vì sao đúng: "The bus fare is only twenty dollars."

questions.prompt: A woman is asking a colleague about some work. Why can't the man finish the work today?
options: He doesn't have a colleague to work with.
He has to leave work early.
questions.explanation:
W: Are you able to finish the work today?
M: I'm afraid I can't.
W: Why not? Do you have another appointment?
M: No, that's not the reason. I'm just really busy today.
W: Are you short of someone to work with?
M: Right. One of my colleagues is absent today, so I have to do all the work by myself.
W: I see. That explains it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – He doesn't have a colleague to work with.
• Vì sao đúng: "One of my colleagues is absent today, so I have to do all the work by myself." Anh phủ nhận lý do có hẹn khác ("No, that's not the reason").

questions.prompt: Two college students are talking. When does the football match usually take place?
questions.explanation:
M: This is my first week here, so I don't know much about the timetable.
W: Lessons are from Monday to Friday, in the mornings.
M: What about Thursday afternoon?
W: That's for private study.
M: I really like playing football. Is there a football team?
W: Yes, and we've even won some cups. There's a football match every week.
M: Oh, when is it?
W: On Wednesday afternoon.
M: Don't we have to study then?
W: No, lessons finish at noon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – On Wednesday afternoon
• Vì sao đúng: Cô gái nói trận đấu diễn ra "On Wednesday afternoon". Chiều thứ Năm là giờ tự học; thứ Sáu chỉ học buổi sáng.

questions.prompt: Two friends are arranging to meet. When will they meet?
questions.explanation:
W: Hi, are you free to meet sometime this week?
M: I'm not sure. I'm really busy with work at the moment.
W: How about Wednesday?
M: I'm afraid I'm too busy with work that day.
W: OK. What about Thursday?
M: Thursday might work for me.
W: Actually, no. I'm not free on Thursday.
M: No problem. How about Friday?
W: Friday is fine for me.
M: Great. Let's meet at nine o'clock at the café in the square.
W: Sounds good. See you there.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – On Friday
• Vì sao đúng: Thứ Tư anh bận, thứ Năm cô bận; cả hai chốt "Friday is fine for me".

questions.prompt: A professor is talking to his student. What does he want the student to do?
questions.explanation:
M: I read your report and it was really interesting. I'd like you to talk about it in front of everyone.
W: Oh, thanks. But where?
M: At a conference next month.
W: Oh. My final exam is the month after, and my project for Dr Jones is due soon.
M: I understand, but it will be a great experience for you.
W: OK, but could you look over my presentation first?
M: Yes, I'd be glad to.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Speak at a conference
• Vì sao đúng: Giáo sư muốn sinh viên trình bày báo cáo "At a conference next month". Báo cáo cô đã viết xong rồi; cũng không ai nhắc tới nghiên cứu thêm.

questions.prompt: A man is asking a colleague about a report. When will the woman write the report?
questions.explanation:
M: Are you free to help me with the report this morning?
W: I'd love to, but I'm tied up with work until lunch.
M: Oh, I see. When do you think you can work on it?
W: I'll have some free time after lunch, so I'll sit down and write it then.
M: Will you be able to finish it today?
W: Yes. My husband gets home at five, and I want to have it finished before he walks through the door.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In the afternoon
• Vì sao đúng: Cô bận đến trưa và sẽ viết "after lunch", xong trước 5 giờ, tức là buổi chiều.

questions.prompt: A woman is calling her friend. How does she get to work?
options: She goes to work by train.
questions.explanation:
Hi there. I've just started my new job this week, and I'm really happy because the new school is really close to my house. It's in the next street, so every morning I walk to work. That wasn't possible when I worked at my old school, which was ten miles away from my house. I chose this job because the environment is great and it's near my house. Call me back and I'll tell you more about it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She walks to work.
• Vì sao đúng: Cô nói "every morning I walk to work". Trường cũ cách 10 dặm mới phải đi xe; tàu không được nhắc tới.

questions.prompt: A man is talking to his wife. Where will he meet her?
questions.explanation:
M: Hi, love. How's your day going? Are we still meeting later?
W: Yes, definitely. I've just got quite a lot to finish at work today.
M: No problem. What time do you think you'll be ready?
W: Probably around six.
M: That's fine. I'll take the car and come over to your office. We can go somewhere for dinner afterwards.
W: Perfect. I'll see you there.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At her office
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll take the car and come over to your office." Nhà hàng là chỗ đi ăn sau khi đã gặp nhau.

questions.prompt: A woman is leaving a message for her friend. What does she usually do in the evenings?
questions.explanation:
Hi Anna, it's Lily. I'm only doing a half day at school today, so I've got a lot of free time. Do you want to meet up? We could go to the park. I usually go for a walk there in the evenings, which is really nice now that the evenings are lighter. Call me back. Bye!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Walking
• Vì sao đúng: Lily nói "I usually go for a walk there in the evenings".

questions.prompt: Two colleagues are talking about their day. What time does the train leave?
questions.explanation:
M: So, what are you doing today?
W: I've got a meeting in the city this morning. What about you?
M: I'm going with you, aren't I? We've got the meeting together.
W: Oh, yes! I nearly forgot. What time are we leaving?
M: The train leaves at nine fifteen, so we'd better get to the station early.
W: Nine fifteen. Got it.
M: And don't forget the presentation. Have you finished it?
W: Yes, I finished writing it last night.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At 9.15
• Vì sao đúng: "The train leaves at nine fifteen."

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about visiting a museum. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: I really enjoyed visiting the museum, especially because I'm quite interested in science and technology. There were so many different exhibitions that I wanted to see, from history and culture to modern inventions. However, I didn't want to spend too much time on the sections that weren't really my thing. I just had a quick look at some of them before moving on to the science and technology exhibitions that I was particularly interested in. There was so much to see that I knew I couldn't explore everything carefully in one visit.

Speaker B: I really enjoy visiting exhibitions and museums, so I was looking forward to seeing this one. Unfortunately, I had some problems with the organisation. The biggest issue was the map and the signs around the museum. I tried to follow the directions on the map, but I couldn't work out where the main entrance was. At one point, I thought I had finally reached it, but I realised that I was actually at another entrance. I kept checking the map and asking people for directions, but it took me almost the whole day to work out where I was supposed to go. Apart from that, I found the exhibition quite interesting.

Speaker C: I actually had quite an interesting experience at the museum. I lost my ticket before I arrived, so I had to go online and book another one. Fortunately, the museum has a really convenient website and a smartphone app where visitors can buy tickets easily. I also enjoyed some of the interactive games inside the museum. It was quite crowded, and I did get a little confused about where to go at first, but I could easily check the information on my phone. So, although there were a few small problems, I thought the technology made the whole visit much more convenient.

Speaker D: I was really impressed by the museum because there was such a wide range of things to learn about. I discovered a lot about history, science and society, and the exhibitions were much more impressive than I had expected. There were quite a lot of visitors when I went, so some areas were a little crowded and I sometimes had to wait to see certain displays. However, I didn't find the crowds too annoying because there was still plenty of space to explore at my own pace. In fact, I enjoyed the experience so much that I'd definitely like to come back when I have more free time. I think there are still many things I haven't had a chance to see.

questions.prompt: Four people are talking about protecting the environment. Match each person to the correct information.
questions.explanation:
Speaker A: I often go to the store near my house when I need clothes or a few things for the home. Lately, I've been choosing second-hand things more often because I think it's better for the environment. You're giving things another life instead of buying something new and eventually sending the old one to landfill. And when I have clothes or shoes that I don't use any more, I don't just throw them away. I usually put them in a bag and donate them, so someone else can use them. It just makes more sense to me.

Speaker B: What I don't really understand is why people throw away perfectly good plastic bottles and containers. I mean, those things can still be useful. I usually wash out the jars and bottles and keep them at home. I use the small ones for sauces or snacks, and the bigger containers are great for storing rice, leftovers or even fish in the freezer. It's just an easy way to reuse things instead of putting them straight in the bin. People at work often talk about buying second-hand clothes, but that's not really my thing. When it comes to plastic, though, I really hate throwing it away.

Speaker C: To be honest, I don't really have much time to think about how I can help the environment. I've got three children and a full-time job, and most days I'm just exhausted. So I don't do anything complicated, like washing jars or recycling everything at home. The one thing I do manage to do is buy environmentally friendly food. When I'm on my way home from work, I usually stop at the shop and choose the greener option, even if it costs a little more. It's a small thing, but at least it's something I can do.

Speaker D: Well, for me, it started with money, really. I do most of my shopping at the big supermarket because it's cheaper. I'm not really into buying all those cleaning products from the shop, especially when they can be quite expensive. So I stopped buying them altogether. I just use a lemon and a bit of salt to clean the floor, and it costs almost nothing. I walk to work as well, but that's not really because I'm trying to help the environment. My office is just really close to my house.
